FILE: scripts/check-contrast.mjs
================================================
import {readFileSync} from "node:fs";
import {fileURLToPath} from "node:url";
import {contrastRatio, parseColor, rgbToHex} from "./lib/color.mjs";

const TOKENS_PATH = fileURLToPath(new URL("../src/styles/tokens.css", import.meta.url));

// Every text color meets WCAG AAA (7:1) on the surfaces it sits on, in the light theme and in the dark one. The SDG
// badges keep the UN's own colors, which no text color reaches 7:1 on, so their numbers stay at AA in a fixed ink or
// paper; the goal's name beside the badge carries the same meaning.
export const CONTRAST_PAIRS = [
    ["fg", ["bg", "surface", "surface-raised"], 7],
    ["fg-muted", ["bg", "surface", "surface-raised"], 7],
    ["fg-subtle", ["bg", "surface", "surface-raised"], 7],
    ["primary", ["bg", "surface", "surface-raised"], 7],
    ["accent", ["bg", "surface"], 7],
    ["on-primary", ["primary", "primary-hover"], 7],
    ["danger", ["bg", "surface"], 7],
    ["success", ["bg", "surface"], 7],
    ["warning", ["bg", "surface"], 7],
    ["border-strong", ["bg", "surface", "surface-raised"], 3],
    ["ring", ["bg", "surface"], 3],
    ["on-whatsapp", ["whatsapp"], 3],
    // A project tile carries its name and its few words on its own layer of color.
    ...["sky", "mint", "peach", "lilac", "butter", "rose", "sage", "stone"].flatMap((tile) => [["fg", [`tile-${tile}`], 7], ["fg-muted", [`tile-${tile}`], 7]]),
    ...["education", "web", "backend", "crm", "data", "devops", "security"].map((line) => [`viz-${line}`, ["bg", "surface"], 3]),
    ...[1, 2, 3, 4].map((level) => [`level-${level}`, ["bg", "surface"], 2]),
    ["bg", ["level-2", "level-3", "level-4"], 4.5],
    ["fg", ["level-1"], 4.5],
    ...[4, 8, 13, 16].map((goal) => ["paper", [`sdg-${goal}`], 4.5]),
    ...[2, 9, 11].map((goal) => ["ink", [`sdg-${goal}`], 4.5]),
];

export const THEMES = ["light", "dark"];

/** A token written as light-dark(light, dark) resolves to one half per theme; any other value serves both. */
const pick = (value, theme) => {
    const match = value.match(/^light-dark\(\s*(.+?)\s*,\s*(.+)\s*\)$/);
    return match ? match[theme === "dark" ? 2 : 1].trim() : value;
};

export function readTokens(css = readFileSync(TOKENS_PATH, "utf8"), theme = "light") {
    const declarations = new Map();
    for (const match of css.matchAll(/--color-([\w-]+):\s*([^;]+);/g)) {
        if (match[1] !== "*") declarations.set(match[1], match[2].trim());
    }
    const resolve = (name, depth = 0) => {
        const value = declarations.get(name);
        if (value === undefined) throw new Error(`Unknown token: ${name}`);
        const alias = value.match(/^var\(--color-([\w-]+)\)$/);
        if (alias && depth < 10) return resolve(alias[1], depth + 1);
        return pick(value, theme);
    };
    return Object.fromEntries([...declarations.keys()].map((name) => [name, resolve(name)]));
}

export function checkContrast(css = readFileSync(TOKENS_PATH, "utf8")) {
    const results = [];
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
        const tokens = readTokens(css, theme);
        for (const [foreground, backgrounds, minimum] of CONTRAST_PAIRS) {
            for (const background of backgrounds) {
                const ratio = contrastRatio(tokens[foreground], tokens[background]);
                results.push({theme, foreground, background, minimum, ratio, pass: ratio >= minimum, tokens});
            }
        }
    }
    return results;
}

if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
    const results = checkContrast();
    console.table(
        results.map(({theme, foreground, background, minimum, ratio, pass, tokens}) => ({
            pair: `${theme}: ${foreground} / ${background}`,
            colors: `${rgbToHex(parseColor(tokens[foreground]))} / ${rgbToHex(parseColor(tokens[background]))}`,
            ratio: ratio.toFixed(2),
            minimum,
            result: pass ? "pass" : "FAIL",
        })),
    );
    const failures = results.filter((result) => !result.pass);
    if (failures.length > 0) {
        console.error(`${failures.length} contrast pair(s) below the minimum`);
        process.exit(1);
    }
}

FILE: scripts/check-links.mjs
================================================
// Checks every external link the site shows: the URLs in the content modules plus the repository links the
// archive builds. Sites behind bot protection answer scripts with 401, 403, 429 or 999; those count as
// unverifiable, not broken, and are worth opening by hand. Exits with 1 when a link is broken.
import {readdirSync} from "node:fs";
import {fileURLToPath} from "node:url";
import {createServer} from "vite";

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("..", import.meta.url));
const SITE = new URL(process.env.SITE_URL ?? "https://sebastianlopezo.page").host;
const UNVERIFIABLE = new Set([401, 403, 429, 999]);
const PER_HOST = 2;
const TIMEOUT = 15_000;
const HEADERS = {
    "user-agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/141.0 Safari/537.36",
    accept: "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,image/*,*/*;q=0.8",
};

const collect = (value, found, seen = new Set()) => {
    if (typeof value === "string") {
        for (const [url] of value.matchAll(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>)]+/g)) found.add(url.split("#")[0]);
        return;
    }
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || seen.has(value)) return;
    seen.add(value);
    for (const item of Array.isArray(value) ? value : Object.values(value)) collect(item, found, seen);
};

const loadUrls = async () => {
    const vite = await createServer({
        root,
        logLevel: "error",
        appType: "custom",
        server: {middlewareMode: true, hmr: false}
    });
    try {
        const found = new Set();
        const modules = readdirSync(`${root}src/content`, {recursive: true})
            .map((file) => file.replaceAll("\\", "/"))
            .filter((file) => file.endsWith(".ts") && !file.endsWith(".test.ts"));
        for (const file of modules) collect(await vite.ssrLoadModule(`/src/content/${file}`), found);
        const {archive, archiveUrl} = await vite.ssrLoadModule("/src/content/shared/archive.ts");
        for (const entry of archive) found.add(archiveUrl(entry));
        return [...found].filter((url) => new URL(url).host !== SITE).sort();
    } finally {
        await vite.close();
    }
};

const check = async (url, attempt = 1) => {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(url, {redirect: "follow", headers: HEADERS, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT)});
        await response.body?.cancel();
        if (response.ok) return {url, status: response.status, verdict: "ok"};
        return {url, status: response.status, verdict: UNVERIFIABLE.has(response.status) ? "unverifiable" : "broken"};
    } catch (error) {
        if (attempt < 2) return check(url, attempt + 1);
        return {
            url,
            status: error.name === "TimeoutError" ? "timeout" : (error.cause?.code ?? error.message),
            verdict: "broken"
        };
    }
};

// A few requests at a time per host, so no site sees a burst from one run.
const checkAll = async (urls) => {
    const byHost = Map.groupBy(urls, (url) => new URL(url).host);
    const results = [];
    await Promise.all([...byHost.values()].map(async (queue) => {
        const workers = Array.from({length: Math.min(PER_HOST, queue.length)}, async () => {
            for (let url = queue.shift(); url; url = queue.shift()) results.push(await check(url));
        });
        await Promise.all(workers);
    }));
    return results.sort((a, b) => a.url.localeCompare(b.url));
};

const urls = await loadUrls();
console.log(`Checking ${urls.length} external links…`);
const results = await checkAll(urls);
for (const verdict of ["broken", "unverifiable"]) {
    const list = results.filter((result) => result.verdict === verdict);
    if (list.length === 0) continue;
    console.log(`\n${verdict === "broken" ? "Broken" : "Unverifiable (open by hand)"}:`);
    for (const {url, status} of list) console.log(`  ${status}  ${url}`);
}
const count = (verdict) => results.filter((result) => result.verdict === verdict).length;
console.log(`\n${results.length} links: ${count("ok")} ok, ${count("unverifiable")} unverifiable, ${count("broken")} broken`);
process.exitCode = count("broken") > 0 ? 1 : 0;

const inlineSvg = async (file, className) => {
    const key = `${className}:${file}`;
    if (!svgCache.has(key)) {
        const raw = await readFile(`${root}public${file}`, "utf8");
        svgCache.set(
            key,
            raw
                .replace(/<style>[\s\S]*?<\/style>\s*/, "")
                .replace("<svg ", `<svg class="${className}" `),
        );
    }
    return svgCache.get(key);
};

const artTile = async ({file, tile}) => `<div class="tile" style="background:var(--tile-${tile})">${await inlineSvg(file, "illustration")}</div>`;

    viewport: {width: 1200, height: 630},
    colorScheme: "dark",
    reducedMotion: "reduce",
});

for (const [name, copy] of Object.entries(variants)) {
    if (filters.length > 0 && !filters.some((filter) => name.includes(filter))) continue;
    const html = Object.entries({aside: heroBoard, ...copy, fonts: pathToFileURL(`${root}node_modules`).href}).reduce(
        (result, [key, value]) => result.replaceAll(`{{${key}}}`, value),
        template,
    );
    const file = `${root}scripts/og/.render-${name}.html`;
    await writeFile(file, html);
    try {
        await page.goto(pathToFileURL(file).href);
        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
        const png = await page.screenshot({type: "png"});
        const output = /^(en|es)$/.test(name) ? `public/og/og-${name}.jpg` : `public/og/${name}.jpg`;
        await sharp(png).jpeg({quality: 84, mozjpeg: true}).toFile(`${root}${output}`);
        console.log(output);
    } finally {
        await rm(file, {force: true});
    }
}

await browser.close();

if (filters.length === 0) {
    const icon = await readFile(`${root}public/icon.svg`);
    await sharp(icon).resize(180, 180).png().toFile(`${root}public/apple-touch-icon.png`);
    console.log("public/apple-touch-icon.png");

// @vitest-environment node
import {readFileSync} from "node:fs";
import {describe, expect, it} from "vitest";
import {SNAPSHOT, trimStats} from "./github-stats.ts";

// The committed snapshot shaped back into the profile repository's stats.json, with fields the portfolio does not read.
const snapshot = JSON.parse(readFileSync(SNAPSHOT, "utf8"));
const {generatedAt, wakatime, ...github} = snapshot;
const remote = () => structuredClone({
    generatedAt,
    github: {...github, calendar: [{date: "2026-10-15", count: 3}]},
    wakatime: {...wakatime, dailyAverage: 3600},
});

describe("trimStats", () => {
    it("keeps what the snapshot holds, in its order, and drops the rest", () => {
        expect(JSON.stringify(trimStats(remote()))).toBe(JSON.stringify(snapshot));
    });

    it("rejects figures that changed shape, so the committed snapshot stays", () => {
        const shortWeek = remote();
        shortWeek.github.weekdays.pop();
        expect(() => trimStats(shortWeek)).toThrow(/weekdays/);

        const textCount = remote();
        (textCount.github.totals as Record<string, unknown>).commits = "28541";
        expect(() => trimStats(textCount)).toThrow(/commits/);
    });

    it("reads stats from before WakaTime reported editors", () => {
        const withoutEditors = remote();
        delete (withoutEditors.wakatime as Partial<typeof wakatime>).editors;
        expect(trimStats(withoutEditors).wakatime.editors).toEqual([]);
    });
});



================================================
FILE: scripts/github-stats.ts
================================================
import {readFile, writeFile} from "node:fs/promises";
import {fileURLToPath} from "node:url";
import {z} from "zod";

/**
 * The profile repository regenerates metrics/stats.json every day with the owner's token, so private contributions
 * count. The portfolio keeps a trimmed copy in src/content/shared/github-stats.json: `pnpm metrics` refreshes it, and
 * CI builds (and the Docker image) refresh it before building, so every deploy shows the latest figures.
 */
export const STATS_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SebastianLopezO/SebastianLopezO/main/metrics/stats.json";
export const SNAPSHOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../src/content/shared/github-stats.json", import.meta.url));

const count = z.number().int().nonnegative();
const day = z.iso.date();
const span = z.object({days: count, from: day, to: day});
const duration = z.object({name: z.string().min(1), seconds: z.number().nonnegative()});

/**
 * The parts of the profile repository's stats.json the portfolio reads, in the order the snapshot keeps them. The
 * file comes from another repository, so a renamed, missing or mistyped field fails the refresh and the committed
 * snapshot stays, instead of the site showing NaN. Keys not listed here are dropped.
 */
const RawStats = z.object({
    generatedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
    github: z.object({
        since: day,
        totals: z.object({
            contributions: count,
            commits: count.min(1),
            pullRequests: count,
            reviews: count,
            issues: count,
            repositoriesCreated: count,
            activeDays: count,
            days: count,
        }),
        years: z.array(z.object({
            year: z.number().int().min(2000),
            contributions: count,
            commits: count,
            pullRequests: count,
            reviews: count,
            activeDays: count,
            days: count,
        })).min(1),
        streaks: z.object({longest: span, current: span}),
        bestDay: z.object({date: day, contributions: count}),
        weekdays: z.array(count).length(7),
        repositories: z.object({owned: count, contributedTo: count, private: count}),
        organizations: z.object({member: count, contributedTo: count}),
        languagesByCommits: z.array(z.object({
            name: z.string().min(1),
            commits: count,
            share: z.number().min(0).max(100)
        })),
    }),
    wakatime: z.object({
        totalSeconds: z.number().positive(),
        languages: z.array(duration),
        editors: z.array(duration).default([]),
    }),
});

export function trimStats(raw: unknown) {
    const {generatedAt, github, wakatime} = RawStats.parse(raw);
    return {generatedAt, ...github, wakatime};
}

/** Downloads the latest figures; on any failure the committed snapshot stays as it is. */
export async function refreshGithubStats({timeout = 8000} = {}) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(STATS_URL, {signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeout)});
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
        const next = trimStats(await response.json());
        const current = JSON.parse(await readFile(SNAPSHOT, "utf8"));
        if (next.generatedAt < current.generatedAt) throw new Error(`remote stats (${next.generatedAt}) are older than the snapshot`);
        await writeFile(SNAPSHOT, `${JSON.stringify(next, null, 2)}\n`);
        console.log(`GitHub stats from ${next.generatedAt}`);
    } catch (error) {
        const reason = error instanceof z.ZodError ? z.prettifyError(error) : (error as Error).message;
        console.warn(`Keeping the committed GitHub stats: ${reason}`);
    }
}

if (process.argv[1] && fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === process.argv[1]) await refreshGithubStats();

import {appendFileSync, readFileSync} from "node:fs";

const dir = process.argv[2] ?? ".lighthouseci/production";
const title = process.argv[3] ?? "Lighthouse (mobile)";
const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/manifest.json`, "utf8"));
const score = (value) => (value === undefined ? "–" : Math.round(value * 100));
const rows = manifest.filter((run) => run.isRepresentativeRun).map(({url, summary, jsonPath}) => {
    const audits = JSON.parse(readFileSync(jsonPath, "utf8")).audits;
    const metric = (id) => audits[id]?.displayValue ?? "–";
    return `| ${new URL(url).pathname}${new URL(url).search} | ${score(summary.performance)} | ${score(summary.accessibility)} | ${score(summary["best-practices"])} | ${score(summary.seo)} | ${metric("first-contentful-paint")} | ${metric("largest-contentful-paint")} | ${metric("total-blocking-time")} | ${metric("cumulative-layout-shift")} |`;
});
const table = [
    "| Page | Performance | Accessibility | Best practices | SEO | FCP | LCP | TBT | CLS |",
    "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|",
    ...rows,
].join("\n");
console.log(table);
if (process.env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, `## ${title}\n\n${table}\n`);

// @vitest-environment node
import {describe, expect, it} from "vitest";
import {buildLlmsTxt, decodeEntities} from "./llms.ts";

const site = "https://example.com";
const profile = {
    name: "Ana Pérez",
    email: "ana@example.com",
    github: "https://github.com/ana",
    linkedin: "https://linkedin.com/in/ana"
};
const page = (path: string, title: string) => ({path, title, description: `About ${title}.`});
const pages = [
    page("/en", "Ana"),
    page("/es", "Ana en español"),
    page("/en/backend", "Backend"),
    page("/en/projects", "Projects"),
    page("/en/projects/shop", "Shop"),
    page("/en/certifications/css", "CSS"),
    page("/en/experience/acme", "Acme"),
];
const text = buildLlmsTxt({
    site,
    pages,
    profile,
    resumes: ["Ana-ATS-ES.pdf", "Ana-ATS-EN.pdf", "Ana-ATS-Long-EN.pdf", "notes.txt"]
});

describe("buildLlmsTxt", () => {
    it("opens with the name and the home page's description", () => {
        expect(text.startsWith("# Ana Pérez\n\n> About Ana.\n")).toBe(true);
    });

    it("lists the English pages by section and leaves the Spanish ones out", () => {
        expect(text).toContain("## Profile\n\n- [Ana](https://example.com/en): About Ana.\n- [Backend](https://example.com/en/backend): About Backend.\n");
        expect(text).toContain("## Projects and case studies\n\n- [Projects](https://example.com/en/projects): About Projects.\n- [Shop]");
        expect(text).toContain("## Experience\n\n- [Acme](https://example.com/en/experience/acme)");
        expect(text).not.toContain("https://example.com/es");
        expect(text).not.toContain("## Education");
    });

    it("links the resumes and the contact, and leaves the certifications for last as optional", () => {
        expect(text).toContain("- [Resume, English (PDF)](https://example.com/cv/Ana-ATS-EN.pdf)\n- [Resume, Spanish (PDF)](https://example.com/cv/Ana-ATS-ES.pdf)\n- [Long resume, English (PDF)]");
        expect(text).not.toContain("notes.txt");
        expect(text).toContain("- [Email](mailto:ana@example.com)");
        expect(text.trimEnd().endsWith("## Optional\n\n- [CSS](https://example.com/en/certifications/css): About CSS.")).toBe(true);
    });
});

describe("decodeEntities", () => {
    it("turns the head's HTML escapes back into text", () => {
        expect(decodeEntities("Backend &amp; Integration &#x27;Dev&#x27; &lt;3 &quot;x&quot;")).toBe("Backend & Integration 'Dev' <3 \"x\"");
    });
});

FILE: scripts/llms.ts
================================================
/**
 * llms.txt (llmstxt.org), the map of the site that language models read. It is built from the title and description
 * each page already carries, so it says nothing the pages do not, and lists the English pages; each has a Spanish twin
 * under /es.
 */
export interface LlmsPage {
    path: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;
}

export interface LlmsProfile {
    name: string;
    email: string;
    github: string;
    linkedin: string;
}

const SECTIONS = [
    {heading: "Profile", match: /^\/en(?:\/(?:about|backend|crm|data|devops|fullstack))?$/},
    {heading: "Projects and case studies", match: /^\/en\/projects(?:\/|$)/},
    {heading: "Experience", match: /^\/en\/experience(?:\/|$)/},
    {heading: "Education", match: /^\/en\/education(?:\/|$)/},
    {heading: "Technical skills", match: /^\/en\/skills(?:\/|$)/},
    {heading: "GitHub organizations", match: /^\/en\/organizations(?:\/|$)/},
    {heading: "Services", match: /^\/en\/services(?:\/|$)/},
    {heading: "Reasons to hire", match: /^\/en\/reasons(?:\/|$)/},
    {heading: "GitHub metrics", match: /^\/en\/metrics$/},
];
// The certifications are many and secondary, so they go under "Optional", the section a reader may skip.
const OPTIONAL = /^\/en\/certifications(?:\/|$)/;

const ENTITIES: Record<string, string> = {
    "&amp;": "&",
    "&quot;": '"',
    "&#x27;": "'",
    "&#39;": "'",
    "&lt;": "<",
    "&gt;": ">"
};

/** Titles and descriptions come from the page heads, escaped for HTML; llms.txt is plain Markdown. */
export const decodeEntities = (text: string) => text.replace(/&(?:amp|quot|#x27|#39|lt|gt);/g, (entity) => ENTITIES[entity]);

const RESUME = /-ATS-(Long-)?(EN|ES)\.pdf$/;

const resumeLabel = (file: string) => {
    const [, long, lang] = file.match(RESUME)!;
    return `${long ? "Long resume" : "Resume"}, ${lang === "EN" ? "English" : "Spanish"} (PDF)`;
};

export function buildLlmsTxt({site, pages, profile, resumes}: {
    site: string;
    pages: LlmsPage[];
    profile: LlmsProfile;
    resumes: string[];
}) {
    const home = pages.find((page) => page.path === "/en");
    if (!home) throw new Error("llms.txt needs the English home page");
    const links = (match: RegExp) =>
        pages.filter((page) => match.test(page.path)).map(({
                                                               path,
                                                               title,
                                                               description
                                                           }) => `- [${title}](${site}${path}): ${description}`);
    const section = (heading: string, lines: string[]) => (lines.length ? [`## ${heading}`, "", ...lines, ""] : []);
    return [
        `# ${profile.name}`,
        "",
        `> ${home.description}`,
        "",
        "Every page listed here also exists in Spanish, at the same address with /es in place of /en.",
        "",
        ...SECTIONS.flatMap(({heading, match}) => section(heading, links(match))),
        ...section("Resumes", resumes.filter((file) => RESUME.test(file)).sort().map((file) => `- [${resumeLabel(file)}](${site}/cv/${file})`)),
        ...section("Contact", [`- [Email](mailto:${profile.email})`, `- [LinkedIn](${profile.linkedin})`, `- [GitHub](${profile.github})`]),
        ...section("Optional", links(OPTIONAL)),
    ].join("\n");
}

// @vitest-environment node
import {describe, expect, it} from "vitest";
import {datePages, pageText} from "./page-dates.ts";

const head = '<title data-head="title">Projects · Sebastián</title>\n<meta data-head="description" name="description" content="What I built.">';

describe("pageText", () => {
    it("keeps the title, the description and the visible text, without markup, scripts or styles", () => {
        const html = '<main><h1 class="a">Projects</h1><style>.a{color:red}</style><p>Built   with\n<b>FastAPI</b></p><script>var x = 1</script></main>';
        expect(pageText(head, html)).toBe("Projects · Sebastián\nWhat I built.\nProjects Built with FastAPI");
    });

    it("ignores changes that only touch markup", () => {
        expect(pageText(head, '<p class="mt-4">Same words</p>')).toBe(pageText(head, '<div><span>Same</span> words</div>'));
    });

    it("reads the same words the same however the renderer escaped them", () => {
        expect(pageText(head, "<p>I&#x27;m &quot;here&quot; &amp; there</p>")).toBe(pageText(head, `<p>I'm "here" &amp; there</p>`));
        expect(pageText(head, '<div class="xl:[&amp;&gt;:first-child]:mt-0">Text</div>')).toBe(pageText(head, '<div class="xl:[&amp;>:first-child]:mt-0">Text</div>'));
    });
});

describe("datePages", () => {
    const texts = new Map([["/en", "Hello"], ["/es", "Hola"], ["/en/projects", "New page"]]);
    const first = datePages(texts, {}, "2026-10-01");

    it("dates every page by the build when the live site has no dates", () => {
        expect(Object.values(first).map(({date}) => date)).toEqual(["2026-10-01", "2026-10-01", "2026-10-01"]);
    });

    it("keeps the date of a page whose text did not change and moves the others to the build", () => {
        const next = datePages(new Map([...texts, ["/es", "Hola de nuevo"]]), first, "2026-10-19");
        expect(next["/en"]).toEqual(first["/en"]);
        expect(next["/es"].date).toBe("2026-10-19");
        expect(next["/es"].hash).not.toBe(first["/es"].hash);
    });
});

FILE: scripts/page-dates.ts
================================================
import {createHash} from "node:crypto";
import {z} from "zod";
import {decodeEntities} from "./llms.ts";

/**
 * The sitemap's lastmod says when a page last changed what it says, not when the site was built. Each build hashes a
 * page's title, description and visible text and compares the hash with page-dates.json on the live site: a page that
 * says the same keeps its date, and any other takes the build date. Without the live file (the first deploy, no
 * network, another host) every page takes the build date.
 */
export const PAGE_DATES = "page-dates.json";

const PageDates = z.record(z.string(), z.object({hash: z.string().min(1), date: z.iso.date()}));
export type PageDates = z.infer<typeof PageDates>;

const firstMatch = (html: string, pattern: RegExp) => html.match(pattern)?.[1] ?? "";

/** A page's title and description as its head carries them, HTML entities included. */
export const headMeta = (head: string) => ({
    title: firstMatch(head, /<title[^>]*>([^<]*)<\/title>/),
    description: firstMatch(head, /<meta[^>]*name="description"[^>]*content="([^"]*)"/),
});

const ESCAPES: Record<string, string> = {"&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#x27;"};

/**
 * The visible text escaped the way React writes it, which is how the live dates were hashed: Solid escapes only the
 * characters it must (an apostrophe stays one), so without this the move to Solid would redate every page whose words
 * did not change.
 */
const escapeLikeReact = (text: string) => decodeEntities(text).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ESCAPES[character]);

/** A tag, read past the quoted values: Solid leaves a ">" in an attribute as it is, such as xl:[&>:first-child]:mt-0. */
const TAG = /<(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^>"'])+>/g;

/** What a reader and a crawler get from a page: markup, scripts and styles left out. */
export const pageText = (head: string, html: string) => {
    const {title, description} = headMeta(head);
    return [title, description, escapeLikeReact(html.replace(/<(script|style)\b[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/g, " ").replace(TAG, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim())].join("\n");
};

export async function fetchPageDates(url: string, {timeout = 8000} = {}): Promise<PageDates> {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(url, {signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeout)});
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
        return PageDates.parse(await response.json());
    } catch (error) {
        const reason = error instanceof z.ZodError ? z.prettifyError(error) : (error as Error).message;
        console.warn(`Dating every page by this build (${url}: ${reason})`);
        return {};
    }
}

export const datePages = (texts: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, live: PageDates, today: string): PageDates =>
    Object.fromEntries([...texts].map(([path, text]) => {
        const hash = createHash("sha256").update(text).digest("base64url");
        const before = live[path];
        return [path, {hash, date: before?.hash === hash ? before.date : today}];
    }));

import {readdir, readFile, rm, writeFile} from "node:fs/promises";
import {dirname, extname, join} from "node:path";
import {promisify} from "node:util";
import {brotliCompress, constants, gzipSync} from "node:zlib";
import {fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL} from "node:url";
import {buildLlmsTxt, decodeEntities, type LlmsPage, type LlmsProfile} from "./llms.ts";
import {datePages, fetchPageDates, headMeta, PAGE_DATES, pageText} from "./page-dates.ts";

interface BuildData {
    prerenderRoutes: { path: string; lang: string }[];
    buildSitemap: (lastmod: (path: string) => string) => string;
    buildRobots: () => string;
    SITE_URL: string;
    profile: LlmsProfile;
}

// Astro has written every page (src/pages); what is built from all of them together comes here: the dates the sitemap
// gives each page, the sitemap, robots.txt and llms.txt, the root's language redirect and the precompressed copies.
const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const dist = join(root, "dist");
const data: BuildData = await import(pathToFileURL(join(root, "dist-ssr", "build-data.js")).href);

/** The head and what the root renders: the text a page carries, as the dates and llms.txt read it. */
const parts = (html: string) => {
    const head = html.slice(html.indexOf("<head>"), html.indexOf("</head>"));
    const body = html.slice(html.indexOf('<div id="root"'), html.lastIndexOf("</body>"));
    return {head, body};
};

const check = (path: string, html: string) => {
    const required = [
        /<title data-head="title">[^<]+<\/title>/,
        /<link data-head="canonical" rel="canonical" href="https?:\/\/[^"]+">/,
        /hreflang="x-default"/,
        /<script data-head="jsonld" type="application\/ld\+json">\{/,
        /<div id="root"[^>]*><[a-z]/,
    ];
    for (const pattern of required) {
        if (!pattern.test(html)) throw new Error(`Generated ${path} is missing ${pattern}`);
    }
    if ((html.match(/rel="alternate" hreflang=/g) ?? []).length !== 3) throw new Error(`Generated ${path} needs 3 hreflang links`);
};

const texts = new Map<string, string>();
const described: LlmsPage[] = [];
for (const route of data.prerenderRoutes) {
    const html = await readFile(join(dist, route.path.slice(1), "index.html"), "utf8");
    check(route.path, html);
    const {head, body} = parts(html);
    texts.set(route.path, pageText(head, body));
    const {title, description} = headMeta(head);
    described.push({path: route.path, title: decodeEntities(title), description: decodeEntities(description)});
}
const dates = datePages(texts, await fetchPageDates(`${data.SITE_URL}/${PAGE_DATES}`), process.env.BUILD_DATE ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
await writeFile(join(dist, PAGE_DATES), `${JSON.stringify(dates)}\n`);

await writeFile(
    join(dist, "index.html"),
    [
        "<!doctype html>",
        '<html lang="en">',
        "<head>",
        '    <meta charset="UTF-8">',
        "    <title>Sebastián López Osorno</title>",
        '    <meta name="robots" content="noindex">',
        `    <link rel="canonical" href="${data.SITE_URL}/en">`,
        // Relative targets so the root resolves them against wherever this file is served: "/" on the main domain, or
        // the repository's subpath on GitHub Pages (e.g. /MyPortfolio-SOLID/en).
        '    <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=en">',
        '    <script>location.replace((navigator.language || "").toLowerCase().startsWith("es") ? "es" : "en")</script>',
        "</head>",
        '<body><a href="en" hreflang="en">English</a> · <a href="es" hreflang="es">Español</a></body>',
        "</html>",
        "",
    ].join("\n"),
);
await writeFile(join(dist, "sitemap.xml"), data.buildSitemap((path) => dates[path].date));
await writeFile(join(dist, "robots.txt"), data.buildRobots());
await writeFile(join(dist, "llms.txt"), buildLlmsTxt({
    site: data.SITE_URL,
    pages: described,
    profile: data.profile,
    resumes: await readdir(join(dist, "cv")),
}));
await rm(join(root, "dist-ssr"), {recursive: true, force: true});

// Every text file gets a .gz for nginx's gzip_static and a .br for brotli_static (Dockerfile), at the highest level of
// each: the work happens once per build, and Brotli is about a quarter smaller than gzip on the pages. The Brotli
// compressions run in parallel on libuv's thread pool.
const COMPRESSIBLE = new Set([".html", ".js", ".css", ".svg", ".xml", ".txt", ".json", ".webmanifest"]);
const brotli = promisify(brotliCompress);
const compress = async (file: string) => {
    const data = await readFile(file);
    if (data.length < 1024) return false;
    const gzip = gzipSync(data, {level: 9});
    if (gzip.length >= data.length) return false;
    const br = await brotli(data, {
        params: {
            [constants.BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY]: constants.BROTLI_MAX_QUALITY,
            [constants.BROTLI_PARAM_SIZE_HINT]: data.length
        },
    });
    await writeFile(`${file}.gz`, gzip);
    if (br.length < gzip.length) await writeFile(`${file}.br`, br);
    return true;
};
const textFiles = (await readdir(dist, {recursive: true, withFileTypes: true}))
    .filter((entry) => entry.isFile() && COMPRESSIBLE.has(extname(entry.name)))
    .map((entry) => join(entry.parentPath, entry.name));
const compressed = (await Promise.all(textFiles.map(compress))).filter(Boolean).length;

console.log(`Dated ${data.prerenderRoutes.length} pages and precompressed ${compressed} files`);

import {readdir} from "node:fs/promises";
import {fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL} from "node:url";
import {chromium} from "@playwright/test";
import sharp from "sharp";

// Captures the recreated screens of private projects (assets-src/mockups/*.html) and the boards that lay out the real
// outputs of public ones (assets-src/boards/*.html) as sources for `pnpm images`.
// Usage: pnpm mockups [name ...] renders every screen, or only the ones named.
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("..", import.meta.url));
const folders = [`${root}assets-src/mockups/`, `${root}assets-src/boards/`];
const only = process.argv.slice(2);

const browser = await chromium.launch();
// 1440x714 CSS pixels at a 4/3 scale give a 1920px-wide source, the size of the real screenshots.
const page = await browser.newPage({viewport: {width: 1440, height: 714}, deviceScaleFactor: 4 / 3});

for (const folder of folders) for (const file of (await readdir(folder)).filter((name) => name.endsWith(".html")).sort()) {
    const name = file.replace(/\.html$/, "");
    if (only.length > 0 && !only.includes(name)) continue;
    await page.goto(pathToFileURL(`${folder}${file}`).href);
    await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
    const png = await page.screenshot({type: "png"});
    await sharp(png).webp({quality: 92}).toFile(`${root}assets-src/projects/${name}.webp`);
    console.log(`assets-src/projects/${name}.webp`);
}

await browser.close();

    if (!data) throw new Error(`Unknown icon ${prefix}:${name}`);
    const width = data.width ?? set.width ?? 24;
    const height = data.height ?? set.height ?? 24;
    return `<svg class="iconify" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}">${data.body}</svg>`;
};

const markdown = new MarkdownIt({html: true}).use(deflist);
const styles = await readFile(join(source, "style.css"), "utf8");

const documentFor = (body, title, lang) => `<!doctype html>
<html lang="${lang}">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>${title}</title>
<style>
@page { size: Letter; margin: 11mm 12mm 11mm 12mm; }
html, body { margin: 0; }
h2, dt { break-after: avoid; }
li, dl { break-inside: avoid; }
${styles}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="resume-preview"><div data-scope="vue-smart-pages" data-part="page">${body}</div></div>
</body>
</html>`;

// The first page of each PDF becomes its preview through poppler (pdftoppm, pdfinfo). Where poppler is not
// installed, as on most Windows machines, the same commands run in a throwaway Debian container.
const POPPLER_IMAGE = "debian:bookworm-slim";
const hasPoppler = () => run("pdfinfo", ["-v"]).then(() => true, () => false);

const popplerInDocker = async (commands) => {
    const script = ["apt-get update -qq", "apt-get install -y -qq poppler-utils > /dev/null", ...commands].join(" && ");
    const {stdout} = await run("docker", ["run", "--rm", "-v", `${output}:/cv`, POPPLER_IMAGE, "sh", "-c", script], {maxBuffer: 1 << 24});
    return stdout;
};

await mkdir(previews, {recursive: true});
const browser = await chromium.launch();
const page = await browser.newPage();

for (const resume of resumes) {
    const text = await readFile(join(source, resume.file), "utf8");
    const body = markdown
        .render(text)
        .replace(/<span class="iconify" data-icon="([\w-]+):([\w-]+)"><\/span>/g, icon)
        .replace(/<\/dd>\s*<dt>/g, "</dd>\n</dl>\n<dl>\n<dt>");
    const lang = resume.file.includes("-ES") ? "es" : "en";
    await page.setContent(documentFor(body, resume.title, lang), {waitUntil: "load"});
    await page.pdf({
        path: join(output, resume.pdf),
        format: "Letter",
        scale: 0.9,
        printBackground: true,
        preferCSSPageSize: true
    });
}

await browser.close();

const pages = {};
if (await hasPoppler()) {
    for (const resume of resumes) {
        const pdf = join(output, resume.pdf);
        await run("pdftoppm", ["-png", "-r", "150", "-f", "1", "-l", "1", "-singlefile", pdf, join(previews, resume.preview)]);
        pages[resume.pdf] = (await run("pdfinfo", [pdf])).stdout.match(/Pages:\s+(\d+)/)?.[1];
    }
} else {
    console.log(`poppler is not installed; running it in ${POPPLER_IMAGE} with Docker…`);
    const stdout = await popplerInDocker(resumes.flatMap(({pdf, preview}) => [
        `pdftoppm -png -r 150 -f 1 -l 1 -singlefile '/cv/${pdf}' '/cv/previews/${preview}'`,
        `printf '%s %s\\n' '${pdf}' "$(pdfinfo '/cv/${pdf}' | sed -n 's/^Pages: *//p')"`,
    ]));
    for (const line of stdout.trim().split("\n")) {
        const [pdf, count] = line.trim().split(" ");
        pages[pdf] = count;
    }
}

for (const resume of resumes) {
    const png = join(previews, `${resume.preview}.png`);
    await writeVariants(png, join(previews, resume.preview), [480, 960]);
    await rm(png);
    console.log(`${resume.pdf}: ${pages[resume.pdf]} page(s)`);
}

FILE: scripts/serve-dist.mjs

import {createReadStream, existsSync, statSync} from "node:fs";
import {createServer} from "node:http";
import {extname, join, normalize, resolve} from "node:path";

const root = resolve(process.argv[2] ?? "dist");
const port = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 4173);
const host = process.env.HOST ?? "127.0.0.1";

const TYPES = {
    ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
    ".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
    ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8",
    ".json": "application/json",
    ".xml": "application/xml",
    ".txt": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
    ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
    ".png": "image/png",
    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
    ".webp": "image/webp",
    ".avif": "image/avif",
    ".ico": "image/x-icon",
    ".woff2": "font/woff2",
    ".woff": "font/woff",
    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
};

const isFile = (path) => existsSync(path) && statSync(path).isFile();

const cacheControl = (pathname, file) => {
    if (pathname.startsWith("/assets/")) return "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";
    if (file.endsWith(".html")) return "no-cache";
    return "public, max-age=3600";
};

const send = (request, response, file, status = 200) => {
    const gzip = `${file}.gz`;
    const compressed = /\bgzip\b/.test(request.headers["accept-encoding"] ?? "") && isFile(gzip);
    response.writeHead(status, {
        "Content-Type": TYPES[extname(file)] ?? "application/octet-stream",
        "Cache-Control": cacheControl(new URL(request.url, "http://localhost").pathname, file),
        Vary: "Accept-Encoding",
        // As nginx says: the role view and the lock in the query change nothing in a page.
        ...(file.endsWith(".html") && {"No-Vary-Search": 'params=("from" "locked")'}),
        ...(compressed && {"Content-Encoding": "gzip"}),
    });
    if (request.method === "HEAD") return response.end();
    createReadStream(compressed ? gzip : file).pipe(response);
};

const server = createServer((request, response) => {
    const url = new URL(request.url, "http://localhost");
    const {pathname, search} = url;

    if (pathname === "/health") {
        response.writeHead(200, {"Content-Type": "application/json"});
        return response.end('{"status":"UP"}');
    }

    if (pathname === "/") {
        const lang = /^es\b/i.test(request.headers["accept-language"] ?? "") ? "es" : "en";
        response.writeHead(302, {Location: `/${lang}${search}`});
        return response.end();
    }

    if (pathname.length > 1 && pathname.endsWith("/")) {
        response.writeHead(301, {Location: `${pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "")}${search}`});
        return response.end();
    }

    // One address per page: the file behind it moves to the page, and the not-found page is not found by its name.
    const file = /^(\/.*?)\/?index\.html$/.exec(pathname);
    if (file) {
        response.writeHead(301, {Location: `${file[1]}${search}`});
        return response.end();
    }
    if (pathname === "/404.html") return send(request, response, join(root, "404.html"), 404);

    const target = normalize(join(root, decodeURIComponent(pathname)));
    if (!target.startsWith(root)) {
        response.writeHead(400);
        return response.end();
    }

    for (const candidate of [target, join(target, "index.html")]) {
        if (isFile(candidate)) return send(request, response, candidate);
    }
    return send(request, response, join(root, "404.html"), 404);
});

server.listen(port, host, () => console.log(`Serving ${root} on http://${host}:${port}`));

/*
 * The hero's board: the portrait sits whole in a square socket at the middle, and cables run from it to six of the
 * devices of the work (the CRM, its snapshots, the monitoring, a planter, a funnel and the bulk tools). It says what the
 * work is, connecting systems, before a word is read. The page lays the portrait over the socket (HERO.socket) and a
 * link over each device (HERO.spots), which names the project the device stands for and opens its page.
 */
import {cable, group, PALETTE as P, plug, slab} from "./kit.mjs";
import {SCENES} from "./scenes.mjs";

const WIDTH = 800;
const HEIGHT = 800;

/*
 * The socket is a square plate as wide as the room between the devices allows, so the photo, which is square, shows
 * whole and as large as it can. The portrait goes in its face, 14 units in from each edge, with corners that follow
 * the plate's.
 */
const PLATE = {x: 200, y: 190, size: 400, radius: 64};
const INSET = 14;

/** Where the portrait goes, in the board's units; the hero places the photo with these as percentages. */
export const SOCKET = {
    x: PLATE.x + INSET,
    y: PLATE.y + INSET,
    width: PLATE.size - INSET * 2,
    height: PLATE.size - INSET * 2,
    radius: PLATE.radius - INSET,
};

/*
 * The devices, in reading order: [the project, where it sits, its scale, the box the drawn device fills on the board].
 * The box is the device's measured outline with a little room around it (x, y, width, height); it is what the page's
 * link covers, so it moves with the device when a device moves or is redrawn.
 */
const DEVICES = [
    ["crmWidgets", 10, 10, 0.5, [41, 34, 140, 158]],
    ["observability", 590, 20, 0.5, [615, 58, 150, 128]],
    ["martech", -6, 300, 0.42, [15, 326, 127, 133]],
    ["zohoToolkit", 636, 300, 0.42, [653, 327, 134, 120]],
    ["crmSnapshots", 20, 560, 0.5, [40, 601, 165, 115]],
    ["smartpot", 580, 566, 0.5, [611, 583, 167, 160]],
];

const place = (id, x, y, scale) => group(SCENES[id](), {transform: `translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${scale})`});

/*
 * The cables, in the devices' order: [the plug on the socket's edge (x, y), the curve to the device, color]. Each one
 * leaves a side of the plate and ends under its device, which is drawn over it.
 */
const LINKS = [
    [[200, 268], "M200 268C150 268 150 205 122 176", P.orange],
    [[600, 260], "M600 260C652 260 652 192 682 160", P.mint],
    [[200, 398], "M200 398C160 398 128 390 92 400", P.pink],
    [[600, 408], "M600 408C648 408 690 396 716 400", P.butter],
    [[200, 528], "M200 528C152 532 156 598 140 640", P.lilac],
    [[600, 520], "M600 520C648 524 646 598 660 640", P.cobalt],
];

const percent = (value, total) => Number((value / total * 100).toFixed(2));

export const HERO = {
    width: WIDTH,
    height: HEIGHT,
    socket: SOCKET,
    /** The socket as percentages of the board, its corners as a percentage of its own width. */
    portrait: {
        left: percent(SOCKET.x, WIDTH),
        top: percent(SOCKET.y, HEIGHT),
        width: percent(SOCKET.width, WIDTH),
        height: percent(SOCKET.height, HEIGHT),
        radius: percent(SOCKET.radius, SOCKET.width),
    },
    /** Each device's box as percentages of the board, the way the page lays a link over it. */
    spots: DEVICES.map(([id, , , , [x, y, width, height]]) => ({
        id,
        left: percent(x, WIDTH),
        top: percent(y, HEIGHT),
        width: percent(width, WIDTH),
        height: percent(height, HEIGHT),
    })),
    body: () => group([
        ...LINKS.map(([, d, color]) => cable(d, color, {width: 8})),
        ...DEVICES.map(([id, x, y, scale]) => place(id, x, y, scale)),
        slab(PLATE.x, PLATE.y, PLATE.size, PLATE.size, {r: PLATE.radius, depth: 20, color: P.alu}),
        ...LINKS.map(([[x, y], , color]) => plug(x, y, color, {w: 22, h: 28, rotate: x < WIDTH / 2 ? 90 : -90})),
    ]),
};

FILE: scripts/illustrations/kit.mjs
================================================
/*
 * The drawing kit of the site's illustrations: soft hardware seen from above, slightly tilted toward the reader.
 * Every object is a few flat layers (a side that gives it thickness, a top face, a sheen and a bevel) over a blurred
 * contact shadow, so the pieces read as one family of small devices. The backgrounds are transparent: the page lays
 * each illustration on a tile of its own color (tokens.css, --color-tile-*), light or dark.
 */

export const PALETTE = {
    alu: "#f3f3f0",
    bone: "#e9e7e1",
    graphite: "#34373c",
    ink: "#15161a",
    orange: "#ff6b2c",
    cobalt: "#3a5cff",
    mint: "#2fc79a",
    butter: "#ffcd45",
    pink: "#ff8db0",
    sky: "#5bb8ff",
    red: "#ff5148",
    lilac: "#9c86ff",
    lime: "#b6e83a",
    leaf: "#43b866",
    soil: "#6e5442",
    paper: "#fbfaf6",
};

const hexToRgb = (hex) => [1, 3, 5].map((index) => parseInt(hex.slice(index, index + 2), 16));
const rgbToHex = (rgb) => `#${rgb.map((value) => Math.round(Math.min(255, Math.max(0, value))).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("")}`;

export const mix = (hex, target, amount) => {
    const a = hexToRgb(hex);
    const b = hexToRgb(target);
    return rgbToHex(a.map((value, index) => value + (b[index] - value) * amount));
};
export const lighten = (hex, amount) => mix(hex, "#ffffff", amount);
export const darken = (hex, amount) => mix(hex, "#000000", amount);
const luminance = (hex) => {
    const [r, g, b] = hexToRgb(hex);
    return (0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b) / 255;
};

const n = (value) => Number(value.toFixed(1));
const attrs = (object) => Object.entries(object)
    .filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== false)
    .map(([key, value]) => `${key}="${typeof value === "number" ? n(value) : value}"`)
    .join(" ");
export const el = (tag, attributes, children = "") =>
    children ? `<${tag} ${attrs(attributes)}>${children}</${tag}>` : `<${tag} ${attrs(attributes)}/>`;
export const group = (children, attributes = {}) => el("g", attributes, [children].flat(Infinity).filter(Boolean).join(""));

/** Shared definitions: the sheen over every top face, the glare of glass and the blur of the contact shadows. */
export const defs = () => `<defs>
<linearGradient id="sheen" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity=".5"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity=".06"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity=".07"/></linearGradient>
<radialGradient id="glass" cx=".32" cy=".28" r=".75"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity=".6"/><stop offset=".4" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
<filter id="soft" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="9"/></filter>
<filter id="glow" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3"/></filter>
</defs>`;

const SHADOW = "#0d1120";

/** A rounded plate with thickness: the workhorse of the kit. */
export function slab(x, y, w, h, {r = 22, depth = 12, color = PALETTE.alu, shadow = true, bevel = true, rotate} = {}) {
    const bright = luminance(color) > 0.55;
    const parts = [
        shadow && el("rect", {
            x: x + 6,
            y: y + depth + 10,
            width: w - 12,
            height: h,
            rx: r,
            fill: SHADOW,
            opacity: 0.2,
            filter: "url(#soft)"
        }),
        depth > 0 && el("rect", {
            x,
            y: y + depth,
            width: w,
            height: h,
            rx: r,
            fill: darken(color, bright ? 0.17 : 0.3)
        }),
        el("rect", {x, y, width: w, height: h, rx: r, fill: color}),
        el("rect", {x, y, width: w, height: h, rx: r, fill: "url(#sheen)"}),
        bevel && el("rect", {
            x: x + 1,
            y: y + 1,
            width: w - 2,
            height: h - 2,
            rx: Math.max(0, r - 1),
            fill: "none",
            stroke: "#fff",
            "stroke-opacity": bright ? 0.7 : 0.16,
            "stroke-width": 1.5,
        }),
    ];
    return group(parts, rotate ? {transform: `rotate(${rotate} ${n(x + w / 2)} ${n(y + h / 2)})`} : {});
}

/** A round plate with thickness: knobs, coins, planters, dials. */
export function disc(cx, cy, r, {depth = 10, color = PALETTE.alu, shadow = true, bevel = true} = {}) {
    const bright = luminance(color) > 0.55;
    return group([
        shadow && el("circle", {cx, cy: cy + depth + 9, r: r * 0.94, fill: SHADOW, opacity: 0.2, filter: "url(#soft)"}),
        depth > 0 && el("circle", {cx, cy: cy + depth, r, fill: darken(color, bright ? 0.17 : 0.3)}),
        el("circle", {cx, cy, r, fill: color}),
        el("circle", {cx, cy, r, fill: "url(#sheen)"}),
        bevel && el("circle", {
            cx,
            cy,
            r: r - 1,
            fill: "none",
            stroke: "#fff",
            "stroke-opacity": bright ? 0.7 : 0.16,
            "stroke-width": 1.5
        }),
    ]);
}

/** A recess cut into a face: wells, slots, screens set into a body. */
export function well(x, y, w, h, {r = 12, color = PALETTE.ink} = {}) {
    return group([
        el("rect", {x, y, width: w, height: h, rx: r, fill: color}),
        el("rect", {
            x: x + 1,
            y: y + 1,
            width: w - 2,
            height: h - 2,
            rx: Math.max(0, r - 1),
            fill: "none",
            stroke: "#000",
            "stroke-opacity": 0.18,
            "stroke-width": 2
        }),
    ]);
}

/** A camera lens: a dark barrel, a colored inner ring and the glare of the glass. */
export function lens(cx, cy, r, {ring = PALETTE.cobalt, body = PALETTE.ink} = {}) {
    return group([
        el("circle", {cx, cy, r: r + 6, fill: darken(PALETTE.alu, 0.12)}),
        el("circle", {cx, cy, r, fill: body}),
        el("circle", {cx, cy, r: r * 0.62, fill: mix(body, ring, 0.35)}),
        el("circle", {cx, cy, r: r * 0.36, fill: body}),
        el("circle", {cx, cy, r, fill: "url(#glass)"}),
        el("ellipse", {cx: cx - r * 0.3, cy: cy - r * 0.34, rx: r * 0.16, ry: r * 0.1, fill: "#fff", opacity: 0.75}),
    ]);
}

/** A screw head with its slot at an angle. */
export function screw(cx, cy, {r = 5, angle = 35} = {}) {
    const dx = Math.cos((angle * Math.PI) / 180) * r * 0.7;
    const dy = Math.sin((angle * Math.PI) / 180) * r * 0.7;
    return group([
        el("circle", {cx, cy, r, fill: "#dcdbd5", stroke: "#b8b6ae", "stroke-width": 1}),
        el("line", {
            x1: cx - dx,
            y1: cy - dy,
            x2: cx + dx,
            y2: cy + dy,
            stroke: "#8f8d86",
            "stroke-width": 1.6,
            "stroke-linecap": "round"
        }),
    ]);
}

/** A status light with its halo; the class lets a page animate it (pulse). */
export function led(cx, cy, color, {r = 4.5, pulse = false} = {}) {
    return group([
        el("circle", {cx, cy, r: r * 2.2, fill: color, opacity: 0.35, filter: "url(#glow)"}),
        el("circle", {cx, cy, r, fill: color, class: pulse ? "pulse" : undefined}),
        el("circle", {cx: cx - r * 0.3, cy: cy - r * 0.35, r: r * 0.35, fill: "#fff", opacity: 0.8}),
    ]);
}

/** A pill-shaped key with a little travel. */
export function key(x, y, w, h, color, {depth = 5} = {}) {
    return slab(x, y, w, h, {r: Math.min(w, h) / 2, depth, color, shadow: false});
}

/** Rows of round holes: a speaker or a vent. */
export function grill(x, y, cols, rows, {gap = 12, r = 2.6, color = "#000", opacity = 0.28} = {}) {
    const dots = [];
    for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
        for (let col = 0; col < cols; col++) dots.push(el("circle", {
            cx: x + col * gap,
            cy: y + row * gap,
            r,
            fill: color,
            opacity
        }));
    }
    return group(dots);
}

/** A thick cable that follows a path, with a darker under-stroke for depth. */
export function cable(d, color, {width = 9} = {}) {
    return group([
        el("path", {
            d,
            fill: "none",
            stroke: darken(color, 0.28),
            "stroke-width": width + 3,
            "stroke-linecap": "round",
            "stroke-linejoin": "round",
            transform: "translate(0 3)"
        }),
        el("path", {
            d,
            fill: "none",
            stroke: color,
            "stroke-width": width,
            "stroke-linecap": "round",
            "stroke-linejoin": "round"
        }),
        el("path", {
            d,
            fill: "none",
            stroke: "#fff",
            "stroke-opacity": 0.35,
            "stroke-width": width * 0.28,
            "stroke-linecap": "round",
            "stroke-linejoin": "round",
            transform: `translate(${-width * 0.15} ${-width * 0.2})`
        }),
    ]);
}

/** A plug at the end of a cable, seen from above. */
export function plug(cx, cy, color, {w = 26, h = 34, rotate = 0} = {}) {
    return group([
        slab(cx - w / 2, cy - h / 2, w, h, {r: 7, depth: 5, color, shadow: false}),
        el("rect", {x: cx - w * 0.22, y: cy - h / 2 + 5, width: w * 0.44, height: 4, rx: 2, fill: darken(color, 0.3)}),
    ], rotate ? {transform: `rotate(${rotate} ${cx} ${cy})`} : {});
}

/** Lines of text as soft bars, for papers and screens. */
export function textLines(x, y, widths, {gap = 13, h = 5, color = "#000", opacity = 0.16} = {}) {
    return group(widths.map((width, index) => el("rect", {
        x,
        y: y + index * gap,
        width,
        height: h,
        rx: h / 2,
        fill: color,
        opacity
    })));
}

/** A small bar chart on a screen. */
export function bars(x, y, heights, {w = 10, gap = 6, color = PALETTE.mint, base} = {}) {
    const bottom = base ?? y;
    return group(heights.map((height, index) => el("rect", {
        x: x + index * (w + gap),
        y: bottom - height,
        width: w,
        height,
        rx: 2.5,
        fill: color
    })));
}

/** The whole illustration: a square canvas with a transparent background. */
export function svg(title, body, {size = 400, width = size, height = size} = {}) {
    return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" width="${width}" height="${height}" role="img" aria-label="${title}">
<style>@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.pulse{animation:pulse 1.4s ease-in-out 3 both}.rise{animation:rise .9s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) both}.sweep{transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box;animation:sweep 2.4s cubic-bezier(.3,0,0,1) 1 both}}@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:.25}}@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}}@keyframes sweep{from{transform:rotate(-120deg)}}</style>
${defs()}
<g class="rise">${body}</g>
</svg>
`;
}

/*
 * The modules of the lab board (components/sections/SkillsSection.tsx): one object per group of tools. Most groups
 * borrow the object of the project that put those tools to work; databases, cloud and networks get objects of their own.
 */
import {cable, darken, disc, el, grill, group, led, lighten, PALETTE as P, slab, well} from "./kit.mjs";

/** A database: three stacked cylinders seen from the front, with a light on each band. */
const databases = () => {
    const parts = [el("ellipse", {
        cx: 200,
        cy: 318,
        rx: 104,
        ry: 26,
        fill: "#0d1120",
        opacity: 0.2,
        filter: "url(#soft)"
    })];
    for (let index = 2; index >= 0; index--) {
        const y = 118 + index * 62;
        const color = [P.cobalt, lighten(P.cobalt, 0.18), lighten(P.cobalt, 0.32)][index];
        parts.push(
            el("path", {d: `M100 ${y}v52a100 34 0 0 0 200 0v-52z`, fill: darken(color, 0.18)}),

/*
 * The objects of the pages beyond the projects, drawn with the same kit on the same 400 × 400 canvas: one per service,
 * per reason to hire me, per job, per program and per GitHub organization. A job is a badge on a lanyard, a program is
 * a book with what it led to on top, an organization is a cabinet of drawers with its label (and a padlock when its
 * code is private), a service or a reason is one object that says it. Each one has a flat glyph of its own, printed
 * on a face the way a logo is pressed into a device.
 */
import {
    bars,
    cable,
    darken,
    disc,
    el,
    group,
    key,
    led,
    lens,
    lighten,
    mix,
    PALETTE as P,
    plug,
    screw,

    well
} from "./kit.mjs";
import {check, leaf, pin, signal, stack} from "./scenes.mjs";

const luminance = (hex) => {
    const [r, g, b] = [1, 3, 5].map((index) => parseInt(hex.slice(index, index + 2), 16));
    return (0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b) / 255;
};

/** Any outline as a plate with thickness: the path's own shape, a darker side under it and the shared sheen. */
const plate = (d, color, {depth = 12, shadow = true, bevel = true, evenodd = false} = {}) => {
    const bright = luminance(color) > 0.55;
    return group([
        shadow && el("path", {
            d,
            fill: "#0d1120",
            opacity: 0.2,
            filter: "url(#soft)",
            transform: `translate(6 ${depth + 10})`
        }),
        depth > 0 && el("path", {d, fill: darken(color, bright ? 0.17 : 0.3), transform: `translate(0 ${depth})`}),
        el("path", {d, fill: color}),
        el("path", {d, fill: "url(#sheen)"}),
        bevel && el("path", {
            d,
            fill: "none",
            stroke: "#fff",
            "stroke-opacity": bright ? 0.6 : 0.16,
            "stroke-width": 1.5
        }),
    ], evenodd ? {"fill-rule": "evenodd"} : {});
};

/**
 * Flat glyphs in a 24-unit box centered on 0. A part is a filled shape unless it says stroke; `tone` paints a part in
 * another color than the glyph's, such as the vein of a leaf.

        tone: "#fff",

    globe: [{

/** A gear's outline: `teeth` flat teeth around a ring, the first one at `phase` radians. */
function gearPath(cx, cy, r, teeth, phase) {
    const inner = r * 0.78;
    const step = (Math.PI * 2) / teeth;
    const points = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < teeth; index++) {
        const angle = phase + index * step;
        points.push([angle - step * 0.26, inner], [angle - step * 0.15, r], [angle + step * 0.15, r], [angle + step * 0.26, inner]);
    }
    return `M${points.map(([angle, radius]) => `${(cx + radius * Math.cos(angle)).toFixed(1)} ${(cy + radius * Math.sin(angle)).toFixed(1)}`).join("L")}Z`;
}

const glyph = (name, cx, cy, size, color) => group(GLYPHS[name].map((part) => part.stroke
        ? el("path", {
            d: part.d,
            fill: "none",
            stroke: part.tone ?? color,
            "stroke-opacity": part.opacity,
            "stroke-width": part.width ?? 2.4,
            "stroke-linecap": "round",
            "stroke-linejoin": "round",
        })
        : el("path", {
            d: part.d,
            fill: part.tone ?? color,
            opacity: part.opacity,
            "fill-rule": part.evenodd ? "evenodd" : undefined
        })),
    {transform: `translate(${cx} ${cy}) scale(${(size / 24).toFixed(3)})`});

/** A round pin-back button with a glyph, worn on a badge or stuck on a cabinet. */
const button = (cx, cy, r, color, name, ink = "#fff") => group([
    disc(cx, cy, r, {color, depth: 7}),
    glyph(name, cx, cy, r * 1.05, ink),
]);

// ─── Services: one object each ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** A speech bubble: a rounded box with its tail at the bottom left or right. */
const bubble = (x, y, w, h, tail, color) => {
    const r = 26;
    const tx = tail === "left" ? x + 46 : x + w - 46;
    const tip = tail === "left" ? -22 : 22;
    const d = `M${x + r} ${y}h${w - 2 * r}a${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${r} ${r}v${h - 2 * r}a${r} ${r} 0 0 1-${r} ${r}`
        + (tail === "left"
            ? `H${tx + 16}l${tip} 26v-26H${x + r}`
            : `H${tx + 8}v26l${tip - 30}-26H${x + r}`)
        + `a${r} ${r} 0 0 1-${r}-${r}v-${h - 2 * r}a${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${r}-${r}z`;
    return plate(d, color, {depth: 10});
};

/** A gear plate with thickness and its hub. */
const gear = (cx, cy, r, teeth, color, phase = 0) => group([
    plate(gearPath(cx, cy, r, teeth, phase), color, {depth: 12}),
    disc(cx, cy, r * 0.42, {color: P.alu, depth: 5, shadow: false}),
    el("circle", {cx, cy, r: r * 0.16, fill: P.ink}),
]);

/** A donut chart: arcs of a ring, each a share of the whole. */
const donut = (cx, cy, r, shares, width = 18) => {
    const length = 2 * Math.PI * r;
    let offset = 0;
    return group(shares.map(([share, color]) => {
        const arc = el("circle", {
            cx, cy, r, fill: "none", stroke: color, "stroke-width": width,
            "stroke-dasharray": `${(share * length - 3).toFixed(1)} ${length.toFixed(1)}`,
            "stroke-dashoffset": (-offset * length).toFixed(1),
            transform: `rotate(-90 ${cx} ${cy})`,
        });
        offset += share;
        return arc;
    }));
};

/*
 * One object per project, drawn with the kit on a 400 × 400 canvas. Each one hints at what the project does without
 * picturing its screens: a hub with cables for the integrations, a camera that takes snapshots of the CRM, a planter
 * with a probe for SmartPot. They are representative, never literal.
 */
import {
    bars,
    cable,
    darken,
    disc,
    el,
    grill,
    group,
    key,
    led,
    lens,
    lighten,
    mix,
    PALETTE as P,
    plug,
    screw,
    slab,
    textLines,
    well,
} from "./kit.mjs";

/** A leaf from (x, y), pointing at the angle, with its midrib. */
export const leaf = (x, y, angle, scale = 1, color = P.leaf) => group([
    el("path", {d: "M0 0C18-24 56-30 84-6C56 10 22 12 0 0Z", fill: color}),
    el("path", {d: "M0 0C18-24 56-30 84-6C56 10 22 12 0 0Z", fill: "url(#sheen)"}),
    el("path", {
        d: "M4 -1C30-8 54-10 78-6",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "#fff",
        "stroke-opacity": 0.45,
        "stroke-width": 2,
        "stroke-linecap": "round"
    }),
], {transform: `translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${angle}) scale(${scale})`});

/** Concentric arcs that leave a point: a signal. */
export const signal = (x, y, color, {
    angle = -45,
    radii = [14, 26, 38]
} = {}) => group(radii.map((r, index) => el("path", {
    d: `M${-r * 0.7} ${-r * 0.7}A${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${r * 0.7} ${-r * 0.7}`,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: color,
    "stroke-width": 5,
    "stroke-linecap": "round",
    opacity: 1 - index * 0.25,
})), {transform: `translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${angle + 45})`});

/** A map pin. */
export const pin = (x, y, color) => group([
    el("ellipse", {cx: x, cy: y + 2, rx: 9, ry: 4, fill: "#000", opacity: 0.18}),
    el("path", {d: `M${x} ${y}c-10-14-18-22-18-32a18 18 0 0 1 36 0c0 10-8 18-18 32z`, fill: color}),
    el("circle", {cx: x, cy: y - 32, r: 7, fill: "#fff"}),
]);

/** A check mark. */
export const check = (x, y, size, color = "#fff") => el("path", {
    d: `M${x - size * 0.45} ${y}l${size * 0.3} ${size * 0.3} ${size * 0.6}-${size * 0.62}`,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: color,
    "stroke-width": size * 0.22,
    "stroke-linecap": "round",
    "stroke-linejoin": "round",
});

/** An envelope seen from the front. */
export const envelope = (x, y, w, h, {color = P.paper, rotate, stamp} = {}) => group([
    slab(x, y, w, h, {r: 12, depth: 7, color}),
    el("path", {
        d: `M${x + 10} ${y + 10}L${x + w / 2} ${y + h * 0.55}L${x + w - 10} ${y + 10}`,
        fill: "none",
        stroke: darken(color, 0.16),
        "stroke-width": 3,
        "stroke-linejoin": "round"
    }),
    stamp && el("rect", {x: x + w - 38, y: y + h - 34, width: 24, height: 20, rx: 4, fill: stamp}),
], rotate ? {transform: `rotate(${rotate} ${x + w / 2} ${y + h / 2})`} : {});

/** A hexagonal plate with thickness. */
export const hexagon = (cx, cy, r, color, depth = 9) => {
    const points = (oy) => Array.from({length: 6}, (_, index) => {
        const angle = (Math.PI / 3) * index + Math.PI / 6;
        return `${(cx + r * Math.cos(angle)).toFixed(1)},${(cy + oy + r * Math.sin(angle)).toFixed(1)}`;
    }).join(" ");
    return group([
        el("polygon", {points: points(depth + 9), fill: "#0d1120", opacity: 0.2, filter: "url(#soft)"}),
        el("polygon", {points: points(depth), fill: darken(color, 0.2), "stroke-linejoin": "round"}),
        el("polygon", {points: points(0), fill: color}),
        el("polygon", {points: points(0), fill: "url(#sheen)"}),
    ]);
};

/** A stack of discs: coins, a database, a funnel. */
export const stack = (cx, cy, r, count, color, {step = 12, depth = 8} = {}) => group(
    Array.from({length: count}, (_, index) => disc(cx, cy - index * step, r, {
        color: index % 2 ? lighten(color, 0.08) : color,
        depth,
        shadow: index === 0,
    })),
);

/** A database: a cylinder of three bands seen from the front. */
export const database = (cx, top, r, color, bands = 3) => {
    const ry = r * 0.36;
    const band = r * 0.62;
    const parts = [el("ellipse", {
        cx,
        cy: top + bands * band + ry + 12,
        rx: r * 0.9,
        ry: ry * 0.8,
        fill: "#0d1120",
        opacity: 0.22,
        filter: "url(#soft)"
    })];
    for (let index = bands - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
        const y = top + index * band;
        parts.push(
            el("path", {
                d: `M${cx - r} ${y}v${band - 6}a${r} ${ry} 0 0 0 ${2 * r} 0v-${band - 6}z`,
                fill: darken(color, 0.12 + index * 0.02)
            }),
            el("ellipse", {cx, cy: y, rx: r, ry, fill: index === 0 ? color : darken(color, 0.06)}),
            el("ellipse", {
                cx,
                cy: y,
                rx: r - 1,
                ry: ry - 1,
                fill: "none",
                stroke: "#fff",
                "stroke-opacity": 0.35,
                "stroke-width": 1.5
            }),
        );
    }
    parts.push(led(cx + r * 0.55, top + band * 0.55 + ry * 0.4, P.mint, {r: 3.5, pulse: true}));
    return group(parts);
};

const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

const linearToSrgb = (value) =>
    value <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 * value : 1.055 * Math.pow(value, 1 / 2.4) - 0.055;

const srgbToLinear = (value) =>
    value <= 0.04045 ? value / 12.92 : Math.pow((value + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);

export function oklchToLinearRgb(l, c, h) {
    const hue = (h * Math.PI) / 180;
    const a = c * Math.cos(hue);
    const b = c * Math.sin(hue);
    const l_ = l + 0.3963377774 * a + 0.2158037573 * b;
    const m_ = l - 0.1055613458 * a - 0.0638541728 * b;
    const s_ = l - 0.0894841775 * a - 1.291485548 * b;
    const lc = l_ ** 3;
    const mc = m_ ** 3;
    const sc = s_ ** 3;
    return [
        4.0767416621 * lc - 3.3077115913 * mc + 0.2309699292 * sc,
        -1.2684380046 * lc + 2.6097574011 * mc - 0.3413193965 * sc,
        -0.0041960863 * lc - 0.7034186147 * mc + 1.707614701 * sc,
    ];
}

export function oklchToRgb(l, c, h) {
    return oklchToLinearRgb(l, c, h).map((channel) => clamp(linearToSrgb(channel), 0, 1));
}

export function hexToRgb(hex) {
    const value = hex.replace("#", "");
    const full = value.length === 3 ? value.split("").map((part) => part + part).join("") : value;
    return [0, 2, 4].map((index) => parseInt(full.slice(index, index + 2), 16) / 255);
}

export function rgbToHex(rgb) {
    return `#${rgb.map((channel) => Math.round(channel * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("")}`;
}

export function rgbToOklch(rgb) {
    const [r, g, b] = rgb.map(srgbToLinear);
    const l = Math.cbrt(0.4122214708 * r + 0.5363325363 * g + 0.0514459929 * b);
    const m = Math.cbrt(0.2119034982 * r + 0.6806995451 * g + 0.1073969566 * b);
    const s = Math.cbrt(0.0883024619 * r + 0.2817188376 * g + 0.6299787005 * b);
    const lightness = 0.2104542553 * l + 0.793617785 * m - 0.0040720468 * s;
    const a = 1.9779984951 * l - 2.428592205 * m + 0.4505937099 * s;
    const bb = 0.0259040371 * l + 0.7827717662 * m - 0.808675766 * s;
    const chroma = Math.sqrt(a * a + bb * bb);
    const hue = ((Math.atan2(bb, a) * 180) / Math.PI + 360) % 360;
    return [lightness, chroma, hue];
}

export function parseColor(input) {
    const value = input.trim();
    if (value.startsWith("#")) return hexToRgb(value);
    const match = value.match(/^oklch\(\s*([\d.]+)(%?)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s*\)$/i);
    if (!match) throw new Error(`Unsupported color: ${input}`);
    const lightness = Number(match[1]) / (match[2] ? 100 : 1);
    return oklchToRgb(lightness, Number(match[3]), Number(match[4]));
}

export function relativeLuminance(rgb) {
    const [r, g, b] = rgb.map(srgbToLinear);
    return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b;
}

export function contrastRatio(foreground, background) {
    const a = relativeLuminance(parseColor(foreground));
    const b = relativeLuminance(parseColor(background));
    const [light, dark] = a > b ? [a, b] : [b, a];
    return (light + 0.05) / (dark + 0.05);
}

import {mkdir} from "node:fs/promises";
import {dirname} from "node:path";
import sharp from "sharp";

const withHeadroom = async (input, headroom) => {
    const {height} = await sharp(input).metadata();
    return sharp(input).extend({top: Math.round(height * headroom), extendWith: "copy"}).toBuffer();
};

export async function writeVariants(input, outputBase, widths, {crop, headroom} = {}) {
    await mkdir(dirname(outputBase), {recursive: true});
    const source = headroom ? await withHeadroom(input, headroom) : input;
    const results = [];
    for (const width of widths) {
        const pipeline = () => {
            const image = sharp(source);
            if (headroom) return image.resize(width, width, {fit: "cover", position: "top"});
            return crop ? image.resize(width, Math.round(width * crop), {
                fit: "cover",
                position: "top"
            }) : image.resize({width});
        };
        const avif = `${outputBase}-${width}.avif`;
        const webp = `${outputBase}-${width}.webp`;
        const [a, w] = await Promise.all([
            pipeline().avif({quality: 55, effort: 6}).toFile(avif),
            pipeline().webp({quality: 78, effort: 6}).toFile(webp),
        ]);
        results.push({width, avif: a.size, webp: w.size});
    }
    return results;
}

FILE: src/components/assistant/AssistantLauncher.tsx

import {createSignal, Show} from "solid-js";
import {Dynamic} from "solid-js/web";
import {MessageCircleQuestionMark} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {loadAssistantCopy, loadCaseStudyCopy, loadFullContent} from "@/content";
import {loadDetailCopy} from "@/content/detail-copy";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import type {Lang} from "@/types/content";

/** The panel's code and everything it answers from, requested together so opening it costs one round trip. */
const loadAssistant = (lang: Lang) =>
    Promise.all([
        import("@/components/assistant/AssistantPanel"),
        loadFullContent(lang),
        loadAssistantCopy(lang),
        loadCaseStudyCopy(lang),
        loadDetailCopy(lang),
    ]).then(([module, content, copy, cases, details]) => ({Panel: module.default, content, copy, cases, details}));

type Assistant = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof loadAssistant>>;

export function AssistantLauncher() {
    const {lang, content} = useLanguage();
    const [open, setOpen] = createSignal(false);
    const [assistant, setAssistant] = createSignal<Assistant>();
    let button: HTMLButtonElement | undefined;
    let request: Promise<Assistant> | undefined;
    const label = content.ui.actions.askAssistant;

    const prefetch = () => {
        request ??= loadAssistant(lang).catch((error: unknown) => {
            // A failed download (offline, a new deploy) may be retried on the next open.
            request = undefined;
            throw error;
        });
        return request;
    };

    const show = () => {
        setOpen(true);
        prefetch().then(setAssistant, () => setOpen(false));
    };

    const close = () => {
        setOpen(false);
        button?.focus();
    };

    return (
        <>
            <button
                ref={button}
                type="button"
                aria-label={label}
                title={label}
                aria-haspopup="dialog"
                aria-expanded={open()}
                onPointerEnter={() => void prefetch().catch(() => undefined)}
                onFocus={() => void prefetch().catch(() => undefined)}
                onClick={show}
                class="floating-action fixed right-3 bottom-3 z-40 grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-on-primary shadow-glow hover:scale-105 md:right-5 md:bottom-5 md:size-12"
            >
                <MessageCircleQuestionMark class="size-5 md:size-6"/>
            </button>
            <Show when={open() && assistant()}>
                {(loaded) => (
                    <Dynamic
                        component={loaded().Panel}
                        onClose={close}
                        content={loaded().content}
                        copy={loaded().copy}
                        cases={loaded().cases}
                        details={loaded().details}
                    />
                )}
            </Show>
        </>
    );
}
