FILE: src/components/assistant/AssistantPanel.tsx
================================================
import {createEffect, createMemo, createSignal, createUniqueId, For, Match, on, onMount, Show, Switch} from "solid-js";
import {ArrowUpRight, ChevronDown, Download, SendHorizontal, X} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {Input} from "@/components/ui/input";
import {createAssistant} from "@/lib/assistant/answer";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {parsePath} from "@/lib/paths";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";
import {useLocation} from "@/routes/router-context";
import type {Answer, AnswerLink, AssistantCopy} from "@/types/assistant";
import type {CaseStudyCopy, CaseStudyId} from "@/types/case-study";
import type {Content} from "@/types/content";
import type {DetailPagesCopy} from "@/types/detail";

interface Message {
    id: number;
    from: "user" | "assistant";
    text: string;
    answer?: Answer;
}

const MAX_LENGTH = 200;
/** Chips shown under the conversation; the rest of the questions live in the catalog. */
const MAX_SUGGESTIONS = 4;

const CHIP_CLASS =
    "min-h-9 rounded-full border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-left text-sm text-fg-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary hover:text-primary";

const LINK_CLASS =
    "inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm text-fg-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary hover:text-primary";

export interface AssistantPanelProps {
    onClose: () => void;
    content: Content;
    copy: AssistantCopy;
    cases: Record<CaseStudyId, CaseStudyCopy>;
    details: DetailPagesCopy;
}

export default function AssistantPanel(props: AssistantPanelProps) {
    const {role, locked, pathFor} = useRole();
    const location = useLocation();
    // The launcher loads the copy before it opens the panel, so it is fixed for the panel's life.
    // eslint-disable-next-line solid/reactivity
    const {content, copy, cases, details} = props;
    const ask = createAssistant(content, copy, cases, details);
    // Section links point at the profile page; away from it, they open the profile at that section.
    const onProfile = () => parsePath(location().pathname) !== null;
    const catalogId = createUniqueId();
    const [catalogOpen, setCatalogOpen] = createSignal(false);
    let dialog: HTMLDialogElement | undefined;
    let input: HTMLInputElement | undefined;
    let end: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
    let nextId = 1;
    const [query, setQuery] = createSignal("");
    const [messages, setMessages] = createSignal<Message[]>([{id: 0, from: "assistant", text: copy.welcome}]);

    onMount(() => {
        if (!dialog || dialog.open) return;
        dialog.showModal();
        if (window.matchMedia("(pointer: fine)").matches) input?.focus();
    });

    createEffect(on(messages, () => end?.scrollIntoView({block: "end"})));

    const close = () => dialog?.close();

    const send = (text: string) => {
        const question = text.trim().slice(0, MAX_LENGTH);
        if (!question) return;
        const answer = ask(question, {role: role(), locked: locked()});
        const id = nextId;
        nextId += 2;
        setMessages((current) => [
            ...current,
            {id, from: "user", text: question},
            {id: id + 1, from: "assistant", text: answer.text, answer},
        ]);
        setQuery("");
        setCatalogOpen(false);
    };

    const submit = (event: SubmitEvent) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        send(query());
    };

    const AnswerLinkView = (linkProps: { link: AnswerLink }) => (
        <Switch fallback={
            <Show when={onProfile()} fallback={
                <Link to={pathFor(role(), linkProps.link.href.slice(1))} onClick={close} class={LINK_CLASS}>
                    {linkProps.link.label}
                </Link>
            }>
                <a href={linkProps.link.href} onClick={close} class={LINK_CLASS}>
                    {linkProps.link.label}
                </a>
            </Show>
        }>
            <Match when={linkProps.link.kind === "route"}>
                <Link to={linkProps.link.href} onClick={close} class={LINK_CLASS}>
                    {linkProps.link.label}
                </Link>
            </Match>
            <Match when={linkProps.link.kind === "download"}>
                <a href={withBase(linkProps.link.href)} download="" class={LINK_CLASS}>
                    <Download class="size-4"/>
                    {linkProps.link.label}
                </a>
            </Match>
            <Match when={linkProps.link.kind === "external"}>
                <a href={linkProps.link.href} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class={LINK_CLASS}>
                    {linkProps.link.label}
                    <ArrowUpRight class="size-4"/>
                </a>
            </Match>
        </Switch>
    );

    const offered = createMemo(() => {
        const all = messages();
        const asked = new Set(all.filter((message) => message.from === "user").map((message) => message.text));
        const lastAnswer = [...all].reverse().find((message) => message.answer)?.answer;
        return [...(lastAnswer?.followUps ?? []), ...copy.suggestions[role() ?? "general"]]
            .filter((question, index, list) => !asked.has(question) && list.indexOf(question) === index)
            .slice(0, MAX_SUGGESTIONS);
    });

    return (
        <dialog
            ref={dialog}
            aria-labelledby="assistant-title"
            onClose={() => props.onClose()}
            onClick={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && close()}
            class="fixed inset-0 m-0 ml-auto h-dvh max-h-none w-full max-w-none border-border bg-surface p-0 text-fg shadow-card backdrop:bg-bg/70 sm:max-w-md sm:border-l"
        >
            <div class="flex h-full flex-col">
                <header class="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border px-5 py-4">
                    <div>
                        <h2 id="assistant-title" class="font-display text-title">{copy.title}</h2>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-fg-subtle">{copy.subtitle}</p>
                    </div>
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={close}
                        aria-label={copy.close}
                        class="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md text-fg-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised hover:text-fg"
                    >
                        <X class="size-5"/>
                    </button>
                </header>

                <div role="log" aria-live="polite" aria-labelledby="assistant-title"
                     class="flex-1 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain px-5 py-5">
                    <For each={messages()}>{(message) => (
                        <div
                            class={message.from === "user" ? "flex justify-end" : "flex justify-start"}>
                            <div
                                class={
                                    message.from === "user"
                                        ? "max-w-[85%] rounded-lg rounded-br-sm bg-primary px-4 py-2.5 text-on-primary"
                                        : "max-w-[92%] rounded-lg rounded-bl-sm border border-border bg-surface-raised px-4 py-3"
                                }
                            >
                                <p class="sr-only">{message.from === "user" ? copy.you : copy.assistant}:</p>
                                <p class="leading-relaxed">{message.text}</p>
                                <Show when={message.answer && message.answer.details.length > 0}>
                                    <ul class="mt-3 list-disc space-y-1.5 ps-5 text-sm text-fg-muted">
                                        <For each={message.answer!.details}>{(detail) => <li>{detail}</li>}</For>
                                    </ul>
                                </Show>
                                <Show when={message.answer && message.answer.links.length > 0}>
                                    <ul class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                        <For each={message.answer!.links}>{(link) => <li><AnswerLinkView link={link}/>
                                        </li>}</For>
                                    </ul>
                                </Show>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    )}</For>
                    <div ref={end}/>
                </div>

                <div class="border-t border-border px-5 pt-3">
                    {/* Every question the assistant knows, by topic; it opens above the suggestions and scrolls on its own. */}
                    <Show when={catalogOpen()}>
                        <div id={catalogId}
                             class="mb-3 max-h-[40dvh] space-y-4 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain border-b border-border pb-3">
                            <For each={copy.catalog.groups}>{(group) => (
                                <section aria-label={group.title}>
                                    <h3 class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{group.title}</h3>
                                    <ul class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                        <For each={group.questions}>{(question) => (
                                            <li>
                                                <button type="button" onClick={() => send(question)}
                                                        class={CHIP_CLASS}>
                                                    {question}
                                                </button>
                                            </li>
                                        )}</For>
                                    </ul>
                                </section>
                            )}</For>
                        </div>
                    </Show>
                    <div class="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <p id="assistant-suggestions"
                           class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">
                            {copy.suggestionsLabel}
                        </p>
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            aria-expanded={catalogOpen()}
                            aria-controls={catalogId}
                            onClick={() => setCatalogOpen((value) => !value)}
                            class="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover"
                        >
                            {catalogOpen() ? copy.catalog.close : copy.catalog.open}
                            <ChevronDown class={cn("size-4 transition-transform", catalogOpen() && "rotate-180")}/>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    {/* The questions wrap instead of scrolling sideways, so a phone never gets a horizontal scrollbar. */}
                    <ul aria-labelledby="assistant-suggestions" class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pb-1">
                        <For each={offered()}>{(suggestion) => (
                            <li>
                                <button type="button" onClick={() => send(suggestion)} class={CHIP_CLASS}>
                                    {suggestion}
                                </button>
                            </li>
                        )}</For>
                    </ul>
                </div>

                <form onSubmit={submit} class="flex gap-2 px-5 pt-3 pb-5">
                    <label for="assistant-input" class="sr-only">{copy.inputLabel}</label>
                    <Input
                        ref={input}
                        id="assistant-input"
                        value={query()}
                        onInput={(event) => setQuery(event.currentTarget.value)}
                        placeholder={copy.placeholder}
                        maxlength={MAX_LENGTH}
                        autocomplete="off"
                        enterkeyhint="send"
                    />
                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        aria-label={copy.send}
                        disabled={!query().trim()}
                        class="grid size-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-on-primary transition-colors hover:bg-primary-hover disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                        <SendHorizontal class="size-5"/>
                    </button>
                </form>
            </div>
        </dialog>
    );
}

import {For} from "solid-js";
import {formatNumber} from "@/content/shared/metrics";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import type {CaseFigureFacts} from "@/types/case-study";

const formatFigure = ({value, atLeast, unit}: CaseFigureFacts, locale: string) => {
    const number = formatNumber(value, locale);
    if (unit === "%") return locale.startsWith("es") ? `${number} %` : `${number}%`;
    return `${number}${atLeast ? "+" : ""}`;
};

interface CaseFiguresProps {
    figures: CaseFigureFacts[];
    labels: Record<string, string>;
    locale: string;
    compact?: boolean;
    class?: string;
}

export function CaseFigures(props: CaseFiguresProps) {
    return (
        <dl class={cn("grid grid-cols-2 gap-3", !props.compact && "sm:grid-cols-4", props.class)}>
            <For each={props.figures}>{(figure) => (
                <div
                    class={cn("flex flex-col-reverse rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface", props.compact ? "p-3" : "p-4")}>
                    <dt class="text-sm text-fg-muted">{props.labels[figure.id]}</dt>
                    <dd class={cn("font-display text-primary", props.compact ? "text-2xl" : "text-3xl")}>{formatFigure(figure, props.locale)}</dd>
                </div>
            )}</For>
        </dl>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/case-study/CaseImages.tsx
================================================
import {For, type JSX, Match, onCleanup, onMount, Show, Switch} from "solid-js";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {widestVariant} from "@/lib/image-widths";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import type {CaseImageFacts} from "@/types/case-study";

// The screens live in public/; each variant's URL carries the base so they load under a subpath too.
const srcSet = (image: CaseImageFacts, format: "avif" | "webp") =>
    image.widths.map((width) => `${withBase(`${image.base}-${width}.${format}`)} ${width}w`).join(", ");

/**
 * `bare` drops the frame (corners and outline) for a screen that fills the top of a card that already has one.
 * `eager` is for the screen a page opens with: it loads at once and ahead of the others.
 * `frameClass` styles the picture around the image, such as the motion that brings it into view (globals.css,
 * screen-unmask), kept off the image so it never competes with the image's own fade.
 *
 * A screen the reader reaches before it has arrived is marked data-loading, which holds its place with a soft pulse,
 * and data-loaded when it arrives, which fades it in (globals.css). One that arrives before it is reached simply shows,
 * one the page opens with is left alone, so the largest paint is never held back, and without this script a screen
 * appears as it loads.
 */
export function CaseImage(props: {
    image: CaseImageFacts;
    alt: string;
    sizes: string;
    eager?: boolean;
    bare?: boolean;
    class?: string;
    frameClass?: string;
}) {
    const fallback = () => withBase(`${props.image.base}-${props.image.widths[Math.min(1, props.image.widths.length - 1)]}.webp`);
    let img: HTMLImageElement | undefined;
    onMount(() => {
        const element = img;
        if (!element || props.eager || element.complete || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;
        const listening = new AbortController();
        const seen = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
            if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
            seen.disconnect();
            if (!element.complete) element.dataset.loading = "";
        });
        const settle = (event: Event) => {
            listening.abort();
            seen.disconnect();
            if (!("loading" in element.dataset)) return;
            delete element.dataset.loading;
            if (event.type === "load") element.dataset.loaded = "";
        };
        seen.observe(element);
        element.addEventListener("load", settle, {signal: listening.signal});
        element.addEventListener("error", settle, {signal: listening.signal});
        onCleanup(() => {
            listening.abort();
            seen.disconnect();
        });
    });
    return (
        <picture class={props.frameClass}>
            <source type="image/avif" srcset={srcSet(props.image, "avif")} sizes={props.sizes}/>
            <img
                ref={img}
                src={fallback()}
                srcset={srcSet(props.image, "webp")}
                sizes={props.sizes}
                alt={props.alt}
                width={props.image.width}
                height={props.image.height}
                loading={props.eager ? "eager" : "lazy"}
                fetchpriority={props.eager ? "high" : undefined}
                decoding="async"
                class={cn("h-auto w-full bg-surface", !props.bare && "rounded-lg border border-border", props.class)}
            />
        </picture>
    );
}

/** A screen of a project page paints in from its top edge as it comes into view (globals.css). */
export const UNMASK = "block screen-unmask";

/** What a screen needs under it: the attribution of its data, or the note that it is a recreation. */
function Caption(props: { image: CaseImageFacts; recreationLabel: string }) {
    return (
        <Show when={props.image.credit} fallback={
            <Show when={props.image.recreation}>
                <figcaption class="mt-1.5 text-xs text-fg-subtle">{props.recreationLabel}</figcaption>
            </Show>
        }>
            {(credit) => (
                <figcaption class="mt-1.5 text-xs text-fg-subtle">
                    <a href={credit().href} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                       class="inline-flex min-h-6 items-center hover:text-primary">
                        {credit().text}
                    </a>
                </figcaption>
            )}
        </Show>
    );
}

interface CaseImagesProps {
    images: CaseImageFacts[];
    /** The same screens as a phone shows them, shown instead of `images` below 48rem. */
    phoneImages?: CaseImageFacts[];
    alts: Record<string, string>;
    recreationLabel: string;
    enlargeLabel: string;
}

/** Each screen links to its largest variant, so its text can be read on a phone or a narrow column. */
function Enlargeable(props: { image: CaseImageFacts; label: string; children: JSX.Element }) {
    return (
        <a href={withBase(widestVariant(props.image))} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
           class="block rounded-lg hover:opacity-90">
            {props.children}
            <span class="sr-only"> ({props.label})</span>
        </a>
    );
}

export function CaseImages(props: CaseImagesProps) {
    const first = () => props.images[0];
    const rest = () => props.images.slice(1);
    return (
        <Switch>
            <Match when={props.phoneImages && props.phoneImages.length > 0 && props.phoneImages}>
                {(phoneImages) => (
                    // Both blocks are in the page; the hidden one's lazy images never load.
                    <>
                        <div class="hidden md:block">
                            <CaseImages images={props.images} alts={props.alts} recreationLabel={props.recreationLabel}
                                        enlargeLabel={props.enlargeLabel}/>
                        </div>
                        <div class="md:hidden">
                            <CaseImages images={phoneImages()} alts={props.alts} recreationLabel={props.recreationLabel}
                                        enlargeLabel={props.enlargeLabel}/>
                        </div>
                    </>
                )}
            </Match>
            {/* Phone screens sit three across; a wide first screen gets the full width. */}
            <Match when={first() && first().height > first().width}>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 sm:mx-auto sm:max-w-3xl sm:gap-6">
                    <For each={props.images}>
                        {(image) => (
                            <figure>
                                <Enlargeable image={image} label={props.enlargeLabel}>
                                    <CaseImage image={image} alt={props.alts[image.id]}
                                               sizes="(min-width: 640px) 15rem, 30vw" frameClass={UNMASK}/>
                                </Enlargeable>
                                <Caption image={image} recreationLabel={props.recreationLabel}/>
                            </figure>
                        )}
                    </For>
                </div>
            </Match>
            <Match when={first()}>
                {(image) => (
                    <div class="space-y-4">
                        <figure>
                            <Enlargeable image={image()} label={props.enlargeLabel}>
                                <CaseImage image={image()} alt={props.alts[image().id]}
                                           sizes="(min-width: 1440px) 80vw, (min-width: 1152px) 72rem, 100vw"
                                           frameClass={UNMASK}/>
                            </Enlargeable>
                            <Caption image={image()} recreationLabel={props.recreationLabel}/>
                        </figure>
                        {/* A lone second screen keeps the full width, so its text stays as legible as the first one's. */}
                        <Show when={rest().length > 0}>
                            <div class={cn("grid gap-4", rest().length > 1 && "md:grid-cols-2")}>
                                <For each={rest()}>
                                    {(image) => (
                                        <figure>
                                            <Enlargeable image={image} label={props.enlargeLabel}>
                                                <CaseImage
                                                    image={image}
                                                    alt={props.alts[image.id]}
                                                    sizes={rest().length > 1 ? "(min-width: 1440px) 40vw, (min-width: 768px) 36rem, 100vw" : "(min-width: 1440px) 80vw, (min-width: 1152px) 72rem, 100vw"}
                                                    frameClass={UNMASK}
                                                />
                                            </Enlargeable>
                                            <Caption image={image} recreationLabel={props.recreationLabel}/>
                                        </figure>
                                    )}
                                </For>
                            </div>
                        </Show>
                    </div>
                )}
            </Match>
        </Switch>
    );
}

/**
 * An architecture drawn as columns of boxes in plain HTML: the markup is the accessible version, columns stack on
 * phones, and the arrows between neighbors are decoration because the caption states how data flows.
 */
export function LayeredDiagram(props: LayeredDiagramProps) {
    return (

                    <li class="relative rounded-lg border border-primary/30 bg-bg/60 p-4">

                            <span aria-hidden="true"
                                  class="absolute -top-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 text-primary lg:top-1/2 lg:-left-9 lg:translate-x-0 lg:-translate-y-1/2">

import {createSignal, For, Show, untrack} from "solid-js";
import {ChevronLeft, ChevronRight} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {CAPABILITIES, capabilityLevels, githubActivity, JOURNEY_YEARS} from "@/content/shared/journey";
import {BUILD_DATE, BUILD_YEAR} from "@/content/shared/site";
import {useJourneyCopy} from "@/hooks/useJourneyCopy";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {evidenceFor, ROLE_AREAS} from "@/lib/journey";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import type {CapabilityId, Level, MilestoneId} from "@/types/journey";

const LEVEL_FILL: Record<Level, string> = {
    0: "transparent",
    1: "var(--color-level-1)",
    2: "var(--color-level-2)",
    3: "var(--color-level-3)",
    4: "var(--color-level-4)",
};

const activityByYear = new Map(githubActivity.years.map((item) => [item.year, item]));
const MAX_DAYS = 366;

interface Focus {
    area: CapabilityId;
    year: number;
}

export function EvolutionGrid(props: { onSelectMilestone: (id: MilestoneId) => void }) {
    const copy = useJourneyCopy();
    const {role} = useRole();
    const [focus, setFocus] = createSignal<Focus>(untrack(() => {
        const current = role();
        return {area: current ? ROLE_AREAS[current][0] : "backend", year: Math.min(BUILD_YEAR, 2026)};
    }));
    const highlighted = (): readonly CapabilityId[] => {
        const current = role();
        return current ? ROLE_AREAS[current] : [];
    };
    const yearIndex = () => JOURNEY_YEARS.indexOf(focus().year);
    const level = () => capabilityLevels[focus().area][yearIndex()];
    const evidence = () => evidenceFor(focus().area, focus().year, BUILD_DATE);
    const target = () => focus().year > BUILD_YEAR;
    const activity = () => activityByYear.get(focus().year);
    const moveYear = (step: 1 | -1) => setFocus({area: focus().area, year: JOURNEY_YEARS[yearIndex() + step]});
    const activeDays = () => {
        const year = activity();
        return year ? `${copy.evolution.activeDays}: ${year.activeDays}${year.partial ? "*" : ""}` : undefined;
    };
    const yearButton =
        "grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border-strong text-fg transition-colors hover:border-primary hover:text-primary active:translate-y-px disabled:opacity-40";
    const label = (area: CapabilityId, year: number, value: Level) =>
        `${copy.areas[area]} · ${year} · ${year > BUILD_YEAR ? `${copy.evolution.target}: ` : ""}${copy.levels[value]}`;

    return (
        <div class="space-y-5">
            {/* Below 64rem the twelve years do not fit side by side, so the grid shows one year at a time. */}
            <div class="space-y-3 lg:hidden">
                <div
                    class="flex items-center justify-center gap-5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface/60 p-3">
                    <button type="button" aria-label={copy.evolution.previousYear} disabled={yearIndex() === 0}
                            onClick={() => moveYear(-1)} class={yearButton}>
                        <ChevronLeft class="size-5"/>
                    </button>
                    <p class="min-w-40 text-center">
                        <span class="block font-display text-3xl text-fg">{focus().year}</span>
                        <span class="block text-xs text-fg-subtle">
                            {target() ? copy.evolution.target : activeDays()}
                        </span>
                    </p>
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        aria-label={copy.evolution.nextYear}
                        disabled={yearIndex() === JOURNEY_YEARS.length - 1}
                        onClick={() => moveYear(1)}
                        class={yearButton}
                    >
                        <ChevronRight class="size-5"/>
                    </button>
                </div>
                <ul class="space-y-2">
                    <For each={CAPABILITIES}>{(area) => {
                        const value = () => capabilityLevels[area][yearIndex()];
                        return (
                            <li>
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    aria-pressed={focus().area === area}
                                    aria-label={label(area, focus().year, value())}
                                    onClick={() => setFocus({area, year: focus().year})}
                                    class={cn(
                                        "flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-full border px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm",
                                        focus().area === area ? "border-fg" : "border-border hover:border-border-strong",
                                    )}
                                >
                                    <span
                                        class={cn("text-fg", highlighted().includes(area) && "font-semibold")}>{copy.areas[area]}</span>
                                    <span class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-xs text-fg-muted">
                                        {copy.levels[value()]}
                                        <span aria-hidden="true"
                                              class={cn("size-6 rounded-sm", value() === 0 && "border border-border", target() && value() > 0 && "journey-target")}
                                              style={{"background-color": LEVEL_FILL[value()]}}
                                        />
                                    </span>
                                </button>
                            </li>
                        );
                    }}</For>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <div class="hidden overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface/60 lg:block">
                <table class="w-full min-w-[48rem] border-separate border-spacing-1 p-2 text-sm">
                    <caption class="px-2 pb-2 text-left text-xs text-fg-subtle">{copy.evolution.caption}</caption>
                    <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th scope="col"
                            class="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-surface px-2 text-left font-semibold text-fg-muted">{copy.evolution.capability}</th>
                        <For each={JOURNEY_YEARS}>{(year) => (
                            <th scope="col"
                                class={cn("px-1 font-mono text-xs font-normal", year > BUILD_YEAR ? "text-fg-subtle" : "text-fg-muted")}>
                                {year}
                                <Show when={year === BUILD_YEAR + 1}>
                                    <span
                                        class="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider">{copy.evolution.target}</span>
                                </Show>
                            </th>
                        )}</For>
                    </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                    <tr>
                        <th scope="row"
                            class="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-surface px-2 text-left text-xs font-normal text-fg-subtle">{copy.evolution.activeDays}</th>
                        <For each={JOURNEY_YEARS}>{(year) => (
                            <td class="h-10 px-1 align-bottom">
                                <Show when={activityByYear.get(year)}>
                                    {(activity) => (
                                        <div class="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-end gap-0.5">
                                            <span
                                                class="font-mono text-[10px] text-fg-muted">{activity().activeDays}{activity().partial ? "*" : ""}</span>
                                            <span aria-hidden="true"
                                                  class="block w-3 rounded-t bg-primary"
                                                  style={{height: `${Math.max(2, (activity().activeDays / MAX_DAYS) * 22)}px`}}
                                            />
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </Show>
                            </td>
                        )}</For>
                    </tr>
                    <For each={CAPABILITIES}>{(area) => (
                        <tr>
                            <th
                                scope="row"
                                class={cn(
                                    "sticky left-0 z-10 bg-surface px-2 text-left whitespace-nowrap",
                                    highlighted().includes(area) ? "font-semibold text-fg" : "font-normal text-fg-muted",
                                )}
                            >
                                {copy.areas[area]}
                            </th>
                            {/* One cell per year, in the years' order, so each cell keeps its position. */}
                            <For each={JOURNEY_YEARS}>{(year, index) => {
                                const value = capabilityLevels[area][untrack(index)];
                                const active = () => focus().area === area && focus().year === year;
                                const future = year > BUILD_YEAR;
                                return (
                                    <td class="p-0">
                                        <button
                                            type="button"
                                            aria-pressed={active()}
                                            aria-label={label(area, year, value)}
                                            onClick={() => setFocus({area, year})}
                                            onFocus={() => setFocus({area, year})}
                                            class={cn(
                                                "block h-8 w-full min-w-9 rounded-sm border-2",
                                                active() ? "border-fg" : value === 0 ? "border-border" : "border-transparent",
                                                future && value > 0 && "journey-target",
                                            )}
                                            style={{"background-color": LEVEL_FILL[value]}}
                                        />
                                    </td>
                                );
                            }}</For>
                        </tr>
                    )}</For>
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-xs text-fg-muted">
                <span class="font-semibold">{copy.evolution.legend}</span>
                <For each={copy.levels}>{(label, value) => (
                    <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span aria-hidden="true"
                              class={cn("size-3.5 rounded-sm", value() === 0 && "border border-border")}
                              style={{"background-color": LEVEL_FILL[value() as Level]}}
                        />
                        {label}
                    </span>
                )}</For>
                <span class="text-fg-subtle">* {copy.evolution.activeDaysNote}</span>
            </div>

            <div aria-live="polite" class="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-5">
                <p class="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-fg-subtle">
                    {focus().year}
                    {target() && ` · ${copy.evolution.target}`}
                </p>
                <p class="mt-1 text-title text-fg">
                    {copy.areas[focus().area]} · <span class="text-primary">{copy.levels[level()]}</span>
                </p>
                <p class="mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-fg-muted">{copy.evolution.evidence}</p>
                <Show when={evidence().length}
                      fallback={<p class="mt-2 text-sm text-fg-subtle">{copy.evolution.noEvidence}</p>}>
                    <ul class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <For each={evidence()}>{(id) => (
                            <li>
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => props.onSelectMilestone(id)}
                                    class="min-h-9 rounded-full border border-border px-3 text-sm text-fg-muted hover:border-primary hover:text-fg"
                                >
                                    {copy.milestones[id].title}
                                </button>
                            </li>
                        )}</For>
                    </ul>
                </Show>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/journey/FocusRadar.tsx
================================================
import {createSignal, For, Show} from "solid-js";
import {RADAR_QUADRANTS, RADAR_RINGS, radarItems} from "@/content/shared/journey";
import {useJourneyCopy} from "@/hooks/useJourneyCopy";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import type {RadarItemId, RadarQuadrant, RadarRing} from "@/types/journey";

const SIZE = 520;
const CENTER = SIZE / 2;
const RING_OUTER: Record<RadarRing, number> = {core: 82, growing: 148, exploring: 208, paused: 252};
const RING_INNER: Record<RadarRing, number> = {core: 0, growing: 82, exploring: 148, paused: 208};
const RING_FILL: Record<RadarRing, string> = {
    core: "var(--color-level-4)",
    growing: "var(--color-level-3)",
    exploring: "var(--color-level-2)",
    paused: "var(--color-level-1)",
};
// Screen angles (clockwise from the positive x axis) that each quadrant's items spread over. The ring labels run
// along the vertical axis inside the data quadrant, so its items start a little later and sit on the outer half of
// their band first.
const QUADRANT_ARC: Record<RadarQuadrant, [number, number]> = {
    build: [180, 270],
    data: [284, 360],
    platforms: [0, 90],
    security: [90, 180]
};

const ordered = RADAR_QUADRANTS.flatMap((quadrant) =>
    RADAR_RINGS.flatMap((ring) => radarItems.filter((item) => item.quadrant === quadrant && item.ring === ring)),
);

const positions = new Map(
    RADAR_QUADRANTS.flatMap((quadrant) =>
        RADAR_RINGS.flatMap((ring) => {
            const items = radarItems.filter((item) => item.quadrant === quadrant && item.ring === ring);
            return items.map((item, index) => {
                const [from, to] = QUADRANT_ARC[quadrant];
                const angle = ((from + ((index + 1) * (to - from)) / (items.length + 1)) * Math.PI) / 180;
                const band = RING_OUTER[ring] - RING_INNER[ring];
                const outer = (index + (quadrant === "data" ? 1 : 0)) % 2 === 1;
                const radius = ring === "core" ? 48 + (index % 2) * 18 : RING_INNER[ring] + band / 2 + (outer ? band * 0.16 : -band * 0.16);
                return [item.id, {x: CENTER + radius * Math.cos(angle), y: CENTER + radius * Math.sin(angle)}] as const;
            });
        }),
    ),
);

export function FocusRadar() {
    const {radar} = useJourneyCopy();
    const [active, setActive] = createSignal<RadarItemId>("fastapi");
    const activeItem = () => radarItems.find((item) => item.id === active())!;

    return (
        <div class="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)] lg:items-start">
            <div>
                <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${SIZE} ${SIZE}`} class="mx-auto block h-auto w-full max-w-130 font-sans"
                     aria-hidden="true">
                    {/* When the tab opens, the rings grow from the center one after another and every technology then
                        flies out from the center to its place (globals.css, radar-ring and radar-blip). */}
                    <For each={[...RADAR_RINGS].reverse()}>
                        {(ring) => (
                            <circle cx={CENTER} cy={CENTER} r={RING_OUTER[ring]} fill="var(--color-surface)"
                                    stroke="var(--color-border)" stroke-width={1}
                                    class="radar-ring" style={{"--i": String(RADAR_RINGS.indexOf(ring))}}/>
                        )}
                    </For>
                    <line x1={CENTER - RING_OUTER.paused} x2={CENTER + RING_OUTER.paused} y1={CENTER} y2={CENTER}
                          stroke="var(--color-border)" stroke-width={1}/>
                    <line x1={CENTER} x2={CENTER} y1={CENTER - RING_OUTER.paused} y2={CENTER + RING_OUTER.paused}
                          stroke="var(--color-border)" stroke-width={1}/>
                    <For each={RADAR_RINGS}>
                        {(ring) => (
                            <text x={CENTER + 6} y={CENTER - RING_OUTER[ring] + 14}
                                  class="fill-fg-subtle text-[11px]">
                                {radar.rings[ring].label}
                            </text>
                        )}
                    </For>
                    <text x={8} y={18}
                          class="fill-fg-muted text-[13px] font-semibold">{radar.quadrants.build}</text>
                    <text x={SIZE - 8} y={18} text-anchor="end"
                          class="fill-fg-muted text-[13px] font-semibold">{radar.quadrants.data}</text>
                    <text x={SIZE - 8} y={SIZE - 8} text-anchor="end"
                          class="fill-fg-muted text-[13px] font-semibold">{radar.quadrants.platforms}</text>
                    <text x={8} y={SIZE - 8}
                          class="fill-fg-muted text-[13px] font-semibold">{radar.quadrants.security}</text>
                    <For each={ordered}>{(item, index) => {
                        const point = positions.get(item.id)!;
                        const selected = () => item.id === active();
                        return (
                            <g class="radar-blip cursor-pointer" onPointerEnter={() => setActive(item.id)}
                               onClick={() => setActive(item.id)}
                               style={{
                                   "--i": String(index()),
                                   "--dx": `${(CENTER - point.x).toFixed(1)}px`,
                                   "--dy": `${(CENTER - point.y).toFixed(1)}px`,
                               }}>
                                <circle cx={point.x} cy={point.y} r={16} fill="transparent"/>
                                <circle
                                    cx={point.x}
                                    cy={point.y}
                                    r={selected() ? 13 : 11}
                                    fill={RING_FILL[item.ring]}
                                    stroke={selected() ? "var(--color-fg)" : "var(--color-surface)"}
                                    stroke-width={2}
                                />
                                <text
                                    x={point.x}
                                    y={point.y + 3.5}
                                    text-anchor="middle"
                                    class={cn("pointer-events-none font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold", item.ring === "paused" ? "fill-fg" : "fill-bg")}
                                >
                                    {index() + 1}
                                </text>
                            </g>
                        );
                    }}</For>
                </svg>
                <p class="mt-3 text-center text-xs text-fg-subtle">{radar.caption}</p>
            </div>

            <div class="space-y-6">
                <div aria-live="polite" class="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-5">
                    <p class="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-fg-subtle">
                        {radar.quadrants[activeItem().quadrant]} · {radar.rings[activeItem().ring].label}
                    </p>
                    <p class="mt-1 text-title text-fg">{radar.items[active()].name}</p>
                    <p class="mt-2 text-fg-muted">{radar.items[active()].note}</p>
                    <p class="mt-2 text-sm text-fg-subtle">{radar.rings[activeItem().ring].description}</p>
                </div>
                <div class="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <For each={RADAR_QUADRANTS}>{(quadrant) => (
                        <div>
                            <h3 class="font-semibold text-fg">{radar.quadrants[quadrant]}</h3>
                            <ol class="mt-2 space-y-1">
                                <For each={ordered}>{(item, index) => (
                                    <Show when={item.quadrant === quadrant}>
                                        <li>
                                            <button
                                                type="button"
                                                aria-pressed={item.id === active()}
                                                onClick={() => setActive(item.id)}
                                                onFocus={() => setActive(item.id)}
                                                onPointerEnter={() => setActive(item.id)}
                                                class={cn(
                                                    "flex min-h-8 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 text-left text-sm",
                                                    item.id === active() ? "bg-surface-raised text-fg" : "text-fg-muted hover:text-fg",
                                                )}
                                            >
                                                <span aria-hidden="true"
                                                      class={cn(
                                                          "grid size-5 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold",
                                                          item.ring === "paused" ? "text-fg" : "text-bg",
                                                      )}
                                                      style={{background: RING_FILL[item.ring]}}
                                                >
                                                    {index() + 1}
                                                </span>
                                                <span class="flex-1">{radar.items[item.id].name}</span>
                                                <span class="sr-only">{radar.rings[item.ring].label}</span>
                                            </button>
                                        </li>
                                    </Show>
                                )}</For>
                            </ol>
                        </div>
                    )}</For>
                </div>
                <ul class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-xs text-fg-muted">
                    <For each={RADAR_RINGS}>
                        {(ring) => (
                            <li class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 rounded-full"
                                      style={{background: RING_FILL[ring]}}/>
                                {radar.rings[ring].label}
                            </li>
                        )}
                    </For>
                </ul>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import {createSignal, For, Show} from "solid-js";
import {Check} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {GOALS, milestones, sdgs} from "@/content/shared/journey";
import {useContent} from "@/context/language";
import {useJourneyCopy} from "@/hooks/useJourneyCopy";
import {formatRange, formatYearMonth} from "@/lib/format";
import {milestonesForSdg} from "@/lib/journey";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import type {MilestoneId, SdgId} from "@/types/journey";
import {SdgBadge} from "./SdgBadge";

export function Horizon(props: { onSelectMilestone: (id: MilestoneId) => void }) {
    const {ui} = useContent();
    const copy = useJourneyCopy();
    const [sdg, setSdg] = createSignal<SdgId>(4);
    const related = () => milestonesForSdg(sdg());

    return (
        <div class="space-y-10">
            <p class="max-w-3xl text-lg text-fg-muted">{copy.horizon.intro}</p>

            <div>
                <h3 class="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-fg-subtle">{copy.horizon.goalsLabel}</h3>
                <ol class="relative mt-4 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                    <For each={GOALS}>{(id, index) => {
                        const milestone = milestones.find((item) => item.id === id)!;
                        const text = copy.milestones[id];
                        const when = milestone.end ? formatRange(milestone.start, milestone.end, ui.months, ui.present) : formatYearMonth(milestone.start, ui.months);
                        return (
                            <li
                                class="relative flex flex-col rounded-lg border border-dashed border-border-strong bg-surface p-5">
                                <span class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">
                                    {String(index() + 1).padStart(2, "0")} · {when}
                                </span>
                                <h4 class="mt-2 font-display text-title text-fg">{text.title}</h4>
                                <p class="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-primary">{text.place}</p>
                                <p class="mt-3 text-sm text-fg-muted">{text.summary}</p>
                                <ul class="mt-4 space-y-1.5 text-sm text-fg-muted">
                                    <For each={copy.horizon.gains[id]}>
                                        {(gain) => (
                                            <li class="flex gap-2">
                                                <Check class="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-primary"/>
                                                {gain}
                                            </li>
                                        )}
                                    </For>
                                </ul>
                                <Show when={milestone.sdgs}>
                                    {(goals) => (
                                        <div class="mt-auto flex items-center gap-2 pt-4">
                                            <span
                                                class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{copy.horizon.sdgShort}</span>
                                            <For each={goals()}>
                                                {(goal) => <SdgBadge id={goal} label={copy.horizon.sdgs[goal].name}
                                                                     compact/>}
                                            </For>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </Show>
                            </li>
                        );
                    }}</For>
                </ol>
            </div>

            <div>
                <h3 class="text-title text-fg">{copy.horizon.sdgTitle}</h3>
                <p class="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-fg-muted">{copy.horizon.sdgIntro}</p>
                <div role="group" aria-label={copy.horizon.sdgTitle} class="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <For each={sdgs}>{(goal) => (
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            aria-pressed={goal.id === sdg()}
                            onClick={() => setSdg(goal.id)}
                            class={cn(
                                "rounded-lg border p-2 pr-3",
                                goal.id === sdg() ? "border-fg bg-surface-raised" : "border-border hover:border-border-strong",
                            )}
                        >
                            <SdgBadge id={goal.id} label={copy.horizon.sdgs[goal.id].name}/>
                        </button>
                    )}</For>

                    <p class="mt-4 text-sm font-semibold text-fg-muted">{copy.horizon.related}</p>

                            <li>
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => props.onSelectMilestone(id)}
                                    class="min-h-9 rounded-full border border-border px-3 text-sm text-fg-muted hover:border-primary hover:text-fg"

                                </button>
                            </li>

FILE: src/components/journey/JourneyMap.tsx
================================================
import {createMemo, createSignal, For, onMount, Show} from "solid-js";
import {JOURNEY_END, JOURNEY_LINES, JOURNEY_YEARS, milestones} from "@/content/shared/journey";
import {BUILD_DATE} from "@/content/shared/site";
import {useContent} from "@/context/language";
import {useJourneyCopy} from "@/hooks/useJourneyCopy";
import {formatYearMonth} from "@/lib/format";
import {
    isFuture,
    laneY,
    layoutStations,
    lineSpans,
    MAP,
    stationRadius,
    stepsAround,
    TAG_HEIGHT,
    tagLayout,
    xFor
} from "@/lib/journey";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import type {JourneyLineId, MilestoneId} from "@/types/journey";
import {JourneySteps, SwipeArea} from "./JourneySteps";
import {LineKey} from "./LineKey";
import {MilestoneDetails} from "./MilestoneDetails";

const STATIONS = layoutStations();
const STATION_BY_ID = new Map(STATIONS.map((station) => [station.id, station]));
const SPANS = lineSpans(STATIONS, BUILD_DATE);
const BY_ID = new Map(milestones.map((milestone) => [milestone.id, milestone]));
const TODAY_X = xFor(BUILD_DATE);
const color = (line: JourneyLineId) => `var(--color-viz-${line})`;
const GRID = JOURNEY_YEARS.map((year) => `M${xFor(year)} ${MAP.gridTop}V${MAP.gridBottom}`).join("");
const RAILS = JOURNEY_LINES.map((line) => `M${MAP.plotLeft} ${laneY(line)}H${MAP.plotRight}`).join("");
const LINE_OPACITY = 0.6;

interface JourneyMapProps {
    selected: MilestoneId;
    onSelect: (id: MilestoneId) => void;
    emphasis: JourneyLineId | null;
    onEmphasis: (line: JourneyLineId | null) => void;
}

export function JourneyMap(props: JourneyMapProps) {
    const {ui} = useContent();
    const copy = useJourneyCopy();
    const [showList, setShowList] = createSignal(false);
    // The stop under the pointer or the keyboard focus names itself in the tag; otherwise the selected one does.
    const [pointed, setPointed] = createSignal<MilestoneId | null>(null);
    let scroller: HTMLDivElement | undefined;

    // The map only shows from 64rem, where it fits; if large text still makes it wider than its box, start near today.
    onMount(() => {
        const element = scroller;
        if (element && element.scrollWidth > element.clientWidth) {
            element.scrollLeft = (element.scrollWidth * TODAY_X) / MAP.width - element.clientWidth * 0.65;
        }
    });

    const dimmed = (lines: JourneyLineId[]) => props.emphasis !== null && !lines.includes(props.emphasis);
    const steps = createMemo(() => stepsAround(STATIONS, props.selected, props.emphasis));
    const tag = createMemo(() => {
        const id = pointed() ?? props.selected;
        const text = `${formatYearMonth(BY_ID.get(id)!.start, ui.months)} · ${copy.milestones[id].title}`;
        return {text, ...tagLayout(STATION_BY_ID.get(id)!, text)};
    });
    const leave = (id: MilestoneId) => {
        if (pointed() === id) setPointed(null);
    };
    const onStationKey = (event: KeyboardEvent, id: MilestoneId) => {
        if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
            event.preventDefault();
            props.onSelect(id);
        }
    };

    return (
        <div class="space-y-5">
            <div role="group" aria-label={copy.map.emphasisHint} class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-pressed={props.emphasis === null}
                    onClick={() => props.onEmphasis(null)}
                    class={cn("min-h-10 shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3.5 text-sm whitespace-nowrap", props.emphasis === null ? "border-primary text-fg" : "border-border text-fg-muted hover:text-fg")}
                >
                    {copy.map.allLines}
                </button>
                <For each={JOURNEY_LINES}>{(line) => (
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        aria-pressed={props.emphasis === line}
                        aria-label={copy.lines[line]}
                        onClick={() => props.onEmphasis(props.emphasis === line ? null : line)}
                        class={cn(
                            "inline-flex min-h-10 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3.5 text-sm whitespace-nowrap",
                            props.emphasis === line ? "border-primary text-fg" : "border-border text-fg-muted hover:text-fg",
                        )}
                    >
                        <LineKey line={line}/>
                        {/* Phones get the one-word names so the chips take two rows instead of five. */}
                        <span class="sm:hidden">{copy.linesShort[line]}</span>
                        <span class="hidden sm:inline">{copy.lines[line]}</span>
                    </button>
                )}</For>
            </div>

            {/* The map rises into place as one piece, like the other blocks of the page (globals.css, section-enter). */}
            <div ref={scroller}
                 class="journey-chart section-enter hidden overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface/60 lg:flex">
                {/* Lane names, short since the chips above carry the full ones, stay pinned to the left edge if large
                    text makes the map scroll. */}
                <div aria-hidden="true" class="pointer-events-none sticky left-0 z-10 w-0 shrink-0">
                    <For each={JOURNEY_LINES}>{(line) => (
                        <span
                            style={{top: `${(laneY(line) / MAP.height) * 100}%`}}
                            class={cn(
                                "absolute left-3 inline-flex -translate-y-1/2 items-center gap-2 text-xs leading-4 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors",
                                props.emphasis === line ? "font-semibold text-fg" : dimmed([line]) ? "text-fg-subtle" : "text-fg-muted",
                            )}
                        >
                            <span class="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{background: color(line)}}/>
                            {copy.linesShort[line]}
                        </span>
                    )}</For>
                </div>
                <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${MAP.width} ${MAP.height}`}
                     class="block h-auto w-full min-w-[56rem] shrink-0 font-sans" role="group"
                     aria-label={copy.tabs.map.label}>
                    {/* The years ahead are a tinted zone, so a plan never reads as a fact. */}
                    <g aria-hidden="true">
                        <rect x={TODAY_X} y={MAP.gridTop} width={MAP.width - 8 - TODAY_X}
                              height={MAP.gridBottom - MAP.gridTop} rx={6} fill="var(--color-fg)" fill-opacity={0.02}/>
                        <path d={GRID} stroke="var(--color-border)" stroke-width={1} stroke-dasharray="2 4"/>
                        <For each={JOURNEY_YEARS}>{(year) => (
                            <text x={(xFor(year) + xFor(Math.min(year + 1, JOURNEY_END + 1))) / 2} y={MAP.axisY}
                                  text-anchor="middle" class="fill-fg-subtle font-mono text-[11px]">{year}</text>
                        )}</For>
                        <line x1={TODAY_X} x2={TODAY_X} y1={MAP.gridTop} y2={MAP.gridBottom}
                              stroke="var(--color-fg-subtle)" stroke-width={1}/>
                        <text x={TODAY_X} y={MAP.height - 8} text-anchor="middle"
                              class="fill-fg font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold">{copy.today}</text>
                        <path d={RAILS} stroke="var(--color-border)" stroke-width={1}/>
                    </g>

                    <g aria-hidden="true">
                        <For each={SPANS}>{(span) => {
                            const y = laneY(span.line);
                            const solidEnd = Math.min(span.to, span.todayX);
                            const style = () => ({opacity: dimmed([span.line]) ? 0.12 : LINE_OPACITY});
                            return (
                                <>
                                    <Show when={span.from < solidEnd}>
                                        <path d={`M${span.from} ${y}H${solidEnd}`} style={style()}
                                              class="transition-opacity" stroke={color(span.line)} stroke-width={3}
                                              stroke-linecap="round"/>
                                    </Show>
                                    <Show when={span.to > span.todayX}>
                                        <path d={`M${Math.max(span.from, span.todayX)} ${y}H${span.to}`}
                                              style={style()} class="transition-opacity" stroke={color(span.line)}
                                              stroke-width={2} stroke-dasharray="5 5"/>
                                    </Show>
                                </>
                            );
                        }}</For>
                    </g>

                    <For each={STATIONS}>{(station) => {
                        const milestone = BY_ID.get(station.id)!;
                        const future = isFuture(milestone, BUILD_DATE);
                        const height = station.bottom - station.top;
                        return (
                            <g
                                role="button"
                                tabindex={0}
                                aria-pressed={station.id === props.selected}
                                aria-label={`${formatYearMonth(milestone.start, ui.months)} · ${copy.milestones[station.id].title}`}
                                onClick={() => props.onSelect(station.id)}
                                onKeyDown={(event) => onStationKey(event, station.id)}
                                onPointerEnter={() => setPointed(station.id)}
                                onPointerLeave={() => leave(station.id)}
                                onFocus={() => setPointed(station.id)}
                                onBlur={() => leave(station.id)}
                                style={{opacity: dimmed(milestone.lines) ? 0.2 : 1}}
                                class="journey-station cursor-pointer transition-opacity"
                            >
                                <rect class="journey-station-ring" x={station.x - 12} y={station.top - 12} width={24}
                                      height={height + 24} rx={12} fill="transparent"/>
                                {/* The stop's lanes are joined and ringed only while it is selected or pointed at. */}
                                <g class="journey-halo">
                                    <Show when={height > 0}>
                                        <line x1={station.x} x2={station.x} y1={station.top} y2={station.bottom}
                                              stroke="var(--color-fg-subtle)" stroke-width={1.5}/>
                                    </Show>
                                    <For each={milestone.lines}>{(line) => (
                                        <circle cx={station.x} cy={laneY(line)} r={10} fill="none"
                                                stroke={color(line)} stroke-width={1.5}/>
                                    )}</For>
                                </g>
                                {/* A main milestone is a ring; a smaller step on the way, a dot. */}
                                <For each={milestone.lines}>{(line) => milestone.major ? (
                                    <circle cx={station.x} cy={laneY(line)} r={stationRadius(milestone)}
                                            fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke={color(line)} stroke-width={2.5}
                                            stroke-dasharray={future ? "2.5 2" : undefined}/>
                                ) : (
                                    <circle cx={station.x} cy={laneY(line)} r={stationRadius(milestone)}
                                            fill={color(line)}/>
                                )}</For>
                            </g>
                        );
                    }}</For>

                    <g aria-hidden="true" class="pointer-events-none">
                        <rect x={tag().x - tag().width / 2} y={tag().y - TAG_HEIGHT / 2} width={tag().width}
                              height={TAG_HEIGHT} rx={TAG_HEIGHT / 2} fill="var(--color-bg)"
                              stroke="var(--color-border-strong)" stroke-width={1}/>
                        <text x={tag().x} y={tag().y + 4} text-anchor="middle"
                              class="fill-fg font-mono text-[11px]">{tag().text}</text>
                    </g>
                </svg>
            </div>
            <JourneySteps stations={STATIONS} steps={steps()} selected={props.selected} onSelect={props.onSelect}
                          emphasis={props.emphasis} class="lg:hidden"/>

            <SwipeArea onPrevious={() => {
                const previous = steps().previous;
                if (previous) props.onSelect(previous.id);
            }} onNext={() => {
                const next = steps().next;
                if (next) props.onSelect(next.id);
            }}>
                <MilestoneDetails id={props.selected}/>
            </SwipeArea>

            <div>
                <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-expanded={showList()}
                    aria-controls="journey-list"
                    onClick={() => setShowList((value) => !value)}
                    class="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover"
                >
                    {showList() ? copy.map.listToggle.hide : copy.map.listToggle.show}
                </button>
                <Show when={showList()}>
                    <ol id="journey-list" class="appear mt-3 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                        <For each={STATIONS}>{({id}) => {
                            const milestone = BY_ID.get(id)!;
                            return (
                                <li>
                                    <button
                                        type="button"
                                        aria-pressed={id === props.selected}
                                        onClick={() => props.onSelect(id)}
                                        class={cn(
                                            "flex w-full items-start gap-3 rounded-full border px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm",
                                            id === props.selected ? "border-primary bg-surface-raised" : "border-border hover:border-border-strong",
                                        )}
                                    >
                                    <span
                                        class="w-20 shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{formatYearMonth(milestone.start, ui.months)}</span>
                                        <span class="text-fg">{copy.milestones[id].title}</span>
                                    </button>
                                </li>
                            );
                        }}</For>
                    </ol>
                </Show>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/journey/JourneySteps.tsx
================================================
import {For, type JSX, Show} from "solid-js";
import {ChevronLeft, ChevronRight} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {JOURNEY_END, JOURNEY_START, milestones} from "@/content/shared/journey";
import {BUILD_DATE} from "@/content/shared/site";
import {useContent} from "@/context/language";
import {useJourneyCopy} from "@/hooks/useJourneyCopy";
import {formatYearMonth} from "@/lib/format";
import {isFuture, type StationLayout, type Steps} from "@/lib/journey";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import type {JourneyLineId, MilestoneId} from "@/types/journey";

const BY_ID = new Map(milestones.map((milestone) => [milestone.id, milestone]));
const SWIPE = 48;

interface JourneyStepsProps {
    stations: StationLayout[];
    steps: Steps;
    selected: MilestoneId;
    onSelect: (id: MilestoneId) => void;
    emphasis: JourneyLineId | null;
    class?: string;
}

/**
 * The journey for screens too narrow for the map: a strip with one dot per stop, in date order, and buttons that move
 * one stop at a time. With a line selected, the steps only visit that line's stops and the other dots fade.
 */
export function JourneySteps(props: JourneyStepsProps) {
    const {ui} = useContent();
    const copy = useJourneyCopy();
    const current = () => BY_ID.get(props.selected)!;
    const todayAt = () => {
        const firstPlanned = props.stations.findIndex(({id}) => isFuture(BY_ID.get(id)!, BUILD_DATE));
        return firstPlanned > 0 ? ((firstPlanned - 0.5) / (props.stations.length - 1)) * 100 : null;
    };
    const button =
        "grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border-strong text-fg transition-colors hover:border-primary hover:text-primary active:translate-y-px disabled:opacity-40";

    return (
        <div class={cn("rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface/60 p-4", props.class)}>
            <div aria-hidden="true" class="relative">
                <div class="flex justify-between font-mono text-[11px] text-fg-subtle">
                    <span>{JOURNEY_START}</span>
                    <span>{JOURNEY_END}</span>
                </div>
                {/* Each dot sits at its share of the strip, so any number of stops fits the width; they may touch. */}
                <div class="relative mt-3 h-4">
                    <span class="absolute inset-x-0 top-1/2 h-px bg-border"/>
                    <Show when={todayAt() !== null}>
                        <span style={{left: `${todayAt()}%`}} class="absolute -top-2 -bottom-2 w-px bg-fg-subtle"/>
                    </Show>
                    <For each={props.stations}>
                        {({id}, index) => {
                            const milestone = BY_ID.get(id)!;
                            const future = isFuture(milestone, BUILD_DATE);
                            const color = () => {
                                const emphasis = props.emphasis;
                                return `var(--color-viz-${emphasis && milestone.lines.includes(emphasis) ? emphasis : milestone.lines[0]})`;
                            };
                            return (
                                <span
                                    style={{
                                        left: `${(index() / (props.stations.length - 1)) * 100}%`,
                                        "border-color": color(),
                                        "background-color": future ? "var(--color-surface)" : color()
                                    }}
                                    class={cn(
                                        "absolute top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full border-2",
                                        future && "border-dashed",
                                        id === props.selected ? "z-10 size-3.5 ring-2 ring-fg ring-offset-2 ring-offset-surface" : "size-2",
                                        props.emphasis !== null && !milestone.lines.includes(props.emphasis) && "opacity-30",
                                    )}
                                />
                            );
                        }}
                    </For>
                </div>
                {/* "Today" sits under the strip, where it cannot collide with the year at either end. */}
                <Show when={todayAt() !== null}>
                    <div class="relative mt-2 h-4">
                        <span style={{left: `clamp(1.75rem, ${todayAt()}%, calc(100% - 1.75rem))`}}
                              class="absolute top-0 -translate-x-1/2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-fg">
                            {copy.today}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </Show>
            </div>

            <div class="mt-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-5">
                <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={copy.map.previousStop}
                    disabled={!props.steps.previous}
                    onClick={() => {
                        const previous = props.steps.previous;
                        if (previous) props.onSelect(previous.id);
                    }}
                    class={button}
                >
                    <ChevronLeft class="size-5"/>
                </button>
                <p class="min-w-20 text-center">
                    <span
                        class="block font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{formatYearMonth(current().start, ui.months)}</span>
                    <span aria-hidden="true" class="font-mono text-sm text-fg-muted tabular-nums">
                        <span
                            class="text-fg">{props.steps.index >= 0 ? props.steps.index + 1 : "–"}</span> / {props.steps.order.length}
                    </span>
                </p>
                <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={copy.map.nextStop}
                    disabled={!props.steps.next}
                    onClick={() => {
                        const next = props.steps.next;
                        if (next) props.onSelect(next.id);
                    }}
                    class={button}
                >
                    <ChevronRight class="size-5"/>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

/**
 * Lets a sideways swipe on touch screens move to the previous or next stop. `touch-action: pan-y pinch-zoom` keeps
 * vertical scrolling and zoom native; a mouse drag is left alone, so text in the details can still be selected.
 */
export function SwipeArea(props: {
    onPrevious: () => void;
    onNext: () => void;
    children: JSX.Element
}) {
    let start: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;

    const onPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
        start = event.pointerType === "touch" ? {x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY} : null;
    };
    const onPointerUp = (event: PointerEvent) => {
        const from = start;
        start = null;
        if (!from) return;
        const dx = event.clientX - from.x;
        if (Math.abs(dx) < SWIPE || Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(event.clientY - from.y)) return;
        if (dx < 0) props.onNext();
        else props.onPrevious();
    };

    return (
        <div onPointerDown={onPointerDown} onPointerUp={onPointerUp} onPointerCancel={() => (start = null)}
             class="touch-pan-y touch-pinch-zoom">
            {props.children}
        </div>
    );
}
