/** The job and program stops have a page of their own. */
const detailOf = (id: MilestoneId) => {
    if (id in EXPERIENCE_SLUG) return {
        collection: "experience" as const,
        slug: EXPERIENCE_SLUG[id as keyof typeof EXPERIENCE_SLUG]
    };
    if (id in EDUCATION_SLUG) return {
        collection: "education" as const,
        slug: EDUCATION_SLUG[id as keyof typeof EDUCATION_SLUG]
    };
    return null;
};

/** One stop's text and links; the details panel draws it anew for each stop it shows. */
function MilestoneContent(props: { id: MilestoneId }) {
    const {lang, content: {ui}} = useLanguage();
    const {locked} = useRole();
    const journey = useJourneyCopy();
    // The panel keys this content by stop, so the id is fixed for its life.
    // eslint-disable-next-line solid/reactivity
    const {id} = props;
    const detail = detailOf(id);
    const milestone = milestones.find((item) => item.id === id)!;
    const text = journey.milestones[id];
    const certificates = certifications.filter((certification) => certification.milestone === id);
    const when = milestone.end === undefined
        ? formatYearMonth(milestone.start, ui.months)
        : formatRange(milestone.start, milestone.end, ui.months, ui.present);

    return (
        <>
            <p class="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-fg-subtle">
                {journey.kinds[milestone.kind]} · {when}
                {isFuture(milestone, BUILD_DATE) && ` · ${journey.planned}`}
            </p>
            <h3 class="mt-2 text-title text-fg">{text.title}</h3>
            <p class="mt-1 font-semibold text-primary">{text.place}</p>
            <p class="mt-3 max-w-4xl text-fg-muted">{text.summary}</p>
            <Show when={certificates.length > 0}>
                <div class="mt-4">
                    <p class="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-fg-subtle">{journey.map.certificates}</p>
                    <ul class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <For each={certificates}>
                            {(certification) => (
                                <li>
                                    <Link
                                        to={buildDetailPath(lang, "certifications", {
                                            slug: CERTIFICATION_SLUG[certification.id],
                                            locked: locked()
                                        })}
                                        class="inline-flex min-h-8 items-center rounded-full border border-border px-3 py-1 text-xs text-fg-muted hover:border-primary hover:text-primary"
                                    >
                                        {certification.title} · {certification.issuer}
                                    </Link>
                                </li>
                            )}
                        </For>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </Show>
            <ul class="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-sm text-fg-muted">
                <For each={milestone.lines}>
                    {(line) => (
                        <li class="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                            <LineKey line={line}/>
                            {journey.lines[line]}
                        </li>
                    )}
                </For>
            </ul>
            <Show when={milestone.sdgs?.length || milestone.anchor}>
                <div class="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                    <Show when={milestone.sdgs && milestone.sdgs.length > 0}>
                        <span class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{journey.horizon.sdgShort}</span>
                    </Show>
                    <For each={milestone.sdgs}>
                        {(sdg) => <SdgBadge id={sdg} label={journey.horizon.sdgs[sdg].name} compact/>}
                    </For>
                    <span class="ml-auto flex flex-wrap gap-x-4">
                        <Show when={detail}>
                            {(page) => (
                                <Link
                                    to={buildDetailPath(lang, page().collection, {
                                        slug: page().slug,
                                        locked: locked()
                                    })}
                                    class="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover"
                                >
                                    {journey.map.detail}
                                    <ArrowRight class="size-4"/>
                                </Link>
                            )}
                        </Show>
                        <Show when={milestone.anchor}>
                            {(anchor) => (
                                <a href={`#${anchor()}`}
                                   class="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover">
                                    {journey.map.goTo}
                                    <ArrowRight class="size-4"/>
                                </a>
                            )}
                        </Show>
                    </span>
                </div>
            </Show>
        </>
    );
}

/** The live region stays in place while the stop it shows changes, so screen readers announce each new stop. */
export function MilestoneDetails(props: { id: MilestoneId }) {
    return (
        <div aria-live="polite" class="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-5 md:p-6">
            <Show when={props.id} keyed>{(id) => <MilestoneContent id={id}/>}</Show>
        </div>
    );
}

            >
                {props.id}
            </span>
            <span class={props.compact ? "sr-only" : "text-fg-muted"}>{props.label}</span>
        </span>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/layout/LanguageSwitcher.tsx
================================================
import {Languages} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {buildPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";

/** On the project pages `href` points to the same page in the other language. */
export function LanguageSwitcher(props: { class?: string; href?: string }) {
    const {alternateLang, content} = useLanguage();
    const {role, locked} = useRole();
    const href = () => props.href ?? buildPath(alternateLang, role(), {locked: locked()});

    const keepHash = (event: MouseEvent & { currentTarget: HTMLAnchorElement }) => {
        if (!window.location.hash || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        // The link as it is followed now, with the role view lib/role-links.ts may have added to it.
        const url = new URL(event.currentTarget.href);
        url.hash = window.location.hash;
        window.location.assign(url.href);
    };

    return (
        <a
            href={withBase(href())}
            hreflang={alternateLang}
            lang={alternateLang}
            onClick={keepHash}
            class={cn(
                "inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-3 font-mono text-sm text-fg-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised hover:text-fg",
                props.class,
            )}
        >
            <Languages class="size-4"/>
            {/* The name read aloud starts with the visible code (WCAG 2.5.3, label in name). */}
            {alternateLang.toUpperCase()}
            <span class="sr-only"> · {content.ui.language.switchTo}</span>
        </a>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/layout/Section.tsx

import {type JSX, Show} from "solid-js";
import {useSectionReady} from "@/lib/ready";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import type {SectionId} from "@/types/content";

interface SectionProps {
    id: SectionId;
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    children: JSX.Element;
    class?: string;
    tone?: "plain" | "raised";
    /**
     * How the heading sits. "wide" puts it above content that needs the whole row (grids, charts, timelines); "split"
     * keeps it in a narrow column at the left that stays in view while the list beside it scrolls, so a section of
     * rows reads like an index; "pair" gives the heading and what it carries (intro) the left half and the content the
     * right half, its top level with the title. Below 64rem they all stack.
     */
    layout?: "wide" | "split" | "pair";
    /** What the heading carries under its subtitle in a "pair" layout, such as the ways to reach me. */
    intro?: JSX.Element;
    /** Additional 100dvh snap boxes that belong to the same section when its content spans more than one viewport. */
    screens?: JSX.Element;
}

// Safe heights in px measured across mobile (390px) and desktop (1440px). Off-screen sections on phones reserve this
// height under content-visibility: auto; keeping estimates at or slightly above actual height prevents off-screen
// bounding boxes from overlapping the following section during accessibility audits.
const HEIGHT: Record<SectionId, readonly [phone: number, desktop: number]> = {
    about: [2200, 1200],
    journey: [1300, 960],
    services: [1250, 760],
    reasons: [2200, 1500],
    experience: [2400, 1600],
    skills: [900, 820],
    projects: [3100, 1700],
    certifications: [1750, 960],
    metrics: [720, 560],
    resume: [1300, 840],
    testimonials: [920, 760],
    contact: [1200, 760],
};

export function Section(props: SectionProps) {
    // A section keeps its id for its whole life: the home page keys each slot by it.
    // eslint-disable-next-line solid/reactivity
    useSectionReady(props.id);
    const split = () => props.layout === "split";
    const pair = () => props.layout === "pair";
    return (
        // A link of the header jumps here: the section takes the focus, so the next Tab continues inside it, and as it
        // is no control it shows no ring.
        <section
            id={props.id}
            aria-labelledby={`${props.id}-title`}
            tabindex={-1}
            class={cn("section focus-visible:outline-none", props.tone === "raised" && "bg-surface", props.class)}
            style={{
                "--section-height": `${HEIGHT[props.id][0]}px`,
                "--section-height-lg": `${HEIGHT[props.id][1]}px`,
            }}
        >
            <div
                class={cn("container-page", split() && "lg:grid lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,2.15fr)] lg:gap-16",
                    pair() && "lg:grid lg:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-16")}>
                <Show when={!split() && !pair()} fallback={
                    <>
                        <header
                            class={cn("section-enter mb-8 md:mb-10", split() ? "lg:sticky lg:top-28 lg:mb-0 lg:self-start" : "lg:mb-0")}>
                            <h2 id={`${props.id}-title`} class="text-heading text-fg">
                                {props.title}
                            </h2>
                            <Show when={props.subtitle}>
                                <p class={cn("mt-3 text-fg-muted", split() ? "text-base lg:text-lg" : "text-base sm:text-lg")}>{props.subtitle}</p>
                            </Show>
                            {props.intro}
                        </header>
                        <div class="min-w-0">{props.children}</div>
                    </>
                }>
                    <div class="min-w-0">
                        {/* The heading rises into place as the section enters (globals.css, section-enter). */}
                        <header class="section-enter mb-8 max-w-3xl md:mb-10">
                            <h2 id={`${props.id}-title`} class="text-heading text-fg">
                                {props.title}
                            </h2>
                            <Show when={props.subtitle}>
                                <p class="mt-3 text-base text-fg-muted sm:text-lg">{props.subtitle}</p>
                            </Show>
                            {props.intro}
                        </header>
                        <div class="min-w-0">{props.children}</div>
                    </div>
                    {props.screens}
                </Show>
            </div>
        </section>
    );
}

                    <p class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{ui.footer.elsewhere}</p>
                    <ul translate="no" class="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <For each={socialLinks}>{(link) => (
                            <li>
                                <a
                                    href={link.href}
                                    target="_blank"
                                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                    class="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center rounded-full border border-border px-4 text-sm text-fg-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary hover:text-primary"
                                >
                                    {link.label}
                                </a>
                            </li>
                        )}</For>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </div>
            <p class="container-page mt-10 text-sm text-fg-subtle">
                © {BUILD_YEAR} {profile.name}. {ui.footer.rights}
            </p>
        </footer>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/layout/SiteHeader.tsx
================================================
import {createSignal, For, onCleanup, onMount, Show} from "solid-js";
import {Menu, X} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";
import {profile} from "@/content/shared/profile";
import {useContent} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {LanguageSwitcher} from "@/components/layout/LanguageSwitcher";
import {ThemeToggle} from "@/components/layout/ThemeToggle";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import type {SectionId} from "@/types/content";

/** How far the page scrolls before the header folds into its floating name and controls. */
const FOLD_AT = 48;

/**
 * Primary sections shown in the horizontal desktop bar so it always stays on a single clean line across every
 * breakpoint (1280px through 2560px); all twelve sections remain accessible from the menu button panel.
 */
const PRIMARY_NAV = new Set<SectionId>(["about", "experience", "projects", "skills", "services", "contact"]);

interface SiteHeaderProps {
    sections: SectionId[];
    /** Pages other than the home page link each section back to the home page of the current role view. */
    homeLinks?: boolean;
    languageHref?: string;
}

/**
 * Tells which section of the home page is being read, for the link that marks it: the one that crosses the middle of
 * the screen, and none while the hero is there. Browsers that track the links of a list themselves
 * (scroll-target-group) always keep one link current, which here would mark the first section from the top of the
 * page, so every browser gets the same observer.
 */
function useCurrentSection(sections: () => SectionId[], enabled: () => boolean) {
    const [current, setCurrent] = createSignal<SectionId | null>(null);
    onMount(() => {
        if (!enabled() || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            for (const entry of entries) {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) setCurrent(entry.target.id as SectionId);
                else setCurrent((id) => (id === entry.target.id ? null : id));
            }
        }, {rootMargin: "-50% 0px -50% 0px"});
        for (const id of sections()) {
            const section = document.getElementById(id);
            if (section) observer.observe(section);
        }
        onCleanup(() => observer.disconnect());
    });
    return current;
}

/**
 * The header. At the top of a page it is a quiet bar: the name, the sections and the controls. Once the reader
 * scrolls, the bar folds away and leaves two small floating pieces, so the page has the screen: the name at the left,
 * so whose page this is never leaves the screen, and at the right a capsule with the theme and a round menu button
 * whose panel lists every section, the one being read marked. Below 80rem the sections always live in that panel.
 */
export function SiteHeader(props: SiteHeaderProps) {
    const {ui} = useContent();
    const {role, pathFor} = useRole();
    const [open, setOpen] = createSignal(false);
    const [folded, setFolded] = createSignal(false);
    const items = () => props.sections;
    const primaryItems = () => props.sections.filter((section) => PRIMARY_NAV.has(section));
    const current = useCurrentSection(items, () => !props.homeLinks);
    let panel: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
    let toggle: HTMLButtonElement | undefined;

    onMount(() => {
        let frame = 0;
        const update = () => {
            frame = 0;
            setFolded(window.scrollY > FOLD_AT);
        };
        const schedule = () => {
            if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(update);
        };
        update();
        window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, {passive: true});
        // The panel closes with Escape, which hands the focus back to its button, or with a press anywhere outside it.
        const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
            if (event.key !== "Escape" || !open()) return;
            setOpen(false);
            toggle?.focus();
        };
        const onPointer = (event: PointerEvent) => {
            const target = event.target as Node;
            if (open() && !panel?.contains(target) && !toggle?.contains(target)) setOpen(false);
        };
        document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
        document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointer);
        onCleanup(() => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
            window.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
            document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
            document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointer);
        });
    });

    const hrefOf = (section: SectionId) => (props.homeLinks ? withBase(pathFor(role(), section)) : `#${section}`);

    return (
        <header
            class="site-header fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-50"
            data-folded={folded() || undefined}
            data-open={open() || undefined}
        >
            <span aria-hidden="true" class="header-backdrop"/>
            <div class="container-page relative flex h-(--header-height) items-center justify-between gap-3 sm:gap-6">
                {/* The whole name at every width: folded, it is the pill that keeps whose page this is in sight. */}
                <Link to={pathFor(role())}
                      class="header-brand shrink-0 rounded-full text-sm leading-tight tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap text-fg hover:text-fg-muted sm:text-lg">
                    {profile.name}
                    <span class="sr-only"> · {ui.home}</span>
                </Link>

                {/* Primary sections in a strictly single-line bar; the full list of sections stays in the menu panel. */}
                <nav aria-label={ui.navLabel} class="header-nav hidden min-w-0 flex-1 xl:block">
                    <ul class="flex flex-nowrap items-center justify-center gap-x-1.5">
                        <For each={primaryItems()}>
                            {(section) => (
                                <li class="shrink-0">
                                    <a
                                        href={hrefOf(section)}
                                        aria-current={current() === section ? "true" : undefined}
                                        class="block rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm whitespace-nowrap text-fg-muted decoration-1 underline-offset-[0.35rem] transition-colors hover:text-fg aria-[current=true]:text-fg aria-[current=true]:underline"
                                    >
                                        {ui.nav[section]}
                                    </a>
                                </li>
                            )}
                        </For>
                    </ul>
                </nav>

                <div class="header-controls flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full p-1">
                    <LanguageSwitcher href={props.languageHref} class="header-language"/>
                    <ThemeToggle/>
                    <button
                        ref={toggle}
                        type="button"
                        class="header-menu-button inline-flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary text-on-primary transition-colors hover:bg-primary-hover"
                        aria-expanded={open()}
                        aria-controls="site-menu"
                        aria-label={open() ? ui.menu.close : ui.menu.open}
                        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
                    >
                        <Show when={open()} fallback={<Menu class="size-[1.125rem]"/>}>
                            <X class="size-[1.125rem]"/>
                        </Show>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* The panel exists only while open: it needs the button, so the prerendered page leaves it out. */}
            <Show when={open()}>
                <div
                    ref={panel}
                    id="site-menu"
                    class="site-menu appear"
                >
                    <nav aria-label={ui.navLabel}>
                        <ul class="grid gap-0.5">
                            <For each={items()}>
                                {(section) => (
                                    <li>
                                        <a
                                            href={hrefOf(section)}
                                            aria-current={current() === section ? "true" : undefined}
                                            onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                                            class="group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-fg-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised hover:text-fg aria-[current=true]:text-fg"
                                        >
                                        <span aria-hidden="true"
                                              class="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-transparent group-aria-[current=true]:bg-accent"/>
                                            {ui.nav[section]}
                                        </a>
                                    </li>
                                )}
                            </For>
                        </ul>
                    </nav>
                    <div class="mt-2 border-t border-border px-3 pt-3 pb-1">
                        <LanguageSwitcher href={props.languageHref} class="w-full justify-center"/>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </Show>
            {/* How far down the page the reader is (globals.css, .reading-progress). */}
            <span aria-hidden="true" class="reading-progress"/>
        </header>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/layout/ThemeToggle.tsx
================================================
import {createSignal, onMount} from "solid-js";
import {Moon, Sun} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {useContent} from "@/context/language";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";

type Theme = "light" | "dark";

const STORAGE_KEY = "theme";
// The browser's bar takes the page's background in each theme.
const BAR_COLORS: Record<Theme, string> = {light: "#fbfcfd", dark: "#0d0d0d"};

/** The theme the page shows: the one the reader pinned (Page.astro sets it before the first paint) or dark by default. */
const currentTheme = (): Theme => {
    const pinned = document.documentElement.dataset.theme;
    return pinned === "light" ? "light" : "dark";
};

/**
 * Switches between the dark (default) and the light theme and remembers the choice for the next visit.
 */
export function ThemeToggle(props: { class?: string }) {
    const {ui} = useContent();
    const [theme, setTheme] = createSignal<Theme>("dark");

    onMount(() => {
        setTheme(currentTheme());
    });

    const toggle = () => {
        const next: Theme = theme() === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
        document.documentElement.dataset.theme = next;
        for (const meta of document.querySelectorAll<HTMLMetaElement>('meta[name="theme-color"]')) meta.content = BAR_COLORS[next];
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next);
        } catch {
            // Storage may be off (a private window): the choice then lasts for this page only.
        }
        setTheme(next);
    };

    return (
        <button
            type="button"
            onClick={toggle}
            aria-label={theme() === "dark" ? ui.theme.toLight : ui.theme.toDark}
            class={cn(
                "inline-flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-fg-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised hover:text-fg",
                props.class,
            )}
        >
            {theme() === "dark" ? <Sun class="size-[1.125rem]"/> : <Moon class="size-[1.125rem]"/>}
        </button>
    );
}

import {createEffect, createSignal, For, type JSX, on, onCleanup, onMount, Show} from "solid-js";
import {ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Check, ChevronRight, Copy} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";

// The pieces the project pages and the job, program, certification and organization pages share: the sections of
// the article, the page index beside it and the links to the pages before and after.

export function TextSection(props: { id: string; title: string; children: JSX.Element }) {

/** The section being read: the last of the page's headings that has passed the top third of the window. */
function useActiveSection(ids: () => string[]) {
    const [active, setActive] = createSignal<string | null>(null);
    onMount(() => {
        createEffect(on(() => ids().join(" "), (key) => {
            const headings = key.split(" ").map((id) => document.getElementById(id)).filter((heading) => heading !== null);
            let frame = 0;
            const update = () => {
                cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
                frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    // Short sections at the end never reach the top third, so the bottom of the page marks the last one.
                    const bottom = window.innerHeight + window.scrollY >= document.documentElement.scrollHeight - 2;
                    const passed = headings.filter((heading) => heading.getBoundingClientRect().top <= window.innerHeight / 3);
                    setActive((bottom && passed.length > 0 ? headings : passed).at(-1)?.id ?? null);
                });
            };
            update();
            window.addEventListener("scroll", update, {passive: true});
            window.addEventListener("resize", update);
            onCleanup(() => {
                cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
                window.removeEventListener("scroll", update);
                window.removeEventListener("resize", update);
            });
        }));
    });
    return active;
}

/**
 * The sections of the page. From 80rem it sits beside the text and marks the section being read; on narrower screens it
 * folds into a menu above the article that closes once a section is picked, and opens without JavaScript too.
 */
export function PageIndex(props: { label: string; sections: { id: string; title: string }[] }) {
    const active = useActiveSection(() => props.sections.map((section) => section.id));
    const [open, setOpen] = createSignal(false);
    const links = (onPick?: () => void) => (
        <ul class="mt-3 space-y-1 border-l border-border text-sm">
            <For each={props.sections}>
                {(section) => (
                    <li>
                        <a href={`#${section.id}`} aria-current={active() === section.id ? "location" : undefined}
                           onClick={() => onPick?.()}
                           class={cn(
                               "-ml-px block border-l py-1.5 pl-4 hover:border-primary hover:text-primary",
                               active() === section.id ? "border-primary text-fg" : "border-transparent text-fg-muted",
                           )}>
                            {section.title}
                        </a>
                    </li>
                )}
            </For>
        </ul>
    );
    return (
        <>
            <details open={open()} onToggle={(event) => setOpen(event.currentTarget.open)}
                     class="mt-8 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface xl:hidden">
                <summary
                    class="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{props.label}</summary>
                <nav aria-label={props.label} class="px-4 pb-4">{links(() => setOpen(false))}</nav>
            </details>
            <nav aria-label={props.label} class="sticky top-24 mt-10 hidden xl:block">
                <p class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{props.label}</p>
                {links()}
            </nav>
        </>
    );
}

/** Copies with the selection command, for browsers without the clipboard API or with its permission denied. */
const copyBySelection = (text: string) => {
    const field = document.createElement("textarea");
    field.value = text;
    field.setAttribute("readonly", "");
    field.className = "fixed opacity-0";
    document.body.append(field);
    field.select();
    const copied = document.execCommand("copy");
    field.remove();
    return copied;
};

/** Copies the page's address, role view included, and says for a moment whether it worked. */
export function CopyLink() {
    const {content: {ui}} = useLanguage();
    const [result, setResult] = createSignal<"copied" | "failed" | null>(null);
    createEffect(on(result, (current) => {
        if (!current) return;
        const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setResult(null), 2500);
        onCleanup(() => window.clearTimeout(timer));
    }, {defer: true}));
    const copy = async () => {
        const url = window.location.href;
        try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
            setResult("copied");
        } catch {
            setResult(copyBySelection(url) ? "copied" : "failed");
        }
    };
    const label = () => {
        const current = result();
        return current ? ui.copyLink[current] : ui.copyLink.copy;
    };
    return (
        <button type="button" onClick={copy}
                class="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-fg-muted hover:border-primary hover:text-primary">
            <Show when={result() === "copied"} fallback={<Copy class="size-4"/>}>
                <Check class="size-4"/>
            </Show>
            <span aria-live="polite">{label()}</span>
        </button>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/page/Timeline.tsx
================================================
import {type Component, createMemo, createSignal, For, Show} from "solid-js";
import {Dynamic} from "solid-js/web";
import {Award, Briefcase, Flag, FolderGit2, GraduationCap, type IconProps, Quote} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useHydrated} from "@/hooks/useHydrated";
import {ToggleButton} from "@/components/ui/ToggleButton";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";
import {TIMELINE_KINDS, type TimelineItem, type TimelineKind, type TimelineLabels} from "@/types/timeline";

const ICONS: Record<TimelineKind, Component<IconProps>> = {
    job: Briefcase,
    program: GraduationCap,
    project: FolderGit2,
    recommendation: Quote,
    certification: Award,
    milestone: Flag,
};

/**
 * Dated entries grouped by year, oldest first, with a filter by kind when there is more than one. Every entry is in the
 * prerendered HTML; the filter only hides entries once the page is interactive.
 */
export function Timeline(props: { items: TimelineItem[]; labels: TimelineLabels }) {
    const {content: {ui}} = useLanguage();
    const interactive = useHydrated();
    const [kind, setKind] = createSignal<TimelineKind | null>(null);
    const sorted = createMemo(() => [...props.items].sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)));
    const kinds = () => TIMELINE_KINDS.filter((value) => sorted().some((item) => item.kind === value));
    const shown = createMemo(() => {
        const current = kind();
        return current ? sorted().filter((item) => item.kind === current) : sorted();
    });
    const years = () => [...new Set(shown().map((item) => item.date.slice(0, 4)))];
    const countOf = (value: TimelineKind | null) => (value ? sorted().filter((item) => item.kind === value).length : sorted().length);

    return (
        <div>
            <Show when={kinds().length > 1}>
                <div role="group" aria-label={props.labels.filter} data-interactive={interactive() || undefined}
                     class="mb-8 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <For each={[null, ...kinds()]}>
                        {(value) => (
                            <ToggleButton pressed={kind() === value} onClick={() => setKind(value)}
                                          count={countOf(value)}>
                                {value ? props.labels.kinds[value] : props.labels.all}
                            </ToggleButton>
                        )}
                    </For>
                </div>
            </Show>
            <ol class="space-y-8">
                <For each={years()}>{(year) => (
                    <li class="section-enter sm:grid sm:grid-cols-[4rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-6">
                        {/* The year stays in view beside its entries while they scroll past. */}
                        <h3 class="font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-fg sm:sticky sm:top-24 sm:self-start">{year}</h3>
                        <ol class="mt-3 ml-3 space-y-5 border-l border-border pl-7 sm:mt-0">
                            <For each={shown().filter((item) => item.date.startsWith(year))}>{(item) => {
                                const month = item.date.length === 7 ? ui.months[Number(item.date.slice(5, 7)) - 1] : null;
                                return (
                                    <li class="relative">
                                        <span aria-hidden="true"
                                              class="absolute top-0 -left-[2.6rem] grid size-6 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border bg-surface text-primary">
                                            <Dynamic component={ICONS[item.kind]} class="size-3.5"/>
                                        </span>
                                        <Show when={month}>
                                            <p class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{month}</p>
                                        </Show>
                                        <p class="text-fg">
                                            <Show when={item.to} fallback={item.text}>
                                                {(to) => (
                                                    <Link to={to()}
                                                          class="font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover">{item.text}</Link>
                                                )}
                                            </Show>
                                        </p>
                                        <Show when={item.note}>
                                            <p class="mt-0.5 text-sm text-fg-muted">{item.note}</p>
                                        </Show>
                                    </li>
                                );
                            }}</For>
                        </ol>
                    </li>
                )}</For>
            </ol>
            <p aria-live="polite"
               class="sr-only">{kind() ? props.labels.showing.replace("{count}", String(shown().length)) : ""}</p>
        </div>
    );
}

import {splitProps} from "solid-js";
import {ArtTile, type ArtTileProps} from "@/components/ui/ArtTile";

interface ProjectTileProps extends Omit<ArtTileProps, "art" | "keepName"> {
    id: ProjectId;
}

/**
 * A project at a glance: its illustration on its own layer of color, its name and a few words, and nothing else. The
 * whole tile is the link to its page, which tells the rest.
 */
export function ProjectTile(props: ProjectTileProps) {

import {createMemo, createSignal, createUniqueId, For, Show} from "solid-js";
import type {RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import {useSectionCopy} from "@/content/sections";
import {PROJECT_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {projects} from "@/content/shared/projects";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {buildProjectPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import {isFocusTech, orderTech} from "@/lib/role-view";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";
import type {ProjectId} from "@/types/project";

interface TechExplorerProps {
    tech: readonly string[];
    role: RoleId | null;
    /** The project whose page this is, left out of the lists. */
    exclude?: ProjectId;
    /** Projects listed before the rest, such as the ones of the job whose page this is. */
    first?: readonly ProjectId[];
}

/**
 * A stack where each technology is a button that lists the projects using it, with a link to each. The chips are in the
 * prerendered page; the lists appear once it is interactive.
 */
export function TechExplorer(props: TechExplorerProps) {
    const {lang} = useLanguage();
    const {locked} = useRole();
    const cards = useSectionCopy("projects");
    const labels = cards.techExplorer;
    const panel = createUniqueId();
    const [picked, setPicked] = createSignal<string | null>(null);
    const listed = createMemo(() => {
        const tech = picked();
        const first = props.first ?? [];
        const using = tech ? projects.filter((project) => project.id !== props.exclude && project.tech.includes(tech)) : [];
        return [...using.filter((project) => first.includes(project.id)), ...using.filter((project) => !first.includes(project.id))];
    });
    const empty = () => (props.exclude ? labels.noOther : labels.none);

    return (
        <div>
            <p class="mb-3 text-sm text-fg-subtle">{labels.hint}</p>
            <ul translate="no" class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                <For each={orderTech(props.tech, props.role)}>
                    {(item) => (
                        <li>
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                aria-pressed={picked() === item}
                                aria-controls={panel}
                                onClick={() => setPicked(picked() === item ? null : item)}
                                class={cn(
                                    "rounded border px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs transition-colors",
                                    picked() === item
                                        ? "border-primary bg-primary text-on-primary"
                                        : cn("hover:border-primary hover:text-primary", isFocusTech(item, props.role) ? "border-primary/50 text-primary" : "border-border text-fg-subtle"),
                                )}
                            >
                                {item}
                            </button>
                        </li>
                    )}
                </For>
            </ul>
            <div id={panel} aria-live="polite">
                <Show when={picked()}>
                    {(tech) => (
                        <div class="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-4">
                            <p class="font-semibold text-fg">
                                {(listed().length > 0 ? labels.usedIn : empty()).replace("{tech}", tech()).replace("{count}", String(listed().length))}
                            </p>
                            <Show when={listed().length > 0}>
                                <ul class="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
                                    <For each={listed()}>
                                        {(project) => (
                                            <li>
                                                <Link to={buildProjectPath(lang, {
                                                    slug: PROJECT_SLUG[project.id],
                                                    locked: locked()
                                                })}
                                                      class="font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover">
                                                    {cards.items[project.id].name}
                                                </Link>
                                                <span
                                                    class="text-sm text-fg-subtle"> · {cards.items[project.id].context}</span>
                                            </li>
                                        )}
                                    </For>
                                </ul>
                            </Show>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </Show>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

const RAW_ASCII_ART = String.raw`
                               \\\\\\\
                              \\\\\\\\\\\\
                            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\
    -----------,-|           |C>   // )\\\\|
             ,','|          /    || ,'/////|
  ---------,','  |         (,    ||   /////
           ||    |          \\  ||||//''''|
           ||    |           |||||||     _|
           ||    |______      ${"`````"}\____/ \
           ||    |     ,|         _/_____/ \
           ||  ,'    ,' |        /          |
           ||,'    ,'   |       |         \  |
  _________|/    ,'     |      /           | |
  _____________,'      ,',_____|      |    | |
               |     ,','      |      |    | |
               |   ,','    ____|_____/    /  |
               | ,','  __/ |             /   |
  _____________|','   ///_/-------------/   |
                |===========,'`;

const asciiLines = RAW_ASCII_ART.replace(/^\n/, "").split("\n");
const asciiIndent = Math.min(...asciiLines.filter((line) => line.trim()).map((line) => line.length - line.trimStart().length));
const ASCII_ART = asciiLines.map((line) => line.slice(asciiIndent).trimEnd()).join("\n");
// Its widest line sizes the font to the frame; its number of lines lets it print one line at a time (globals.css).
const ASCII_STYLE = {
    "--ascii-cols": String(Math.max(...ASCII_ART.split("\n").map((line) => line.length))),
    "--ascii-rows": String(ASCII_ART.split("\n").length),
};

const LINK = "inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover";

                <span class="size-2.5 rounded-full bg-danger/70"/>
                <span class="size-2.5 rounded-full bg-warning/70"/>
                <span class="size-2.5 rounded-full bg-success/70"/>
                <span class="ml-2 truncate font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">~/sebastian</span>
            </div>
            <div aria-hidden="true" translate="no"
                 class="ascii-frame flex flex-1 flex-col justify-center px-4 py-5 sm:px-6">
                <p class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">$ cat engineer.txt</p>
                <pre class="ascii-art my-auto pt-3 font-mono text-primary/80"
                     style={ASCII_STYLE}>{ASCII_ART}</pre>
            </div>
        </figure>
    );
}

import {createMemo, createSignal, For, Show} from "solid-js";
import {ArrowRight, ExternalLink} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {forProfile} from "@/content/roles";
import {certifications} from "@/content/shared/certifications";
import {CERTIFICATION_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/detail-links";
import {milestones} from "@/content/shared/journey";
import {useSectionCopy} from "@/content/sections";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {useJourneyCopy} from "@/hooks/useJourneyCopy";
import {Section} from "@/components/layout/Section";
import {LineKey} from "@/components/journey/LineKey";
import {formatYearMonth} from "@/lib/format";
import {buildDetailPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import {prioritize, split} from "@/lib/role-view";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";

const VISIBLE_CERTIFICATIONS = 6;
const STOPS = new Map(milestones.map((milestone) => [milestone.id, milestone]));

export function CertificationsSection() {
    const {lang, content: {ui}} = useLanguage();
    const copy = useSectionCopy("certifications");
    const journey = useJourneyCopy();
    const {role, locked} = useRole();
    const [expanded, setExpanded] = createSignal(false);
    const ordered = createMemo(() => prioritize(certifications, (item) => item.roles, role()));
    const parts = createMemo(() => split(ordered(), VISIBLE_CERTIFICATIONS));
    const items = () => (expanded() ? ordered() : parts().visible);

    return (
        <Section id="certifications" title={copy.title} subtitle={forProfile(copy.subtitle, role())} tone="raised">
            {/* Rows of an index split by hairlines, two across from 48rem; the full list of 29 reads the same way. */}
            <ul class="enter-each grid border-b border-border md:grid-cols-2 md:gap-x-12">
                <For each={items()}>{(item) => {
                    const text = copy.items[item.id];
                    const stop = STOPS.get(item.milestone)!;
                    return (
                        <li class="flex gap-4 border-t border-border py-5">
                            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                                <h3 class="text-fg">
                                    <Link to={buildDetailPath(lang, "certifications", {
                                        slug: CERTIFICATION_SLUG[item.id],
                                        locked: locked()
                                    })} class="inline-block py-0.5 leading-snug hover:text-primary">
                                        {item.title}
                                    </Link>
                                </h3>
                                <p class="text-xs font-mono text-fg-subtle">
                                    {item.issuer} · {formatYearMonth(item.date, ui.months)}
                                </p>
                                <p class="mt-2 text-sm text-fg-muted">{text.learned}</p>
                                <p class="mt-1.5 text-sm text-fg">
                                    <span class="font-semibold text-primary">{copy.labels.adds}: </span>
                                    {text.adds}
                                </p>
                                <div class="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
                                    <p class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-xs text-fg-subtle">
                                        <span>{copy.labels.stop}:</span>
                                        <a href="#journey"
                                           class="inline-flex min-h-7 items-center font-semibold text-fg-muted hover:text-primary">
                                            {journey.milestones[stop.id].title}
                                        </a>
                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                            <For each={stop.lines}>{(line) => <LineKey line={line}/>}</For>
                                            <span
                                                class="sr-only">{stop.lines.map((line) => journey.lines[line]).join(", ")}</span>
                                        </span>
                                    </p>
                                    <Show when={item.url}>{(url) => (
                                        <a
                                            href={url()}
                                            target="_blank"
                                            rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                            class="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover"
                                        >
                                            {ui.actions.viewCredential}
                                            <ExternalLink class="size-4"/>
                                        </a>
                                    )}</Show>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </li>
                    );
                }}</For>
            </ul>
            <div class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                <Show when={parts().hidden.length > 0}>
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        aria-expanded={expanded()}
                        onClick={() => setExpanded((value) => !value)}
                        class="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center rounded-full border border-border-strong px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-fg hover:border-primary hover:text-primary"
                    >
                        {expanded() ? ui.actions.showFewer : `${ui.actions.showAll} (${ordered().length})`}
                    </button>
                </Show>
                <Link
                    to={buildDetailPath(lang, "certifications", {locked: locked()})}
                    class="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover"
                >
                    {copy.labels.index}
                    <ArrowRight class="size-4"/>
                </Link>
            </div>
        </Section>
    );
}

import {createSignal, For, onCleanup, onMount, Show} from "solid-js";

export function ContactSection() {

    onMount(() => {
        const section = document.getElementById("contact");
        if (!section || !("IntersectionObserver" in window)) return;
        const root = document.documentElement;
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => root.toggleAttribute("data-contact-visible", entry.isIntersecting));
        observer.observe(section);
        onCleanup(() => {
            observer.disconnect();
            root.removeAttribute("data-contact-visible");
        });
    });

    // Both buttons submit the form, so the browser checks the required fields before either app opens.
    const submit = (event: SubmitEvent) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (event.submitter?.getAttribute("value") === "email") {
            window.location.href = mailtoUrl(contact.emailSubject, form());
        } else {
            window.open(whatsappUrl(contact.whatsappIntro, form()), "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
        }
    };
    const update = (field: "name" | "email" | "message") => (event: InputEvent & {
        currentTarget: HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement
    }) =>
        setForm((current) => ({...current, [field]: event.currentTarget.value}));

    const copyEmail = async () => {
        try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(profile.email);
            setCopied("done");
        } catch {
            setCopied("failed");
        }
    };

    const copiedLabel = () => {
        const state = copied();
        return state ? contact.copyEmail[state] : "";
    };

    // On a phone the address wraps at the @ instead of mid-word.
    const [mailbox, domain] = profile.email.split("@");
    const details = [
        {icon: MapPin, label: contact.labels.location, value: hero.location},
        {icon: Phone, label: contact.labels.phone, value: profile.phone.display, href: `tel:${profile.phone.e164}`},
        {
            icon: Mail,
            label: contact.labels.email,
            value: <>{mailbox}
                <wbr/>
                @{domain}</>,
            href: `mailto:${profile.email}`,
            copy: true
        },
        {icon: LinkedinIcon, label: contact.labels.linkedin, value: "sebastianlopezosorno", href: profile.linkedin},
    ];

    return (
        // The ways to reach me sit under the title, and the form beside them starts level with the title.
        <Section id="contact" title={contact.title} subtitle={forProfile(contact.subtitle, role())} tone="raised"
                 layout="pair" intro={
            <div class="mt-10">
                <h3 class="text-title text-fg">{contact.connect}</h3>
                <p class="mt-3 text-fg-muted">{contact.description}</p>
                <ul class="mt-8 space-y-5">
                    <For each={details}>{(detail) => (
                        <li class="flex items-center gap-4">
                            <span
                                class="grid size-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md border border-border bg-surface text-primary">
                                <Dynamic component={detail.icon} class="size-5"/>
                            </span>
                            <div class="min-w-0">
                                <p class="text-sm text-fg-subtle">{detail.label}</p>
                                <p class="wrap-anywhere text-fg">
                                    <Show when={detail.href} fallback={detail.value}>
                                        {(href) => (
                                            <a href={href()} class="hover:text-primary"
                                               target={href().startsWith("http") ? "_blank" : undefined}
                                               rel={href().startsWith("http") ? "noopener noreferrer" : undefined}>
                                                {detail.value}
                                            </a>
                                        )}
                                    </Show>
                                </p>
                                <Show when={detail.copy}>
                                    <p role="status" class="text-sm text-fg-subtle">{copiedLabel()}</p>
                                </Show>
                            </div>
                            <Show when={detail.copy}>
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={copyEmail}
                                    aria-label={contact.copyEmail.label}
                                    title={contact.copyEmail.label}
                                    class="grid size-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md border border-border text-fg-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary hover:text-primary"
                                >
                                    <Show when={copied() === "done"} fallback={<Copy class="size-5"/>}>
                                        <Check class="size-5"/>
                                    </Show>
                                </button>
                            </Show>
                        </li>
                    )}</For>
                </ul>
            </div>
        }>
            <form onSubmit={submit}
                  class="space-y-5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-6 shadow-card">
                <div>
                    <label for="contact-name"
                           class="mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-fg">{contact.form.name}</label>
                    <Input id="contact-name" name="name" autocomplete="name" required value={form().name}
                           placeholder={contact.placeholders.name}
                           onInput={update("name")}/>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <label for="contact-email"
                           class="mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-fg">{contact.form.email}</label>
                    <Input id="contact-email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" spellcheck={false}
                           required value={form().email}
                           placeholder={contact.placeholders.email}
                           onInput={update("email")}/>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <label for="contact-message"
                           class="mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold text-fg">{contact.form.message}</label>
                    <Textarea id="contact-message" name="message" rows={5} required prop:value={form().message}
                              placeholder={contact.placeholders.message}
                              onInput={update("message")}/>
                </div>
                {/* Side by side only when both labels fit whole; otherwise each button takes its own row. */}
                <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        name="channel"
                        value="whatsapp"
                        class="inline-flex h-12 flex-auto items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap text-on-primary hover:bg-primary-hover active:translate-y-px"
                    >
                        <Send class="size-5"/>
                        {contact.form.send}
                    </button>
                    <button
                        type="submit"
                        name="channel"
                        value="email"
                        class="inline-flex h-12 flex-auto items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border-strong px-5 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap text-fg transition-colors hover:border-primary hover:text-primary active:translate-y-px"
                    >
                        <Mail class="size-5"/>
                        {contact.form.sendEmail}
                    </button>
                </div>
                <p class="text-center text-xs text-fg-subtle">{contact.form.note}</p>
            </form>
        </Section>
    );
}

import {createMemo, createSignal, For, onCleanup, onMount, Show} from "solid-js";
import {ArrowRight, ChevronDown} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {forProfile, type RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import {EXPERIENCE_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/detail-links";
import {EXPERIENCE_PROJECTS, PROJECT_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {experience} from "@/content/shared/experience";
import {PROJECT_ART} from "@/content/shared/project-art";
import {useSectionCopy} from "@/content/sections";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {Section} from "@/components/layout/Section";
import {formatDuration, formatRange, monthsBetween} from "@/lib/format";
import {buildDetailPath, buildProjectPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import {More} from "@/components/ui/More";
import {TechList} from "@/components/ui/TechList";
import {useHydrated} from "@/hooks/useHydrated";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {setAll, watch} from "@/lib/disclosures";
import {countMatches, orderExperience, prioritize, split} from "@/lib/role-view";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";
import type {Bullet, ExperienceFacts} from "@/types/content";

// In a role view a job shows up to three achievements that match it; the rest, and all of them otherwise, open on demand.
const MAX_RELEVANT_BULLETS = 3;

function BulletItem(props: { bullet: Bullet; role: RoleId | null }) {
    const match = () => props.role !== null && props.bullet.roles.includes(props.role);
    return (
        <li class={cn("flex gap-3", match() && "text-fg")}>
            <span aria-hidden="true"
                  class={cn("mt-2.5 size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full", props.role && !match() ? "border border-fg-subtle" : "bg-fg")}
            />
            {props.bullet.text}
        </li>
    );
}

function ExperienceItem(props: { facts: ExperienceFacts; role: RoleId | null }) {
    const {lang, content: {ui}} = useLanguage();
    const copy = useSectionCopy("experience");
    const {locked} = useRole();
    const projectCopy = useSectionCopy("projects");
    const related = () => EXPERIENCE_PROJECTS[props.facts.id] ?? [];
    const item = () => copy.items[props.facts.id];
    const matches = () => countMatches(item().bullets, props.role);
    // In a role view the achievements that match it lead, and the first of them stay in view; the rest fold away.
    const bullets = createMemo(() => {
        const ordered = prioritize(item().bullets, (bullet) => bullet.roles, props.role);
        return split(ordered, props.role ? Math.min(matches(), MAX_RELEVANT_BULLETS) : 0);
    });
    const meta = () => [ui.workMode[props.facts.workMode], props.facts.employment && ui.employment[props.facts.employment]].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    const detail = () => buildDetailPath(lang, "experience", {slug: EXPERIENCE_SLUG[props.facts.id], locked: locked()});

    return (
        // One job is one row of the index: its dates, its title and company with a sentence, and what it is now. Its
        // achievements, stack and projects open in place; its page tells the whole story.
        <li class="timeline-card grid gap-x-8 gap-y-2 border-t border-border py-6 md:grid-cols-[11rem_minmax(0,1fr)]">
            <div class="font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed text-fg-subtle">
                <p>{formatRange(props.facts.start, props.facts.end, ui.months, ui.present)}</p>
                <p>{formatDuration(monthsBetween(props.facts.start, props.facts.end), lang)}</p>
            </div>
            <div class="min-w-0">
                <div class="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-x-6 gap-y-2">
                    <div>
                        <h3 class="text-title text-fg">
                            <Link to={detail()} class="hover:text-fg-muted">{item().title}</Link>
                        </h3>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-fg-muted sm:text-base">
                            {props.facts.company}
                            <span class="text-fg-subtle"> · {props.facts.location} · {meta()}</span>
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <Show when={props.role && matches() > 0}>
                            <span class="rounded-full bg-surface-raised px-3 py-1 font-mono text-xs text-fg">
                                {copy.matches.replace("{count}", String(matches())).replace("{total}", String(item().bullets.length))}
                            </span>
                        </Show>
                        <Show when={props.facts.end === null}>
                            <span
                                class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface-raised px-3 py-1 font-mono text-xs text-fg">
                                <span aria-hidden="true" class="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-success"/>
                                {copy.current}
                            </span>
                        </Show>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <p class="mt-3 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-fg-muted sm:text-base">{forProfile(item().summary, props.role)}</p>

                <Show when={bullets().visible.length > 0}>
                    <ul class="mt-3.5 max-w-3xl space-y-2 text-sm text-fg-muted sm:text-base">
                        <For each={bullets().visible}>{(bullet) => <BulletItem bullet={bullet}
                                                                               role={props.role}/>}</For>
                    </ul>
                </Show>

                <More class="mt-2.5" label={`${ui.actions.showMore} (${bullets().hidden.length})`}
                      openLabel={ui.actions.showLess}>
                    <div class="mt-4 grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.5fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
                        <ul class="space-y-2 text-sm text-fg-muted sm:text-base">
                            <For each={bullets().hidden}>{(bullet) => <BulletItem bullet={bullet}
                                                                                  role={props.role}/>}</For>
                        </ul>
                        {/* The first ten tools, the role view's first; the job's page lists them all. */}
                        <TechList tech={props.facts.tech} role={props.role} limit={10} class="content-start"/>
                    </div>
                </More>

                <Show when={related().length > 0}>
                    <div class="mt-3">
                        <p class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{copy.projects}</p>
                        <ul class="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                            <For each={related()}>
                                {(id) => (
                                    <li>
                                        <Link
                                            to={buildProjectPath(lang, {slug: PROJECT_SLUG[id], locked: locked()})}
                                            class="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border py-1 pr-3 pl-1 text-xs text-fg transition-colors hover:border-border-strong hover:bg-surface sm:text-sm"
                                        >
                                            <span class="grid size-6 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full"
                                                  style={{background: `var(--color-tile-${PROJECT_ART[id].tile})`}}>
                                                <img src={withBase(PROJECT_ART[id].file)} alt="" width={24} height={24}
                                                     loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="size-5"/>
                                            </span>
                                            {projectCopy.items[id].name}
                                        </Link>
                                    </li>
                                )}
                            </For>
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                </Show>

                {/* Titles, timeline, every achievement and the recommendations of this job live on its own page. */}
                <Link
                    to={detail()}
                    class="mt-4 inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface-raised px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-border"
                >
                    {copy.detail}
                    <ArrowRight class="size-4"/>
                </Link>
            </div>
        </li>
    );
}

export function ExperienceSection() {
    const {ui} = useLanguage().content;
    const copy = useSectionCopy("experience");
    const {role} = useRole();
    const jobs = createMemo(() => orderExperience(experience, (job) => copy.items[job.id].bullets, role()));
    const interactive = useHydrated();
    const [everything, setEverything] = createSignal(false);
    let list: HTMLOListElement | undefined;
    onMount(() => onCleanup(watch(list!, setEverything)));

    return (
        <Section id="experience" title={copy.title} subtitle={forProfile(copy.subtitle, role())}>
            <Show when={role()}>
                {(current) => (
                    <p class="-mt-4 mb-8 max-w-3xl text-sm text-fg-subtle">
                        {copy.relevanceNote.replace("{role}", ui.roleNames[current()])}
                    </p>
                )}
            </Show>
            {/* For a reader who wants every achievement at once; it only appears once the page can open them. */}
            <Show when={interactive()}>
                <div class="-mt-4 mb-6 flex justify-end">
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        aria-controls="experience-jobs"
                        onClick={() => setAll(list!, !everything())}
                        class="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border-strong px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised active:translate-y-px"
                    >
                        {everything() ? ui.actions.collapseAll : ui.actions.expandAll}
                        <ChevronDown
                            class={cn("size-4 motion-safe:transition-transform motion-safe:duration-400", everything() && "rotate-180")}/>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </Show>
            <ol ref={list} id="experience-jobs" class="enter-each border-b border-border">
                <For each={jobs()}>{(facts) => <ExperienceItem facts={facts} role={role()}/>}</For>
            </ol>
        </Section>
    );
}
