import {createSignal, For, onCleanup, onMount} from "solid-js";
import {ArrowRight, Download} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {HERO_ART, HERO_SPOTS} from "@/content/shared/project-art";
import {PROJECT_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {profile} from "@/content/shared/profile";
import {resumeVersions} from "@/content/shared/resume";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {buildProjectPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";
import profile480Avif from "@/assets/images/profile-480.avif?url";
import profile640Avif from "@/assets/images/profile-640.avif?url";
import profile480Webp from "@/assets/images/profile-480.webp?url";
import profile640Webp from "@/assets/images/profile-640.webp?url";

// Kept at the portrait's full measure so 1x and 1.25x screens load at least the 480px variant instead of a soft thumbnail.
const PHOTO_SIZES = "(min-width: 1024px) 24rem, (min-width: 640px) 20rem, 16rem";

export function HeroSection() {
    const {lang, content} = useLanguage();
    const {role, locked} = useRole();
    const {hero, ui} = content;
    const copy = () => hero.byProfile[role() ?? "general"];
    const cv = withBase(resumeVersions[0].files[lang]);
    let actions: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
    // Escape puts away a device's label without moving the pointer or the focus (WCAG 1.4.13); the next device the
    // pointer or the focus reaches shows its own again.
    const [quiet, setQuiet] = createSignal(false);

    onMount(() => {
        const dismiss = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
            if (event.key === "Escape") setQuiet(true);
        };
        document.addEventListener("keydown", dismiss);
        onCleanup(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", dismiss));
    });

    // The floating buttons take the bottom 9.5rem of a phone screen; while the hero's buttons sit there, the page flags
    // it and the floating buttons step aside (globals.css), so they never cover "Download CV" or "Contact me".
    onMount(() => {
        const element = actions;
        if (!element) return;
        const root = document.documentElement;
        let frame = 0;
        const update = () => {
            frame = 0;
            const {top, bottom} = element.getBoundingClientRect();
            root.toggleAttribute("data-hero-actions-covered", bottom > window.innerHeight - 152 && top < window.innerHeight);
        };
        const schedule = () => {
            if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(update);
        };
        update();
        window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, {passive: true});
        window.addEventListener("resize", schedule);
        // The buttons also move without a scroll: when the web fonts arrive or the copy changes with the role view, the
        // text above them takes another height.
        const observer = typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined" ? null : new ResizeObserver(schedule);
        observer?.observe(element.closest("section") ?? element);
        void document.fonts?.ready.then(schedule);
        onCleanup(() => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
            observer?.disconnect();
            window.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
            window.removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
            root.removeAttribute("data-hero-actions-covered");
        });
    });

    return (
        <section id="home" aria-labelledby="hero-title" class="hero-backdrop pt-(--header-height)">
            <div
                class="container-page grid items-center gap-x-12 gap-y-8 pt-8 pb-12 md:py-12 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.15fr)_minmax(0,1fr)] lg:py-8 xl:gap-x-16">
                <div class="hero-copy">
                    {/* The name and the role read as one statement in two tones, the way a title card does. */}
                    <h1 id="hero-title"
                        class="text-display tracking-tight">
                        <span class="block text-fg">{profile.name}</span>
                        <span
                            class="mt-2.5 block text-[0.56em] leading-tight tracking-tight text-fg-subtle">{copy().title}</span>
                    </h1>
                    <p class="mt-5 max-w-xl text-lg leading-snug text-fg md:text-xl">{copy().headline}</p>
                    <p class="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-fg-muted sm:text-base">{copy().summary}</p>

                    <div ref={actions} class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3 md:mt-8">
                        <a
                            href={cv}
                            download=""
                            class="inline-flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-on-primary transition-colors hover:bg-primary-hover active:translate-y-px sm:text-base"
                        >
                            <Download class="size-5"/>
                            {ui.actions.downloadCv}
                        </a>
                        <a
                            href="#contact"
                            class="inline-flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border-strong px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised active:translate-y-px sm:text-base"
                        >
                            {ui.actions.contact}
                            <ArrowRight class="size-5"/>
                        </a>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* The board: the portrait sits in the socket at its middle and cables run from it to the devices of
                    the work (scripts/illustrations/hero.mjs). The portrait is the largest paint, so it is drawn at
                    once; the drawing around it is decoration, and the links over its devices carry its meaning. The
                    role views have no switcher: each one is reached by its address (/en/backend, /es/data...). */}
                <div class="hero-portrait hero-board relative mx-auto aspect-square w-full max-w-xs sm:max-w-sm lg:max-w-lg">
                    <img
                        src={withBase(HERO_ART.file)}
                        alt=""
                        width={HERO_ART.width}
                        height={HERO_ART.height}
                        decoding="async"
                        class="absolute inset-0 size-full"
                    />
                    <picture>
                        <source
                            type="image/avif"
                            srcset={`${profile480Avif} 480w, ${profile640Avif} 640w`}
                            sizes={PHOTO_SIZES}
                        />
                        <img
                            src={profile640Webp}
                            srcset={`${profile480Webp} 480w, ${profile640Webp} 640w`}
                            sizes={PHOTO_SIZES}
                            alt={profile.name}
                            width={640}
                            height={640}
                            fetchpriority="high"
                            style={{
                                left: `${HERO_ART.portrait.left}%`,
                                top: `${HERO_ART.portrait.top}%`,
                                width: `${HERO_ART.portrait.width}%`,
                                height: `${HERO_ART.portrait.height}%`,
                                "border-radius": `${HERO_ART.portrait.radius}%`,
                            }}
                            class="hero-socket absolute object-cover"
                        />
                    </picture>
                    {/* Each device links to the project it stands for. A pointer resting on it, or the keyboard
                        reaching it, brings up the project's name and a line about it (globals.css, board-spot);
                        the box each link covers comes from the drawing itself (HERO_SPOTS). */}
                    <ul
                        aria-label={hero.board.label}
                        class="board-spots"
                        data-quiet={quiet() ? "" : undefined}
                        onPointerLeave={() => setQuiet(false)}
                        onFocusIn={() => setQuiet(false)}
                    >
                        <For each={HERO_SPOTS}>
                            {(spot) => {
                                const device = hero.board.devices[spot.id];
                                const id = `hero-device-${spot.id}`;
                                return (
                                    <li
                                        style={{
                                            left: `${spot.left}%`,
                                            top: `${spot.top}%`,
                                            width: `${spot.width}%`,
                                            height: `${spot.height}%`,
                                        }}
                                        data-side={spot.left + spot.width / 2 < 50 ? "start" : "end"}
                                        data-tip={spot.top + spot.height / 2 < 60 ? "below" : "above"}
                                        onPointerEnter={() => setQuiet(false)}
                                    >
                                        <Link
                                            to={buildProjectPath(lang, {slug: PROJECT_SLUG[spot.id], locked: locked()})}
                                            class="board-spot"
                                            aria-labelledby={`${id}-name`}
                                            aria-describedby={`${id}-note`}
                                        >
                                            <span class="board-tip">
                                                <span id={`${id}-name`}
                                                      class="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold text-fg">
                                                    {device.name}
                                                    <ArrowRight class="size-4 shrink-0"/>
                                                </span>
                                                <span id={`${id}-note`}
                                                      class="mt-1 block text-fg-muted">{device.note}</span>
                                            </span>
                                        </Link>
                                    </li>
                                );
                            }}
                        </For>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/sections/JourneySection.tsx

import {createComputed, createMemo, createSignal, For, Match, on, Show, Switch} from "solid-js";
import {forProfile} from "@/content/roles";
import {useJourneyCopy} from "@/hooks/useJourneyCopy";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {useHydrated} from "@/hooks/useHydrated";
import {Section} from "@/components/layout/Section";
import {EvolutionGrid} from "@/components/journey/EvolutionGrid";
import {FocusRadar} from "@/components/journey/FocusRadar";
import {Horizon} from "@/components/journey/Horizon";
import {JourneyMap} from "@/components/journey/JourneyMap";
import {milestones} from "@/content/shared/journey";
import {BUILD_DATE} from "@/content/shared/site";
import {isFuture, ROLE_LINE} from "@/lib/journey";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import type {JourneyLineId, JourneyTab, MilestoneId} from "@/types/journey";

const TABS: JourneyTab[] = ["map", "evolution", "focus", "horizon"];

/** The most recent milestone that has already happened, on the given line when there is one. */
const latestMilestone = (line: JourneyLineId | null): MilestoneId =>
    milestones
        .filter((item) => item.major && !isFuture(item, BUILD_DATE) && (line === null || item.lines.includes(line)))
        .sort((a, b) => b.start.localeCompare(a.start))[0].id;

export function JourneySection() {
    const journey = useJourneyCopy();
    const {role} = useRole();
    const interactive = useHydrated();
    const roleLine = createMemo(() => {
        const current = role();
        return current ? ROLE_LINE[current] : null;
    });
    const [tab, setTab] = createSignal<JourneyTab>("map");
    const [emphasis, setEmphasis] = createSignal<JourneyLineId | null>(roleLine());
    const [selected, setSelected] = createSignal<MilestoneId>(latestMilestone(roleLine()));
    const tabs: Partial<Record<JourneyTab, HTMLButtonElement>> = {};

    // A role switch happens without a reload, so the map follows the new role's line.
    createComputed(on(roleLine, (line) => {
        setEmphasis(line);
        setSelected(latestMilestone(line));
    }, {defer: true}));

    // Picking a line moves to its latest stop when the selected one is not on it, so the details match the line.
    const emphasize = (line: JourneyLineId | null) => {
        setEmphasis(line);
        if (line !== null && !milestones.find((item) => item.id === selected())!.lines.includes(line)) setSelected(latestMilestone(line));
    };

    const showMilestone = (id: MilestoneId) => {
        setSelected(id);
        setTab("map");
        tabs.map?.focus();
    };

    const onTabKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
        const index = TABS.indexOf(tab());
        const next = {ArrowRight: index + 1, ArrowLeft: index - 1, Home: 0, End: TABS.length - 1}[event.key];
        if (next === undefined) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        const target = TABS[(next + TABS.length) % TABS.length];
        setTab(target);
        tabs[target]?.focus();
    };

    return (
        <Section id="journey" title={journey.title} subtitle={forProfile(journey.subtitle, role())}>
            <div
                role="tablist"
                aria-label={journey.tabsLabel}
                data-interactive={interactive() || undefined}
                onKeyDown={onTabKey}
                class="mb-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:flex-wrap"
            >
                <For each={TABS}>
                    {(id) => (
                        <button
                            ref={(element) => {
                                tabs[id] = element;
                            }}
                            type="button"
                            role="tab"
                            id={`journey-tab-${id}`}
                            aria-selected={tab() === id}
                            aria-controls={`journey-panel-${id}`}
                            tabindex={tab() === id ? 0 : -1}
                            onClick={() => setTab(id)}
                            class={cn(
                                "min-h-10 rounded-full border px-3 py-2 text-sm leading-tight font-semibold transition-colors sm:px-4",
                                tab() === id ? "border-primary bg-primary text-on-primary" : "border-border text-fg-muted hover:border-primary hover:text-primary",
                            )}
                        >
                            {journey.tabs[id].label}
                        </button>
                    )}
                </For>
            </div>

            <For each={TABS}>
                {(id) => (
                    <div role="tabpanel" id={`journey-panel-${id}`} aria-labelledby={`journey-tab-${id}`}
                         hidden={tab() !== id} tabindex={0} class="appear">
                        {/* Only the open view is rendered, which keeps the prerendered HTML and the DOM small. */}
                        <Show when={tab() === id}>
                            <p class="mb-6 max-w-3xl text-fg-muted">{journey.tabs[id].description}</p>
                            <Switch>
                                <Match when={id === "map"}>
                                    <JourneyMap selected={selected()} onSelect={setSelected} emphasis={emphasis()}
                                                onEmphasis={emphasize}/>
                                </Match>
                                <Match when={id === "evolution"}>
                                    <EvolutionGrid onSelectMilestone={showMilestone}/>
                                </Match>
                                <Match when={id === "focus"}>
                                    <FocusRadar/>
                                </Match>
                                <Match when={id === "horizon"}>
                                    <Horizon onSelectMilestone={showMilestone}/>
                                </Match>
                            </Switch>
                        </Show>
                    </div>
                )}
            </For>
        </Section>
    );
}

    other: [],

const AREA_COLORS: Record<CommitAreaId, string> = {
    landings: "bg-chart-1",

    smartpot: "bg-chart-3",
    coursework: "bg-chart-4",
    signatures: "bg-chart-5",
    other: "bg-chart-6",
};

/** The same language under GitHub's name and WakaTime's. */
const LANGUAGES = [
    {name: "Python", commits: "Python", hours: "Python"},
    {name: "TypeScript", commits: "TypeScript", hours: "TypeScript"},
    {name: "Java", commits: "Java", hours: "Java"},
    {name: "JavaScript", commits: "JavaScript", hours: "JavaScript"},

    name,
    commits: githubStats.languagesByCommits.find((language) => language.name === commits)?.share ?? 0,
    hours: ((githubStats.wakatime.languages.find((language) => language.name === hoursName)?.seconds ?? 0) / githubStats.wakatime.totalSeconds) * 100,
}));

const areaTotals = commitAreas.reduce((total, area) => ({
    commits: total.commits + area.commits,
    repositories: total.repositories + area.repositories
}), {commits: 0, repositories: 0});
const maxYear = Math.max(...activityByYear.map((year) => year.contributions));
const maxWeekday = Math.max(...githubStats.weekdays);
const editorSeconds = githubStats.wakatime.editors.reduce((total, editor) => total + editor.seconds, 0);

const fill = (template: string, values: Record<string, string>) => template.replace(/\{(\w+)}/g, (match, key: string) => values[key] ?? match);

const percent = (value: number, locale: string) =>
    new Intl.NumberFormat(locale.replace("_", "-"), {
        style: "percent",
        maximumFractionDigits: value < 10 ? 1 : 0
    }).format(value / 100);

/** The headline figures, each counting up the first time the reader reaches it (lib/count-up.ts). */

                    <dd data-count="true"
                        class="font-display text-4xl text-primary tabular-nums">{formatNumber(metricValues[id], locale)}</dd>

}

                    })}</p>
                    <p>{fill(metrics.habits.more, {
                        created: number(githubStats.totals.repositoriesCreated),
                        issues: number(githubStats.totals.issues)
                    })}</p>
                </section>
            </div>

            <Show when={loaded()} fallback={
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setLoaded(true)}
                    class="mt-8 inline-flex min-h-10 items-center rounded-full border border-border-strong px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-fg hover:border-primary hover:text-primary"
                >
                    {metrics.load}
                </button>
            }>
                <div class="mt-10">
                    <h3 class="font-semibold text-fg">{metrics.imagesTitle}</h3>
                    <ul class="mt-5 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
                        <For each={metricImages}>{({wide, ...image}) => (
                            <li
                                class={cn("rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-3", wide && "md:col-span-2")}>
                                <SvgImage {...image} label={metrics.imageAlts[image.id]} class="mx-auto"/>
                            </li>
                        )}</For>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </Show>
        </>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/sections/ProjectsSection.tsx

import {createComputed, createMemo, createSignal, For, on, Show} from "solid-js";
import {ArrowRight, ExternalLink, Lock} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {GithubIcon} from "@/components/layout/BrandIcons";
import {forProfile, roleConfig} from "@/content/roles";
import {useSectionCopy} from "@/content/sections";
import {ORGANIZATION_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/detail-links";
import {organizations} from "@/content/shared/organizations";
import {isCaseStudy, PROJECT_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {projectById, projectsIn} from "@/content/shared/projects";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {useHydrated} from "@/hooks/useHydrated";
import {Section} from "@/components/layout/Section";
import {ProjectTile} from "@/components/projects/ProjectTile";
import {buildDetailPath, buildProjectPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import {listProjects, prioritize} from "@/lib/role-view";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";
import {PROJECT_CATEGORIES, type ProjectCategory, type ProjectId} from "@/types/project";

/** The years a project ran, as a tile's corner shows them: 2024, 2022 – 2023 or 2024 –. */
export const projectYears = (id: ProjectId) => {
    const project = projectById(id);
    const start = project.start.slice(0, 4);
    if (project.end === null) return `${start} –`;
    const end = (project.end ?? project.start).slice(0, 4);
    return end === start ? start : `${start} – ${end}`;
};

export function ProjectsSection() {
    const {lang, content: {ui}} = useLanguage();
    const copy = useSectionCopy("projects");
    const {role, locked} = useRole();
    const config = createMemo(() => roleConfig(role()));
    const interactive = useHydrated();
    const [category, setCategory] = createSignal<ProjectCategory>(config().projectCategory);
    const tabs: Partial<Record<ProjectCategory, HTMLButtonElement>> = {};

    // A role switch happens without a reload, so the tabs open on the new role's category.
    createComputed(on(config, (current) => setCategory(current.projectCategory), {defer: true}));

    const hrefOf = (id: ProjectId) => buildProjectPath(lang, {slug: PROJECT_SLUG[id], locked: locked()});
    // The featured project already opens the section, so its category lists the rest.
    const listed = createMemo(() => listProjects(projectsIn(category()), role()));

    const onTabKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
        const index = PROJECT_CATEGORIES.indexOf(category());
        const next = {
            ArrowRight: index + 1,
            ArrowLeft: index - 1,
            Home: 0,
            End: PROJECT_CATEGORIES.length - 1
        }[event.key];
        if (next === undefined) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        const target = PROJECT_CATEGORIES[(next + PROJECT_CATEGORIES.length) % PROJECT_CATEGORIES.length];
        setCategory(target);
        tabs[target]?.focus();
    };

    return (
        <Section
            id="projects"
            title={copy.title}
            subtitle={forProfile(copy.subtitle, role())}
            layout="wide"
        >
            {/* The role view's featured project spans the row: its illustration beside its name, a few words and one
                sentence. Like every tile, the whole of it leads to its page. */}
            <Show when={config().featuredProject} keyed>
                {(id) => (
                    <div data-featured="true" class="section-enter">
                        <ProjectTile
                            id={id}
                            name={copy.items[id].name}
                            brief={copy.items[id].brief}
                            summary={copy.items[id].summary}
                            tag={`${copy.featured} · ${projectYears(id)}`}
                            href={hrefOf(id)}
                            wide
                        />
                        <div class="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                            <Link to={hrefOf(id)}
                                  class="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-on-primary transition-colors hover:bg-primary-hover">

                                    </a>

FILE: src/components/sections/ReasonsSection.tsx

import {createMemo, createSignal, For, onCleanup, onMount} from "solid-js";
import {REASON_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/detail-links";
import {REASON_ART} from "@/content/shared/page-art";
import {benefitOrder, benefitRoles} from "@/content/shared/services";
import {testimonials} from "@/content/shared/testimonials";
import {useSectionCopy} from "@/content/sections";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {Section} from "@/components/layout/Section";
import {ArrowRight} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {buildDetailPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import {prioritize} from "@/lib/role-view";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";
import type {BenefitId} from "@/types/content";

/** A number as the slides write it, with two digits. */
const ordinal = (index: number) => String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0");

/**
 * The reasons to hire me, laid out like a presentation: a slide with the reason's object, its number and the words of
 * the recommendation behind it, beside the list of every reason. Each card of the list slides in as it comes up, and
 * from 64rem the slide stays in view and turns to the reason crossing the middle of the screen. One observer marks
 * that reason; nothing else runs, and on a phone the slide shows the first reason above the list.
 */
export function ReasonsSection() {
    const {lang} = useLanguage();
    const services = useSectionCopy("services");
    const recommendations = useSectionCopy("testimonials");
    const {role, locked} = useRole();
    const ordered = createMemo(() => prioritize(benefitOrder, (id) => benefitRoles[id], role()));
    const [active, setActive] = createSignal(0);
    const page = (id: BenefitId | null = null) => buildDetailPath(lang, "reasons", {
        slug: id ? REASON_SLUG[id] : null,
        locked: locked()
    });
    const authorOf = (id: BenefitId) => testimonials.find((item) => item.id === services.benefits[id].evidence.testimonial)!;
    let list: HTMLOListElement | undefined;

    onMount(() => {
        if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined" || !list) return;
        const wide = window.matchMedia("(width >= 64rem)");
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            for (const entry of entries) {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) setActive(Number((entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.index));
            }
        }, {rootMargin: "-50% 0px -50% 0px"});
        const items = list.querySelectorAll("[data-index]");
        // The slide follows the list only where it stays beside it; on a phone it keeps the first reason.
        const follow = () => {
            observer.disconnect();
            if (wide.matches) items.forEach((item) => observer.observe(item));
            else setActive(0);
        };
        follow();
        wide.addEventListener("change", follow);
        onCleanup(() => {
            observer.disconnect();
            wide.removeEventListener("change", follow);
        });
    });

    return (
        <Section id="reasons" title={services.benefitsTitle} subtitle={services.benefitsSubtitle}>
            <div class="reasons lg:grid lg:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-12 xl:gap-16">
                {/* The slide: compact horizontal highlight below 64rem so it never fills a phone/tablet screen;
                    sticky presentation stage from 64rem capped to fit 768px-tall laptops without clipping. */}
                <div class="reasons-stage grid lg:sticky lg:top-24 lg:self-start">
                    <For each={ordered()}>
                        {(id, index) => {
                            const author = authorOf(id);
                            return (
                                <figure
                                    class="reason-slide m-0 grid grid-cols-[4.5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-border p-4 lg:block lg:border-0 lg:p-0"
                                    data-active={index() === active() || undefined}
                                >
                                    <div aria-hidden="true"
                                         class="grid aspect-square place-items-center overflow-clip rounded-2xl lg:aspect-video"
                                         style={{background: `var(--color-tile-${REASON_ART[id].tile})`}}>
                                        <img src={withBase(REASON_ART[id].file)} alt="" width={400} height={400}
                                             loading="lazy" decoding="async"
                                             class="reason-slide-art h-[86%] w-auto object-contain"/>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="min-w-0 lg:mt-4">
                                        <p aria-hidden="true" class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">
                                            {services.reasons.counter.replace("{current}", ordinal(index())).replace("{total}", String(ordered().length))}
                                        </p>
                                        <blockquote class="mt-2 text-base leading-snug text-fg text-pretty sm:text-lg lg:text-2xl">
                                            “{services.benefits[id].evidence.excerpt}”
                                        </blockquote>
                                        <figcaption class="mt-2 text-xs text-fg-muted sm:text-sm">
                                            {author.author} · {recommendations.items[author.id].role}
                                        </figcaption>
                                    </div>
                                </figure>
                            );
                        }}
                    </For>
                </div>

                <ol ref={list} aria-label={services.reasons.listLabel} class="reasons-list mt-6 grid gap-3 lg:mt-0">
                    <For each={ordered()}>
                        {(id, index) => (
                            <li data-index={index()} data-active={index() === active() || undefined}
                                class="group/reason">
                                <Link to={page(id)}
                                      class="reason-card group grid grid-cols-[3.5rem_minmax(0,1fr)_auto] items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-bg p-3 pr-4 hover:border-border-strong sm:grid-cols-[4.5rem_minmax(0,1fr)_auto] sm:p-4 lg:group-data-active/reason:border-fg">
                                    <span aria-hidden="true" class="grid aspect-square place-items-center rounded-xl"
                                          style={{background: `var(--color-tile-${REASON_ART[id].tile})`}}>
                                        <img src={withBase(REASON_ART[id].file)} alt="" width={72} height={72}
                                             loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="w-[90%]"/>
                                    </span>
                                    <span class="min-w-0">
                                        <span aria-hidden="true"
                                              class="block font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{ordinal(index())}</span>
                                        <h3 class="text-base leading-snug text-fg sm:text-lg">{services.benefits[id].title}</h3>
                                        <span
                                            class="mt-1 block text-sm text-fg-muted">{services.benefits[id].description}</span>
                                    </span>
                                    <ArrowRight class="reason-arrow size-4 text-fg-subtle"/>
                                </Link>
                            </li>
                        )}
                    </For>
                </ol>
            </div>
            <Link
                to={page()}
                class="mt-10 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border-strong px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised"
            >
                {services.reasons.pageLink}
                <ArrowRight class="size-4"/>
            </Link>
        </Section>
    );
}

import {createSignal, For, Show} from "solid-js";
import {Check, Download, ExternalLink, FileText} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {forProfile} from "@/content/roles";
import {resumeVersions} from "@/content/shared/resume";
import {useSectionCopy} from "@/content/sections";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {Section} from "@/components/layout/Section";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {formatDay} from "@/lib/format";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import type {ResumeId} from "@/types/content";

/** Sheets drawn behind the preview, one per extra page, so the stack shows how long the document is. */
const MAX_SHEETS = 4;
const SHEET_OFFSET = 10;
/** A length in px, with zero written bare as the stylesheet would. */
const px = (value: number) => (value === 0 ? "0" : `${value}px`);

export function ResumeSection() {
    const {lang, content} = useLanguage();
    const resume = useSectionCopy("resume");
    const {role} = useRole();
    const [selected, setSelected] = createSignal<ResumeId>("ats");
    const version = () => resumeVersions.find((item) => item.id === selected()) ?? resumeVersions[0];
    // PDFs and preview images live in public/; under a subpath they need the base. External resumes keep their URL.
    const file = () => withBase(version().files[lang]);
    const preview = () => withBase(version().preview[lang]);
    const copy = () => resume.versions[selected()];
    const pages = () => (version().pages === 1 ? resume.pages.one : resume.pages.other).replace("{count}", String(version().pages));
    const sheets = () => Math.min(version().pages - 1, MAX_SHEETS);

    return (
        <Section id="resume" title={resume.title} subtitle={forProfile(resume.subtitle, role())} tone="raised">
            {/* Two columns of fixed measure, centered together, so the choices and the preview sit side by side. */}
            <div
                class="enter-each mx-auto grid max-w-5xl gap-10 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.15fr)_minmax(0,1fr)] lg:items-center lg:gap-12">
                <div>
                    <div role="group" aria-label={resume.title} class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <For each={resumeVersions}>{(item) => (
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                aria-pressed={item.id === selected()}
                                onClick={() => setSelected(item.id)}
                                class={cn(
                                    "min-h-10 rounded-full border px-4 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors",
                                    item.id === selected()
                                        ? "border-primary bg-primary text-on-primary"
                                        : "border-border text-fg-muted hover:border-primary hover:text-primary",
                                )}
                            >
                                {resume.versions[item.id].label}
                            </button>
                        )}</For>
                    </div>
                    <p class="mt-6 text-lg text-fg-muted">{copy().description}</p>
                    <ul class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-2 border-y border-border py-4 text-sm text-fg-muted">
                        <li class="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-fg">
                            <FileText class="size-4 text-primary"/>
                            {pages()}
                        </li>
                        <li>{copy().format}</li>
                        <Show when={version().updated}>
                            {(updated) =>
                                <li>{resume.updated.replace("{date}", formatDay(updated(), content.locale))}</li>}
                        </Show>
                    </ul>
                    <h3 class="mt-6 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-fg-subtle">{resume.includesTitle}</h3>
                    <ul class="mt-3 space-y-2.5">
                        <For each={copy().includes}>
                            {(item) => (
                                <li class="flex gap-3 text-fg-muted">
                                    <Check class="mt-1 size-4 shrink-0 text-primary"/>
                                    {item}
                                </li>
                            )}
                        </For>
                    </ul>
                    <div class="mt-8 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                        <Show when={!version().external} fallback={
                            <a
                                href={file()}
                                target="_blank"
                                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                class="inline-flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 font-semibold text-on-primary hover:bg-primary-hover active:translate-y-px"
                            >
                                <ExternalLink class="size-5"/>
                                {resume.open}
                            </a>
                        }>
                            <a
                                href={file()}
                                download=""
                                class="inline-flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 font-semibold text-on-primary hover:bg-primary-hover active:translate-y-px"
                            >
                                <Download class="size-5"/>
                                {resume.download}
                            </a>
                            <a
                                href={file()}
                                target="_blank"
                                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                class="inline-flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border-strong px-5 font-semibold text-fg hover:border-primary hover:text-primary active:translate-y-px"
                            >
                                <ExternalLink class="size-5"/>
                                {resume.open}
                            </a>
                        </Show>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <a
                    href={file()}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    class="relative mx-auto mb-6 block w-full max-w-xs sm:max-w-sm lg:mb-0"
                    style={{
                        "padding-right": px(sheets() * SHEET_OFFSET),
                        "padding-bottom": px(sheets() * SHEET_OFFSET),
                    }}
                >
                    {/* The other pages, stacked behind the first one. */}
                    <For each={Array.from({length: sheets()}, (_, index) => sheets() - index)}>
                        {(depth) => (
                            <span aria-hidden="true"
                                  class="absolute rounded-lg border border-border-strong bg-fg shadow-card"
                                  style={{
                                      opacity: 0.85 - depth * 0.12,
                                      top: px(depth * SHEET_OFFSET),
                                      left: px(depth * SHEET_OFFSET),
                                      right: px((sheets() - depth) * SHEET_OFFSET),
                                      bottom: px((sheets() - depth) * SHEET_OFFSET),
                                  }}
                            />
                        )}
                    </For>
                    <picture class="relative block">
                        <source type="image/avif" srcset={`${preview()}-480.avif 480w, ${preview()}-960.avif 960w`}
                                sizes="(min-width: 1024px) 28rem, 92vw"/>
                        <img
                            src={`${preview()}-960.webp`}
                            srcset={`${preview()}-480.webp 480w, ${preview()}-960.webp 960w`}

                            decoding="async"
                            class="h-auto w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-fg shadow-card"
                        />
                    </picture>
                    <span class="absolute -bottom-7 left-0 font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">
                        {resume.firstPage.replace("{count}", String(version().pages))}
                    </span>
                </a>
            </div>
        </Section>
    );

FILE: src/components/sections/section-loaders.ts

import type {Component} from "solid-js";
import {loadSectionCopies} from "@/content/sections";
import type {Lang, SectionCopyKey, SectionId} from "@/types/content";

/** One chunk per home section; the build renders them in place instead (islands/server.tsx). */
const LOADERS: Record<SectionId, () => Promise<Component>> = {
    about: () => import("./AboutSection").then((module) => module.AboutSection),
    journey: () => import("./JourneySection").then((module) => module.JourneySection),
    services: () => import("./ServicesSection").then((module) => module.ServicesSection),
    reasons: () => import("./ReasonsSection").then((module) => module.ReasonsSection),
    experience: () => import("./ExperienceSection").then((module) => module.ExperienceSection),
    skills: () => import("./SkillsSection").then((module) => module.SkillsSection),
    projects: () => import("./ProjectsSection").then((module) => module.ProjectsSection),
    certifications: () => import("./CertificationsSection").then((module) => module.CertificationsSection),
    metrics: () => import("./MetricsSection").then((module) => module.MetricsSection),
    resume: () => import("./ResumeSection").then((module) => module.ResumeSection),
    testimonials: () => import("./TestimonialsSection").then((module) => module.TestimonialsSection),
    contact: () => import("./ContactSection").then((module) => module.ContactSection),
};

/**
 * The copy each section reads, its own and the ones it borrows (the reasons quote recommendations, the jobs name their
 * projects). The journey ships its text with its code (content/journey-copy.ts).
 */
const COPIES: Record<SectionId, readonly SectionCopyKey[]> = {
    about: ["about"],
    journey: [],
    services: ["services"],
    reasons: ["services", "testimonials"],
    experience: ["experience", "projects"],
    skills: ["skills"],
    projects: ["projects"],
    certifications: ["certifications"],
    metrics: ["metrics"],
    resume: ["resume"],
    testimonials: ["testimonials"],
    contact: ["contact"],
};

/** A section's code once its copy has arrived too, so it renders, and hydrates, without waiting for anything else. */
export const loadSection = (id: SectionId, lang: Lang) =>
    Promise.all([LOADERS[id](), loadSectionCopies(COPIES[id], lang)]).then(([component]) => ({default: component}));

import {createEffect, createMemo, createSignal, For, onCleanup, onMount} from "solid-js";
import {SKILL_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/detail-links";
import {SKILL_ART} from "@/content/shared/skill-art";
import {skillGroups} from "@/content/shared/skills";
import {forProfile} from "@/content/roles";
import {useSectionCopy} from "@/content/sections";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {Section} from "@/components/layout/Section";
import {ArrowRight, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Pause, Play} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {buildDetailPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import {orderSkillGroups} from "@/lib/role-view";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";

/** How long each card faces the reader, its turn included (globals.css, .skill-ring, turns in 1.1 s). */
const STEP_MS = 3600;

/** A horizontal swipe longer than this turns the gallery; a shorter one is a tap. */
const SWIPE_PX = 40;

/** The round buttons of the other sliders (components/ui/Carousel.tsx). */
const BUTTON = "grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border-strong text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised active:translate-y-px";

/** A number as the gallery writes it, with two digits. */
const ordinal = (index: number) => String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0");

const fill = (template: string, values: Record<string, string | number>) =>
    template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, key: string) => (key in values ? String(values[key]) : match));

/**
 * Every group of tools as a card on a ring that turns, one card at a time, while the section is in view. Each card is a
 * link to the group's page, which tells its focus, what it is good for and where it shows. The ring is CSS
 * (globals.css, skill-stage): the script only counts turns, and the prerendered page shows it at rest.
 *
 * It stops while the pointer rests on it, while anything inside it has the focus, while it is off screen and when the
 * reader pauses it, and a reader who asks for less motion gets it paused. The focus on the pause button does not hold
 * it, so pressing it to resume resumes at once. Tabbing to a card, clicking one at the side or swiping brings that card
 * to the front; the buttons come first so a keyboard reaches them before the cards.
 */
export function SkillsSection() {
    const skills = useSectionCopy("skills");
    const {lang} = useLanguage();
    const {role, locked} = useRole();
    const ordered = createMemo(() => orderSkillGroups(skillGroups, role()));
    const count = () => ordered().length;
    // The turns since the start, unbounded, so the ring always turns the short way and never spins back.
    const [turn, setTurn] = createSignal(0);
    const [paused, setPaused] = createSignal(false);
    const [hovered, setHovered] = createSignal(false);
    const [focused, setFocused] = createSignal(false);
    const [inView, setInView] = createSignal(false);
    const [shown, setShown] = createSignal(true);
    const [status, setStatus] = createSignal("");
    const active = () => ((turn() % count()) + count()) % count();
    /** How many places a card is from the front, negative to the left. */
    const offset = (index: number) => {
        const steps = (((index - active()) % count()) + count()) % count();
        return steps > count() / 2 ? steps - count() : steps;
    };
    const page = (slug: string | null = null) => buildDetailPath(lang, "skills", {slug, locked: locked()});
    const announce = () => {
        const group = ordered()[active()];
        setStatus(`${skills.groups[group.id]}, ${fill(skills.gallery.slide, {index: active() + 1, count: count()})}`);
    };
    const move = (steps: number) => {
        setTurn((value) => value + steps);
        announce();
    };
    let root: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
    let toggle: HTMLButtonElement | undefined;
    let swiped = false;
    let start: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;

    onMount(() => {
        if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) setPaused(true);
        const visibility = () => setShown(document.visibilityState === "visible");
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
        const observer = typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined"
            ? null
            : new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => setInView(entry.isIntersecting), {threshold: 0.35});
        if (observer && root) observer.observe(root);
        else setInView(true);
        onCleanup(() => {
            observer?.disconnect();
            document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
        });
    });

    // One timer at a time: each turn, and each change of what holds the ring, starts it again.
    createEffect(() => {
        turn();
        if (paused() || hovered() || focused() || !inView() || !shown()) return;
        const timer = setTimeout(() => setTurn((value) => value + 1), STEP_MS);
        onCleanup(() => clearTimeout(timer));
    });

    const onPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
        start = event.isPrimary ? {x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY} : null;
    };
    const onPointerUp = (event: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!start) return;
        const dx = event.clientX - start.x;
        const dy = event.clientY - start.y;
        start = null;
        if (Math.abs(dx) < SWIPE_PX || Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy)) return;
        // The click that ends a swipe over a card must not open it.
        swiped = true;
        setTimeout(() => (swiped = false));
        move(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1);
    };

    return (
        <Section id="skills" title={skills.title} subtitle={forProfile(skills.subtitle, role())}>
            <div
                ref={root}
                role="region"
                aria-roledescription="carousel"
                aria-label={skills.gallery.label}
                onFocusIn={(event) => setFocused(event.target !== toggle)}
                onFocusOut={(event) => {
                    if (!root?.contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setFocused(false);
                }}
            >
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                    <p aria-hidden="true" class="min-w-0 truncate font-mono text-sm text-fg-muted tabular-nums">
                        <span class="text-fg">{ordinal(active())}</span> / {String(count()).padStart(2, "0")}
                        <span class="ml-3 hidden text-fg-subtle sm:inline">{skills.groups[ordered()[active()].id]}</span>
                    </p>
                    <div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                        <button type="button" aria-label={skills.gallery.previous} onClick={() => move(-1)}
                                class={BUTTON}>
                            <ChevronLeft class="size-5"/>
                        </button>
                        {/* Its name says what it does next, so it carries no pressed state. */}
                        <button ref={toggle} type="button"
                                aria-label={paused() ? skills.gallery.play : skills.gallery.pause}
                                onClick={() => setPaused((value) => !value)} class={BUTTON}>
                            {paused() ? <Play class="size-4"/> : <Pause class="size-4"/>}
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" aria-label={skills.gallery.next} onClick={() => move(1)}
                                class={BUTTON}>
                            <ChevronRight class="size-5"/>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div
                    class="skill-stage relative mt-6 touch-pan-y overflow-clip py-4"
                    style={{"--count": String(count())}}
                    onPointerEnter={(event) => event.pointerType === "mouse" && setHovered(true)}
                    onPointerLeave={() => setHovered(false)}
                    onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
                    onPointerUp={onPointerUp}
                    onPointerCancel={() => (start = null)}
                >
                    <div class="skill-ring relative mx-auto h-full" style={{"--turn": String(turn())}}>
                        <For each={ordered()}>{(group, index) => {
                            const distance = () => Math.abs(offset(index()));
                            return (
                                <div
                                    role="group"
                                    aria-roledescription="slide"
                                    aria-label={fill(skills.gallery.slide, {index: index() + 1, count: count()})}
                                    class="skill-card absolute inset-0"
                                    style={{"--i": String(index()), "--d": String(distance())}}
                                    data-active={distance() === 0 ? "true" : undefined}
                                    data-edge={distance() === 2 ? "" : undefined}
                                    data-far={distance() > 2 ? "" : undefined}
                                    aria-hidden={distance() > 2 ? "true" : undefined}
                                >
                                    <a
                                        href={withBase(page(SKILL_SLUG[group.id]))}
                                        draggable={false}
                                        tabindex={distance() > 2 ? -1 : undefined}
                                        class="art-row flex h-full flex-col rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4 transition-colors hover:border-border-strong"
                                        onFocus={(event) => {
                                            // The keyboard brings a card to the front; a click decides below.
                                            if (event.currentTarget.matches(":focus-visible")) setTurn((value) => value + offset(index()));
                                        }}
                                        onClick={(event) => {
                                            if (swiped) event.preventDefault();
                                            // A click on a card at the side turns it to the front; one at the front, or
                                            // from the keyboard or a screen reader (detail 0), opens its page.
                                            else if (event.detail > 0 && offset(index()) !== 0) {
                                                event.preventDefault();
                                                move(offset(index()));
                                            }
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <span aria-hidden="true"
                                              class="grid aspect-[4/3] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl"
                                              style={{background: `var(--color-tile-${SKILL_ART[group.id].tile})`}}>
                                            <img src={withBase(SKILL_ART[group.id].file)} alt="" width={96}
                                                 height={96} loading="lazy" decoding="async" draggable={false}
                                                 class="art-row-icon size-20"/>
                                        </span>
                                        <span class="mt-3.5 font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">
                                            {skills.count.replace("{count}", String(group.items.length))}
                                        </span>
                                        <h3 class="mt-1 text-base leading-snug font-semibold text-fg sm:text-lg">{skills.groups[group.id]}</h3>
                                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-fg-muted">{skills.taglines[group.id]}</p>
                                        <span class="mt-auto inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-fg">
                                            {skills.gallery.open}
                                            <ArrowRight class="art-row-arrow size-4"/>
                                        </span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                            );
                        }}</For>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <p role="status" class="sr-only">{status()}</p>
            </div>

            <Link to={page()}
                  class="mt-8 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border-strong px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised">
                {fill(skills.all, {count: count()})}
                <ArrowRight class="size-4"/>
            </Link>
        </Section>
    );
}

import {createEffect, createMemo, createSignal, For, on, onCleanup, Show} from "solid-js";
import {ChevronDown, Quote} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {forProfile} from "@/content/roles";
import {testimonials} from "@/content/shared/testimonials";
import {useSectionCopy} from "@/content/sections";
import {useContent} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {useHydrated} from "@/hooks/useHydrated";
import {Section} from "@/components/layout/Section";
import {Carousel} from "@/components/ui/Carousel";
import {formatYearMonth} from "@/lib/format";
import {prioritize} from "@/lib/role-view";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";

// The prerendered page carries the first three, as the old pager did, to keep the page within the HTML budget
// (tests/build/build-output.test.ts); the slider gets the rest once the page is interactive.
const PRERENDERED = 3;

/**
 * A long recommendation shows its first lines and a toggle, so one long quote does not stretch the whole row of
 * cards. The full text stays in the page; the toggle appears only when the clamp actually cuts it at this width.
 */
function ClampedQuote(props: {
    id: string;
    text: string;
    lang?: string;
    more: string;
    less: string
}) {
    let quote: HTMLParagraphElement | undefined;
    const [open, setOpen] = createSignal(false);
    const [clipped, setClipped] = createSignal(false);

    // Measured after mount and again whenever the quote closes or its text changes.
    createEffect(on([open, () => props.text], ([isOpen]) => {
        const element = quote;
        if (!element || isOpen) return;
        const measure = () => setClipped(element.scrollHeight > element.clientHeight + 1);
        measure();
        if (typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
        const observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);
        observer.observe(element);
        onCleanup(() => observer.disconnect());
    }));

    return (
        <div class="flex-1">
            <blockquote class="text-fg-muted" lang={props.lang}>
                <p id={props.id} ref={quote} class={cn(!open() && "line-clamp-6")}>“{props.text}”</p>
            </blockquote>
            <Show when={clipped() || open()}>
                <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-expanded={open()}
                    aria-controls={props.id}
                    onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
                    class="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover"
                >
                    {open() ? props.less : props.more}
                    <ChevronDown class={cn("size-4 transition-transform", open() && "rotate-180")}/>
                </button>
            </Show>
        </div>
    );
}

export function TestimonialsSection() {
    const {ui} = useContent();
    const copy = useSectionCopy("testimonials");
    const {role} = useRole();
    const hydrated = useHydrated();
    const ordered = createMemo(() => prioritize(testimonials, (item) => item.roles, role()));
    const shown = createMemo(() => (hydrated() ? ordered() : ordered().slice(0, PRERENDERED)));
    const supervisors = testimonials.filter((item) => item.relationship === "directSupervisor" || item.relationship === "seniorPosition").length;
    const stats = [
        [copy.stats.total, testimonials.length],
        [copy.stats.supervisors, supervisors],
        [copy.stats.teammates, testimonials.length - supervisors],
    ] as const;

    return (
        <Section id="testimonials" title={copy.title} subtitle={forProfile(copy.subtitle, role())}>
            {/* Compact horizontal strip of figures across every screen width so stats never bloat mobile vertical space. */}
            <dl class="enter-each mb-8 grid max-w-3xl grid-cols-3 gap-0">
                <For each={stats}>
                    {([label, value], index) => (
                        <div
                            class={cn(
                                "flex flex-col-reverse items-start justify-end gap-1",
                                index() === 0 ? "pr-3 sm:pr-8" : "border-l border-border px-3 sm:px-8",
                            )}
                        >
                            <dt class="text-xs leading-snug text-fg-muted sm:text-sm">{label}</dt>
                            <dd data-count="true"
                                class="font-display text-3xl text-primary tabular-nums md:text-4xl">{value}</dd>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </For>
            </dl>

            {/* One recommendation per view on phones, two on tablets/laptops and three on wide desktop screens. */}
            <Carousel
                previousLabel={copy.previous}
                nextLabel={copy.next}
                slideClass="flex basis-[85%] sm:basis-[calc((100%-1.25rem)/2)] xl:basis-[calc((100%-2.5rem)/3)]"
                items={shown()}
            >
                {(item) => {
                    const local = copy.items[item.id];
                    return (
                        <article class="flex w-full flex-col rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface p-6">
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                                <Quote class="size-6 text-primary"/>
                                <span
                                    class="rounded-full border border-accent/40 px-3 py-0.5 text-xs text-accent">{local.highlight}</span>
                            </div>
                            <figure class="mt-4 flex flex-1 flex-col">
                                <ClampedQuote
                                    id={`testimonial-${item.id}`}
                                    text={local.quote ?? item.quote}
                                    lang={local.quote ? undefined : "es"}
                                    more={ui.actions.showMore}
                                    less={ui.actions.showLess}
                                />
                                <Show when={local.quote && copy.translatedNote}>
                                    <details class="mt-3 text-sm">
                                        <summary class="cursor-pointer text-fg-subtle">
                                            {copy.translatedNote} · {copy.showOriginal}
                                        </summary>
                                        <p lang="es" class="mt-2 text-fg-subtle">“{item.quote}”</p>
                                    </details>
                                </Show>
                                <figcaption class="mt-5 border-t border-border pt-4">
                                    <p class="font-semibold text-fg">{item.author}</p>
                                    <p class="text-sm text-fg-muted">
                                        {local.role} · {local.context}
                                    </p>
                                    <p class="mt-1 text-xs text-fg-subtle">
                                        {copy.relationships[item.relationship]} · {formatYearMonth(item.date, ui.months)}
                                    </p>
                                </figcaption>
                            </figure>
                        </article>
                    );
                }}
            </Carousel>
        </Section>
    );
}

import {mergeProps, Show} from "solid-js";
import {Dynamic} from "solid-js/web";
import {ArrowUpRight} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import type {Art} from "@/content/shared/page-art";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";
import {Link} from "@/routes/Router";

export interface ArtTileProps {
    art: Art;
    name: string;
    /** Two to five words under the name. */
    brief: string;
    href: string;
    /** A short mark in the corner, such as "Case study" or the years. */
    tag?: string;
    headingLevel?: "h2" | "h3" | "h4";
    /** The tile spans the row: the illustration sits beside the text instead of above it. */
    wide?: boolean;
    /** What a wide tile adds under the brief: one sentence of summary. */
    summary?: string;
    /** The first tiles on screen when the page opens load their illustration at once. */
    eager?: boolean;
    /** Names that stay as they are, such as a GitHub organization, are not translated by the browser. */
    keepName?: boolean;
    class?: string;
}

/**
 * Something at a glance: its illustration on its own layer of color, its name and a few words, and nothing else. The
 * whole tile is the link to its page, which tells the rest. Hovering lifts the illustration and leans the arrow. A
 * project, a job, a program, an organization, a service and a reason all use it.
 */
export function ArtTile(rawProps: ArtTileProps) {
    const props = mergeProps({headingLevel: "h3" as const, wide: false, eager: false}, rawProps);

    return (
        <article class={cn("project-tile group h-full", props.class)}>
            <Link
                to={props.href}
                class={cn(
                    "tile-surface relative flex h-full flex-col overflow-clip rounded-xl text-fg md:rounded-2xl",
                    props.wide && "md:grid md:grid-cols-[1fr_1.15fr] md:items-stretch",
                )}
            >
                <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    class="absolute inset-0 -z-10 rounded-[inherit]"
                    style={{background: `var(--color-tile-${props.art.tile})`}}
                />
                <div
                    class={cn(
                        "tile-art relative grid place-items-center",
                        props.wide ? "aspect-video md:order-2 md:aspect-auto md:min-h-64" : "aspect-[4/3]",
                    )}>
                    <img
                        src={withBase(props.art.file)}
                        alt=""
                        width={400}
                        height={400}
                        loading={props.eager ? "eager" : "lazy"}
                        decoding="async"
                        class={cn(
                            "tile-illustration h-auto object-contain",
                            props.wide ? "w-1/2 max-w-56 md:w-2/3 md:max-w-72" : "max-h-48 w-2/3",
                        )}
                    />
                </div>
                <div
                    class={cn(
                        "relative flex flex-1 flex-col px-4 pb-4 sm:px-5 sm:pb-5",
                        props.wide ? "pr-11 md:justify-center md:p-8" : "pr-10 sm:pr-11",
                    )}>
                    <Show when={props.tag}>
                        <span
                            class="tile-tag absolute top-0 right-4 -translate-y-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] rounded-full bg-bg/80 px-2.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs text-fg-muted backdrop-blur md:static md:mb-3 md:translate-y-0 md:self-start">
                            {props.tag}
                        </span>
                    </Show>
                    <Dynamic
                        component={props.headingLevel}
                        translate={props.keepName ? "no" : undefined}
                        class={cn("tracking-tight text-pretty [overflow-wrap:anywhere]", props.wide ? "text-heading" : "text-base leading-snug sm:text-lg")}
                    >
                        {props.name}
                    </Dynamic>
                    <p class={cn("mt-1 text-fg-muted", props.wide ? "mt-2 text-base sm:text-lg" : "text-xs leading-snug sm:text-sm")}>{props.brief}</p>
                    <Show when={props.wide && props.summary}>
                        <p class="mt-3 hidden max-w-xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-fg-muted md:block">{props.summary}</p>
                    </Show>
                </div>
                <ArrowUpRight
                    class="tile-arrow absolute right-4 bottom-4 size-5 text-fg-muted"/>
            </Link>
        </article>
    );
}

FILE: src/components/ui/Carousel.tsx

import {
    type Accessor,
    createEffect,
    createSignal,
    createUniqueId,
    For,
    type JSX,
    on,
    onCleanup,
    onMount,
    Show
} from "solid-js";
import {ChevronLeft, ChevronRight} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";

interface CarouselProps<T> {
    items: readonly T[];
    /** Draws one slide; it runs once per item and moves with it when the order changes. */
    children: (item: T, index: Accessor<number>) => JSX.Element;
    /** Classes for an item's list element, such as a grid span once the carousel becomes a grid. */
    itemClass?: (item: T, index: number) => string | undefined;
    previousLabel: string;
    nextLabel: string;
    /** Width of each slide per breakpoint, e.g. "basis-[85%] sm:basis-[calc((100%-1.25rem)/2)]". */
    slideClass: string;
    /** Extra classes for the track, e.g. "md:grid md:grid-cols-2" to turn it into a plain grid from a breakpoint. */
    trackClass?: string;
    /** Extra classes for the buttons row, e.g. "md:hidden" when the track is a grid from that breakpoint. */
    controlsClass?: string;
}

interface Position {
    index: number;
    perView: number;
}

const samePosition = (a: Position, b: Position) => a.index === b.index && a.perView === b.perView;

/**
 * A row of slides that scrolls sideways with snap points, so a phone swipes through it one card at a time and a wide
 * screen sees several. All slides stay in the page (and the prerendered HTML); the buttons and the counter only move
 * the scroll position, so a screen reader reads the list as a plain list.
 */
export function Carousel<T>(props: CarouselProps<T>) {
    const trackId = createUniqueId();
    let track: HTMLUListElement | undefined;
    const [position, setPosition] = createSignal<Position>({index: 0, perView: 1}, {equals: samePosition});

    const step = () => {
        const slides = track?.children;
        if (!slides || slides.length < 2) return track?.clientWidth ?? 1;
        return (slides[1] as HTMLElement).offsetLeft - (slides[0] as HTMLElement).offsetLeft || 1;
    };

    onMount(() => {
        const element = track!;
        let frame = 0;
        const measure = () => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
            frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                const width = step();
                // A track that scrolls takes keyboard focus, so arrow keys can move it; as a plain grid it stays out of the tab order.
                element.tabIndex = element.scrollWidth > element.clientWidth + 1 ? 0 : -1;
                const perView = Math.max(1, Math.round(element.clientWidth / width));
                const atEnd = element.scrollLeft + element.clientWidth >= element.scrollWidth - 2;
                const index = atEnd ? Math.max(0, props.items.length - perView) : Math.round(element.scrollLeft / width);
                setPosition({index, perView});
            });
        };
        measure();
        // Slides added after hydration lengthen the track without resizing it.
        createEffect(on(() => props.items.length, measure, {defer: true}));
        element.addEventListener("scroll", measure, {passive: true});
        const observer = typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined" ? null : new ResizeObserver(measure);
        observer?.observe(element);
        onCleanup(() => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
            element.removeEventListener("scroll", measure);
            observer?.disconnect();
        });
    });

    // The track's CSS scroll-behavior animates the move, and the reduced-motion rule in globals.css turns it off.
    const go = (direction: 1 | -1) => {
        if (!track) return;
        const {index, perView} = position();
        const target = Math.min(Math.max(index + direction * perView, 0), props.items.length - 1);
        track.scrollTo({left: target * step()});
    };

    const last = () => Math.min(position().index + position().perView, props.items.length);
    const range = () => (position().perView > 1 ? `${position().index + 1}–${last()}` : `${position().index + 1}`);

    return (
        <div class="min-w-0">
            {/* As a grid, each card rises as it enters the screen (globals.css, .enter-each); as a slider on a phone,
                the cards at its edges turn away and dim (carousel-depth). */}
            <ul
                id={trackId}
                ref={track}
                class={cn(
                    "enter-each carousel-depth scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-px-4 gap-5 overflow-x-auto scroll-smooth px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:scroll-px-0 sm:px-0",
                    props.trackClass,
                )}
            >
                <For each={props.items}>
                    {(item, index) => (
                        <li class={cn("shrink-0 snap-start", props.slideClass, props.itemClass?.(item, index()))}>
                            {props.children(item, index)}
                        </li>
                    )}
                </For>
            </ul>
            {/* Centered, so on phones the buttons stay clear of the floating WhatsApp and assistant buttons on the right. */}
            <Show when={props.items.length > 1}>
                <div class={cn("mt-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-5", props.controlsClass)}>
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        aria-label={props.previousLabel}
                        aria-controls={trackId}
                        disabled={position().index === 0}
                        onClick={() => go(-1)}
                        class="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border-strong text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised active:translate-y-px disabled:opacity-40"
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft class="size-5"/>
                    </button>
                    <p aria-hidden="true" class="min-w-16 text-center font-mono text-sm text-fg-muted tabular-nums">
                        <span class="text-fg">{range()}</span> / {props.items.length}
                    </p>
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        aria-label={props.nextLabel}
                        aria-controls={trackId}
                        disabled={last() >= props.items.length}
                        onClick={() => go(1)}
                        class="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border-strong text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-surface-raised active:translate-y-px disabled:opacity-40"
                    >
                        <ChevronRight class="size-5"/>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </Show>
        </div>
    );
}

/*
 * The Lucide icons the site uses (lucide.dev, v1.58.0, ISC license: Copyright (c) for portions of Lucide are held by
 * Cole Bemis 2013-2022 as part of Feather (MIT); all other copyright (c) for Lucide are held by Lucide Contributors
 * 2022). They are drawn here instead of imported from a package: the site needs about thirty, always decorative, so
 * each is one static template and the page carries no icon runtime. Add a new one by copying its path data from
 * lucide.dev.
 */

export interface IconProps {
    class?: string;
}

/** Every icon is decorative: the control or text next to it carries the name, so it is hidden from assistive tech. */
function Icon(props: { name: string; class?: string; children: JSX.Element }) {
    // A name may carry Lucide's alias classes after it, as "folder-git2 lucide-folder-git-2" does.
    return (
        <svg
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
            width="24"
            height="24"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            stroke-width="2"
            stroke-linecap="round"
            stroke-linejoin="round"
            class={`lucide lucide-${props.name}${props.class ? ` ${props.class}` : ""}`}
            aria-hidden="true"
        >
            {props.children}
        </svg>
    );
}

import type {JSX} from "solid-js";
import {ChevronDown} from "@/components/ui/icons";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * The second layer of a part of the page: a "Show more" that opens what the first glance leaves out. It is a native
 * details element, so the text stays in the prerendered page for search engines, find in page opens it on a match, it
 * works before the page is interactive, and a reader on assistive technology hears a disclosure. "Expand all" opens
 * every one in its section (lib/disclosures.ts).
 */
export function More(props: {
    /** What the summary says while closed, such as "Show more (4)". */
    label: string;
    /** What it says once open. */
    openLabel: string;
    children: JSX.Element;
    class?: string;
    summaryClass?: string;
}) {
    return (
        <details class={cn("more", props.class)}>
            <summary
                class={cn("inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover", props.summaryClass)}>
                <span class="more-closed">{props.label}</span>
                <span class="more-open">{props.openLabel}</span>
                <ChevronDown class="more-chevron size-4"/>
            </summary>
            {props.children}
        </details>
    );
}

interface SvgImageProps {

export function SvgImage(props: SvgImageProps) {
    return (
        // Never wider than the card's own size, so small cards are not blown up next to wide ones.
        <svg
            role="img"
            aria-label={props.label}
            viewBox={`0 0 ${props.width} ${props.height}`}
            style={{"max-width": `${props.width}px`}}
            class={cn("block h-auto w-full", props.class)}
        >
            <image href={props.src} width={props.width} height={props.height}/>
        </svg>
    );
}

import {For, Show} from "solid-js";
import type {RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import {isFocusTech, orderTech} from "@/lib/role-view";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";

interface TechListProps {
    tech: readonly string[];
    role: RoleId | null;
    limit?: number;
    class?: string;
}

/**
 * A stack as small chips, the role view's own first. With a limit it shows that many and says how many more there are,
 * which the page the card leads to lists in full.
 */
export function TechList(props: TechListProps) {
    const rest = () => (props.limit === undefined ? 0 : Math.max(props.tech.length - props.limit, 0));
    return (
        <ul translate="no" class={cn("flex flex-wrap gap-1.5", props.class)}>
            <For each={orderTech(props.tech, props.role).slice(0, props.limit)}>
                {(item) => (
                    <li
                        class={cn(
                            "rounded border px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs",
                            isFocusTech(item, props.role) ? "border-primary/50 text-primary" : "border-border text-fg-subtle",
                        )}
                    >
                        {item}
                    </li>
                )}
            </For>
            <Show when={rest() > 0}>
                <li class="rounded border border-dashed border-border px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">+{rest()}</li>
            </Show>
        </ul>
    );
}
