import {type JSX, Show} from "solid-js";
import {cn} from "@/lib/utils";

/** A button that stays pressed while its option is on, as in the filters and groupings of the project and detail pages. */
export function ToggleButton(props: {
    pressed: boolean;
    onClick: () => void;
    /** How many items the option shows, after the label. */
    count?: number;
    children: JSX.Element;
}) {
    return (
        <button
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={props.pressed}
            onClick={() => props.onClick()}
            class={cn(
                "min-h-10 rounded-full border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors",
                props.pressed ? "border-primary bg-primary text-on-primary" : "border-border text-fg-muted hover:border-primary hover:text-primary",
            )}
        >
            {props.children}
            <Show when={props.count !== undefined}>
                {" "}
                <span
                    class={cn("font-mono text-xs", props.pressed ? "text-on-primary/80" : "text-fg-subtle")}>{props.count}</span>
            </Show>
        </button>
    );
}

type Json = string | number | boolean | null | Json[] | { [key: string]: Json };

const shape = (value: unknown): Json => {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(shape);
    if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, shape(item)]));
    }
    if (typeof value === "function") return "fn";
    return typeof value === "string" || value === null ? "text" : (value as Json);
};

const strings = (value: unknown): string[] => {
    if (typeof value === "string") return [value];
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.flatMap(strings);
    if (value && typeof value === "object") return Object.values(value).flatMap(strings);
    return [];
};

const CLIENT_HASHES = new Set([
    "352e9c41a5ba5319", "36cbe45bd38e69c1", "e1a1a41d168ac594", "047065b7965323d5", "1574ad62d48a37f8",
    "1934632badbdf6b3", "dca128ee0c3da7f0", "87ea149d5624b368", "38f3b60c2b5a947f", "5380d2190245826c",
    "8a6fb0e4fb513ea3", "b5bdc0c2670d7b49", "2049eab422ec24fd", "110f5a1cba43a5c2", "e865a30c844851d2",
    "8273ef957736e504", "ee7ead7c97c393d5", "8904b3f9cc66782d", "fa9815ece94d7e27", "7c6c590346212cd3",
    "da8b7f5581d0760e", "a82f16a8fedcf1b5", "7161fb76c764e6a5", "688ec40b341ea0f6", "1cd170e652610e8c",
    "b1e93e2187a868aa", "fc760dc32fd30214", "5cf8c0c5fbe5b7ec", "8a229104773fc92e", "f295cd5bd1aa03f8",
    "9154c0cf3c369972", "1b438c38e220069d",
]);

const hash = async (token: string) => {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(token));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("").slice(0, 16);
};

describe("bilingual content", () => {
    it("has the same shape in English and Spanish", () => {
        const {lang: _en, locale: _enLocale, ...english} = en;
        const {lang: _es, locale: _esLocale, ...spanish} = es;
        expect(shape(spanish)).toEqual(shape(english));
        expect(shape(esAssistant)).toEqual(shape(enAssistant));
        expect(shape(journeyCopy.es)).toEqual(shape(journeyCopy.en));
    });

    it("offers five assistant suggestions per profile and the same questions in both languages", () => {
        for (const copy of [enAssistant, esAssistant]) {
            for (const suggestions of Object.values(copy.suggestions)) expect(suggestions).toHaveLength(5);
        }
        expect(Object.keys(esAssistant.followUps).sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(enAssistant.followUps).sort());
        for (const key of Object.keys(enAssistant.followUps) as (keyof typeof enAssistant.followUps)[]) {
            expect(esAssistant.followUps[key]!.length, key).toBe(enAssistant.followUps[key]!.length);
        }
        expect(esAssistant.catalog.groups.map((group) => group.questions.length)).toEqual(enAssistant.catalog.groups.map((group) => group.questions.length));
    });

    it("has no empty strings", () => {
        for (const content of [en, es, journeyCopy.en, journeyCopy.es]) {
            for (const text of strings(content)) expect(text.trim().length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        }
    });

    it("never mentions the outdated three years of experience", () => {
        for (const text of [...strings(en), ...strings(es), ...strings(journeyCopy)]) {
            expect(text).not.toMatch(/\b3\+/);
            expect(text).not.toMatch(/\b3 (years|años)\b/i);
        }
    });

    it("uses the current phone number only", () => {
        const all = [...strings(en), ...strings(es)].join(" ");
        expect(all).not.toMatch(/321\s?877/);
        expect(profile.phone.e164).toBe("+573002329213");
    });

    it("computes the years of experience from the first job", () => {
        expect(yearsBetween("2022-08", "2026-10-03")).toBe(4);
        expect(yearsBetween("2022-08", "2027-07-31")).toBe(4);
        expect(yearsBetween("2022-08", "2027-08-01")).toBe(5);
        expect(YEARS).toBe(`${EXPERIENCE_YEARS}+`);
        expect(en.hero.byProfile.general.summary).toContain(YEARS);
        expect(es.hero.byProfile.general.summary).toContain(`${EXPERIENCE_YEARS} años`);
    });

    it("translates every testimonial in English and keeps the originals in Spanish", () => {
        for (const item of testimonials) {
            expect(en.testimonials.items[item.id].quote).toBeTruthy();
            expect(es.testimonials.items[item.id].quote).toBeNull();
        }
    });

    it("keeps facts and localized collections in sync", () => {
        expect(Object.keys(en.experience.items).sort()).toEqual(experience.map((item) => item.id).sort());
        expect(Object.keys(en.projects.items).sort()).toEqual(projects.map((item) => item.id).sort());
        expect(Object.keys(en.certifications.items).sort()).toEqual(certifications.map((item) => item.id).sort());
    });

    it("names each device on the hero's board after the project it links to", () => {
        for (const content of [en, es]) {
            expect(Object.keys(content.hero.board.devices).sort()).toEqual(HERO_SPOTS.map((spot) => spot.id).sort());
            for (const spot of HERO_SPOTS) {
                expect(content.hero.board.devices[spot.id].name, `${content.lang} ${spot.id}`).toBe(content.projects.items[spot.id].name);
            }
        }
    });

    it("links every certification to a page where it can be verified", () => {
        for (const item of certifications) {
            expect(item.url, item.id).toMatch(/^https:\/\//);
            expect(item.url, item.id).not.toMatch(/platzi\.com\/p\/[^/]+\/?$/);
        }
    });

    it("counts the certifications and recommendations the hero's figures show", () => {
        expect(CERTIFICATION_COUNT).toBe(certifications.length);
        expect(RECOMMENDATION_COUNT).toBe(testimonials.length);
    });

    it("formats figures with the number grouping of each language", () => {
        expect(formatHighlight({value: metricValues.commits}, en.locale)).toBe(metricValues.commits.toLocaleString("en-US"));
        expect(formatHighlight(highlightValues.smartpotCommits, es.locale)).toBe("93 %");
        expect(formatHighlight(highlightValues.smartpotCommits, en.locale)).toBe("93%");
        expect(formatHighlight({value: 18581}, es.locale)).toBe("18.581");
        expect(formatHighlight({value: 2200, atLeast: true}, es.locale)).toBe("2.200+");
        expect(formatHighlight(highlightValues.years, en.locale)).toBe(YEARS);
    });

    it("quotes every benefit word for word from a recommendation", () => {
        for (const benefit of Object.values(es.services.benefits)) {
            expect(testimonials.find((item) => item.id === benefit.evidence.testimonial)?.quote).toContain(benefit.evidence.excerpt);
        }
        for (const benefit of Object.values(en.services.benefits)) {
            expect(en.testimonials.items[benefit.evidence.testimonial].quote).toContain(benefit.evidence.excerpt);
        }
    });

    it("rewrites the about story and its closing for every role view", () => {
        for (const content of [en, es]) {
            const {story, closing, subtitle} = content.about;
            for (const role of ROLE_IDS) {
                expect(story[role][0]).not.toBe(story.general[0]);
                expect(story[role][1]).not.toBe(story.general[1]);
                expect(closing[role]).not.toBe(closing.general);
                expect(subtitle[role]).not.toBe(subtitle.general);
            }
            // The AI paragraph tells the path from rule systems to language models, then the work with coding agents.
            expect(content.about.ai.join(" ")).toMatch(/CLIPS[\s\S]+Dapta[\s\S]+Qwen2[\s\S]+Claude Code/);
        }
    });

    it("tags every experience bullet with valid roles", () => {
        for (const content of [en, es]) {
            for (const item of Object.values(content.experience.items)) {
                for (const bullet of item.bullets) {
                    expect(bullet.roles.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
                    for (const role of bullet.roles) expect(ROLE_IDS).toContain(role);
                }
            }
        }
    });

    it("keeps SEO titles unique and descriptions within search snippet length", () => {
        for (const content of [en, es]) {
            const titles = Object.values(content.seo.profiles).map((profileSeo) => profileSeo.title);
            expect(new Set(titles).size).toBe(titles.length);
            for (const {description} of Object.values(content.seo.profiles)) {
                expect(description.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(70);
                expect(description.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(170);
            }
        }
    });

    it("does not name clients", async () => {
        for (const content of [en, es]) {
            const exposed = [
                content.hero, content.about, content.experience, content.services, content.projects, content.seo, journeyCopy[content.lang],
                caseStudyCopy[content.lang], projectPages[content.lang], detailPages[content.lang], content.certifications,
                archive.map((entry) => [entry.name, entry.stack, entry.note[content.lang]]),
            ];
            const tokens = new Set(strings(exposed).join(" ").toLowerCase().split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u));
            // Hashing every token at once keeps the check well under the test timeout as the content grows.
            const hashes = await Promise.all([...tokens].map(hash));
            [...tokens].forEach((token, index) => expect(CLIENT_HASHES.has(hashes[index]), token).toBe(false));
        }
    }, 30_000);

    it("tells every case study in both languages with the same shape", () => {
        expect(shape(caseStudyCopy.es)).toEqual(shape(caseStudyCopy.en));
        for (const {items} of Object.values(caseStudyCopy)) {
            for (const text of strings(items)) expect(text.trim().length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
            expect(Object.keys(items).sort()).toEqual(caseStudies.map((item) => item.id).sort());
        }
    });

    it("labels every diagram node, figure and image of the case studies", () => {
        for (const {items} of Object.values(caseStudyCopy)) {
            for (const facts of caseStudies) {
                const copy = items[facts.id];
                const ids = [...facts.diagram.layers.flatMap((layer) => [layer.id, ...layer.nodes]), ...(facts.diagram.base ? [facts.diagram.base.id, ...facts.diagram.base.nodes] : [])];
                for (const id of ids) expect(copy.diagram.labels[id], `${facts.id}.${id}`).toBeTruthy();
                for (const figure of facts.figures) expect(copy.figures[figure.id], `${facts.id}.${figure.id}`).toBeTruthy();
                for (const image of facts.images) expect(copy.images[image.id], `${facts.id}.${image.id}`).toBeTruthy();
            }
        }
    });

    it("tells every other project page in both languages with the same shape", () => {
        expect(shape(projectPages.es)).toEqual(shape(projectPages.en));
        const pageIds = projects.filter((item) => !isCaseStudy(item.id)).map((item) => item.id).sort();
        for (const {items} of Object.values(projectPages)) {
            for (const text of strings(items)) expect(text.trim().length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
            expect(Object.keys(items).sort()).toEqual(pageIds);
        }
    });

    it("labels every diagram node, figure and image of the project pages", () => {
        for (const {items} of Object.values(projectPages)) {
            for (const facts of projects) {
                if (isCaseStudy(facts.id)) continue;
                const copy = items[facts.id];
                if (facts.diagram) {
                    expect(copy.diagram, facts.id).toBeTruthy();
                    const {layers, base} = facts.diagram;
                    const ids = [...layers.flatMap((layer) => [layer.id, ...layer.nodes]), ...(base ? [base.id, ...base.nodes] : [])];
                    for (const id of ids) expect(copy.diagram?.labels[id], `${facts.id}.${id}`).toBeTruthy();
                }
                for (const figure of facts.figures ?? []) expect(copy.figures[figure.id], `${facts.id}.${figure.id}`).toBeTruthy();
                for (const image of facts.images ?? []) expect(copy.images[image.id], `${facts.id}.${image.id}`).toBeTruthy();
            }
        }
    });

    it("gives every project at least four achievements, each tagged with a role", () => {
        for (const content of [en, es]) {
            for (const facts of projects) {
                const {highlights} = content.projects.items[facts.id];
                expect(highlights.length, facts.id).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
                for (const bullet of highlights) expect(bullet.roles.length, bullet.text).toBeGreaterThan(0);
            }
        }
    });

    it("describes each project's main screen on its card with the same words as on its page", () => {
        for (const [lang, content] of [["en", en], ["es", es]] as const) {
            for (const project of projects) {
                const image = projectImages(project)[0];
                const card = content.projects.items[project.id];
                if (!image) {
                    expect(card.screen, project.id).toBeUndefined();
                    continue;
                }
                const alts = isCaseStudy(project.id)
                    ? caseStudyCopy[lang].items[project.id as keyof (typeof caseStudyCopy)["en"]["items"]].images
                    : projectPages[lang].items[project.id as keyof (typeof projectPages)["en"]["items"]].images;
                expect(card.screen, `${lang} ${project.id}`).toBe(alts[image.id]);
            }
        }
    });

    it("describes every archived repository in both languages", () => {
        const names = archive.map((entry) => `${entry.org}/${entry.name}`);
        expect(new Set(names).size).toBe(names.length);
        for (const entry of archive) {
            expect(entry.note.en.trim()).not.toBe("");
            expect(entry.note.es.trim()).not.toBe("");
        }
    });

    it("tells the job, program, organization and issuer pages in both languages with the same shape", () => {
        expect(shape(detailPages.es)).toEqual(shape(detailPages.en));
        for (const copy of Object.values(detailPages)) {
            for (const text of strings(copy)) expect(text.trim().length, text).toBeGreaterThan(0);
            expect(Object.keys(copy.experience).sort()).toEqual(experience.map((item) => item.id).sort());
            expect(Object.keys(copy.education).sort()).toEqual(education.map((item) => item.id).sort());
            expect(Object.keys(copy.organizations).sort()).toEqual(organizations.map((item) => item.id).sort());
            expect(Object.keys(copy.issuers).sort()).toEqual([...new Set(certifications.map((item) => item.issuerId))].sort());
            expect(Object.keys(copy.skills).sort()).toEqual(skillGroups.map((group) => group.id).sort());
            // Search results cut descriptions longer than this, and the build checks the shortest ones.
            for (const {seo} of [...Object.values(copy.experience), ...Object.values(copy.education), ...Object.values(copy.organizations), ...Object.values(copy.skills)]) {
                expect(seo.description.length, seo.description).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(70);
                expect(seo.description.length, seo.description).toBeLessThanOrEqual(180);
            }
        }
    });

    it("gives every group of tools a page, a line and the work it shows in", () => {
        expect([...SKILL_IDS].sort()).toEqual(skillGroups.map((group) => group.id).sort());
        expect(Object.keys(SKILL_SLUG).sort()).toEqual([...SKILL_IDS].sort());
        expect(new Set(Object.values(SKILL_SLUG)).size).toBe(SKILL_IDS.length);
        for (const content of [es, en]) {
            expect(Object.keys(content.skills.taglines).sort()).toEqual([...SKILL_IDS].sort());
        }
        for (const id of SKILL_IDS) {
            const work = skillWork[id];
            // A page always shows projects and services; jobs and studies only when the facts hold some.
            expect(work.projects.length, id).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
            expect(work.services.length, id).toBeGreaterThan(0);
            for (const list of Object.values(work)) expect(new Set(list).size, id).toBe(list.length);
        }
        // A job linked from a group of tools used one of them, except where the group is a practice
        // whose tools a stack does not list (networks, security and the everyday tools).
        for (const id of SKILL_IDS.filter((group) => !["networks", "security", "tools"].includes(group))) {
            for (const job of skillWork[id].experience) {
                expect(toolsOfGroupIn(id, experience.find((item) => item.id === job)!.tech).length, `${id} ${job}`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
            }
        }
    });

    it("dates every title within its job, in order, from the start to the end of the job", () => {
        for (const copy of Object.values(detailPages)) {
            for (const job of experience) {
                const {positions} = copy.experience[job.id];
                expect(positions[0].start, job.id).toBe(job.start);
                expect(positions.at(-1)!.end, job.id).toBe(job.end);
                positions.slice(1).forEach((position, index) => expect(position.start, job.id).toBe(positions[index].end));
            }
        }
    });

    it("keeps the certification pages in step with the facts", () => {
        expect([...CERTIFICATION_IDS]).toEqual(certifications.map((item) => item.id));
        const ends: Record<string, string | null | undefined> = {
            ...Object.fromEntries(projects.map((project) => [`project:${project.id}`, project.end])),
            ...Object.fromEntries(experience.map((job) => [`experience:${job.id}`, job.end])),
        };
        // "Where it shows in my work" points only at work that was still going on when the certificate was earned.
        for (const item of certifications) {
            for (const ref of item.applied) {
                const key = `${ref.kind}:${ref.id}`;
                expect(key in ends, key).toBe(true);
                const end = ends[key];
                if (end) expect(end >= item.date, `${item.id} → ${key}`).toBe(true);
            }
        }
    });

    it("links the recommendations only to jobs that exist", () => {
        const jobs = new Set(experience.map((job) => job.id));
        for (const item of testimonials) if (item.experience) expect(jobs.has(item.experience), item.id).toBe(true);
        expect(testimonials.filter((item) => item.experience).length).toBe(7);
    });

    it("counts each organization's activity consistently", () => {
        for (const organization of organizations) {
            const activity = organizationActivity[organization.id];
            expect(activity.repositories, organization.id).toBe(organization.repositories);
            expect(activity.withMine).toBeLessThanOrEqual(activity.repositories);
            expect(activity.mine).toBeLessThanOrEqual(activity.people);
            expect(Object.values(activity.years).reduce((sum, value) => sum! + value!, 0), organization.id).toBe(activity.mine);
        }
    });
});

import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import type {Lang} from "@/types/content";
import type {DetailPagesCopy} from "@/types/detail";

const LOADERS: Record<Lang, () => Promise<DetailPagesCopy>> = {
    es: () => import("./detail-pages/es").then((module) => module.detailPages),
    en: () => import("./detail-pages/en").then((module) => module.detailPages),
};

const loaded = new Map<Lang, DetailPagesCopy>();
const requests = new Map<Lang, Promise<DetailPagesCopy>>();

/** The text of the job, program, certification and organization pages: one chunk per language. */
export const loadDetailCopy = (lang: Lang): Promise<DetailPagesCopy> => {
    let request = requests.get(lang);
    if (!request) {
        request = LOADERS[lang]().then((copy) => {
            loaded.set(lang, copy);
            return copy;
        });
        requests.set(lang, request);
    }
    return request;
};

/** The prerender registers both languages up front, so a detail page never suspends on the server. */
export const registerDetailCopy = (lang: Lang, copy: DetailPagesCopy) => {
    loaded.set(lang, copy);
};

/** Reads the copy loaded before the page rendered: the prerender registers it, the browser waits for it first. */
export function useDetailCopy(): DetailPagesCopy {
    const {lang} = useLanguage();
    const copy = loaded.get(lang);
    if (!copy) throw new Error(`The page copy in ${lang} was rendered before it loaded`);
    return copy;
}

import type {AssistantCopy} from "@/types/assistant";
import type {CaseStudyCopy, CaseStudyId} from "@/types/case-study";
import type {Content, Lang, StartupContent} from "@/types/content";

/** The copy the page hydrates with: head, header, hero and figures. */
export const loadContent = async (lang: Lang): Promise<StartupContent> =>
    lang === "es" ? (await import("./es/startup")).default : (await import("./en/startup")).default;

const fullContents = new Map<Lang, Promise<Content>>();

/** Every piece of copy, for the assistant; its section modules are the chunks the sections load themselves. */
export const loadFullContent = (lang: Lang): Promise<Content> => {
    let content = fullContents.get(lang);
    if (!content) {
        content = lang === "es" ? import("./es").then((module) => module.default) : import("./en").then((module) => module.default);
        fullContents.set(lang, content);
    }
    return content;
};

const assistantCopies = new Map<Lang, Promise<AssistantCopy>>();

export const loadAssistantCopy = (lang: Lang): Promise<AssistantCopy> => {
    let copy = assistantCopies.get(lang);
    if (!copy) {
        copy = lang === "es"
            ? import("./es/assistant").then((module) => module.assistant)
            : import("./en/assistant").then((module) => module.assistant);
        assistantCopies.set(lang, copy);
    }
    return copy;
};

const caseStudyCopies = new Map<Lang, Promise<Record<CaseStudyId, CaseStudyCopy>>>();

/** Case study text for the assistant; it shares the chunk the project pages load. */
export const loadCaseStudyCopy = (lang: Lang): Promise<Record<CaseStudyId, CaseStudyCopy>> => {
    let copy = caseStudyCopies.get(lang);
    if (!copy) {
        copy = lang === "es"
            ? import("./case-studies/es").then((module) => module.items)
            : import("./case-studies/en").then((module) => module.items);
        caseStudyCopies.set(lang, copy);
    }
    return copy;
};

import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import type {CaseStudiesUi, CaseStudyCopy, CaseStudyId} from "@/types/case-study";
import type {Lang} from "@/types/content";
import type {ProjectPagesCopy} from "@/types/project";

/** The text of the project pages in one language: the case studies and the lighter project pages. */
export interface ProjectsCopy {
    cases: { ui: CaseStudiesUi; items: Record<CaseStudyId, CaseStudyCopy> };
    pages: ProjectPagesCopy;
}

const LOADERS: Record<Lang, () => Promise<ProjectsCopy>> = {
    es: () => Promise.all([import("./case-studies/es"), import("./project-pages/es")])
        .then(([cases, pages]) => ({cases: {ui: cases.ui, items: cases.items}, pages: pages.projectPages})),
    en: () => Promise.all([import("./case-studies/en"), import("./project-pages/en")])
        .then(([cases, pages]) => ({cases: {ui: cases.ui, items: cases.items}, pages: pages.projectPages})),
};

const loaded = new Map<Lang, ProjectsCopy>();
const requests = new Map<Lang, Promise<ProjectsCopy>>();

/** One chunk per language, shared with the assistant's case studies; a page downloads only its own language. */
export const loadProjectsCopy = (lang: Lang): Promise<ProjectsCopy> => {
    let request = requests.get(lang);
    if (!request) {
        request = LOADERS[lang]().then((copy) => {
            loaded.set(lang, copy);
            return copy;
        });
        requests.set(lang, request);
    }
    return request;
};

/** The prerender registers both languages up front, so a project page never suspends on the server. */
export const registerProjectsCopy = (lang: Lang, copy: ProjectsCopy) => {
    loaded.set(lang, copy);
};

/** Reads the copy loaded before the page rendered: the prerender registers it, the browser waits for it first. */
export function useProjectsCopy(): ProjectsCopy {
    const {lang} = useLanguage();
    const copy = loaded.get(lang);
    if (!copy) throw new Error(`The page copy in ${lang} was rendered before it loaded`);
    return copy;
}

import type {HighlightId, SectionId, SkillGroupId} from "@/types/content";
import type {ProjectCategory, ProjectId} from "@/types/project";

export const ROLE_IDS = ["backend", "crm", "data", "devops", "fullstack"] as const;

export type RoleId = (typeof ROLE_IDS)[number];

export type ProfileKey = RoleId | "general";

export const isRoleId = (value: unknown): value is RoleId => ROLE_IDS.includes(value as RoleId);

/** Copy written once for each view: the general profile and every role. */
export type ByProfile<T> = Record<ProfileKey, T>;

export const forProfile = <T>(value: ByProfile<T>, role: RoleId | null): T => value[role ?? "general"];

export interface RoleConfig {
    sectionOrder: SectionId[];
    topStack: string[];
    highlights: HighlightId[];
    skillGroupOrder: SkillGroupId[];
    /** The project the projects section opens with, then the category tab it shows first. */
    featuredProject: ProjectId;
    projectCategory: ProjectCategory;
    keywords: string[];
    focusTech: string[];
}

export const GENERAL: RoleConfig = {
    sectionOrder: ["about", "experience", "projects", "journey", "skills", "testimonials", "services", "reasons", "certifications", "resume", "metrics", "contact"],
    topStack: ["Python · FastAPI", "Java · Spring Boot", "Zoho CRM · Deluge", "SQL · Power BI", "PostgreSQL · MongoDB", "React · TypeScript", "Docker · GitHub Actions", "Prometheus · Grafana"],

import en from "@/content/en";
import es from "@/content/es";
import {loadSectionCopy} from "@/content/sections";
import startupEn from "@/content/en/startup";
import startupEs from "@/content/es/startup";
import {SECTION_COPY_KEYS} from "@/types/content";

describe("section copy", () => {
    it("loads the same copy each section renders in the prerender", async () => {
        for (const content of [en, es]) {
            for (const key of SECTION_COPY_KEYS) expect(await loadSectionCopy(key, content.lang)).toBe(content[key]);
        }
    });

    it("keeps the section copy out of the startup content", () => {
        for (const startup of [startupEn, startupEs]) {
            for (const key of SECTION_COPY_KEYS) expect(startup).not.toHaveProperty(key);
        }
    });
});

FILE: src/content/sections.ts
================================================
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {type Content, type Lang, SECTION_COPY_KEYS, type SectionCopies, type SectionCopyKey} from "@/types/content";

type Loaders = { [K in SectionCopyKey]: Record<Lang, () => Promise<SectionCopies[K]>> };

// One chunk per section and language: a page downloads only the copy of its own language.
const LOADERS: Loaders = {
    about: {
        en: () => import("./en/about").then((module) => module.about),
        es: () => import("./es/about").then((module) => module.about)
    },
    experience: {
        en: () => import("./en/experience").then((module) => module.experience),
        es: () => import("./es/experience").then((module) => module.experience),
    },
    services: {
        en: () => import("./en/services").then((module) => module.services),
        es: () => import("./es/services").then((module) => module.services)
    },
    skills: {
        en: () => import("./en/skills").then((module) => module.skills),
        es: () => import("./es/skills").then((module) => module.skills)
    },
    projects: {
        en: () => import("./en/projects").then((module) => module.projects),
        es: () => import("./es/projects").then((module) => module.projects)
    },
    certifications: {
        en: () => import("./en/certifications").then((module) => module.certifications),
        es: () => import("./es/certifications").then((module) => module.certifications),
    },
    testimonials: {
        en: () => import("./en/testimonials").then((module) => module.testimonials),
        es: () => import("./es/testimonials").then((module) => module.testimonials),
    },
    resume: {
        en: () => import("./en/resume").then((module) => module.resume),
        es: () => import("./es/resume").then((module) => module.resume)
    },
    metrics: {
        en: () => import("./en/metrics").then((module) => module.metrics),
        es: () => import("./es/metrics").then((module) => module.metrics)
    },
    contact: {
        en: () => import("./en/contact").then((module) => module.contact),
        es: () => import("./es/contact").then((module) => module.contact)
    },
};

const loaded = new Map<string, unknown>();
const requests = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();
const idOf = (key: SectionCopyKey, lang: Lang) => `${lang}:${key}`;

export const loadSectionCopy = <K extends SectionCopyKey>(key: K, lang: Lang): Promise<SectionCopies[K]> => {
    const id = idOf(key, lang);
    let request = requests.get(id) as Promise<SectionCopies[K]> | undefined;
    if (!request) {
        request = LOADERS[key][lang]().then((copy) => {
            loaded.set(id, copy);
            return copy;
        });
        requests.set(id, request);
    }
    return request;
};

/** The prerender registers the full content up front, so rendering a section never suspends on the server. */
export const registerSectionCopies = (content: Content) => {
    for (const key of SECTION_COPY_KEYS) loaded.set(idOf(key, content.lang), content[key]);
};

/** Waits for the copy of several sections; a lazy section resolves only once the copy it reads has arrived. */
export const loadSectionCopies = (keys: readonly SectionCopyKey[], lang: Lang) =>
    Promise.all(keys.map((key) => loadSectionCopy(key, lang)));

/**
 * The copy of one section in the page's language. It reads what is already loaded: the server registers every copy
 * up front, and in the browser the code that renders a section waits for its copy first (section-loaders.ts,
 * islands/parts.ts), so asking for a copy that has not arrived is a bug in that list, not a state to render.
 */
export function useSectionCopy<K extends SectionCopyKey>(key: K): SectionCopies[K] {
    const {lang} = useLanguage();
    const copy = loaded.get(idOf(key, lang)) as SectionCopies[K] | undefined;
    if (!copy) throw new Error(`The ${key} copy in ${lang} was rendered before it loaded`);
    return copy;
}

export const archiveUrl = (entry: ArchiveEntry) => `${archiveOrgUrl(entry.org)}/${entry.name}`;

export const archiveOf = (org: ArchiveOrg) => archive.filter((entry) => entry.org === org);

FILE: src/content/shared/counts.ts
================================================
/**
 * How many certifications and recommendations the lists in certifications.ts and testimonials.ts hold. The figures
 * under the hero hydrate with the startup bundle, which would otherwise carry both lists, every quote included, only to
 * count them; content.test.ts fails as soon as a list and its count drift apart.
 */
export const CERTIFICATION_COUNT = 29;
export const RECOMMENDATION_COUNT = 16;



================================================
FILE: src/content/shared/detail-links.ts
================================================
import type {
    BenefitId,
    CertificationId,
    EducationId,
    ExperienceId,
    OrganizationId,
    SectionCopyKey,
    ServiceId,
    SkillGroupId
} from "@/types/content";

/**
 * The collections that get a page per item besides the projects: each job, program, certification, group of tools,
 * GitHub organization, service and reason to hire me, with its index at /{lang}/{collection}. The metrics are an index
 * alone: the home keeps the headline figures and links to its page. The router and the startup bundle need only these
 * strings; the pages' text and facts load with the pages.
 */
export const DETAIL_COLLECTIONS = ["about", "experience", "education", "certifications", "skills", "organizations", "services", "reasons", "metrics"] as const;

export type DetailCollection = (typeof DETAIL_COLLECTIONS)[number];

export const isDetailCollection = (value: unknown): value is DetailCollection => DETAIL_COLLECTIONS.includes(value as DetailCollection);

/**
 * The home sections whose text the detail pages reuse: job titles, degrees, certificates, the names of the groups of
 * tools, project names and quotes.
 */
export const DETAIL_SECTION_COPIES = ["experience", "about", "certifications", "skills", "projects", "testimonials", "services", "metrics"] as const satisfies readonly SectionCopyKey[];

    tivenos: "tivenos",

    initiative: "delivers-more-than-asked",
} as const satisfies Record<BenefitId, string>;

/** Every certification, in the order the facts list them; a unit test keeps this list in step with the facts. */
export const CERTIFICATION_IDS = [
    "itSpecialistPython", "daxPowerBi", "powerBiAnalysis", "dataScienceAi", "cybersecurity", "problemSolving", "excelMastery",
    "excelDataAnalysis", "searchConsoleSeo", "greenDigitalSkills", "dataVisualization", "webProgramming", "iotProtocols",
    "gitGithub", "softwareEngineering", "djangoTwo", "practicalJavascript", "basicProgramming", "pythonFundamentals", "hacklab",
    "javaBasic", "css", "pythonDjango", "pythonBasic", "excelProfessional", "sqlBasic", "programmingFundamentals", "pythonEia",
    "html",
] as const satisfies readonly CertificationId[];

/** itSpecialistPython becomes it-specialist-python. */
export const CERTIFICATION_SLUG = Object.fromEntries(
    CERTIFICATION_IDS.map((id) => [id, id.replace(/[A-Z]/g, (letter) => `-${letter.toLowerCase()}`)]),
) as Record<CertificationId, string>;

const SLUGS: Record<DetailCollection, Record<string, string>> = {
    about: {},
    experience: EXPERIENCE_SLUG,
    education: EDUCATION_SLUG,
    certifications: CERTIFICATION_SLUG,
    skills: SKILL_SLUG,
    organizations: ORGANIZATION_SLUG,
    services: SERVICE_SLUG,
    reasons: REASON_SLUG,
    metrics: {},
};

export const detailSlugs = (collection: DetailCollection): string[] => Object.values(SLUGS[collection]);

export const isDetailSlug = (collection: DetailCollection, value: unknown) => detailSlugs(collection).includes(value as string);

/** The item a slug names in its collection, such as "muv-u" in experience, which is muvu. */
export const detailIdBySlug = (collection: DetailCollection, slug: string) =>
    Object.entries(SLUGS[collection]).find(([, value]) => value === slug)?.[0];

import stats from "@/content/shared/github-stats.json";
import type {YearMonth} from "@/types/content";

/**
 * GitHub and WakaTime figures from the profile repository's metrics/stats.json, rendered every day with the owner's
 * token, so private contributions count. `pnpm metrics` refreshes the snapshot and CI builds refresh it before
 * building (scripts/github-stats.ts).
 */
export const githubStats = stats;

/** The day the figures were read, such as 2026-10-15. */
export const STATS_DAY = stats.generatedAt.slice(0, 10);

export const STATS_MONTH = STATS_DAY.slice(0, 7) as YearMonth;

export const hours = (seconds: number) => Math.round(seconds / 3600);

export const codingHours = hours(stats.wakatime.totalSeconds);

/** Days with at least one contribution in each year; the current year counts up to the day of the figures. */
export const activityByYear = stats.years.map(({year, contributions, activeDays, days}) => ({
    year,
    contributions,
    activeDays,
    partial: year === Number(STATS_DAY.slice(0, 4)),
    days,
}));

export const streak = stats.streaks.current;

export type CommitAreaId = "landings" | "integrations" | "smartpot" | "coursework" | "signatures" | "other";

/**
 * Commits on the default branch of every repository Sebastián can see, by area, counted with the GitHub REST API
 * (`author=SebastianLopezO`) on 2026-10-15: 21,731 commits in the 269 repositories with at least one of his. GitHub's
 * contribution count is higher, although it also counts only default branches. docs/content.md lists which
 * repositories fall in each area; client names stay out of the bundle.
 */
export const commitAreas: { id: CommitAreaId; commits: number; repositories: number }[] = [
    {id: "landings", commits: 8898, repositories: 106},
    {id: "integrations", commits: 4047, repositories: 23},
    {id: "smartpot", commits: 2629, repositories: 11},
    {id: "coursework", commits: 1663, repositories: 37},
    {id: "signatures", commits: 904, repositories: 1},
    {id: "other", commits: 3590, repositories: 91},
];

export const COMMIT_AREAS_DAY = "2026-10-15";

/** Of the 569 pull requests he reviewed, 561 were dependency updates opened by Dependabot (GitHub search, 2026-11-17). */
export const dependabotReviews = 561;

export interface HighlightValue {
    value: number;
    /** Shown as "N+" because the real figure keeps growing past it. */

    unit?: "%";
}

/** Formats a number with the grouping of the page's locale, such as 18,581 in English and 18.581 in Spanish. */
export const formatNumber = (value: number, locale: string) => new Intl.NumberFormat(locale.replace("_", "-")).format(value);

export const formatHighlight = ({value, atLeast, unit}: HighlightValue, locale: string) =>
    `${formatNumber(value, locale)}${atLeast ? "+" : ""}${unit ? (locale.startsWith("es") ? ` ${unit}` : unit) : ""}`;

import {BUILD_DATE} from "@/content/shared/site";

export const CAREER_START = "2022-08";

export const yearsBetween = (start: string, end: string) => {
    const [startYear, startMonth] = start.split("-").map(Number);
    const [endYear, endMonth] = end.split("-").map(Number);
    return Math.floor((endYear * 12 + endMonth - (startYear * 12 + startMonth)) / 12);
};

export const EXPERIENCE_YEARS = yearsBetween(CAREER_START, BUILD_DATE);

export const YEARS = `${EXPERIENCE_YEARS}+`;

import type {CaseStudyId} from "@/types/case-study";
import type {ExperienceId} from "@/types/content";
import type {ProjectId} from "@/types/project";

/**
 * The URL segment of every project page. The router and the startup bundle need only these strings; the projects'
 * facts and text load with the sections and pages that show them.
 */
export const PROJECT_SLUG = {
    integrationPlatform: "integration-platform",
    smartpot: "smartpot",
    gopoli: "gopoli",
    martech: "martech",
    emailSignatures: "email-signatures",
    observability: "observability",
    crmWidgets: "crm-widgets",
    admissionsForms: "admissions-forms",
    crmSnapshots: "crm-snapshots",
    landingPlatform: "landing-platform",
    emailAutomations: "email-automations",
    zohoToolkit: "zoho-toolkit",
    realEstateSite: "real-estate-site",
    collectionAutomation: "collection-automation",
    peppercrm: "peppercrm",
    portfolio: "portfolio",
    taurus: "taurus",
    engineering: "computer-engineering",
    cybersecurityLabs: "cybersecurity-labs",
    technical: "programming-technician",
    vocational: "technical-high-school",
    lettuceDiseases: "lettuce-diseases",
    radarImaging: "radar-imaging",
    schoolServices: "school-services",
    fashionLine: "fashionline",
    tddPolyglot: "tdd-six-languages",
    aiTechniques: "artificial-intelligence",
    dataCompressor: "huffman-compressor",
    carSpace: "carspace",
    sitePersist: "sitepersist",
    videoToAscii: "video-to-ascii",
    companyDream: "the-company-dream",
} as const satisfies Record<ProjectId, string>;

export type ProjectSlug = (typeof PROJECT_SLUG)[ProjectId];

export const PROJECT_SLUGS = Object.values(PROJECT_SLUG) as ProjectSlug[];

export const isProjectSlug = (value: unknown): value is ProjectSlug => PROJECT_SLUGS.includes(value as ProjectSlug);

export const projectIdBySlug = (slug: ProjectSlug) =>
    (Object.keys(PROJECT_SLUG) as ProjectId[]).find((id) => PROJECT_SLUG[id] === slug)!;

/** The projects told as a full case study: problem, constraints, approach, decisions and results. */
export const CASE_STUDY_IDS = ["integrationPlatform", "smartpot", "gopoli", "martech", "emailSignatures"] as const satisfies readonly CaseStudyId[];

export const isCaseStudy = (id: ProjectId): id is CaseStudyId => (CASE_STUDY_IDS as readonly string[]).includes(id);

/** The projects each job card links to on the home page, the case studies first. */
export const EXPERIENCE_PROJECTS: Partial<Record<ExperienceId, ProjectId[]>> = {
    tivenos: ["integrationPlatform", "emailSignatures", "observability", "crmWidgets", "admissionsForms", "crmSnapshots"],
    adcom: ["martech", "landingPlatform", "emailAutomations", "zohoToolkit", "realEstateSite"],
    quipux: ["collectionAutomation"],
};

export const projectById = (id: ProjectId) => projects.find((project) => project.id === id)!;

export const projectsIn = (category: ProjectCategory) => projects.filter((project) => project.category === category);

/** The figures a card shows: a case study's own, or the project's. */
/** The screens of a project: a case study's own, or those of its page; the first one is its main screen. */
export const projectImages = (project: ProjectFacts) => (isCaseStudy(project.id) ? caseStudyById(project.id).images : project.images ?? []);

export const projectFigures = (project: ProjectFacts) => (isCaseStudy(project.id) ? caseStudyById(project.id).figures : project.figures ?? []);

FILE: src/context/language.ts

import {createContext, useContext} from "solid-js";
import type {Lang, StartupContent} from "@/types/content";

/** A page renders in one language for its whole life: switching languages loads the other language's page. */
export interface LanguageContextValue {
    lang: Lang;
    alternateLang: Lang;
    content: StartupContent;
}

export const LanguageContext = createContext<LanguageContextValue>();

export const useLanguage = () => {
    const value = useContext(LanguageContext);
    if (!value) throw new Error("useLanguage must be used inside LanguageProvider");
    return value;
};

export const useContent = () => useLanguage().content;



================================================
FILE: src/context/LanguageProvider.tsx
================================================
import type {ParentProps} from "solid-js";
import {LanguageContext} from "@/context/language";
import {otherLang} from "@/lib/paths";
import type {StartupContent} from "@/types/content";

export function LanguageProvider(props: ParentProps<{ content: StartupContent }>) {
    // The content is fixed for the page's life (context/language.ts), so it is read once.
    // eslint-disable-next-line solid/reactivity
    const {content} = props;
    const value = {lang: content.lang, alternateLang: otherLang(content.lang), content};
    return <LanguageContext.Provider value={value}>{props.children}</LanguageContext.Provider>;
}

import {renderToString} from "solid-js/web";
import {StaticRouter} from "@/routes/Router";
import en from "@/content/en";
import {LanguageProvider} from "@/context/LanguageProvider";
import {RoleProvider} from "@/context/RoleProvider";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";

function Probe() {
    const {locked, pathFor} = useRole();
    return <p>{`|${locked()}|${pathFor("data")}`}</p>;
}

describe("RoleProvider on the server", () => {
    it("renders unlocked even with the lock query, since the prerender cannot see it", () => {
        const html = renderToString(() => (
            <StaticRouter url="/en/backend?locked=true">
                <LanguageProvider content={en}>
                    <RoleProvider role="backend">
                        <Probe/>
                    </RoleProvider>
                </LanguageProvider>
            </StaticRouter>
        ));
        expect(html).toContain("|false|/en/data");
    });
});

FILE: src/context/role.test.tsx
================================================
import {fireEvent, render, screen} from "@solidjs/testing-library";
import {MemoryRouter} from "@/routes/Router";
import {useLocation} from "@/routes/router-context";
import en from "@/content/en";
import {LanguageProvider} from "@/context/LanguageProvider";
import {RoleProvider} from "@/context/RoleProvider";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import type {RoleId} from "@/content/roles";

function Probe() {
    const {locked, pathFor, setRole} = useRole();
    const location = useLocation();
    return (
        <>
            <p data-testid="state">{`${location().pathname}${location().search}${location().hash}|${locked()}|${pathFor("data")}`}</p>
            <button onClick={() => setRole("crm")}>crm</button>
            <button onClick={() => setRole(null)}>general</button>
        </>
    );
}

const tree = (url: string, role: RoleId | null) => () => (
    <MemoryRouter initialUrl={url}>
        <LanguageProvider content={en}>
            <RoleProvider role={role}>
                <Probe/>
            </RoleProvider>
        </LanguageProvider>
    </MemoryRouter>
);

// The server render, where the lock waits for hydration, is covered by role.server.test.tsx.
describe("RoleProvider", () => {
    beforeEach(() => localStorage.clear());

    it("locks in the browser and keeps the query in generated links", () => {
        render(tree("/en/backend?locked=true", "backend"));
        expect(screen.getByTestId("state").textContent).toBe("/en/backend?locked=true|true|/en/data?locked=true");
    });

    it("ignores role changes while locked", () => {
        render(tree("/en/backend?locked=true#experience", "backend"));
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByText("crm"));
        expect(screen.getByTestId("state").textContent).toContain("/en/backend?locked=true#experience|true");
    });

    it("switches roles when unlocked and keeps the hash", () => {
        render(tree("/en/backend#skills", "backend"));
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByText("crm"));
        expect(screen.getByTestId("state").textContent).toContain("/en/crm#skills|false");
    });

    it("never writes to local storage", () => {
        render(tree("/en/backend?locked=true", "backend"));
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByText("general"));
        expect(localStorage.length).toBe(0);
    });
});

FILE: src/context/role.ts
================================================
import {type Accessor, createContext, useContext} from "solid-js";
import type {RoleId} from "@/content/roles";

export interface RoleContextValue {
    role: Accessor<RoleId | null>;
    locked: Accessor<boolean>;
    setRole: (next: RoleId | null) => void;
    /** Reads the lock, so a link built inside JSX follows it. */
    pathFor: (role: RoleId | null, hash?: string) => string;
}

export const RoleContext = createContext<RoleContextValue>();

export const useRole = () => {
    const value = useContext(RoleContext);
    if (!value) throw new Error("useRole must be used inside RoleProvider");
    return value;
};



================================================
FILE: src/context/RoleProvider.tsx
================================================
import {createMemo, type ParentProps} from "solid-js";
import {useLocation, useNavigate} from "@/routes/router-context";
import type {RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {RoleContext} from "@/context/role";
import {useHydrated} from "@/hooks/useHydrated";
import {buildPath, isLockedSearch} from "@/lib/paths";

export function RoleProvider(props: ParentProps<{ role: RoleId | null }>) {
    const {lang} = useLanguage();
    const location = useLocation();
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const hydrated = useHydrated();
    // The prerender cannot see the query, so the lock applies once the page is hydrated.
    const locked = createMemo(() => hydrated() && isLockedSearch(location().search));
    const role = () => props.role;

    const pathFor = (next: RoleId | null, hash?: string) => buildPath(lang, next, {locked: locked(), hash});

    const setRole = (next: RoleId | null) => {
        if (locked() || next === props.role) return;
        navigate(buildPath(lang, next, {hash: location().hash}));
    };

    return <RoleContext.Provider value={{role, locked, setRole, pathFor}}>{props.children}</RoleContext.Provider>;
}



================================================
FILE: src/hooks/useHydrated.ts
================================================
import {type Accessor, createSignal, onMount, sharedConfig} from "solid-js";
import {isServer} from "solid-js/web";

/**
 * False on the server and while the component hydrates, then true; true from the start for a component created in
 * the browser after hydration. Anything that differs from the prerendered HTML (the query, the browser's own state)
 * waits for it, so hydration always finds the markup the server wrote.
 */
export const useHydrated = (): Accessor<boolean> => {
    const fresh = !isServer && !sharedConfig.context;
    const [hydrated, setHydrated] = createSignal(fresh);
    if (!fresh) onMount(() => setHydrated(true));
    return hydrated;
};

FILE: src/islands/client.ts
================================================
import hydrate from "@astrojs/solid-js/client.js";
import {sharedConfig} from "solid-js";
import type {PartProps} from "./shell";

interface Island {
    preload?: (props: PartProps) => Promise<void>;
}

/** What Solid's hydration script leaves on the page (the HydrationScript Astro adds before the first island). */
declare global {
    var _$HY: { done?: boolean } | undefined;
}

/**
 * Astro's Solid renderer with two steps first.
 *
 * The island's part, its code and copy, loads before Solid hydrates it. Solid keeps the nodes left to hydrate in one
 * registry per page, which each island's hydration starts afresh, so an island that waited for a chunk halfway through
 * would find its nodes gone if another island began meanwhile. Loaded first, every island hydrates in one synchronous
 * pass.
 *
 * And Solid takes the first event it handles as the end of the page's hydration, as it is for an app with one root:
 * from then on it would render every island that comes near the screen afresh, replacing its HTML. Each island starts
 * its own hydration instead.
 */
export default (element: HTMLElement) =>
    async (Component: Island, props: PartProps, slotted: Record<string, string>, options: { client: string }) => {
        await Component.preload?.(props);
        sharedConfig.done = false;
        if (globalThis._$HY) globalThis._$HY.done = false;
        hydrate(element)(Component, props, slotted, options);
    };

FILE: src/islands/head.ts
================================================
import {caseStudyCopy} from "@/content/case-studies";
import {detailPages as enDetails} from "@/content/detail-pages/en";
import {detailPages as esDetails} from "@/content/detail-pages/es";
import en from "@/content/en";
import es from "@/content/es";
import {projectPages as enPages} from "@/content/project-pages/en";
import {projectPages as esPages} from "@/content/project-pages/es";
import {caseStudyById} from "@/content/shared/case-studies";
import {isCaseStudy, PROJECT_SLUG, projectIdBySlug} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {projectById, projects} from "@/content/shared/projects";
import type {Route} from "@/lib/paths";
import {buildHead, renderHeadTags} from "@/lib/seo";
import {detailHead} from "@/lib/seo-details";
import {buildCaseStudyHead, buildProjectPageHead, buildProjectsHead} from "@/lib/seo-projects";
import type {Content} from "@/types/content";

export const contentOf = (lang: string): Content => (lang === "es" ? es : en);

/** The head tags of a generated page: title, description, canonical, alternates, social tags and structured data. */
export const headFor = (route: Route) => {
    const content = contentOf(route.lang);
    if (route.kind === "projects") {
        const {ui, items} = caseStudyCopy[content.lang];
        const cards = content.projects.items;
        if (!route.slug) {
            const listed = projects.map((facts) => ({slug: PROJECT_SLUG[facts.id], name: cards[facts.id].name}));
            return renderHeadTags(buildProjectsHead(content, ui, listed));
        }
        const id = projectIdBySlug(route.slug);
        if (isCaseStudy(id)) return renderHeadTags(buildCaseStudyHead(content, ui, route.slug, items[id], caseStudyById(id)));
        const pages = content.lang === "es" ? esPages : enPages;
        return renderHeadTags(buildProjectPageHead(content, ui, route.slug, cards[id], pages.items[id], projectById(id)));
    }
    if (route.kind === "detail") {
        const copy = content.lang === "es" ? esDetails : enDetails;
        return renderHeadTags(detailHead(content, {
            copy,
            about: content.about,
            certifications: content.certifications,
            services: content.services,
            skills: content.skills,
        }, route.collection, route.slug));
    }
    return renderHeadTags(buildHead(content, route.role));
};

import {Dynamic} from "solid-js/web";
import {loadPart} from "./parts";
import {registeredPart, registerPart} from "./registry";
import {type PartProps, shell} from "./shell";

/**
 * One part of a page. Without a client directive it is plain HTML; with one it is an island: the prerender renders it
 * in place, and in the browser its code and copy load in a chunk of their own (preload) before Solid hydrates its HTML
 * in one pass. Its props stay small (the part's name, the page's language, path and view), since Astro writes them into
 * the page.
 */
export default function PageIsland(props: PartProps) {
    const resolved = () => {
        const registered = registeredPart(props.part, props.lang);
        if (!registered) throw new Error(`The ${props.part} part hydrates before it loads`);
        return shell(...registered);
    };
    return <Dynamic component={resolved()} part={props.part} lang={props.lang} path={props.path} role={props.role}/>;
}

/** Loads a part before its island hydrates (islands/client.ts), from the props Astro wrote into the page. */
PageIsland.preload = async ({part, lang, path}: PartProps) => {
    if (!registeredPart(part, lang)) registerPart(part, lang, await loadPart(part, lang, path));
};

import type {Component} from "solid-js";
import {loadSection} from "@/components/sections/section-loaders";
import {loadContent} from "@/content";
import {loadDetailPage, loadProjectPage} from "@/lib/page-loaders";
import {parseDetailPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import type {Lang, SectionId, StartupContent} from "@/types/content";
import type {PartProps} from "./shell";

/** The parts a page is made of; the static ones never reach the browser as code. */
export type PartName =
    | "boot" | "header" | "hero" | "assistant" | "projectBody" | "detailBody"
    | `section:${SectionId}`
    | "skip" | "footer" | "whatsapp" | "notFound";

type Loader = (lang: Lang, path: string) => Promise<Component<PartProps>>;

/**
 * How the browser gets each interactive part: its code in a chunk of its own and the copy it reads, together, so the
 * part renders, and hydrates, without waiting for anything else.
 */
const LOADERS: Record<string, Loader> = {
    boot: () => import("./parts/boot").then((module) => module.Boot),
    header: () => import("./parts/header").then((module) => module.HeaderPart),
    hero: () => import("@/components/sections/HeroSection").then((module) => module.HeroSection),
    assistant: () => import("@/components/assistant/AssistantLauncher").then((module) => module.AssistantLauncher),
    projectBody: (lang) => loadProjectPage(lang),
    detailBody: (lang, path) => {
        const detail = parseDetailPath(path);
        return loadDetailPage(lang, Boolean(detail?.slug) && detail?.collection !== "certifications");
    },
};

const loaderOf = (part: string): Loader => {
    if (part.startsWith("section:")) {
        const id = part.slice("section:".length) as SectionId;
        return (lang) => loadSection(id, lang).then((module) => module.default);
    }
    const loader = LOADERS[part];
    if (!loader) throw new Error(`The ${part} part does not hydrate`);
    return loader;
};

/** A part's code and copy with the page's startup copy, which the shell around it provides. */
export const loadPart = (part: string, lang: Lang, path: string): Promise<[Component<PartProps>, StartupContent]> =>
    Promise.all([loaderOf(part)(lang, path), loadContent(lang)]);

import type {Component} from "solid-js";
import type {Lang, StartupContent} from "@/types/content";
import type {PartProps} from "./shell";

type Loaded = [Component<PartProps>, StartupContent];

let serverParts: Record<string, Component<PartProps>> | null = null;
let serverContents: Record<Lang, StartupContent> | null = null;
const loaded = new Map<string, Loaded>();

/**
 * The build registers every part and both languages' copy up front (islands/server.tsx), so a page renders every part
 * in place without loading a chunk.
 */
export const registerServerParts = (registered: Record<string, Component<PartProps>>, startup: Record<Lang, StartupContent>) => {
    serverParts = registered;
    serverContents = startup;
};

/** The browser registers an island's part once its chunk and copy have loaded (PageIsland.preload). */
export const registerPart = (part: string, lang: Lang, value: Loaded) => loaded.set(`${part}:${lang}`, value);

export const registeredPart = (part: string, lang: Lang): Loaded | null =>
    serverParts?.[part] && serverContents ? [serverParts[part], serverContents[lang]] : loaded.get(`${part}:${lang}`) ?? null;

FILE: src/islands/settled.ts
================================================
import type {ClientDirective} from "astro";

interface SettledOptions {
    /** Also wait until the island comes this close to the screen. */
    rootMargin?: string;
}

declare module "astro" {
    interface AstroClientDirectives {
        "client:settled"?: SettledOptions | boolean;
    }
}

/**
 * Hydrates an island once the page has settled, as the single-page editions did: after the load event and the first
 * paint, in the next idle period (at most 1.5 s later), or 3 s after the load event if the browser reports no paint.
 * Nothing then competes with the first paint for the network or the main thread. With a rootMargin the island also
 * waits until it comes that close to the screen, so the sections far down load only as the reader nears them.
 *
 * Astro writes this directive into the page as an inline script, which the CSP allows by its hash
 * (nginx/security-headers.conf).
 */
const settled: ClientDirective = (load, options, element) => {
    const {rootMargin} = (typeof options.value === "object" ? options.value : {}) as SettledOptions;
    let started = false;
    let waited = false;

    const hydrate = async () => {
        if (started) return;
        started = true;
        await (await load())();
    };

    const whenNear = () => {
        if (waited) return;
        waited = true;
        if (!rootMargin) return void hydrate();
        // The island is display: contents, so its children are what comes into view.
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            if (!entries.some((entry) => entry.isIntersecting)) return;
            observer.disconnect();
            void hydrate();
        }, {rootMargin});
        for (const child of element.children) observer.observe(child);
    };

    const idle = () => {
        if ("requestIdleCallback" in window) requestIdleCallback(whenNear, {timeout: 1500});
        else setTimeout(whenNear, 1);
    };

    const afterPaint = () => {
        if (performance.getEntriesByName("first-contentful-paint").length) return idle();
        try {
            new PerformanceObserver((_, observer) => {
                observer.disconnect();
                idle();
            }).observe({type: "paint"});
        } catch {
            idle();
        }
        setTimeout(whenNear, 3000);
    };

    if (document.readyState === "complete") afterPaint();
    else addEventListener("load", afterPaint, {once: true});
};

export default settled;

import {type Component, onMount, type ParentProps} from "solid-js";
import type {RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import {LanguageProvider} from "@/context/LanguageProvider";
import {RoleProvider} from "@/context/RoleProvider";
import {useHydrated} from "@/hooks/useHydrated";
import {roleFromSearch} from "@/lib/paths";
import {markIslandReady} from "@/lib/ready";
import {PageRouter} from "@/routes/Router";
import {useLocation} from "@/routes/router-context";
import type {Lang, StartupContent} from "@/types/content";

/** What every part of a page receives: which part it is, the page's language and path and, on a home page, its view. */
export interface PartProps {
    part: string;
    lang: Lang;
    path: string;
    /** The role view of a home page. A project or detail page has none: it learns the view from ?from= once hydrated. */
    role?: RoleId | null;
}

function PageRole(props: ParentProps<{ role?: RoleId | null }>) {
    const location = useLocation();
    const hydrated = useHydrated();
    const role = () => (props.role !== undefined ? props.role : hydrated() ? roleFromSearch(location().search) : null);
    return <RoleProvider role={role()}>{props.children}</RoleProvider>;
}

/**
 * Wraps a part in what the old single-page app provided once for the whole page: the location, the language with its
 * startup copy, and the role view. Each island gets its own, since islands share no Solid context.
 */
export const shell = (Part: Component<PartProps>, content: StartupContent): Component<PartProps> => (props) => {
    onMount(() => markIslandReady(props.part));
    return (
        <PageRouter path={props.path}>
            <LanguageProvider content={content}>
                <PageRole role={props.role}>
                    <Part {...props}/>
                </PageRole>
            </LanguageProvider>
        </PageRouter>
    );
};

import {onMount} from "solid-js";
import {scheduleAnalytics} from "@/lib/analytics";
import {keepAnchorsInPlace} from "@/lib/anchors";
import {loadWebFonts} from "@/lib/fonts";
import {countUpFigures} from "@/lib/count-up";
import {carryLock} from "@/lib/lock";
import {carryRole} from "@/lib/role-links";

/**
 * What every page starts once it is idle and has nothing to draw: the web fonts (the first paint uses metric-matched
 * fallbacks), the correction that keeps a #fragment's target in place while the page settles, the lock on the links
 * of the parts not hydrated yet, the role view on the links a visitor follows, the figures that count up as the reader
 * reaches them, and analytics.
 */
export function Boot() {
    onMount(() => {
        keepAnchorsInPlace(loadWebFonts());
        carryLock();
        carryRole();
        countUpFigures();
        if (import.meta.env.PROD) scheduleAnalytics();
    });
    return null;
}

import {SiteHeader} from "@/components/layout/SiteHeader";
import {useLanguage} from "@/context/language";
import {useRole} from "@/context/role";
import {buildDetailPath, buildProjectPath, parseDetailPath, parseProjectPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import {sectionOrder} from "@/lib/role-view";
import type {PartProps} from "../shell";

/**
 * The header of any page. Away from the home page its section links lead back to the home page of the role view, and
 * the language link keeps the page, the view and the lock.
 */
export function HeaderPart(props: PartProps) {
    const {alternateLang} = useLanguage();
    const {role, locked} = useRole();
    // A page keeps its path for its whole life.
    // eslint-disable-next-line solid/reactivity
    const {path} = props;
    const project = parseProjectPath(path);
    const detail = parseDetailPath(path);
    const languageHref = () => {
        if (project) return buildProjectPath(alternateLang, {slug: project.slug, locked: locked()});
        if (detail) return buildDetailPath(alternateLang, detail.collection, {
            slug: detail.slug,
            locked: locked()
        });
        return undefined;
    };
    return <SiteHeader sections={sectionOrder(role())} homeLinks={Boolean(project || detail)}
                       languageHref={languageHref()}/>;
}

import "@/styles/globals.css";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";

interface Props {
    lang: string;
    /** The page's title, description, canonical, alternates, social tags and structured data, from lib/seo. */
    head: string;
    robots?: string;
    /** The islands that hydrate once the page has settled; <html data-hydrated> appears when all of them have. */
    islands?: string;
    /** The id of what closes the first screen: the page is not painted, nor faded into, before it has been parsed. */
    firstScreen?: string;
}

const {lang, head, robots = "index, follow, max-image-preview:large", islands = "", firstScreen} = Astro.props;

// Pins the theme the reader chose with the header's button before the first paint, so a dark page never flashes white;
// without a choice the page follows the system (tokens.css, light-dark()). The CSP allows it by its SHA-256 hash
// (nginx/security-headers.conf), so its text must stay exactly as it is, whitespace included.
const THEME_SCRIPT = `try {
        var theme = localStorage.getItem("theme");
        if (theme === "light" || theme === "dark") document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme
    } catch (e) {
    }`;

// Starts fetching a page of the site when the pointer rests on its link or presses it, so the page that fades in is
// already there; a browser without speculation rules ignores them. Files (a resume, a certificate, an image), links
// that open another tab and jumps within the page are left out. The link is prefetched as written, and a click may add
// the role view (?from=, lib/role-links.ts) or the lock; the pages say with No-Vary-Search (nginx) that those change
// nothing, so the prefetched page still serves the visit. The CSP names this block by its hash too.
const SPECULATION_RULES = JSON.stringify({
    prefetch: [{
        where: {
            and: [
                {href_matches: "/*"},
                {not: {href_matches: "/*.*"}},
                {not: {selector_matches: "[download], [target=_blank], [href^='#']"}},
            ],
        },
        eagerness: "moderate",
        expects_no_vary_search: "params=(\"from\" \"locked\")",
    }],
});

FILE: src/lib/analytics.ts

const GTM_ID = "GTM-KQTK5XZH";
const INTERACTIONS = ["pointerdown", "keydown", "scroll", "touchstart"] as const;
const FALLBACK_DELAY = 8000;

declare global {
    interface Window {
        dataLayer?: unknown[];
    }
}

export function scheduleAnalytics() {
    let loaded = false;

    const load = () => {
        if (loaded) return;
        loaded = true;
        for (const event of INTERACTIONS) window.removeEventListener(event, load);
        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer ?? [];
        window.dataLayer.push({"gtm.start": Date.now(), event: "gtm.js"});
        const script = document.createElement("script");
        script.async = true;
        script.src = `https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id=${GTM_ID}`;
        document.head.appendChild(script);
    };

    for (const event of INTERACTIONS) window.addEventListener(event, load, {once: true, passive: true});
    window.setTimeout(() => {
        if ("requestIdleCallback" in window) window.requestIdleCallback(load);
        else load();
    }, FALLBACK_DELAY);
}

FILE: src/lib/anchors.ts
================================================
import {whenHydrated} from "@/lib/ready";

/*
 * In-page jumps. Sections off screen on phones take an estimated height until they render (globals.css, .section), and
 * the web fonts and each section's hydration can reflow text on the way. A click on a link to a part of the page
 * therefore travels there itself: it lays every section out (data-traveling, data-traveled) while turning scroll-snap
 * off so the browser's snap engine never hijacks the trip midway, scrolls smoothly to the target's exact frame (top 0
 * for 100dvh snap boxes on desktop, or under the header on smaller screens and detail pages), holds the target locked
 * in place for a few frames after arrival, and then re-enables scroll-snap. Any input from the reader ends the trip's
 * corrections at once.
 */
const FRAMES = 14;
/** How long a trip may take before it is taken as over, for browsers without the scrollend event. */
const TRIP_LIMIT = 2500;
const INPUT = ["wheel", "touchstart", "keydown", "pointerdown"] as const;

let generation = 0;
let stopCurrentTrip: (() => void) | null = null;

const headerOffset = (target: HTMLElement) => {
    const margin = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(target).scrollMarginTop);
    if (margin > 0) return margin;
    return parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).scrollPaddingTop) || 0;
};

const targetOf = (hash: string) => {
    const id = decodeURIComponent(hash.slice(1));
    return id ? document.getElementById(id) : null;
};

const offsetOf = (target: HTMLElement) => target.getBoundingClientRect().top - headerOffset(target);

function hold(target: HTMLElement, onDone?: () => void) {
    const current = generation;
    let frames = 0;
    const step = () => {
        if (current !== generation || !target.isConnected) {
            onDone?.();
            return;
        }
        const delta = offsetOf(target);
        if (Math.abs(delta) >= 1) window.scrollBy({top: delta, behavior: "instant"});
        if (++frames < FRAMES) requestAnimationFrame(step);
        else onDone?.();
    };
    step();
}

function travel(target: HTMLElement) {
    stopCurrentTrip?.();
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const current = generation;
    root.dataset.traveling = "true";
    root.dataset.traveled = "true";
    let timer = 0;
    let finished = false;

    const cleanup = () => {
        if (finished) return;
        finished = true;
        window.removeEventListener("scrollend", arrive);
        window.clearTimeout(timer);
        if (stopCurrentTrip === cancel) stopCurrentTrip = null;
    };

    const releaseSnap = () => {
        if (current === generation) delete root.dataset.traveling;
    };

    const cancel = () => {
        cleanup();
        delete root.dataset.traveling;
    };

    const arrive = () => {
        cleanup();
        if (current === generation) hold(target, releaseSnap);
        else delete root.dataset.traveling;
    };

    stopCurrentTrip = cancel;
    const distance = offsetOf(target);
    if (Math.abs(distance) < 1) {
        arrive();
        return;
    }
    window.addEventListener("scrollend", arrive);
    timer = window.setTimeout(arrive, TRIP_LIMIT);
    const smooth = !window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    window.scrollBy({top: distance, behavior: smooth ? "smooth" : "instant"});
}

function onClick(event: MouseEvent) {
    if (event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
    const link = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest("a[href]") : null;
    if (!(link instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) || !link.hash) return;
    if (link.origin !== location.origin || link.pathname !== location.pathname || link.search !== location.search) return;
    const target = targetOf(link.hash);
    if (!target) return;
    // The page travels itself instead of letting the browser jump. The address still names the target, and the target
    // takes the focus the way a jump would give it, so the next Tab continues from there.
    event.preventDefault();
    if (location.hash !== link.hash) history.pushState(history.state, "", link.hash);
    target.focus({preventScroll: true});
    travel(target);
}

export function keepAnchorsInPlace(fonts: Promise<unknown>) {
    for (const event of INPUT) {
        window.addEventListener(
            event,
            () => {
                generation++;
                stopCurrentTrip?.();
            },
            {capture: true, passive: true},
        );
    }
    // Bubbling, so a click that a part of the page handles itself (and prevents) never travels.
    document.addEventListener("click", onClick);

    const {hash} = location;
    const target = targetOf(hash);
    if (!target) return;
    document.documentElement.dataset.traveled = "true";
    const loaded = generation;
    hold(target);
    void Promise.all([fonts, new Promise<void>((resolve) => whenHydrated(resolve))]).then(() => {
        if (generation === loaded && location.hash === hash) hold(targetOf(hash) ?? target);
    });
}

FILE: src/lib/base.ts
================================================
/*
 * The subpath the site is served from. It is "/" on the main domain (the nginx image) and the repository's path on
 * GitHub Pages (e.g. "/MyPortfolio-SOLID/"), set by Astro's `base` and read here through Vite's import.meta.env.
 * Internal links, client navigation and references to files in public/ pass through withBase so they keep working
 * under the subpath. The canonical and social URLs in lib/seo stay on the main domain (content/shared/site.ts), so a
 * GitHub Pages mirror points search engines back at the real site instead of competing with it.
 *
 * This module reads import.meta.env, so only code that Vite compiles may import it; the Node build scripts must not.
 */
const RAW = import.meta.env.BASE_URL;

/** The base without its trailing slash: "" at the root, "/MyPortfolio-SOLID" under a subpath. */
const PREFIX = RAW.replace(/\/+$/, "");

/** Prefixes an in-site absolute path with the base; hashes, queries and external URLs pass through unchanged. */
export const withBase = (path: string): string => (PREFIX && path.startsWith("/") ? `${PREFIX}${path}` : path);

/** Drops the base from a browser pathname, so the rest of the app parses and matches base-less paths. */
export const stripBase = (pathname: string): string => {
    if (!PREFIX) return pathname;
    if (pathname === PREFIX) return "/";
    return pathname.startsWith(`${PREFIX}/`) ? pathname.slice(PREFIX.length) : pathname;
};

describe("contact links", () => {

        const url = new URL(mailtoUrl("From your portfolio", message));
        expect(url.protocol).toBe("mailto:");
        expect(url.pathname).toBe(profile.email);
        expect(url.searchParams.get("subject")).toBe("From your portfolio · Ana Gómez");
        expect(url.searchParams.get("body")).toBe("¿Hablamos? Tasa 5% & más\r\nSegunda línea\r\n\r\nAna Gómez\r\nana@example.com");
    });

    it("types the WhatsApp message without sending it", () => {
        const url = new URL(whatsappUrl("Hi Sebastián", message));
        expect(`${url.origin}${url.pathname}`).toBe(`https://wa.me/${profile.phone.whatsapp}`);

import {profile} from "@/content/shared/profile";

export interface ContactMessage {
    name: string;
    email: string;
    message: string;
}

/** A WhatsApp chat with the message already typed; the visitor still presses send. */
export const whatsappUrl = (intro: string, {name, email, message}: ContactMessage) =>
    `https://wa.me/${profile.phone.whatsapp}?text=${encodeURIComponent(`${intro}\n\n${name}\n${email}\n\n${message}`)}`;

/** A draft in the visitor's mail app. RFC 6068 asks for CRLF line breaks in the body. */
export const mailtoUrl = (subject: string, {name, email, message}: ContactMessage) => {
    const body = `${message}\n\n${name}\n${email}`.replace(/\r?\n/g, "\r\n");
    return `mailto:${profile.email}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(`${subject} · ${name}`)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`;
};
