import {countUpFigures, formatFigure, parseFigure} from "@/lib/count-up";

// jsdom has no IntersectionObserver; this one lets a test say what came into view.
class Observer {
    static last: Observer | undefined;
    targets = new Set<Element>();

    constructor(private readonly callback: IntersectionObserverCallback) {
        Observer.last = this;
    }

    observe(target: Element) {
        this.targets.add(target);
    }

    unobserve(target: Element) {
        this.targets.delete(target);
    }

    /** Reports each element as on screen or off it, the way the browser does after a layout. */
    report(...changes: [Element, boolean][]) {
        const entries = changes.filter(([target]) => this.targets.has(target))
            .map(([target, isIntersecting]) => ({target, isIntersecting}) as IntersectionObserverEntry);
        this.callback(entries, this as unknown as IntersectionObserver);
    }
}

const reducedMotion = (reduce: boolean) =>
    vi.spyOn(window, "matchMedia").mockImplementation((query) => ({matches: reduce && query.includes("reduce")}) as MediaQueryList);

describe("parseFigure", () => {
    it("reads the number of a figure with what surrounds it", () => {
        expect(parseFigure("20+")).toEqual({prefix: "", value: 20, separator: "", suffix: "+"});
        expect(parseFigure("28,541")).toEqual({prefix: "", value: 28541, separator: ",", suffix: ""});
        expect(parseFigure("28.541")).toEqual({prefix: "", value: 28541, separator: ".", suffix: ""});
        expect(parseFigure("93 %")).toEqual({prefix: "", value: 93, separator: "", suffix: " %"});
        expect(parseFigure("1,234,567+")).toEqual({prefix: "", value: 1234567, separator: ",", suffix: "+"});
    });

    it("leaves alone a text that is not a whole number", () => {
        expect(parseFigure("97.9%")).toBeNull();
        expect(parseFigure("Native")).toBeNull();
        expect(parseFigure("2022 – 2026")).toBeNull();
        expect(parseFigure("")).toBeNull();
    });
});

describe("formatFigure", () => {
    it("groups thousands with the figure's own separator", () => {
        expect(formatFigure(28541, ",")).toBe("28,541");
        expect(formatFigure(1234567, ".")).toBe("1.234.567");
        expect(formatFigure(541, ",")).toBe("541");
        expect(formatFigure(2273, "")).toBe("2273");
    });
});

describe("countUpFigures", () => {
    const figure = (id: string) => document.getElementById(id)!;

    beforeEach(() => {
        Observer.last = undefined;
        vi.stubGlobal("IntersectionObserver", Observer);
        document.body.innerHTML = '<dl><dd id="still" data-count="true">487</dd><dd id="later" data-count="true">28,541+</dd></dl>';
    });

    afterEach(() => {
        vi.unstubAllGlobals();
        vi.restoreAllMocks();
        document.body.replaceChildren();
    });

    it("does nothing for a reader who asked for less motion", () => {
        reducedMotion(true);
        countUpFigures();
        expect(Observer.last).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it("counts a figure up only when the reader reaches it later, and ends on the text as written", () => {
        reducedMotion(false);
        const frames: FrameRequestCallback[] = [];
        vi.spyOn(window, "requestAnimationFrame").mockImplementation((callback) => frames.push(callback));
        vi.spyOn(performance, "now").mockReturnValue(0);
        countUpFigures();
        const figures = Observer.last!;
        figures.report([figure("still"), true], [figure("later"), false]);
        expect(frames).toHaveLength(0);

        figures.report([figure("later"), true]);
        const text = figure("later").firstChild as Text;
        frames.shift()!(550);
        expect(text.data).toBe("24,973+");
        frames.shift()!(1100);
        expect(text.data).toBe("28,541+");
        // The same text node is still there, which is what a part hydrated later holds on to.
        expect(figure("later").firstChild).toBe(text);
        expect(frames).toHaveLength(0);
        expect(figure("still").textContent).toBe("487");
        expect(figures.targets.size).toBe(0);
    });

    it("stops counting when something else rewrites the figure", () => {
        reducedMotion(false);
        const frames: FrameRequestCallback[] = [];
        vi.spyOn(window, "requestAnimationFrame").mockImplementation((callback) => frames.push(callback));
        vi.spyOn(performance, "now").mockReturnValue(0);
        countUpFigures();
        const figures = Observer.last!;
        figures.report([figure("later"), false]);
        figures.report([figure("later"), true]);
        const text = figure("later").firstChild as Text;
        frames.shift()!(550);
        expect(text.data).toBe("24,973+");
        // Another view of the page writes its own figure into the same node.
        text.data = "139";
        frames.shift()!(800);
        expect(text.data).toBe("139");
        expect(frames).toHaveLength(0);
    });
});

FILE: src/lib/count-up.ts
================================================
/**
 * Figures that run up to their value the first time the reader reaches them (islands/parts/boot.tsx starts it once the
 * page is idle). A figure that is already on screen when the page settles keeps still, and with prefers-reduced-motion,
 * or without an IntersectionObserver, nothing runs: the page says the same before, after and without this.
 */

const COUNT_MS = 1100;

export interface Figure {
    prefix: string;
    value: number;
    /** The character between thousands as the page's language writes it, or none. */
    separator: string;
    suffix: string;
}

/**
 * A figure's text as what precedes its number, the number and what follows ("20+", "28,541", "93 %"), or null when the
 * text is not a whole number: a decimal such as 97.9 stays as it is written.
 */
export const parseFigure = (text: string): Figure | null => {
    const match = /^(\D*)(\d{1,3}(?:[.,\s]\d{3})+|\d+)(\D*)$/.exec(text);
    if (!match) return null;
    const [, prefix, digits, suffix] = match;
    return {prefix, value: Number(digits.replace(/\D/g, "")), separator: /\D/.exec(digits)?.[0] ?? "", suffix};
};

/** A whole number grouped in thousands with the figure's own separator. */
export const formatFigure = (value: number, separator: string) =>
    separator ? String(value).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+$)/g, separator) : String(value);

/**
 * Rewrites the figure's text node in place, so the node the page's own code holds stays the same, and ends on the text
 * as written. If anything else rewrites the figure meanwhile (another view of the page, for one), the count stops and
 * leaves that text alone.
 */
function run(element: Element) {
    const node = element.firstChild;
    if (!(node instanceof Text) || element.childNodes.length !== 1) return;
    const text = node.data;
    const figure = parseFigure(text);
    if (!figure || figure.value === 0) return;
    const start = performance.now();
    let shown = text;
    const frame = (now: number) => {
        if (node.data !== shown) return;
        const progress = Math.min((now - start) / COUNT_MS, 1);
        // Fast at first and slow into the value.
        const eased = 1 - (1 - progress) ** 3;
        shown = progress < 1
            ? `${figure.prefix}${formatFigure(Math.round(figure.value * eased), figure.separator)}${figure.suffix}`
            : text;
        node.data = shown;
        if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

/** Counts up every figure marked data-count that the reader reaches after the page has settled. */
export function countUpFigures() {
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined" || matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
    const waiting = new WeakSet<Element>();
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
            if (!entry.isIntersecting) {
                // Off screen for now, also when its section has not been laid out yet (content-visibility).
                waiting.add(entry.target);
                continue;
            }
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
            // On screen from the start means it has been read already.
            if (waiting.has(entry.target)) run(entry.target);
        }
    });
    for (const element of document.querySelectorAll("[data-count]")) observer.observe(element);
}

/** A tool's name without its version, its note in brackets or its case: "React 19" and "React" are the same tool. */
const toolKey = (name: string) => name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s*\(.*\)$/, "").replace(/\s+\d[\w.]*$/, "").trim();

/** The tools of a group that a stack uses, as the group names them, in the group's order. */
export const toolsOfGroupIn = (id: SkillGroupId, stack: readonly string[]) => {
    const used = new Set(stack.map(toolKey));
    return skillGroupById(id).items.filter((item) => used.has(toolKey(item)));
};

export const experienceById = (id: ExperienceId) => experience.find((item) => item.id === id)!;
export const educationById = (id: EducationId) => education.find((item) => item.id === id)!;
export const certificationById = (id: CertificationId) => certifications.find((item) => item.id === id)!;
export const organizationById = (id: OrganizationId) => organizations.find((item) => item.id === id)!;

/** The items before and after one in its list, wrapping around at both ends. */
export const neighbors = <T>(items: readonly T[], index: number) => ({
    previous: items[(index - 1 + items.length) % items.length],
    next: items[(index + 1) % items.length],
});

/** Whether a month falls within a period that may still be open; "2025-06" compares as text. */
export const within = (date: YearMonth, start: YearMonth, end: YearMonth | null) => date >= start && (end === null || date <= end);

const yearOf = (date: YearMonth) => Number(date.slice(0, 4));

export const projectsOfExperience = (id: ExperienceId): ProjectFacts[] =>
    (EXPERIENCE_PROJECTS[id] ?? []).map((projectId) => projects.find((project) => project.id === projectId)!);

    certifications.filter((item) => within(item.date, start, end)).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));

/** The jobs held and the programs being studied in the month a certification was earned. */
export const jobsAt = (date: YearMonth) => experience.filter((job) => within(date, job.start, job.end));
export const programsAt = (date: YearMonth) => education.filter((program) => yearOf(date) >= program.start && yearOf(date) <= program.end);

export const jobsOfOrganization = (id: OrganizationId) => experience.filter((job) => job.organization === id);
export const programsOfOrganization = (id: OrganizationId) => education.filter((program) => program.organizationId === id);

/** The program's own coursework page first, then the products built while studying it. */
export const projectsOfProgram = (id: EducationId) => {
    const program = education.find((item) => item.id === id)!;
    // The program's own project and its listed ones first, then every coursework project filed under it.
    const listed = [program.project, ...(program.projects ?? [])].filter((value) => value !== undefined);
    const filed = projects.filter((project) => project.education === id && !listed.includes(project.id)).map((project) => project.id);
    return [...listed, ...filed].map((projectId) => projects.find((project) => project.id === projectId)!);
};

export const sameStop = (certification: CertificationFacts) =>
    certifications.filter((item) => item.milestone === certification.milestone && item.id !== certification.id);

const ARCHIVE_ORGS = new Set<string>(archive.map((entry) => entry.org));

/** The public repositories of an organization listed one by one in the archive; private ones list none. */
export const archiveOf = (organization: OrganizationFacts) =>
    ARCHIVE_ORGS.has(organization.name) ? archive.filter((entry) => entry.org === (organization.name as ArchiveOrg)) : [];

/** Certifications grouped by who issued them, the issuer with the most first. */
export const certificationsByIssuer = () => {
    const groups = new Map<CertificationFacts["issuerId"], CertificationFacts[]>();
    for (const item of certifications) groups.set(item.issuerId, [...(groups.get(item.issuerId) ?? []), item]);
    return [...groups.entries()]
        .map(([issuer, items]) => ({issuer, items: [...items].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))}))
        .sort((a, b) => b.items.length - a.items.length);
};

export const projectById = (id: ProjectId) => projects.find((project) => project.id === id)!;

/** The jobs whose cards link one of these projects, in the order of the jobs. */
export const jobsOfProjects = (ids: readonly ProjectId[]) =>
    experience.filter((job) => (EXPERIENCE_PROJECTS[job.id] ?? []).some((id) => ids.includes(id)));

/** A service's projects, and the jobs it was done in. */

export const jobsOfService = (id: ServiceId) => jobsOfProjects(serviceProjects[id]);

export const servicesWithReason = (id: BenefitId) => SERVICE_IDS.filter((service) => serviceReasons[service].includes(id));

FILE: src/lib/disclosures.ts

/**
 * "Expand all" and "Collapse all" for the disclosures of one part of the page (components/ui/More.tsx), so a recruiter
 * who wants everything gets it in one press. `watch` reports whether every one is open after any of them changes,
 * including when find in page opens one.
 */

const disclosures = (root: Element) => [...root.querySelectorAll<HTMLDetailsElement>("details.more")];

export const allOpen = (root: Element) => {
    const all = disclosures(root);
    return all.length > 0 && all.every((details) => details.open);
};

export const setAll = (root: Element, open: boolean) => {
    for (const details of disclosures(root)) details.open = open;
};

/** Calls back with allOpen(root) whenever one of root's disclosures opens or closes; returns the way to stop. */
export const watch = (root: Element, callback: (open: boolean) => void) => {
    // A details element's toggle event does not bubble, so it is caught on the way down.
    const listener = () => callback(allOpen(root));
    root.addEventListener("toggle", listener, true);
    return () => root.removeEventListener("toggle", listener, true);
};

FILE: src/lib/fonts.ts

import dmSerifText400 from "@fontsource/dm-serif-text/files/dm-serif-text-latin-400-normal.woff2?url";
import ibmPlexSans400 from "@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans/files/ibm-plex-sans-latin-400-normal.woff2?url";
import ibmPlexSans600 from "@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans/files/ibm-plex-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2?url";
import sourceCodePro400 from "@fontsource/source-code-pro/files/source-code-pro-latin-400-normal.woff2?url";

const WEB_FONTS = [
    {family: "IBM Plex Sans", weight: "400", url: ibmPlexSans400},
    {family: "IBM Plex Sans", weight: "600", url: ibmPlexSans600},
    {family: "DM Serif Text", weight: "400", url: dmSerifText400},
    {family: "Source Code Pro", weight: "400", url: sourceCodePro400},
] as const;

// The faces are registered together once all of them have loaded, so the text is laid out again only once and
// no style is recalculated. `display: "swap"` keeps the metric-matched fallback visible until then (it never
// blocks on the download), which is also what Lighthouse's font-display audit asks for.
export function loadWebFonts() {
    const faces = WEB_FONTS.map(({
                                     family,
                                     weight,
                                     url
                                 }) => new FontFace(family, `url(${url}) format("woff2")`, {weight, display: "swap"}));
    return Promise.all(faces.map((face) => face.load()))
        .then(() => faces.forEach((face) => document.fonts.add(face)))
        .catch(() => undefined);
}

FILE: src/lib/format.ts

import {BUILD_DATE} from "@/content/shared/site";
import type {Lang, YearMonth} from "@/types/content";

const parts = (value: string) => value.split("-").map(Number) as [number, number];

export const formatYearMonth = (value: YearMonth, months: readonly string[]) => {
    const [year, month] = parts(value);
    return `${months[month - 1]} ${year}`;
};

/** A day such as 2026-10-16 in words: "16 de octubre de 2026" or "October 16, 2026", or without the year. */
export const formatDay = (value: string, locale: string, {year = true} = {}) =>
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale.replace("_", "-"), {
        day: "numeric",
        month: "long",
        year: year ? "numeric" : undefined,
        timeZone: "UTC"
    })
        .format(new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`));

export const formatRange = (start: YearMonth, end: YearMonth | null, months: readonly string[], present: string) =>
    `${formatYearMonth(start, months)} – ${end ? formatYearMonth(end, months) : present}`;

export const monthsBetween = (start: YearMonth, end: YearMonth | null) => {
    const [startYear, startMonth] = parts(start);
    const [endYear, endMonth] = parts(end ?? BUILD_DATE.slice(0, 7));
    return endYear * 12 + endMonth - (startYear * 12 + startMonth) + 1;
};

const UNITS: Record<Lang, { year: [string, string]; month: [string, string] }> = {
    en: {year: ["yr", "yrs"], month: ["mo", "mos"]},
    es: {year: ["año", "años"], month: ["mes", "meses"]},
};

export const formatDuration = (months: number, lang: Lang) => {
    const units = UNITS[lang];
    const years = Math.floor(months / 12);
    const rest = months % 12;
    const label = (count: number, [one, many]: [string, string]) => `${count} ${count === 1 ? one : many}`;
    return [years > 0 && label(years, units.year), rest > 0 && label(rest, units.month)].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
};

import {describe, expect, it} from "vitest";
import {capabilityLevels, JOURNEY_LINES, JOURNEY_YEARS, milestones, radarItems} from "@/content/shared/journey";
import {journeyCopy} from "@/content/journey-copy";
import {
    evidenceFor,
    isFuture,
    layoutStations,
    lineSpans,
    MAP,
    milestonesForSdg,
    STATION_SPACE,
    stationRadius,
    stepsAround,
    TAG_HEIGHT,
    tagLayout,
    xFor
} from "@/lib/journey";

describe("journey map", () => {
    it("moves forward in time from left to right inside the plot", () => {
        const xs = ["2019-01", "2021-06", "2022-01", "2024-07", "2026-10", "2030-12"].map((date) => xFor(date));
        expect(xs).toEqual([...xs].sort((a, b) => a - b));
        expect(xs[0]).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(MAP.plotLeft);
        expect(xs[xs.length - 1]).toBeLessThanOrEqual(MAP.plotRight);
    });

    it("keeps stations that share a line apart", () => {
        const stations = layoutStations();
        for (const line of JOURNEY_LINES) {
            const marks = milestones
                .filter((milestone) => milestone.lines.includes(line))
                .map((milestone) => ({x: stations.find((station) => station.id === milestone.id)!.x, r: stationRadius(milestone)}))
                .sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
            marks.slice(1).forEach((mark, index) => expect(mark.x - mark.r - (marks[index].x + marks[index].r)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(STATION_SPACE - 1e-9));
        }
    });

    it("never pushes a stop that has happened past today", () => {
        const today = "2026-11-19";
        const stations = layoutStations();
        for (const milestone of milestones.filter((item) => !isFuture(item, today))) {
            expect(stations.find((station) => station.id === milestone.id)!.x).toBeLessThanOrEqual(xFor(today));
        }
    });

    it("runs every line from its first to its last station, and on to today while it is still active", () => {
        const today = "2026-10-05";
        const stations = layoutStations();
        const spans = lineSpans(stations, today);
        expect(spans.map((span) => span.line)).toEqual(JOURNEY_LINES);
        for (const span of spans) {
            expect(span.to).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(span.from);
            const ongoing = milestones.some((item) => item.lines.includes(span.line) && item.end === null && !isFuture(item, today));
            if (ongoing) expect(span.to).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(xFor(today));
        }
    });

    it("keeps the tag of any stop inside the map and between two lanes", () => {
        const stations = layoutStations();
        for (const copy of Object.values(journeyCopy)) {
            for (const station of stations) {
                const tag = tagLayout(station, `Sep 2026 · ${copy.milestones[station.id].title}`);
                expect(tag.x - tag.width / 2).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
                expect(tag.x + tag.width / 2).toBeLessThanOrEqual(MAP.width);
                expect(tag.y - TAG_HEIGHT / 2).toBeGreaterThan(station.bottom + 6);
                expect(tag.y + TAG_HEIGHT / 2).toBeLessThan(Math.min(station.bottom + MAP.laneGap - 6, MAP.gridBottom));
            }
        }
    });

    it("steps through every stop in date order, or only through one line's stops", () => {
        const stations = layoutStations();
        const middle = stations[5].id;
        const all = stepsAround(stations, middle, null);
        expect(all.order).toHaveLength(milestones.length);
        expect([all.previous?.id, all.next?.id]).toEqual([stations[4].id, stations[6].id]);
        expect(stepsAround(stations, stations[0].id, null).previous).toBeUndefined();
        expect(stepsAround(stations, stations.at(-1)!.id, null).next).toBeUndefined();

        const onData = stepsAround(stations, middle, "data");
        expect(onData.order.every(({id}) => milestones.find((item) => item.id === id)!.lines.includes("data"))).toBe(true);
    });

    it("finds the nearest stops on a line when the selected stop is not on it", () => {
        const stations = layoutStations();
        const offLine = milestones.find((milestone) => !milestone.lines.includes("crm") && milestone.start > "2024-01" && milestone.start < "2026-01")!;
        const steps = stepsAround(stations, offLine.id, "crm");
        const date = (id: string) => milestones.find((item) => item.id === id)!.start;
        expect(steps.index).toBe(-1);
        if (steps.previous) expect(date(steps.previous.id) < offLine.start).toBe(true);
        if (steps.next) expect(date(steps.next.id) > offLine.start).toBe(true);
        expect(steps.previous ?? steps.next).toBeDefined();
    });

    it("marks only planned milestones as future", () => {
        const future = milestones.filter((milestone) => isFuture(milestone, "2026-10-05")).map((milestone) => milestone.id);
        expect(future).toEqual(["graduation", "dataScience", "cybersecurity", "vision"]);
    });
});

describe("journey data", () => {
    it("gives every capability a level for every year", () => {
        for (const levels of Object.values(capabilityLevels)) expect(levels).toHaveLength(JOURNEY_YEARS.length);
    });

    it("backs current capabilities with milestones", () => {
        expect(evidenceFor("backend", 2026, "2026-10-05")).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["tivenos", "gopoli", "smartpot"]));
        expect(evidenceFor("crm", 2019, "2026-10-05")).toEqual([]);
    });

    it("links every goal of the 2030 Agenda to at least one milestone", () => {
        for (const sdg of [2, 4, 8, 9, 11, 13, 16] as const) expect(milestonesForSdg(sdg).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    it("labels every major milestone and radar item in both languages", () => {
        for (const copy of Object.values(journeyCopy)) {
            for (const milestone of milestones.filter((item) => item.major)) expect(copy.milestones[milestone.id].short).toBeTruthy();
            for (const item of radarItems) expect(copy.radar.items[item.id].name).toBeTruthy();
        }
    });
});

FILE: src/lib/journey.ts
================================================
import type {RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import {JOURNEY_END, JOURNEY_LINES, JOURNEY_START, milestones} from "@/content/shared/journey";
import type {YearMonth} from "@/types/content";
import type {CapabilityId, JourneyLineId, MilestoneFacts, MilestoneId, SdgId} from "@/types/journey";

export const ROLE_LINE: Record<RoleId, JourneyLineId> = {
    backend: "backend",
    crm: "crm",
    data: "data",
    devops: "devops",
    fullstack: "web",
};

export const ROLE_AREAS: Record<RoleId, CapabilityId[]> = {
    backend: ["backend", "databases"],
    crm: ["crm"],
    data: ["data", "ai"],
    devops: ["devops"],
    fullstack: ["web", "backend"],
};

/** Decimal year of the first day of a month, e.g. 2024-07 -> 2024.5. */
export const yearFraction = (value: YearMonth | string) => {
    const [year, month = "1", day = "1"] = value.split("-");
    return Number(year) + (Number(month) - 1) / 12 + (Number(day) - 1) / 365;
};

export const isFuture = (milestone: MilestoneFacts, today: string) => milestone.start > today.slice(0, 7);

export const milestoneEnd = (milestone: MilestoneFacts, today: string) =>
    milestone.end === undefined ? milestone.start : (milestone.end ?? today.slice(0, 7));

/** Milestones active during a year that worked on a capability, newest first. */
export const evidenceFor = (area: CapabilityId, year: number, today: string) =>
    milestones
        .filter((milestone) => milestone.areas.includes(area))
        .filter((milestone) => Number(milestone.start.slice(0, 4)) <= year && Number(milestoneEnd(milestone, today).slice(0, 4)) >= year)
        .sort((a, b) => b.start.localeCompare(a.start))
        .map((milestone) => milestone.id);

export const milestonesForSdg = (sdg: SdgId) => milestones.filter((milestone) => milestone.sdgs?.includes(sdg)).map((milestone) => milestone.id);

export interface MapGeometry {
    width: number;
    height: number;
    plotLeft: number;
    plotRight: number;
    /** Baseline of the year labels. */
    axisY: number;
    /** Where the year grid, the "today" rule and the planned zone start and end. */
    gridTop: number;
    gridBottom: number;
    laneTop: number;
    laneGap: number;
}

export const MAP: MapGeometry = {
    width: 1120,
    height: 400,
    plotLeft: 128,
    plotRight: 1090,
    axisY: 36,
    gridTop: 48,
    gridBottom: 376,
    laneTop: 72,
    laneGap: 44,
};

// Recent years hold most milestones, so they get more width than the early school years and the planned ones.
const YEAR_WEIGHT = (year: number) => (year < 2022 ? 0.7 : year <= 2026 ? 1.3 : 0.7);
const TOTAL_WEIGHT = Array.from({length: JOURNEY_END + 1 - JOURNEY_START}, (_, index) => YEAR_WEIGHT(JOURNEY_START + index)).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

export const xFor = (value: YearMonth | string | number) => {
    const year = Math.min(Math.max(typeof value === "number" ? value : yearFraction(value), JOURNEY_START), JOURNEY_END + 1);
    let offset = 0;
    for (let current = JOURNEY_START; current < Math.floor(year); current += 1) offset += YEAR_WEIGHT(current);
    offset += (year - Math.floor(year)) * YEAR_WEIGHT(Math.floor(year));
    return MAP.plotLeft + (offset / TOTAL_WEIGHT) * (MAP.plotRight - MAP.plotLeft);
};

export const laneY = (line: JourneyLineId) => MAP.laneTop + JOURNEY_LINES.indexOf(line) * MAP.laneGap;

/** A main milestone is drawn as a ring, a smaller step as a dot; neighbors on a lane keep STATION_SPACE between them. */
export const stationRadius = (milestone: MilestoneFacts) => (milestone.major ? 5.5 : 3.5);
export const STATION_SPACE = 5;

export interface StationLayout {
    id: MilestoneId;
    x: number;
    top: number;
    bottom: number;
    lanes: number[];
}

/** Places stations by date and nudges them right when they would touch a station on a shared lane. */
export function layoutStations(items: MilestoneFacts[] = milestones): StationLayout[] {
    const last = new Map<JourneyLineId, { x: number; r: number }>();
    return [...items]
        .sort((a, b) => a.start.localeCompare(b.start))
        .map((milestone) => {
            const r = stationRadius(milestone);
            const minimum = Math.max(...milestone.lines.map((line) => {
                const before = last.get(line);
                return before ? before.x + before.r + STATION_SPACE + r : -Infinity;
            }));
            const x = Math.max(xFor(milestone.start), minimum);
            for (const line of milestone.lines) last.set(line, {x, r});
            const lanes = milestone.lines.map(laneY).sort((a, b) => a - b);
            return {id: milestone.id, x, top: lanes[0], bottom: lanes[lanes.length - 1], lanes};
        });
}

export interface Steps {
    /** Stops that the steps visit: every stop, or only those of the selected line. */
    order: StationLayout[];
    /** Position of the selected stop in that order, or -1 when it is not on the selected line. */
    index: number;
    previous?: StationLayout;
    next?: StationLayout;
}

/** The stops before and after the selected one; off the selected line, the nearest ones on it by date. */
export function stepsAround(stations: StationLayout[], selected: MilestoneId, line: JourneyLineId | null): Steps {
    const byId = new Map(milestones.map((milestone) => [milestone.id, milestone]));
    const order = stations.filter(({id}) => line === null || byId.get(id)!.lines.includes(line));
    const index = order.findIndex(({id}) => id === selected);
    if (index >= 0) return {order, index, previous: order[index - 1], next: order[index + 1]};
    const start = byId.get(selected)!.start;
    return {
        order,
        index,
        previous: order.filter(({id}) => byId.get(id)!.start < start).at(-1),
        next: order.find(({id}) => byId.get(id)!.start > start),
    };
}

export interface LineSpan {
    line: JourneyLineId;
    from: number;
    to: number;
    todayX: number;
}

/**
 * Each line runs from its first station to its last one, and on to today while one of its milestones is still going
 * on, so every active line meets the "today" rule; the part after today is drawn as a projection.
 */
export function lineSpans(stations: StationLayout[], today: string): LineSpan[] {
    const byId = new Map(stations.map((station) => [station.id, station]));
    const todayX = xFor(today);
    return JOURNEY_LINES.map((line) => {
        const onLine = milestones.filter((milestone) => milestone.lines.includes(line));
        const xs = onLine.map((milestone) => byId.get(milestone.id)!.x);
        const ongoing = onLine.some((milestone) => milestone.end === null && !isFuture(milestone, today));
        return {line, from: Math.min(...xs), to: Math.max(...xs, ongoing ? todayX : -Infinity), todayX};
    });
}

/** Width of one character of the 11px monospaced type the map's tag uses. */
const TAG_CHAR = 6.6;
export const TAG_HEIGHT = 22;

export interface TagLayout {
    /** Center of the tag. */
    x: number;
    y: number;
    width: number;
}

/**
 * The tag that names the selected or pointed stop: half a lane below its lowest dot, so it sits between two lines and
 * covers none of their stops, and pulled inside the map at either end.
 */
export function tagLayout(station: StationLayout, text: string): TagLayout {
    const width = Math.ceil(text.length * TAG_CHAR + 20);
    const half = width / 2;
    const x = Math.min(Math.max(station.x, 12 + half), MAP.width - 12 - half);
    return {x, y: station.bottom + MAP.laneGap / 2, width};
}

import {carryLock} from "@/lib/lock";

// Builds an island the way Astro writes it: `ssr` until it hydrates.
const linkIn = (href: string, {hydrated = false} = {}) => {
    const island = document.createElement("astro-island");
    if (!hydrated) island.setAttribute("ssr", "");
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = href;
    island.append(link);
    document.body.append(island);
    return link;
};

const follow = (link: HTMLAnchorElement) => {
    // jsdom does not navigate; the test reads the link as the browser would follow it.
    document.addEventListener("click", (event) => event.preventDefault(), {once: true});
    link.click();
    return link.getAttribute("href");
};

describe("carryLock", () => {
    afterEach(() => {
        document.body.replaceChildren();
    });

    it("leaves the links alone when the page is not locked", () => {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/en/backend");
        carryLock();
        expect(follow(linkIn("/en/projects/smartpot?from=backend"))).toBe("/en/projects/smartpot?from=backend");
    });

    it("carries the lock on the links of the parts not hydrated yet", () => {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/en/backend?locked=true");
        carryLock();
        expect(follow(linkIn("/en/experience/tivenos?from=backend"))).toBe("http://localhost:3000/en/experience/tivenos?from=backend&locked=true");
        expect(follow(linkIn("/en/backend#projects"))).toBe("http://localhost:3000/en/backend?locked=true#projects");
        expect(follow(linkIn("/en/projects?from=backend", {hydrated: true}))).toBe("/en/projects?from=backend");
        expect(follow(linkIn("/en/projects?from=backend&locked=true"))).toBe("/en/projects?from=backend&locked=true");
        expect(follow(linkIn("https://github.com/sebastianlopezo"))).toBe("https://github.com/sebastianlopezo");
    });
});

FILE: src/lib/lock.ts

import {isLockedSearch, LOCK_PARAM} from "@/lib/paths";

/**
 * A part of the page hydrates as it comes near the screen, and until then its links are the prerendered ones, which
 * cannot see the page's query. On a locked link, a link followed before its part hydrates carries the lock on to the
 * next page, as the hydrated link would.
 */
export function carryLock() {
    if (!isLockedSearch(location.search)) return;
    document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        const link = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest("a[href]") : null;
        if (!(link instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) || link.origin !== location.origin || !link.closest("astro-island[ssr]")) return;
        if (isLockedSearch(link.search)) return;
        const url = new URL(link.href);
        url.searchParams.set(LOCK_PARAM, "true");
        link.href = url.href;
    }, {capture: true});
}

import {loadDetailCopy} from "@/content/detail-copy";
import {loadProjectsCopy} from "@/content/project-copy";
import {loadSectionCopy} from "@/content/sections";
import {DETAIL_SECTION_COPIES} from "@/content/shared/detail-links";
import type {Lang} from "@/types/content";

/**
 * The body of the project pages with the text it reads: its own chunk, the case studies and project pages, the cards
 * and the about section, whose degrees name the programs in the related links.
 */
export const loadProjectPage = (lang: Lang) =>
    Promise.all([
        import("@/islands/parts/project-body"),
        loadProjectsCopy(lang),
        loadSectionCopy("projects", lang),
        loadSectionCopy("about", lang),
    ]).then(([module]) => module.ProjectBodyPart);

/**
 * The body of the job, program, certification and organization pages with the text it reads. A job, program or
 * organization shows its projects' screens, whose descriptions live with the project pages.
 */
export const loadDetailPage = (lang: Lang, withProjects: boolean) =>
    Promise.all([
        import("@/islands/parts/detail-body"),
        loadDetailCopy(lang),
        ...DETAIL_SECTION_COPIES.map((key) => loadSectionCopy(key, lang)),
        withProjects && loadProjectsCopy(lang),
    ]).then(([module]) => module.DetailBodyPart);

import {isRoleId, ROLE_IDS, type RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import {
    DETAIL_COLLECTIONS,
    type DetailCollection,
    detailSlugs,
    isDetailCollection,
    isDetailSlug
} from "@/content/shared/detail-links";
import {isProjectSlug, PROJECT_SLUGS, type ProjectSlug} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {absoluteUrl} from "@/content/shared/site";
import type {Lang} from "@/types/content";

export const LANGS = ["en", "es"] as const satisfies readonly Lang[];

export const DEFAULT_LANG: Lang = "en";

export const LOCK_PARAM = "locked";

/**
 * Carries the role view a visitor came from into the project and detail pages, so links back keep it. The links are
 * written without it, so search engines find one address per page; lib/role-links.ts adds it when a visitor follows one.
 */
export const FROM_PARAM = "from";

export const PROJECTS_SEGMENT = "projects";

export const isLang = (value: unknown): value is Lang => LANGS.includes(value as Lang);

export const otherLang = (lang: Lang): Lang => (lang === "en" ? "es" : "en");

export interface PathOptions {
    locked?: boolean;
    hash?: string;
}

const fragment = (hash: string) => (hash ? (hash.startsWith("#") ? hash : `#${hash}`) : "");

export const buildPath = (lang: Lang, role: RoleId | null, {locked = false, hash = ""}: PathOptions = {}) => {
    const path = role ? `/${lang}/${role}` : `/${lang}`;
    const query = locked ? `?${LOCK_PARAM}=true` : "";
    return `${path}${query}${fragment(hash)}`;
};

export const parsePath = (pathname: string): { lang: Lang; role: RoleId | null } | null => {
    const segments = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
    if (segments.length === 0 || segments.length > 2) return null;
    const [lang, role] = segments;
    if (!isLang(lang)) return null;
    if (role === undefined) return {lang, role: null};
    return isRoleId(role) ? {lang, role} : null;
};

export interface ProjectPathOptions extends PathOptions {
    slug?: ProjectSlug | null;
}

export const buildProjectPath = (lang: Lang, {slug = null, locked = false, hash = ""}: ProjectPathOptions = {}) => {
    const path = slug ? `/${lang}/${PROJECTS_SEGMENT}/${slug}` : `/${lang}/${PROJECTS_SEGMENT}`;
    const query = locked ? `?${LOCK_PARAM}=true` : "";
    return `${path}${query}${fragment(hash)}`;
};

export const parseProjectPath = (pathname: string): { lang: Lang; slug: ProjectSlug | null } | null => {
    const segments = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
    if (segments.length < 2 || segments.length > 3) return null;
    const [lang, section, slug] = segments;
    if (!isLang(lang) || section !== PROJECTS_SEGMENT) return null;
    if (slug === undefined) return {lang, slug: null};
    return isProjectSlug(slug) ? {lang, slug} : null;
};

export interface DetailPathOptions extends PathOptions {
    slug?: string | null;
}

/** A job, program, certification or organization page, or with no slug the collection's index. */
export const buildDetailPath = (lang: Lang, collection: DetailCollection, {
    slug = null,
    locked = false,
    hash = ""
}: DetailPathOptions = {}) => {
    const path = slug ? `/${lang}/${collection}/${slug}` : `/${lang}/${collection}`;
    const query = locked ? `?${LOCK_PARAM}=true` : "";
    return `${path}${query}${fragment(hash)}`;
};

export const parseDetailPath = (pathname: string): {
    lang: Lang;
    collection: DetailCollection;
    slug: string | null
} | null => {
    const segments = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
    if (segments.length < 2 || segments.length > 3) return null;
    const [lang, collection, slug] = segments;
    if (!isLang(lang) || !isDetailCollection(collection)) return null;
    if (slug === undefined) return {lang, collection, slug: null};
    return isDetailSlug(collection, slug) ? {lang, collection, slug} : null;
};

export const isLockedSearch = (search: string) => new URLSearchParams(search).get(LOCK_PARAM) === "true";

export const roleFromSearch = (search: string): RoleId | null => {
    const value = new URLSearchParams(search).get(FROM_PARAM);
    return isRoleId(value) ? value : null;
};

export const alternates = (role: RoleId | null) => [
    ...LANGS.map((lang) => ({hreflang: lang as string, href: absoluteUrl(buildPath(lang, role))})),
    {hreflang: "x-default", href: absoluteUrl(buildPath(DEFAULT_LANG, role))},
];

export const projectAlternates = (slug: ProjectSlug | null) => [
    ...LANGS.map((lang) => ({hreflang: lang as string, href: absoluteUrl(buildProjectPath(lang, {slug}))})),
    {hreflang: "x-default", href: absoluteUrl(buildProjectPath(DEFAULT_LANG, {slug}))},
];

export const detailAlternates = (collection: DetailCollection, slug: string | null) => [
    ...LANGS.map((lang) => ({hreflang: lang as string, href: absoluteUrl(buildDetailPath(lang, collection, {slug}))})),
    {hreflang: "x-default", href: absoluteUrl(buildDetailPath(DEFAULT_LANG, collection, {slug}))},
];

export type Route =
    | { kind: "profile"; lang: Lang; role: RoleId | null; path: string }
    | { kind: "projects"; lang: Lang; slug: ProjectSlug | null; path: string }
    | { kind: "detail"; lang: Lang; collection: DetailCollection; slug: string | null; path: string };

export const prerenderRoutes: Route[] = [
    ...LANGS.flatMap((lang) => [null, ...ROLE_IDS].map((role) => ({
        kind: "profile" as const,
        lang,
        role,
        path: buildPath(lang, role)
    }))),
    ...LANGS.flatMap((lang) => [null, ...PROJECT_SLUGS].map((slug) => ({
        kind: "projects" as const,
        lang,
        slug,
        path: buildProjectPath(lang, {slug})
    }))),
    ...LANGS.flatMap((lang) =>
        DETAIL_COLLECTIONS.flatMap((collection) =>
            [null, ...detailSlugs(collection)].map((slug) => ({
                kind: "detail" as const,
                lang,
                collection,
                slug,
                path: buildDetailPath(lang, collection, {slug})
            })),
        ),
    ),
];

FILE: src/lib/ready.ts

import {onMount} from "solid-js";

/**
 * Marks `<html data-hydrated="true">` once every island the page hydrates as it settles can respond to input. The page
 * lists them on its root (`<div id="root" data-islands="boot header hero">`, layouts/Page.astro); the sections below the
 * first screen hydrate as they come into view and are not waited for. The end-to-end tests wait for this flag.
 */
const ready = new Set<string>();
const waiting: (() => void)[] = [];

const expected = () => document.getElementById("root")?.dataset.islands?.split(" ").filter(Boolean) ?? [];

const flush = () => {
    if (!expected().every((name) => ready.has(name))) return;
    document.documentElement.dataset.hydrated = "true";
    for (const callback of waiting.splice(0)) callback();
};

export const whenHydrated = (callback: () => void) => {
    if (document.documentElement.dataset.hydrated === "true") callback();
    else waiting.push(callback);
};

export const markIslandReady = (name: string) => {
    ready.add(name);
    flush();
};

/** A home section marks itself too, so a section's hydration can be told apart from the rest of the page. */
export const useSectionReady = (id: string) =>
    onMount(() => {
        document.getElementById(id)?.setAttribute("data-hydrated", "true");
    });

import {carryRole} from "@/lib/role-links";

const linkTo = (href: string) => {
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = href;
    document.body.append(link);
    return link;
};

// jsdom does not navigate; the test reads the link as the browser would follow it.
const follow = (link: HTMLAnchorElement, type: "click" | "auxclick" | "contextmenu" = "click") => {
    document.addEventListener(type, (event) => event.preventDefault(), {once: true});
    link.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(type, {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: type === "auxclick" ? 1 : 0}));
    return link.getAttribute("href");
};

describe("carryRole", () => {
    let controller: AbortController;

    beforeEach(() => {
        // Each test starts its own listeners; the ones of the test before are dropped with the controller.
        controller = new AbortController();
        const add = document.addEventListener.bind(document);
        vi.spyOn(document, "addEventListener").mockImplementation((type, listener, options) =>
            add(type, listener, {
                ...(typeof options === "object" ? options : {capture: options}),
                signal: controller.signal
            }));
    });

    afterEach(() => {
        controller.abort();
        vi.restoreAllMocks();
        document.body.replaceChildren();
    });

    it("adds the role view of a home page to the project and detail pages a visitor opens", () => {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/en/backend");
        carryRole();
        expect(follow(linkTo("/en/projects/smartpot"))).toBe("http://localhost:3000/en/projects/smartpot?from=backend");
        expect(follow(linkTo("/en/experience/tivenos#detail-applied"), "auxclick"))
            .toBe("http://localhost:3000/en/experience/tivenos?from=backend#detail-applied");
        expect(follow(linkTo("/en/projects"), "contextmenu")).toBe("http://localhost:3000/en/projects?from=backend");
    });

    it("writes the view first, before the lock", () => {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/en/backend?locked=true");
        carryRole();
        expect(follow(linkTo("/en/projects/gopoli?locked=true"))).toBe("http://localhost:3000/en/projects/gopoli?from=backend&locked=true");
    });

    it("keeps the view of a project page on the pages opened from it", () => {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/en/projects/smartpot?from=data");
        carryRole();
        expect(follow(linkTo("/es/projects/smartpot"))).toBe("http://localhost:3000/es/projects/smartpot?from=data");
        expect(follow(linkTo("/en/certifications/power-bi-analysis"))).toBe("http://localhost:3000/en/certifications/power-bi-analysis?from=data");
    });

    it("leaves the other links alone", () => {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/en/backend");
        carryRole();
        expect(follow(linkTo("/en/data"))).toBe("/en/data");
        expect(follow(linkTo("/resume-en.pdf"))).toBe("/resume-en.pdf");
        expect(follow(linkTo("https://github.com/sebastianlopezo"))).toBe("https://github.com/sebastianlopezo");
        expect(follow(linkTo("/en/projects/smartpot?from=crm"))).toBe("/en/projects/smartpot?from=crm");
    });

    it("does nothing on a page without a view", () => {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", "/en");
        carryRole();
        expect(follow(linkTo("/en/projects/smartpot"))).toBe("/en/projects/smartpot");
    });
});

FILE: src/lib/role-links.ts

import {stripBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {FROM_PARAM, parseDetailPath, parsePath, parseProjectPath, roleFromSearch} from "@/lib/paths";

/**
 * The links to the project and detail pages are written without the role view they are followed from, so a search
 * engine finds one address per page instead of one per view. The view rides along only when a visitor follows a link:
 * on a click (also with a modifier or the keyboard), a middle click or the context menu that opens it in a new tab, the
 * link gets `?from=` with the view of this page, first in the query as the pages have always written it.
 */
export function carryRole() {
    const role = parsePath(stripBase(location.pathname))?.role ?? roleFromSearch(location.search);
    if (!role) return;
    const carry = (event: Event) => {
        const link = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest("a[href]") : null;
        if (!(link instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) || link.origin !== location.origin) return;
        const path = stripBase(link.pathname);
        if (!parseProjectPath(path) && !parseDetailPath(path)) return;
        const params = new URLSearchParams(link.search);
        if (params.has(FROM_PARAM)) return;
        link.search = new URLSearchParams([[FROM_PARAM, role], ...params]).toString();
    };
    for (const type of ["click", "auxclick", "contextmenu"]) document.addEventListener(type, carry, {capture: true});
}

import {experience} from "@/content/shared/experience";
import {projects} from "@/content/shared/projects";
import {skillGroups} from "@/content/shared/skills";
import en from "@/content/en";
import {GENERAL, ROLE_IDS, ROLES} from "@/content/roles";
import {
    countMatches,
    isFocusTech,
    listProjects,
    orderExperience,
    orderSkillGroups,
    orderTech,
    prioritize,
    sectionOrder,
    split
} from "@/lib/role-view";

describe("role view", () => {
    it("uses the general order without a role", () => {
        expect(sectionOrder(null)).toEqual(GENERAL.sectionOrder);
    });

    it("keeps every section reachable in every role", () => {
        const sections = [...GENERAL.sectionOrder].sort();
        for (const role of ROLE_IDS) expect([...ROLES[role].sectionOrder].sort()).toEqual(sections);
    });

    it("moves role bullets first without dropping any", () => {
        const bullets = en.experience.items.tivenos.bullets;
        const ordered = prioritize(bullets, (bullet) => bullet.roles, "devops");
        expect(ordered).toHaveLength(bullets.length);
        expect(ordered[0].roles).toContain("devops");
        expect(new Set(ordered)).toEqual(new Set(bullets));
    });

    it("keeps the original order when no role is active", () => {
        const bullets = en.experience.items.adcom.bullets;
        expect(prioritize(bullets, (bullet) => bullet.roles, null)).toEqual(bullets);
    });

    it("never reorders the jobs", () => {
        expect(experience.map((item) => item.id)).toEqual(["tivenos", "adcom", "muvu", "quipux"]);
    });

    it("orders skill groups and projects by role", () => {
        expect(orderSkillGroups(skillGroups, "data")[0].id).toBe("data");
        expect(orderSkillGroups(skillGroups, "data")).toHaveLength(skillGroups.length);
        const work = projects.filter((project) => project.category === "work");
        expect(listProjects(work, "data")[0].roles).toContain("data");
        expect(listProjects(work, "crm").map((project) => project.id)).not.toContain("martech");
        expect(listProjects(work, null)).toHaveLength(work.length);
    });

    it("splits visible and hidden items", () => {
        expect(split([1, 2, 3, 4], 3)).toEqual({visible: [1, 2, 3], hidden: [4]});
    });
});

describe("role relevance", () => {
    it("matches focus technologies by whole name", () => {
        expect(isFocusTech("Spring Boot 4", "backend")).toBe(true);
        expect(isFocusTech("SOAP/WSDL (Zeep)", "backend")).toBe(true);
        expect(isFocusTech("Java 21", "backend")).toBe(true);
        expect(isFocusTech("JavaScript", "backend")).toBe(false);
        expect(isFocusTech("Docker", null)).toBe(false);
    });

    it("moves the role's technologies first without dropping any", () => {
        const tech = ["React", "Docker", "FastAPI", "Prometheus"];
        expect(orderTech(tech, "devops")).toEqual(["Docker", "Prometheus", "React", "FastAPI"]);
        expect(orderTech(tech, null)).toEqual(tech);
    });

    it("orders jobs by relevance in role views and chronologically otherwise", () => {
        const bulletsOf = (job: (typeof experience)[number]) => en.experience.items[job.id].bullets;
        const ids = (role: Parameters<typeof orderExperience>[2]) => orderExperience(experience, bulletsOf, role).map((job) => job.id);
        expect(ids(null)).toEqual(experience.map((job) => job.id));
        expect(ids("data")[0]).toBe("quipux");
        // Both current jobs carry most of the CRM and full-stack achievements; the share of matches decides between them.
        expect(ids("crm").slice(0, 2).sort()).toEqual(["adcom", "tivenos"]);
        expect(ids("fullstack").slice(0, 2).sort()).toEqual(["adcom", "tivenos"]);
        expect(new Set(ids("data"))).toEqual(new Set(ids(null)));
    });

    it("counts the bullets tagged with a role", () => {
        const bullets = en.experience.items.quipux.bullets;
        expect(countMatches(bullets, "data")).toBe(bullets.length);
        expect(countMatches(bullets, null)).toBe(0);
    });
});

import {roleConfig, type RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import type {Bullet, SectionId, SkillGroupId} from "@/types/content";
import type {ProjectFacts} from "@/types/project";

export const sectionOrder = (role: RoleId | null): SectionId[] => roleConfig(role).sectionOrder;

export const prioritize = <T>(items: readonly T[], rolesOf: (item: T) => readonly RoleId[], role: RoleId | null): T[] => {
    if (!role) return [...items];
    const matching = items.filter((item) => rolesOf(item).includes(role));
    const rest = items.filter((item) => !rolesOf(item).includes(role));
    return [...matching, ...rest];
};

export const orderByIds = <T extends { id: string }>(items: readonly T[], ids: readonly string[]): T[] => {
    const rank = (item: T) => {
        const index = ids.indexOf(item.id);
        return index === -1 ? ids.length : index;
    };
    return items
        .map((item, index) => ({item, index}))
        .sort((a, b) => rank(a.item) - rank(b.item) || a.index - b.index)
        .map(({item}) => item);
};

export const orderSkillGroups = <T extends { id: SkillGroupId }>(groups: readonly T[], role: RoleId | null): T[] =>
    orderByIds(groups, roleConfig(role).skillGroupOrder);

/** The projects a category lists in a role view: the role's own first, without the featured one above them. */
export const listProjects = (projects: readonly ProjectFacts[], role: RoleId | null): ProjectFacts[] =>
    prioritize(projects.filter((project) => project.id !== roleConfig(role).featuredProject), (project) => project.roles, role);

export const split = <T>(items: readonly T[], visible: number) => ({
    visible: items.slice(0, visible),
    hidden: items.slice(visible),
});

export const isFocusTech = (tech: string, role: RoleId | null) => {
    if (!role) return false;
    const name = tech.toLowerCase();
    return roleConfig(role).focusTech.some((focus) => {
        const key = focus.toLowerCase();
        return name === key || name.startsWith(`${key} `) || name.startsWith(`${key}/`);
    });
};

export const orderTech = (techs: readonly string[], role: RoleId | null): string[] =>
    [...techs.filter((tech) => isFocusTech(tech, role)), ...techs.filter((tech) => !isFocusTech(tech, role))];

export const countMatches = (bullets: readonly Bullet[], role: RoleId | null) =>
    role ? bullets.filter((bullet) => bullet.roles.includes(role)).length : 0;

export const relevance = (bullets: readonly Bullet[], role: RoleId | null) => {
    const matches = countMatches(bullets, role);
    return bullets.length ? matches + matches / bullets.length : 0;
};

export const orderExperience = <T extends {
    start: string
}>(jobs: readonly T[], bulletsOf: (job: T) => readonly Bullet[], role: RoleId | null): T[] =>
    role
        ? [...jobs].sort((a, b) => relevance(bulletsOf(b), role) - relevance(bulletsOf(a), role) || b.start.localeCompare(a.start))
        : [...jobs];

import {certifications} from "@/content/shared/certifications";

import {SKILL_IDS} from "@/content/shared/skills";
import {testimonials} from "@/content/shared/testimonials";
import {absoluteUrl, SITE_URL} from "@/content/shared/site";
import {
    certificationBySlug,

    reasonBySlug,
    serviceBySlug,
    skillBySlug

import type {Content, Lang, StartupContent} from "@/types/content";
import type {DetailPagesCopy} from "@/types/detail";

// Kept apart from seo.ts, like the project pages' heads, so the startup bundle does not carry them.

/** Every job, program, certification and organization has an image of its own; the indexes share one per language. */
export const detailOgImagePath = (lang: Lang, collection: DetailCollection, slug: string | null) =>
    slug ? `/og/${collection}-${slug}-${lang}.jpg` : `/og/${collection}-${lang}.jpg`;

export interface DetailHeadInput {
    collection: DetailCollection;
    slug: string | null;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    /** The page's name in the breadcrumb and the image's alt text. */
    name: string;
    /** The schema.org node of what the page is about: the company, the program, the credential or the organization. */
    about?: object;
    /** On an index, the pages it lists. */
    items?: { slug: string; name: string }[];
}

export const buildDetailHead = (content: StartupContent, copy: DetailPagesCopy, input: DetailHeadInput): HeadData => {
    const {lang} = content;
    const {collection, slug} = input;
    const canonical = absoluteUrl(buildDetailPath(lang, collection, {slug}));
    const index = copy.indexes[collection];
    const page = input.items
        ? {
            "@type": "CollectionPage",
            "@id": `${canonical}#page`,
            url: canonical,
            name: input.title,
            description: input.description,
            inLanguage: lang,
            author: {"@id": `${SITE_URL}/#person`},
            mainEntity: {
                "@type": "ItemList",
                itemListElement: input.items.map((item, position) => ({
                    "@type": "ListItem",
                    position: position + 1,
                    name: item.name,
                    url: absoluteUrl(buildDetailPath(lang, collection, {slug: item.slug})),
                })),
            },
        }
        : {
            "@type": "WebPage",
            "@id": `${canonical}#page`,
            url: canonical,
            name: input.title,
            description: input.description,
            inLanguage: lang,
            author: {"@id": `${SITE_URL}/#person`},
            ...(input.about ? {about: input.about} : {}),
        };
    const crumbs = [
        {name: content.seo.siteName, url: absoluteUrl(buildPath(lang, null))},
        {name: index.title, url: absoluteUrl(buildDetailPath(lang, collection))},
        ...(slug ? [{name: input.name, url: canonical}] : []),
    ];
    return {
        lang,
        type: slug ? "article" : "website",
        title: input.title,
        description: input.description,
        canonical,
        alternates: detailAlternates(collection, slug),
        locale: LOCALES[lang],
        alternateLocale: LOCALES[otherLang(lang)],
        image: absoluteUrl(detailOgImagePath(lang, collection, slug)),
        imageAlt: input.name,
        siteName: content.seo.siteName,
        jsonLd: graphOf([page, personNode(), breadcrumb(crumbs)]),
    };
};

/**
 * The text a detail page's head needs besides its own: the job titles, the degrees, the certifications, the names of
 * the groups of tools, and the services and the reasons to hire me.
 */
export interface DetailHeadTexts {
    copy: DetailPagesCopy;
    about: Content["about"];
    certifications: Content["certifications"];
    services: Content["services"];
    skills: Content["skills"];
}

const indexInput = (texts: DetailHeadTexts, collection: DetailCollection, items: {
    slug: string;
    name: string
}[]): DetailHeadInput => {
    const index = texts.copy.indexes[collection];
    return {
        collection,
        slug: null,
        title: index.seo.title,
        description: index.seo.description,
        name: index.title,
        items
    };
};

const experienceInput = (texts: DetailHeadTexts, slug: string | null): DetailHeadInput => {
    if (!slug) return indexInput(texts, "experience", experience.map((job) => ({
        slug: EXPERIENCE_SLUG[job.id],
        name: job.company
    })));
    const job = experienceBySlug(slug)!;
    const {seo} = texts.copy.experience[job.id];
    return {
        collection: "experience",
        slug, ...seo,
        name: job.company,
        about: {"@type": "Organization", name: job.company}
    };
};

const educationInput = (texts: DetailHeadTexts, slug: string | null): DetailHeadInput => {
    if (!slug) return indexInput(texts, "education", education.map((program) => ({
        slug: EDUCATION_SLUG[program.id],
        name: texts.about.education[program.id].degree
    })));
    const program = educationBySlug(slug)!;
    const {seo} = texts.copy.education[program.id];
    const degree = texts.about.education[program.id].degree;
    return {
        collection: "education",
        slug,
        ...seo,
        name: degree,
        about: {
            "@type": "EducationalOccupationalProgram",
            name: degree,
            provider: {"@type": "EducationalOrganization", name: program.school}
        },
    };
};

const certificationInput = (texts: DetailHeadTexts, slug: string | null, months: readonly string[]): DetailHeadInput => {
    if (!slug) return indexInput(texts, "certifications", certifications.map((item) => ({
        slug: CERTIFICATION_SLUG[item.id],
        name: item.title
    })));
    const item = certificationBySlug(slug)!;
    const text = texts.certifications.items[item.id];
    // Certificate titles are the same in both languages, so the collection's name keeps each title unique. Search results
    // cut a title past about 65 characters, so a long one leaves the issuer to the description.
    const eyebrow = texts.copy.ui.eyebrow.certifications;
    const withIssuer = `${item.title} (${item.issuer}) · ${eyebrow}`;
    const lead = `${item.issuer}, ${formatYearMonth(item.date, months)}. ${text.learned}`;
    const full = `${lead} ${text.adds}`;
    const description = full.length <= 160 ? full : lead;
    const tailed = `${description} ${texts.copy.ui.certificationSeoTail}`;
    return {
        collection: "certifications",
        slug,
        title: withIssuer.length <= 65 ? withIssuer : `${item.title} · ${eyebrow}`,
        description: description.length < 110 && tailed.length <= 165 ? tailed : description,
        name: item.title,
        about: {
            "@type": "EducationalOccupationalCredential",
            name: item.title,
            credentialCategory: "certificate",
            dateCreated: item.date,
            recognizedBy: {"@type": "Organization", name: item.issuer},
            ...(item.url ? {url: item.url} : {}),
        },
    };
};

const organizationInput = (texts: DetailHeadTexts, slug: string | null): DetailHeadInput => {
    if (!slug) return indexInput(texts, "organizations", organizations.map((item) => ({
        slug: ORGANIZATION_SLUG[item.id],
        name: item.name
    })));
    const item = organizationBySlug(slug)!;
    const {seo} = texts.copy.organizations[item.id];
    return {
        collection: "organizations",
        slug, ...seo,
        name: item.name,
        about: {"@type": "Organization", name: item.name, url: item.url}
    };
};

const serviceInput = (texts: DetailHeadTexts, slug: string | null): DetailHeadInput => {
    if (!slug) return indexInput(texts, "services", SERVICE_IDS.map((id) => ({
        slug: SERVICE_SLUG[id],
        name: texts.services.items[id].title
    })));
    const id = serviceBySlug(slug)!;
    const service = texts.services.items[id];
    return {
        collection: "services",
        slug,
        ...texts.copy.services[id].seo,
        name: service.title,
        about: {
            "@type": "Service",
            name: service.title,
            description: service.description,
            serviceType: service.title,
            provider: {"@id": `${SITE_URL}/#person`},
        },
    };
};

/** A reason's search result: its title with the collection's name, its sentence and, when there is room, who backs it. */
const reasonInput = (texts: DetailHeadTexts, slug: string | null): DetailHeadInput => {
    if (!slug) return indexInput(texts, "reasons", benefitOrder.map((id) => ({
        slug: REASON_SLUG[id],
        name: texts.services.benefits[id].title
    })));
    const id = reasonBySlug(slug)!;
    const benefit = texts.services.benefits[id];
    const author = testimonials.find((item) => item.id === benefit.evidence.testimonial)!.author;
    const tailed = `${benefit.description} ${texts.copy.ui.reasonSeoTail.replace("{author}", author)}`;
    return {
        collection: "reasons",
        slug,
        title: `${benefit.title} · ${texts.copy.indexes.reasons.title.replace(/[¿?]/g, "")}`,
        description: benefit.description.length < 120 && tailed.length <= 165 ? tailed : benefit.description,
        name: benefit.title,
    };
};

/** A group of tools: what its page tells, about the skill it names. */
const skillInput = (texts: DetailHeadTexts, slug: string | null): DetailHeadInput => {
    if (!slug) return indexInput(texts, "skills", SKILL_IDS.map((id) => ({
        slug: SKILL_SLUG[id],
        name: texts.skills.groups[id]
    })));
    const id = skillBySlug(slug)!;
    const name = texts.skills.groups[id];
    return {
        collection: "skills",
        slug,
        ...texts.copy.skills[id].seo,
        name,
        about: {"@type": "DefinedTerm", name, description: texts.skills.taglines[id]},
    };
};

/** The about page and the metrics are pages with nothing under them. */
const aboutInput = (texts: DetailHeadTexts): DetailHeadInput => {
    const index = texts.copy.indexes.about;
    return {
        collection: "about",
        slug: null,
        title: index.seo.title,
        description: index.seo.description,
        name: index.title
    };
};

const metricsInput = (texts: DetailHeadTexts): DetailHeadInput => {
    const index = texts.copy.indexes.metrics;
    return {
        collection: "metrics",
        slug: null,
        title: index.seo.title,
        description: index.seo.description,
        name: index.title
    };
};

const INPUTS: Record<DetailCollection, (texts: DetailHeadTexts, slug: string | null, months: readonly string[]) => DetailHeadInput> = {
    about: aboutInput,
    experience: experienceInput,
    education: educationInput,
    certifications: certificationInput,
    skills: skillInput,
    organizations: organizationInput,
    services: serviceInput,
    reasons: reasonInput,
    metrics: metricsInput,
};

/** The head of any detail page or index, the same on the server and after hydration. */
export const detailHead = (content: StartupContent, texts: DetailHeadTexts, collection: DetailCollection, slug: string | null) =>
    buildDetailHead(content, texts.copy, INPUTS[collection](texts, slug, content.ui.months));

import {profile} from "@/content/shared/profile";
import {SITE_URL} from "@/content/shared/site";

// The JSON-LD pieces every page after the profile shares: the person behind the site, the breadcrumb and the graph.

export const personNode = () => ({
    "@type": "Person",
    "@id": `${SITE_URL}/#person`,
    name: profile.name,
    url: `${SITE_URL}/`
});

export const breadcrumb = (items: { name: string; url: string }[]) => ({
    "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
    itemListElement: items.map((item, index) => ({
        "@type": "ListItem",
        position: index + 1,
        name: item.name,
        item: item.url
    })),
});

export const graphOf = (nodes: object[]) => JSON.stringify({
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@graph": nodes
}).replace(/</g, "\u003c");

import {isCaseStudy, projectIdBySlug, type ProjectSlug} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {absoluteUrl, SITE_URL} from "@/content/shared/site";
import {widestVariant} from "@/lib/image-widths";
import {buildPath, buildProjectPath, projectAlternates} from "@/lib/paths";
import {type HeadData, LOCALES, ogImagePath} from "@/lib/seo";
import {breadcrumb, graphOf, personNode} from "@/lib/seo-graph";
import type {CaseImageFacts, CaseStudiesUi, CaseStudyCopy, CaseStudyFacts} from "@/types/case-study";
import type {Lang, StartupContent} from "@/types/content";
import type {ProjectCardCopy, ProjectFacts, ProjectPageCopy} from "@/types/project";

// Kept apart from seo.ts so the startup bundle, which builds the profile heads, does not carry the project pages' heads.

/** Case studies keep their original image names; the other project pages use their own prefix. */
export const projectOgImagePath = (lang: Lang, slug: ProjectSlug) =>
    `/og/${isCaseStudy(projectIdBySlug(slug)) ? "case" : "project"}-${slug}-${lang}.jpg`;

/** The share image first, then each screen of the project with its alt text as the caption. */
const imagesOf = (share: string, screens: CaseImageFacts[], alts: Record<string, string>) => [
    share,
    ...screens.map((screen) => ({
        "@type": "ImageObject",
        contentUrl: absoluteUrl(widestVariant(screen)),
        caption: alts[screen.id]
    })),
];

/** Head of the projects index: every project as an item list. */
export const buildProjectsHead = (content: StartupContent, ui: CaseStudiesUi, items: {
    slug: ProjectSlug;
    name: string
}[]): HeadData => {
    const canonical = absoluteUrl(buildProjectPath(content.lang));
    const alternateLang: Lang = content.lang === "en" ? "es" : "en";
    const home = absoluteUrl(buildPath(content.lang, null));
    return {
        lang: content.lang,
        type: "website",
        title: ui.indexSeo.title,
        description: ui.indexSeo.description,
        canonical,
        alternates: projectAlternates(null),
        locale: LOCALES[content.lang],
        alternateLocale: LOCALES[alternateLang],
        image: absoluteUrl(ogImagePath(content.lang)),
        imageAlt: content.seo.ogImageAlt,
        siteName: content.seo.siteName,
        jsonLd: graphOf([
            {
                "@type": "CollectionPage",
                "@id": `${canonical}#page`,
                url: canonical,
                name: ui.indexSeo.title,
                description: ui.indexSeo.description,
                inLanguage: content.lang,
                author: {"@id": `${SITE_URL}/#person`},
                mainEntity: {
                    "@type": "ItemList",
                    itemListElement: items.map((item, index) => ({
                        "@type": "ListItem",
                        position: index + 1,
                        name: item.name,
                        url: absoluteUrl(buildProjectPath(content.lang, {slug: item.slug})),
                    })),
                },
            },
            personNode(),
            breadcrumb([{name: content.seo.siteName, url: home}, {name: ui.indexTitle, url: canonical}]),
        ]),
    };
};

/** Head of one case study, shared as an article written by the person behind the site. */
export const buildCaseStudyHead = (content: StartupContent, ui: CaseStudiesUi, slug: ProjectSlug, copy: CaseStudyCopy, facts: CaseStudyFacts): HeadData => {
    const canonical = absoluteUrl(buildProjectPath(content.lang, {slug}));
    const alternateLang: Lang = content.lang === "en" ? "es" : "en";
    const image = absoluteUrl(projectOgImagePath(content.lang, slug));
    return {
        lang: content.lang,
        type: "article",
        title: copy.seo.title,
        description: copy.seo.description,
        canonical,
        alternates: projectAlternates(slug),
        locale: LOCALES[content.lang],
        alternateLocale: LOCALES[alternateLang],
        image,
        imageAlt: copy.name,
        siteName: content.seo.siteName,
        jsonLd: graphOf([
            {
                "@type": "CreativeWork",
                "@id": `${canonical}#case`,
                url: canonical,
                name: copy.name,
                headline: copy.seo.title,
                description: copy.seo.description,
                abstract: copy.summary,
                inLanguage: content.lang,
                image: imagesOf(image, facts.images, copy.images),
                dateCreated: facts.start,
                keywords: facts.tech.join(", "),
                author: {"@id": `${SITE_URL}/#person`},
                ...(facts.links.code ? {codeRepository: facts.links.code} : {}),
            },
            personNode(),
            breadcrumb([
                {name: content.seo.siteName, url: absoluteUrl(buildPath(content.lang, null))},
                {name: ui.indexTitle, url: absoluteUrl(buildProjectPath(content.lang))},
                {name: copy.name, url: canonical},
            ]),
        ]),
    };
};

/** Head of a project page without a full case study, shared as a creative work like the case studies. */
export const buildProjectPageHead = (
    content: StartupContent,
    ui: CaseStudiesUi,
    slug: ProjectSlug,
    card: ProjectCardCopy,
    page: ProjectPageCopy,
    facts: ProjectFacts,
): HeadData => {
    const canonical = absoluteUrl(buildProjectPath(content.lang, {slug}));
    const alternateLang: Lang = content.lang === "en" ? "es" : "en";
    const image = absoluteUrl(projectOgImagePath(content.lang, slug));
    return {
        lang: content.lang,
        type: "article",
        title: page.seo.title,
        description: page.seo.description,
        canonical,
        alternates: projectAlternates(slug),
        locale: LOCALES[content.lang],
        alternateLocale: LOCALES[alternateLang],
        image,
        imageAlt: card.name,
        siteName: content.seo.siteName,
        jsonLd: graphOf([
            {
                "@type": "CreativeWork",
                "@id": `${canonical}#project`,
                url: canonical,
                name: card.name,
                headline: page.seo.title,
                description: page.seo.description,
                abstract: card.summary,
                inLanguage: content.lang,
                image: imagesOf(image, facts.images ?? [], page.images),
                dateCreated: facts.start,
                keywords: facts.tech.join(", "),
                author: {"@id": `${SITE_URL}/#person`},
                ...(facts.links.code ? {codeRepository: facts.links.code} : {}),
            },
            personNode(),
            breadcrumb([
                {name: content.seo.siteName, url: absoluteUrl(buildPath(content.lang, null))},
                {name: ui.indexTitle, url: absoluteUrl(buildProjectPath(content.lang))},
                {name: card.name, url: canonical},
            ]),
        ]),
    };
};

FILE: src/lib/seo.test.ts
================================================
import en from "@/content/en";
import es from "@/content/es";
import {ROLE_IDS} from "@/content/roles";
import {caseStudyCopy} from "@/content/case-studies";
import {projectPages as enPages} from "@/content/project-pages/en";
import {projectPages as esPages} from "@/content/project-pages/es";
import {isCaseStudy, PROJECT_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {caseStudyById} from "@/content/shared/case-studies";
import {projects} from "@/content/shared/projects";
import {buildHead, renderHeadTags} from "@/lib/seo";
import {buildCaseStudyHead, buildProjectPageHead, buildProjectsHead} from "@/lib/seo-projects";

describe("seo", () => {
    it("builds a unique head for every language and role", () => {
        const titles = new Set<string>();
        for (const content of [en, es]) {
            for (const role of [null, ...ROLE_IDS]) {
                const head = buildHead(content, role);
                titles.add(head.title);
                expect(head.canonical).toBe(`https://sebastianlopezo.page/${content.lang}${role ? `/${role}` : ""}`);
                expect(head.alternates.map((alternate) => alternate.hreflang)).toEqual(["en", "es", "x-default"]);
                expect(head.image).toBe(`https://sebastianlopezo.page/og/og-${content.lang}.jpg`);
            }
        }
        expect(titles.size).toBe(12);
    });

    it("emits valid structured data for the person behind the page", () => {
        const data = JSON.parse(buildHead(es, "devops").jsonLd);
        const types = data["@graph"].map((node: { "@type": string }) => node["@type"]);
        expect(types).toEqual(["WebSite", "ProfilePage", "Person"]);
        const person = data["@graph"][2];
        expect(person.jobTitle).toBe(es.hero.byProfile.devops.title);
        expect(person.telephone).toBe("+573002329213");
        expect(person.worksFor).toHaveLength(2);
        const schools = person.alumniOf.map((school: { name: string }) => school.name);
        expect(new Set(schools).size).toBe(schools.length);
    });

    it("renders escaped head tags with locale alternates", () => {
        const html = renderHeadTags(buildHead(en, "crm"));
        expect(html).toContain('<link data-head="canonical" rel="canonical" href="https://sebastianlopezo.page/en/crm">');
        expect(html).toContain('hreflang="x-default" href="https://sebastianlopezo.page/en/crm"');
        expect(html).toContain('property="og:locale" content="en_US"');
        expect(html).toContain('property="og:locale:alternate" content="es_CO"');
        expect(html).toContain("Zoho CRM &amp; Integrations Engineer");
        expect(html).not.toContain("</script><");
    });

    it("builds a unique article head for every project page and a list for the index", () => {
        const titles = new Set<string>();
        for (const content of [en, es]) {
            const {ui, items} = caseStudyCopy[content.lang];
            const pages = content.lang === "es" ? esPages : enPages;
            const cards = content.projects.items;
            const index = buildProjectsHead(content, ui, projects.map((facts) => ({
                slug: PROJECT_SLUG[facts.id],
                name: cards[facts.id].name
            })));
            expect(index.canonical).toBe(`https://sebastianlopezo.page/${content.lang}/projects`);
            const graph = JSON.parse(index.jsonLd)["@graph"];
            expect(graph.map((node: {
                "@type": string
            }) => node["@type"])).toEqual(["CollectionPage", "Person", "BreadcrumbList"]);
            expect(graph[0].mainEntity.itemListElement).toHaveLength(projects.length);
            titles.add(index.title);
            for (const facts of projects) {
                const id = facts.id;
                const slug = PROJECT_SLUG[id];
                const head = isCaseStudy(id)
                    ? buildCaseStudyHead(content, ui, slug, items[id], caseStudyById(id))
                    : buildProjectPageHead(content, ui, slug, cards[id], pages.items[id], facts);
                titles.add(head.title);
                expect(head.type).toBe("article");
                expect(head.canonical).toBe(`https://sebastianlopezo.page/${content.lang}/projects/${slug}`);
                expect(head.image).toBe(`https://sebastianlopezo.page/og/${isCaseStudy(id) ? "case" : "project"}-${slug}-${content.lang}.jpg`);
                expect(head.description.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(70);
                expect(head.description.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(170);
                const html = renderHeadTags(head);
                expect(html).toContain('property="og:type" content="article"');
                expect(html).not.toContain("profile:first_name");
            }
        }
        expect(titles.size).toBe(2 * (projects.length + 1));
    });
});

FILE: src/lib/seo.ts
