import {roleConfig, type RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import {experience} from "@/content/shared/experience";
import {education} from "@/content/shared/education";
import {profile, socialLinks} from "@/content/shared/profile";
import {absoluteUrl, BUILD_DATE, SITE_URL} from "@/content/shared/site";
import {alternates, buildPath} from "@/lib/paths";
import type {Lang, StartupContent} from "@/types/content";

export interface HeadData {
    lang: Lang;
    /** The Open Graph type: profile for the role views, article for the case studies, website for the index. */
    type?: "profile" | "article" | "website";
    title: string;
    description: string;
    canonical: string;
    alternates: { hreflang: string; href: string }[];
    locale: string;
    alternateLocale: string;
    image: string;
    imageAlt: string;
    siteName: string;
    jsonLd: string;
}

export const LOCALES: Record<Lang, string> = {en: "en_US", es: "es_CO"};

const OG_IMAGE_SIZE = {width: 1200, height: 630};

export const ogImagePath = (lang: Lang) => `/og/og-${lang}.jpg`;

const structuredData = (content: StartupContent, role: RoleId | null, canonical: string) => {
    const copy = content.hero.byProfile[role ?? "general"];
    const seo = content.seo.profiles[role ?? "general"];
    const website = `${SITE_URL}/#website`;
    const person = `${SITE_URL}/#person`;
    const graph = [
        {
            "@type": "WebSite",
            "@id": website,
            url: `${SITE_URL}/`,
            name: content.seo.siteName,
            inLanguage: ["en", "es"],
        },
        {
            "@type": "ProfilePage",
            "@id": `${canonical}#page`,
            url: canonical,
            name: seo.title,
            description: seo.description,
            inLanguage: content.lang,
            isPartOf: {"@id": website},
            mainEntity: {"@id": person},
            dateModified: BUILD_DATE,
        },
        {
            "@type": "Person",
            "@id": person,
            name: profile.name,
            givenName: profile.givenName,
            familyName: profile.familyName,
            jobTitle: copy.title,
            description: copy.headline,
            url: `${SITE_URL}/`,
            image: absoluteUrl(ogImagePath(content.lang)),
            email: `mailto:${profile.email}`,
            telephone: profile.phone.e164,
            address: {
                "@type": "PostalAddress",
                addressLocality: profile.location.city,
                addressRegion: profile.location.region,
                addressCountry: profile.location.countryCode,
            },
            alumniOf: [...new Set(education.map((item) => item.school))]
                .slice(0, 2)
                .map((name) => ({"@type": "EducationalOrganization", name})),
            worksFor: experience
                .filter((item) => item.end === null)
                .map((item) => ({"@type": "Organization", name: item.company})),
            knowsAbout: roleConfig(role).topStack,
            knowsLanguage: ["es", "en"],
            sameAs: socialLinks.map((link) => link.href),
        },
    ];
    return JSON.stringify({"@context": "https://schema.org", "@graph": graph}).replace(/</g, "\\u003c");
};

export const buildHead = (content: StartupContent, role: RoleId | null): HeadData => {
    const seo = content.seo.profiles[role ?? "general"];
    const canonical = absoluteUrl(buildPath(content.lang, role));
    const alternateLang: Lang = content.lang === "en" ? "es" : "en";
    return {
        lang: content.lang,
        title: seo.title,
        description: seo.description,
        canonical,
        alternates: alternates(role),
        locale: LOCALES[content.lang],
        alternateLocale: LOCALES[alternateLang],
        image: absoluteUrl(ogImagePath(content.lang)),
        imageAlt: content.seo.ogImageAlt,
        siteName: content.seo.siteName,
        jsonLd: structuredData(content, role, canonical),
    };
};

const escape = (value: string) =>
    value.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");

const meta = (key: string, attribute: "name" | "property", name: string, value: string) =>
    `<meta data-head="${key}" ${attribute}="${name}" content="${escape(value)}">`;

export const renderHeadTags = (head: HeadData) =>
    [
        `<title data-head="title">${escape(head.title)}</title>`,
        meta("description", "name", "description", head.description),
        `<link data-head="canonical" rel="canonical" href="${escape(head.canonical)}">`,
        ...head.alternates.map(
            (alternate) =>
                `<link data-head="alternate-${alternate.hreflang}" rel="alternate" hreflang="${alternate.hreflang}" href="${escape(alternate.href)}">`,
        ),
        meta("og-type", "property", "og:type", head.type ?? "profile"),
        meta("og-site-name", "property", "og:site_name", head.siteName),
        meta("og-title", "property", "og:title", head.title),
        meta("og-description", "property", "og:description", head.description),
        meta("og-url", "property", "og:url", head.canonical),
        meta("og-image", "property", "og:image", head.image),
        meta("og-image-type", "property", "og:image:type", "image/jpeg"),
        meta("og-image-width", "property", "og:image:width", String(OG_IMAGE_SIZE.width)),
        meta("og-image-height", "property", "og:image:height", String(OG_IMAGE_SIZE.height)),
        meta("og-image-alt", "property", "og:image:alt", head.imageAlt),
        meta("og-locale", "property", "og:locale", head.locale),
        meta("og-locale-alternate", "property", "og:locale:alternate", head.alternateLocale),
        ...((head.type ?? "profile") === "profile"
            ? [
                meta("profile-first-name", "property", "profile:first_name", profile.givenName),
                meta("profile-last-name", "property", "profile:last_name", profile.familyName),
            ]
            : []),
        meta("twitter-card", "name", "twitter:card", "summary_large_image"),
        meta("twitter-site", "name", "twitter:site", profile.twitter),
        meta("twitter-title", "name", "twitter:title", head.title),
        meta("twitter-description", "name", "twitter:description", head.description),
        meta("twitter-image", "name", "twitter:image", head.image),
        meta("twitter-image-alt", "name", "twitter:image:alt", head.imageAlt),
        `<script data-head="jsonld" type="application/ld+json">${head.jsonLd}</script>`,
    ].join("\n    ");

import {buildRobots, buildSitemap} from "@/lib/sitemap";

describe("sitemap and robots", () => {
    it("lists the profile, project and detail pages in both languages as plain XML", () => {
        const sitemap = buildSitemap();
        expect(sitemap.match(/<url>/g)).toHaveLength(260);
        expect(sitemap).toContain("<loc>https://sebastianlopezo.page/es/data</loc>");
        expect(sitemap).toContain("<loc>https://sebastianlopezo.page/es/projects/smartpot</loc>");
        expect(sitemap).toContain("<loc>https://sebastianlopezo.page/es/projects/gopoli</loc>");
        expect(sitemap).toContain("<loc>https://sebastianlopezo.page/en/projects/landing-platform</loc>");
        expect(sitemap).toContain("<loc>https://sebastianlopezo.page/es/experience/muv-u</loc>");
        expect(sitemap).toContain("<loc>https://sebastianlopezo.page/en/certifications/it-specialist-python</loc>");
        expect(sitemap).toContain("<lastmod>2026-10-03</lastmod>");
        expect(sitemap).not.toContain("http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml");
        expect(sitemap).not.toContain("<xhtml:link");
    });

    it("dates each page by the day it last changed", () => {
        const sitemap = buildSitemap((path) => (path === "/es/projects/smartpot" ? "2026-09-12" : "2026-10-03"));
        const smartpot = sitemap.split("<url>").find((entry) => entry.includes("<loc>https://sebastianlopezo.page/es/projects/smartpot</loc>"))!;
        expect(smartpot).toContain("<lastmod>2026-09-12</lastmod>");
        expect(sitemap.match(/<lastmod>2026-09-12<\/lastmod>/g)).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it("lists the screens of each project", () => {
        const sitemap = buildSitemap();
        const smartpot = sitemap.split("<url>").find((entry) => entry.includes("<loc>https://sebastianlopezo.page/en/projects/smartpot</loc>"))!;
        expect(smartpot.match(/<image:loc>/g)).toHaveLength(3);
        expect(smartpot).toMatch(/<image:loc>https:\/\/sebastianlopezo\.page\/[^<]+\.webp<\/image:loc>/);
        const profile = sitemap.split("<url>").find((entry) => entry.includes("<loc>https://sebastianlopezo.page/en</loc>"))!;
        expect(profile).not.toContain("<image:image>");
    });

    it("points crawlers to the sitemap", () => {
        expect(buildRobots()).toContain("Sitemap: https://sebastianlopezo.page/sitemap.xml");
    });
});

FILE: src/lib/sitemap.ts
================================================
import {projectIdBySlug} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {projectById, projectImages} from "@/content/shared/projects";
import {absoluteUrl, BUILD_DATE, SITE_URL} from "@/content/shared/site";
import {widestVariant} from "@/lib/image-widths";
import {prerenderRoutes, type Route} from "@/lib/paths";

const priority = (route: Route) => {
    if (route.kind === "profile") return route.role ? "0.8" : "1.0";
    if (route.kind === "projects") return route.slug ? "0.7" : "0.9";
    return route.slug ? "0.6" : "0.8";
};

/** The pictures a page shows of its own subject: a project's screens. */
const imagesOf = (route: Route) =>
    route.kind === "projects" && route.slug ? projectImages(projectById(projectIdBySlug(route.slug))) : [];

/**
 * `lastmod` gives the day a page last changed what it says (scripts/page-dates.ts); the build date otherwise.
 * `hreflang` alternates live in each page's `<head>`: emitting `<xhtml:link>` here makes Chromium treat the file as
 * XHTML+XML and disable its XML tree viewer, rendering the sitemap as unstyled inline text.
 */
export const buildSitemap = (lastmod: (path: string) => string = () => BUILD_DATE) => {
    const urls = prerenderRoutes.map((route) => {
        const images = imagesOf(route).map((image) => `    <image:image><image:loc>${absoluteUrl(widestVariant(image))}</image:loc></image:image>`);
        return [
            "  <url>",
            `    <loc>${absoluteUrl(route.path)}</loc>`,
            `    <lastmod>${lastmod(route.path)}</lastmod>`,
            "    <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>",
            `    <priority>${priority(route)}</priority>`,
            ...images,
            "  </url>",
        ].join("\n");
    });
    return [
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>',
        '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9" xmlns:image="http://www.google.com/schemas/sitemap-image/1.1">',
        ...urls,
        "</urlset>",
        "",
    ].join("\n");
};

export const buildRobots = () => ["User-agent: *", "Allow: /", "", `Sitemap: ${SITE_URL}/sitemap.xml`, ""].join("\n");

FILE: src/lib/utils.ts

export type ClassValue = string | false | null | undefined | 0;

/**
 * Joins class names, skipping the falsy ones a condition leaves behind. It does not resolve conflicts between
 * utilities: a component and its caller never set the same property, and conditional branches carry the whole value
 * (font-normal on one side, font-semibold on the other).
 */
export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
    let classes = "";
    for (const input of inputs) {
        if (input) classes = classes ? `${classes} ${input}` : input;
    }
    return classes;
}

FILE: src/lib/assistant/answer.ts
================================================
import {forProfile, roleConfig, type RoleId, ROLES} from "@/content/roles";
import {certifications} from "@/content/shared/certifications";
import {type DetailCollection, EDUCATION_SLUG, EXPERIENCE_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/detail-links";
import {education} from "@/content/shared/education";
import {experience} from "@/content/shared/experience";
import {codingHours, githubStats, hours, STATS_DAY} from "@/content/shared/github";
import {formatHighlight, highlightValues, metricValues} from "@/content/shared/metrics";
import {organizationActivity} from "@/content/shared/organization-activity";
import {organizations} from "@/content/shared/organizations";
import {profile, YEARS} from "@/content/shared/profile";
import {EXPERIENCE_PROJECTS, PROJECT_SLUG, type ProjectSlug} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {resumeVersions} from "@/content/shared/resume";
import {benefitOrder, benefitRoles, SERVICE_IDS, serviceRoles} from "@/content/shared/services";
import {testimonials} from "@/content/shared/testimonials";
import {detect} from "@/lib/assistant/intents";
import {buildKnowledgeBase, shortCompany} from "@/lib/assistant/knowledge";
import {terms, tokenize} from "@/lib/assistant/normalize";
import {createIndex, type Hit, search} from "@/lib/assistant/retrieval";
import {formatRange} from "@/lib/format";
import {buildDetailPath, buildPath, buildProjectPath, prerenderRoutes} from "@/lib/paths";
import {prioritize} from "@/lib/role-view";
import type {
    Answer,
    AnswerFacts,
    AnswerLink,
    AssistantCopy,
    Fact,
    FollowUpKey,
    IntentId,
    PlainIntent
} from "@/types/assistant";
import type {Content, SectionId} from "@/types/content";
import type {CaseStudyCopy, CaseStudyId} from "@/types/case-study";
import type {DetailPagesCopy} from "@/types/detail";

const MIN_SCORE = 1.5;
const MAX_LINKS = 4;
/** WakaTime counts these as languages; the answer about coding time names programming languages only. */
const NOT_PROGRAMMING = new Set(["Markdown", "YAML", "JSON", "Text", "Other", "XML", "TOML", "INI"]);

export interface AskOptions {
    role: RoleId | null;
    locked: boolean;
}

const INTENT_SECTIONS: Partial<Record<IntentId, SectionId>> = {
    about: "about",
    experienceYears: "experience",
    currentRole: "experience",
    roleFit: "experience",
    availability: "contact",
    location: "contact",
    education: "about",
    plans: "journey",
    languages: "about",
    certifications: "certifications",
    testimonials: "testimonials",
    resume: "resume",
    githubStats: "metrics",
    coding: "metrics",
    clients: "experience",
    industries: "experience",
    services: "services",
    whyHire: "reasons",
    workStyle: "about",
    journey: "journey",
    stack: "skills",
    ai: "skills",
    security: "skills",
    salary: "contact",
};

/** A page beyond the profile: an index when there is no slug. */
interface PageRef {
    collection: DetailCollection | "projects";
    slug?: string;
}

/** Pages beyond the profile that an answer links to, besides its section. */
const INTENT_PAGES: Partial<Record<IntentId, PageRef[]>> = {
    experienceYears: [{collection: "experience"}],
    education: [{collection: "education"}],
    certifications: [{collection: "certifications"}],
    githubStats: [{collection: "organizations"}],
    organizations: [{collection: "organizations"}],
    industries: [{collection: "experience"}],
    journey: [{collection: "experience"}],
    projects: [{collection: "projects"}],
    leadership: [{collection: "experience", slug: EXPERIENCE_SLUG.tivenos}, {
        collection: "projects",
        slug: PROJECT_SLUG.smartpot
    }],
    security: [
        {collection: "education", slug: EDUCATION_SLUG.cyberDiploma},
        {collection: "projects", slug: PROJECT_SLUG.cybersecurityLabs},
        {collection: "certifications", slug: "hacklab"},
    ],
    ai: [{collection: "projects", slug: PROJECT_SLUG.smartpot}, {
        collection: "education",
        slug: EDUCATION_SLUG.politecnico
    }],
    site: [{collection: "projects", slug: PROJECT_SLUG.portfolio}],
};

const isBullet = (fact: Fact) => fact.section === "experience" && /^experience\.\w+\.\d+$/.test(fact.id);

export const formatFact = (fact: Fact) => `${fact.label}: ${fact.text}`;

export const createAssistant = (content: Content, copy: AssistantCopy, cases?: Record<CaseStudyId, CaseStudyCopy>, details?: DetailPagesCopy) => {
    const facts = buildKnowledgeBase(content, cases, details);
    const index = createIndex(facts);
    const certificationIndex = createIndex(facts.filter((fact) => fact.id.startsWith("certifications.")));
    const tag = content.locale.replace("_", "-");
    const number = new Intl.NumberFormat(tag).format;
    const base: Omit<AnswerFacts, "topStack" | "services"> = {
        years: YEARS,
        currentJobs: experience
            .filter((job) => job.end === null)
            .map((job) => ({title: content.experience.items[job.id].title, company: shortCompany(job.company)})),
        certifications: certifications.length,
        issuers: new Set(certifications.map((item) => item.issuerId)).size,
        testimonials: testimonials.length,
        contributions: metricValues.contributions.toLocaleString(tag),
        commits: metricValues.commits.toLocaleString(tag),
        repositories: metricValues.repos,
        organizations: organizations.length,
        streak: metricValues.streak,
        asOf: new Intl.DateTimeFormat(tag, {
            month: "long",
            year: "numeric",
            timeZone: "UTC"
        }).format(new Date(`${STATS_DAY}T12:00:00Z`)),
        integrations: formatHighlight(highlightValues.integrations, tag),
        clients: formatHighlight(highlightValues.clients, tag),
        landingPages: formatHighlight(highlightValues.landingPages, tag),
        codingHours: number(codingHours),
        topLanguages: githubStats.wakatime.languages
            .filter((language) => !NOT_PROGRAMMING.has(language.name))
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map((language) => `${language.name} (${number(hours(language.seconds))} h)`),
        pages: prerenderRoutes.length,
    };
    const sectionLink = (id: SectionId): AnswerLink => ({kind: "section", label: copy.links[id], href: `#${id}`});
    const cvLink: AnswerLink = {
        kind: "download",
        label: copy.links.downloadCv,
        href: resumeVersions[0].files[content.lang]
    };
    const whatsappLink: AnswerLink = {
        kind: "external",
        label: copy.links.whatsapp,
        href: `https://wa.me/${profile.phone.whatsapp}?text=${encodeURIComponent(content.ui.whatsapp.message)}`,
    };
    const emailLink: AnswerLink = {kind: "external", label: copy.links.email, href: `mailto:${profile.email}`};

    return (query: string, {role: activeRole, locked}: AskOptions): Answer => {
        const detection = detect(query, activeRole);
        const services = prioritize(SERVICE_IDS, (id) => serviceRoles[id], activeRole).map((id) => content.services.items[id].title);
        const known: AnswerFacts = {...base, topStack: roleConfig(activeRole).topStack, services};
        const pageHref = (page: PageRef) =>
            page.collection === "projects"
                ? buildProjectPath(content.lang, {slug: (page.slug ?? null) as ProjectSlug | null, locked})
                : buildDetailPath(content.lang, page.collection, {slug: page.slug ?? null, locked});
        // A page's link reads as the page's name, taken from the fact that links to it.
        const labelOf = (page: PageRef) =>
            (page.slug && facts.find((fact) => fact.page?.collection === page.collection && fact.page.slug === page.slug)?.label) || copy.pages[page.collection];
        const pageLink = (page: PageRef, label?: string): AnswerLink => ({
            kind: "route",
            label: label ?? labelOf(page),
            href: pageHref(page)
        });
        const factLink = (fact: Fact): AnswerLink => (fact.page ? pageLink(fact.page, fact.label) : sectionLink(fact.section));
        const queryTerms = terms(query);
        const texts: string[] = [];
        const notes: string[] = [];
        const links: AnswerLink[] = [];
        let followUp: FollowUpKey = detection.intents[0] ?? "search";

        for (const intent of detection.intents) {
            if (intent === "roleFit" && detection.role) {
                const role = detection.role;
                const ofRole = (hit: Hit) => hit.fact.roles.includes(role);
                const hits = search(index, queryTerms, [role], 6).filter(ofRole);
                const example = hits.find((hit) => isBullet(hit.fact))?.fact
                    ?? search(index, ROLES[role].keywords.flatMap(tokenize), [role], 6).filter(ofRole).find((hit) => isBullet(hit.fact))?.fact
                    ?? index.facts.find((fact) => isBullet(fact) && fact.roles.includes(role));
                if (!example) continue;
                texts.push(copy.answers.roleFit({
                    ...known,
                    role: content.ui.roleNames[role],
                    stack: ROLES[role].topStack,
                    company: example.label,
                    example: example.text,
                }));
                notes.push(...supporting(hits, example));
                if (!locked && role !== activeRole) links.push({
                    kind: "route",
                    label: copy.links.roleView,
                    href: buildPath(content.lang, role)
                });
                const projectHit = hits.find((hit) => hit.fact.page?.collection === "projects");
                if (projectHit) links.push(factLink(projectHit.fact));
                if (example.page) links.push(factLink(example));
                links.push(sectionLink("experience"));
                continue;
            }
            if (intent === "company" && detection.company) {
                const job = experience.find((item) => item.id === detection.company)!;
                const item = content.experience.items[job.id];
                const company = shortCompany(job.company);
                texts.push(copy.answers.company({
                    ...known,
                    company,
                    title: item.title,
                    period: formatRange(job.start, job.end, content.ui.months, content.ui.present),
                    summary: forProfile(item.summary, activeRole),
                }));
                notes.push(...prioritize(item.bullets, (bullet) => bullet.roles, activeRole).slice(0, 3).map((bullet) => bullet.text));
                links.push(pageLink({collection: "experience", slug: EXPERIENCE_SLUG[job.id]}, company));
                for (const id of (EXPERIENCE_PROJECTS[job.id] ?? []).slice(0, 2)) links.push(pageLink({
                    collection: "projects",
                    slug: PROJECT_SLUG[id]
                }, content.projects.items[id].name));
                continue;
            }
            if (intent === "program" && detection.program) {
                const program = education.find((item) => item.id === detection.program)!;
                const degree = content.about.education[program.id].degree;
                const page = details?.education[program.id];
                texts.push(copy.answers.program({
                    ...known,
                    degree,
                    school: program.school,
                    period: program.start === program.end ? String(program.start) : `${program.start} – ${program.end}`,
                    tagline: page?.tagline ?? content.about.education[program.id].skills.slice(0, 4).join(", "),
                }));
                notes.push(...(page && page.areas.length > 0
                    ? page.areas.slice(0, 3).map((area) => `${area.title}: ${area.text}`)
                    : [content.about.education[program.id].skills.join(", ")]));
                links.push(pageLink({collection: "education", slug: EDUCATION_SLUG[program.id]}, degree));
                if (program.project) links.push(pageLink({
                    collection: "projects",
                    slug: PROJECT_SLUG[program.project]
                }, content.projects.items[program.project].name));
                continue;
            }
            if (intent === "projects" && detection.project) {
                const project = content.projects.items[detection.project];
                texts.push(copy.answers.project({...known, name: project.name, summary: project.summary}));
                notes.push(...prioritize(project.highlights, (bullet) => bullet.roles, activeRole).slice(0, 3).map((bullet) => bullet.text));
                links.push(pageLink({
                    collection: "projects",
                    slug: PROJECT_SLUG[detection.project]
                }, project.name), pageLink({collection: "projects"}));
                followUp = "project";
                continue;
            }
            if (intent === "certifications") {
                const topic = queryTerms.filter((term) => term !== "certification");
                // A certification named after the topic comes first, in the profile's order (the industry one leads);
                // otherwise the search over what each one covered decides.
                const named = certificationIndex.facts.filter((fact) => terms(fact.label).some((term) => topic.includes(term)));
                const matched = named.length > 0 ? named.slice(0, 4) : topic.length > 0 ? search(certificationIndex, topic, [activeRole], 4).map((hit) => hit.fact) : [];
                if (matched.length > 0) {
                    texts.push(copy.answers.certificationMatch({...known, titles: matched.map((fact) => fact.label)}));
                    notes.push(...matched.map(formatFact));
                    links.push(...matched.slice(0, 3).map(factLink), pageLink({collection: "certifications"}));
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if (intent === "roleFit") continue;
            texts.push(intent === "workStyle" || intent === "journey"
                ? copy.inHisWords(forProfile(content.about.story, activeRole)[intent === "workStyle" ? 0 : 1])
                : copy.answers[intent as PlainIntent](known));
            notes.push(...detailsFor(intent, content, activeRole, number));
            if (intent === "availability" || intent === "salary") links.push(whatsappLink);
            if (intent === "availability") links.push(emailLink);
            if (intent === "resume" || intent === "experienceYears" || intent === "about") links.push(cvLink);
            if (intent === "whyHire") links.push(sectionLink("testimonials"));
            if (intent === "currentRole") {
                for (const job of experience.filter((item) => item.end === null)) links.push(pageLink({
                    collection: "experience",
                    slug: EXPERIENCE_SLUG[job.id]
                }, shortCompany(job.company)));
            }
            for (const page of INTENT_PAGES[intent] ?? []) links.push(pageLink(page));
            const section = INTENT_SECTIONS[intent];
            if (section) links.push(sectionLink(section));
        }

        const followUps = (key: FollowUpKey) => (copy.followUps[key] ?? copy.followUps.fallback ?? []).filter((question) => question !== query.trim());

        if (texts.length > 0) {
            return {
                intents: detection.intents,
                text: texts.join(" "),
                details: notes.slice(0, 3),
                links: unique(links),
                followUps: followUps(followUp)
            };
        }

        const hits = search(index, queryTerms, [activeRole, detection.role]);
        if (hits.length > 0 && hits[0].score >= MIN_SCORE) {
            return {
                intents: ["search"],
                text: copy.answers.search(known),
                details: hits.map((hit) => formatFact(hit.fact)),
                links: unique(hits.map((hit) => factLink(hit.fact))),
                followUps: followUps("search"),
            };
        }

        return {
            intents: ["fallback"],
            text: copy.answers.fallback(known),
            details: [],
            links: [sectionLink("contact"), whatsappLink],
            followUps: followUps("fallback"),
        };
    };
};

/** The supporting lines under an answer that come straight from the content: reasons, services, organizations. */
const detailsFor = (intent: IntentId, content: Content, role: RoleId | null, number: (value: number) => string): string[] => {
    if (intent === "whyHire") {
        return prioritize(benefitOrder, (id) => benefitRoles[id], role).slice(0, 3).map((id) => {
            const benefit = content.services.benefits[id];
            const author = testimonials.find((item) => item.id === benefit.evidence.testimonial)!.author;
            return `${benefit.title}: “${benefit.evidence.excerpt}” (${author})`;
        });
    }
    if (intent === "services") {
        return prioritize(SERVICE_IDS, (id) => serviceRoles[id], role).slice(0, 3).map((id) => `${content.services.items[id].title}: ${content.services.items[id].description}`);
    }
    if (intent === "organizations") {
        return [...organizations]
            .sort((a, b) => organizationActivity[b.id].mine - organizationActivity[a.id].mine)
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map((organization) => `${organization.name}: ${number(organizationActivity[organization.id].mine)} / ${number(organizationActivity[organization.id].people)} commits`);
    }
    if (intent === "testimonials") {
        return prioritize(testimonials, (item) => item.roles, role).slice(0, 3).map((item) => {
            const copy = content.testimonials.items[item.id];
            return `${item.author} (${copy.role}): ${copy.highlight}`;
        });
    }
    return [];
};

const SUPPORTING_SECTIONS: SectionId[] = ["projects", "skills", "services", "experience"];

const supporting = (hits: Hit[], example: Fact) =>
    hits
        .filter((hit) => hit.fact !== example && !isBullet(hit.fact) && SUPPORTING_SECTIONS.includes(hit.fact.section))
        .slice(0, 2)
        .map((hit) => formatFact(hit.fact));

const unique = (links: AnswerLink[]) =>
    links.filter((link, position) => links.findIndex((other) => other.href === link.href) === position).slice(0, MAX_LINKS);

import en from "@/content/en";

import {assistant as enCopy} from "@/content/en/assistant";

import {EXPERIENCE_YEARS} from "@/content/shared/profile";
import {createAssistant} from "@/lib/assistant/answer";
import {items as enCases} from "@/content/case-studies/en";
import {items as esCases} from "@/content/case-studies/es";
import {detailPages as enDetails} from "@/content/detail-pages/en";
import {detailPages as esDetails} from "@/content/detail-pages/es";

describe("normalize", () => {
    it("removes accents and protects compound terms", () => {
        expect(normalize("¿Cuántos AÑOS?")).toContain("anos");
        expect(tokenize("C# and CI/CD with Node.js")).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["csharp", "cicd", "nodejs"]));
        expect(tokenize("hoja de vida")).toEqual(["cv"]);
        expect(tokenize("Full Stack")).toEqual(["fullstack"]);
        expect(tokenize("Power BI")).toEqual(["powerbi"]);
    });

    it("maps both languages to the same terms", () => {
        expect(terms("certificaciones")).toEqual(terms("certifications"));
        expect(terms("integraciones")).toEqual(terms("integrations"));
        expect(terms("experiencia")).toEqual(terms("experience"));
        expect(terms("¿Qué proyectos tiene?")).toEqual(["project"]);
    });
});

describe("intent detection", () => {
    it.each(fixtures)("%s → %s", (query, intent, role) => {
        const detection = detect(query, null);
        expect(detection.intents[0]).toBe(intent);
        if (role) expect(detection.role).toBe(role);
    });

    it("keeps leads, the CRM records, apart from leading people", () => {
        expect(detect("How does he capture leads in Zoho CRM?", null).intents).not.toContain("leadership");
    });

    it("names the job, the program and the project a question is about", () => {
        expect(detect("¿Qué proyectos hizo en ADCOM?", null)).toMatchObject({intents: ["company"], company: "adcom"});
        expect(detect("What did he study at SENA?", null).program).toBe("sena");
        expect(detect("What are the Zoho CRM widgets?", null).project).toBe("crmWidgets");
    });

    it("never combines salary with other intents", () => {
        expect(detect("Is he available and what is his salary?", null).intents).toEqual(["salary"]);
    });

    it("prefers the active role on ties", () => {
        expect(detect("Which APIs has he integrated?", "crm").role).toBe("crm");
        expect(detect("Which APIs has he integrated?", "backend").role).toBe("backend");
    });

    it("uses the active role for generic fit questions", () => {
        const detection = detect("Is he a good fit for this role?", "data");
        expect(detection.intents).toContain("roleFit");
        expect(detection.role).toBe("data");
    });
});

        expect(askEs("¿Cuántos años de experiencia?", {
            role: null,
            locked: false
        }).text).toContain(`más de ${EXPERIENCE_YEARS} años`);
    });

    it("quotes a real experience bullet when answering role fit", () => {
        const answer = askEn("Is he a good fit for a backend role?", {role: null, locked: false});
        const bullets = Object.values(en.experience.items).flatMap((item) => item.bullets.map((bullet) => bullet.text));
        expect(bullets.some((bullet) => answer.text.includes(bullet))).toBe(true);
        expect(answer.links.map((link) => link.href)).toContain("/en/backend");
    });

    it("never links to another role view when the profile is locked", () => {
        const answer = askEs("¿Encaja en un rol de datos?", {role: "backend", locked: true});
        expect(answer.intents).toContain("roleFit");
        // The only pages it may open keep the lock: projects and detail pages, never another role. The view itself is
        // added when a link is followed (lib/role-links.ts).
        for (const link of answer.links.filter((item) => item.kind === "route")) expect(link.href).toMatch(/^\/es\/[\w/-]+\?locked=true$/);
    });

    it("finds specific technologies through retrieval", () => {

    });

    });

            role: null,
            locked: false
        }).links[0].href).toBe("/cv/Sebastian-Lopez-Osorno-ATS-ES.pdf");
    });

        expect(answer.details.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

describe("assistant with the detail pages", () => {
    const ask = createAssistant(en, enCopy, enCases, enDetails);
    const askSpanish = createAssistant(es, esCopy, esCases, esDetails);
    const general = {role: null, locked: false};

    it("answers every suggested, follow-up and catalog question without falling back", () => {
        for (const [copy, assistant] of [[enCopy, ask], [esCopy, askSpanish]] as const) {
            const questions = new Set([
                ...ROLE_IDS.flatMap((role) => copy.suggestions[role]),
                ...copy.suggestions.general,
                ...Object.values(copy.followUps).flat(),
                ...copy.catalog.groups.flatMap((group) => group.questions),
            ]);
            expect(questions.size).toBeGreaterThan(40);
            for (const question of questions) {
                const answer = assistant(question!, general);
                expect(answer.intents, question).not.toContain("fallback");
                expect(answer.text.length, question).toBeGreaterThan(20);
            }
        }
    });

    it("tells a job and links its page", () => {
        const answer = ask("What does he do at ADCOM?", {role: "crm", locked: true});
        expect(answer.text).toMatch(/^CRM & MarTech Developer at ADCOM GROUP \(Feb 2025 – Present\)\. In his words: "/);
        expect(answer.details).toHaveLength(3);
        expect(answer.links[0]).toEqual({
            kind: "route",
            label: "ADCOM GROUP",
            href: "/en/experience/adcom?locked=true"
        });
    });

    it("tells a program with its areas and links its page and coursework", () => {
        const answer = askSpanish("¿Qué estudió en el SENA?", general);
        expect(answer.text).toMatch(/^Técnico en Programación de Software, SENA/);
        expect(answer.details[0]).toMatch(/^Análisis y diseño:/);
        expect(answer.links.map((link) => link.href)).toEqual(["/es/education/programming-technician", "/es/projects/programming-technician"]);
    });

    it("lists the certifications that match a topic and links their pages", () => {
        const answer = ask("Does he have a Python certification?", general);
        expect(answer.text).toMatch(/^Yes\. He holds the .*IT Specialist – Python.* certifications?\.$/);
        expect(answer.links.filter((link) => link.href.startsWith("/en/certifications/")).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
        expect(answer.links.map((link) => link.href)).toContain("/en/certifications");
    });

    it("quotes the recommendations behind the reasons to hire", () => {
        const answer = askSpanish("¿Por qué contratarlo?", general);
        expect(answer.details).toHaveLength(3);
        for (const detail of answer.details) expect(detail).toMatch(/: “.+” \(.+\)$/);
    });

    it("counts the organizations and lists the busiest", () => {
        const answer = ask("Which GitHub organizations is he in?", general);
        expect(answer.text).toContain("10 GitHub organizations");
        expect(answer.details[0]).toBe("ADCOM-Group: 9,671 / 9,671 commits");
        expect(answer.links.map((link) => link.href)).toContain("/en/organizations");
    });

    it("explains the site with its page count and links the project", () => {
        const answer = askSpanish("¿Cómo está hecho este sitio?", general);
        expect(answer.text).toContain("260 páginas");
        expect(answer.links.map((link) => link.href)).toContain("/es/projects/portfolio");
    });

    it("tells how he works and how he got here from the about text of the role view", () => {
        expect(ask("How does he work?", {
            role: "data",
            locked: false
        }).text).toBe(`In his words: "${en.about.story.data[0]}"`);
        expect(askSpanish("¿Cómo ha sido su trayectoria?", general).text).toBe(`En sus palabras: «${es.about.story.general[1]}»`);
    });

    it("offers follow-up questions about the same topic, never the one just asked", () => {
        const answer = ask("Who is Sebastián?", general);
        expect(answer.followUps).toEqual(enCopy.followUps.about);
        expect(ask("Where does he work now?", general).followUps).not.toContain("Where does he work now?");
    });

    it("links search results to the detail pages they come from", () => {
        const answer = askSpanish("¿Vio teoría de compiladores?", general);
        expect(answer.links.map((link) => link.href)).toContain("/es/education/computer-engineering");
    });
});

FILE: src/lib/assistant/intents.ts
================================================
import {ROLE_IDS, type RoleId, ROLES} from "@/content/roles";
import {tokenize} from "@/lib/assistant/normalize";
import type {EducationId, ExperienceId} from "@/types/content";
import type {ProjectId} from "@/types/project";
import type {IntentId} from "@/types/assistant";

interface Pattern {
    all: string[];
    none?: string[];
}

const any = (...tokens: string[]): Pattern[] => tokens.map((token) => ({all: [token]}));

/** The order is the priority: a question that matches several rules gets the first two answers. */
const RULES: { id: Exclude<IntentId, "roleFit" | "greeting" | "company" | "program">; patterns: Pattern[] }[] = [
    {id: "salary", patterns: any("salary")},
    {id: "site", patterns: any("thissite", "assistantself")},
    {id: "about", patterns: any("aboutperson")},
    {id: "whyHire", patterns: [{all: ["why", "hire"]}, {all: ["reason", "hire"]}, ...any("strength")]},
    {id: "workStyle", patterns: any("mindset")},
    {id: "journey", patterns: any("trajectory")},
    // "Leads" are also what a CRM captures, so a question about them is not about leading people.
    {
        id: "leadership",
        patterns: [{all: ["lead"], none: ["crm", "zoho", "campaign", "landing", "form", "capture", "contact"]}]
    },
    {
        id: "experienceYears",
        patterns: [
            {all: ["year"], none: ["graduation", "education", "degree", "university"]},
            {all: ["seniority"]},
            {all: ["howmany", "experience"]},
        ],
    },
    {
        id: "currentRole",
        patterns: [
            {all: ["current"], none: ["available", "open", "opportunity", "year"]},
            {all: ["company"]},
            {all: ["where", "work"]},
        ],
    },
    {
        id: "availability",
        patterns: [...any("available", "open", "opportunity", "contact", "email", "phone", "whatsapp", "freelance"), {
            all: ["hire"],
            none: ["why", "reason"]
        }],
    },
    {
        id: "location",
        patterns: [
            ...any("location", "live", "city", "country", "remote", "hybrid", "onsite", "relocate", "timezone", "medellin", "colombia"),
            {all: ["where"], none: ["work", "education", "university", "degree", "cv", "project"]},
        ],
    },
    {
        id: "plans",
        patterns: [...any("plan", "goal", "master", "specialization", "sdg"), {all: ["cybersecurity", "education"]}]
    },
    {id: "security", patterns: [{all: ["cybersecurity"], none: ["plan", "goal", "master", "specialization"]}]},
    {
        id: "education",
        patterns: any("education", "university", "degree", "graduation", "engineering", "semester", "sena", "school", "highschool", "diploma")
    },
    {
        id: "languages",
        patterns: [
            ...any("idioma", "english", "spanish", "speak", "bilingual"),
            {all: ["language"], none: ["programming", "use", "stack"]},
        ],
    },
    {id: "projects", patterns: any("project", "smartpot", "gopoli", "peppercrm", "taurus")},
    {id: "certifications", patterns: any("certification")},
    {id: "testimonials", patterns: any("recommendation", "colleague")},
    {id: "resume", patterns: any("cv")},
    {id: "clients", patterns: any("client")},
    {id: "industries", patterns: any("industry")},
    {
        id: "services",
        patterns: [...any("offer"), {
            all: ["service"],
            none: ["deploy", "integration", "run", "operate", "observability", "web"]
        }]
    },
    {id: "organizations", patterns: any("organization")},
    {id: "coding", patterns: any("hour", "editor")},
    {id: "ai", patterns: any("ai", "ml")},
    {
        id: "githubStats",
        patterns: [{
            all: ["github"],
            none: ["organization"]
        }, ...any("commit", "repository", "contribution", "streak", "metric", "opensource")],
    },
    {
        id: "stack",
        patterns: [...any("stack", "skill", "framework"), {all: ["programming", "language"]}, {all: ["language", "use"]}],
    },
];

const GREETINGS = new Set(["hello", "good", "morning", "afternoon", "evening", "there", "tarde", "noche", "dia"]);

/** Projects a question can name, by the token their name leaves after normalizing. */
const PROJECT_TOKENS: Partial<Record<string, ProjectId>> = {
    smartpot: "smartpot",
    gopoli: "gopoli",
    peppercrm: "peppercrm",
    taurus: "taurus",
    widget: "crmWidgets",
    snapshot: "crmSnapshots",
    signature: "emailSignatures",
    martech: "martech",
    embudo: "martech",
    funnel: "martech",
    cumpleano: "emailAutomations",
    birthday: "emailAutomations",
    inmobiliaria: "realEstateSite",
    inmueble: "realEstateSite",
    estate: "realEstateSite",
    wasi: "realEstateSite",
    toolkit: "zohoToolkit",
    recaudo: "collectionAutomation",
};

// Tokens are stemmed: "tivenos" loses its final s.
const COMPANY_TOKENS: Partial<Record<string, ExperienceId>> = {
    tiveno: "tivenos",
    adcom: "adcom",
    muvu: "muvu",
    quipux: "quipux"
};

const PROGRAM_TOKENS: Partial<Record<string, EducationId>> = {
    sena: "sena",
    inem: "inem",
    pascual: "pascual",
    diploma: "cyberDiploma",
    highschool: "inem"
};

const ROLE_KEYWORDS: Record<RoleId, Set<string>> = Object.fromEntries(
    ROLE_IDS.map((role) => [role, new Set(ROLES[role].keywords.flatMap(tokenize))]),
) as Record<RoleId, Set<string>>;

/** What the answer about a named job already tells, so those intents do not answer a second time. */
const COMPANY_COVERS = new Set<IntentId>(["currentRole", "projects", "experienceYears"]);

/** The intents that leave room for a role fit answer: a question that asks for something else gets that instead. */
const ROLE_FRIENDLY = new Set<IntentId>(["experienceYears", "currentRole", "stack"]);

export interface Detection {
    intents: IntentId[];
    role: RoleId | null;
    project: ProjectId | null;
    company: ExperienceId | null;
    program: EducationId | null;
}

const matches = (tokens: Set<string>, {all, none = []}: Pattern) =>
    all.every((token) => tokens.has(token)) && !none.some((token) => tokens.has(token));

export const detectRole = (tokens: string[], preferred: RoleId | null): RoleId | null => {
    let best: RoleId | null = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const role of ROLE_IDS) {
        const score = tokens.filter((token) => ROLE_KEYWORDS[role].has(token)).length;
        if (score > bestScore || (score === bestScore && score > 0 && role === preferred)) {
            best = role;
            bestScore = score;
        }
    }
    return best;
};

const firstOf = <T>(tokens: string[], table: Partial<Record<string, T>>): T | null => tokens.map((token) => table[token]).find(Boolean) ?? null;

export const detect = (query: string, activeRole: RoleId | null): Detection => {
    const tokens = tokenize(query);
    const set = new Set(tokens);
    const project = firstOf(tokens, PROJECT_TOKENS);
    const company = firstOf(tokens, COMPANY_TOKENS);
    const program = firstOf(tokens, PROGRAM_TOKENS);
    const none = {project: null, company: null, program: null};

    if (tokens.length > 0 && tokens.every((token) => GREETINGS.has(token))) {
        return {intents: ["greeting"], role: null, ...none};
    }

    const role = detectRole(tokens, activeRole) ?? (set.has("fit") || set.has("role") ? activeRole : null);
    const matched: IntentId[] = RULES.filter((rule) => rule.patterns.some((pattern) => matches(set, pattern))).map((rule) => rule.id);

    if (matched.includes("salary")) return {intents: ["salary"], role, project, company: null, program: null};

    // A named job or program answers first; a named project brings the projects intent with it.
    if (company) {
        const rest = matched.filter((intent) => !COMPANY_COVERS.has(intent));
        return {intents: (["company", ...rest] as IntentId[]).slice(0, 2), role, project, company, program: null};
    }
    if (program) {
        const rest = matched.filter((intent) => intent !== "education");
        return {intents: (["program", ...rest] as IntentId[]).slice(0, 2), role, project: null, company: null, program};
    }
    if (project && !matched.includes("projects")) matched.unshift("projects");

    const roleFits = role !== null && !project && matched.every((intent) => ROLE_FRIENDLY.has(intent));
    const intents = roleFits ? insertRoleFit(matched) : matched;
    if (!role && (set.has("fit") || set.has("role")) && !intents.includes("stack")) intents.push("stack");
    return {intents: intents.slice(0, 2), role, project, company: null, program: null};
};

const insertRoleFit = (matched: IntentId[]): IntentId[] => {
    const rest = matched.filter((intent) => intent !== "stack");
    const index = rest.findIndex((intent) => intent !== "experienceYears" && intent !== "currentRole");
    return index === -1 ? [...rest, "roleFit"] : [...rest.slice(0, index), "roleFit", ...rest.slice(index)];
};

import {ROLE_IDS, type RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import {PROJECT_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import {caseStudyRoles} from "@/content/shared/case-roles";
import {certifications} from "@/content/shared/certifications";
import {CERTIFICATION_SLUG, EDUCATION_SLUG, EXPERIENCE_SLUG, ORGANIZATION_SLUG} from "@/content/shared/detail-links";
import {education} from "@/content/shared/education";
import {experience} from "@/content/shared/experience";
import {organizations} from "@/content/shared/organizations";
import {projects} from "@/content/shared/projects";
import {serviceRoles} from "@/content/shared/services";
import {skillGroups} from "@/content/shared/skills";
import {testimonials} from "@/content/shared/testimonials";
import {terms} from "@/lib/assistant/normalize";
import type {Fact, FactPage} from "@/types/assistant";
import type {CaseStudyCopy, CaseStudyId} from "@/types/case-study";
import type {Content, SectionId, ServiceId, SkillGroupId} from "@/types/content";
import type {DetailPagesCopy} from "@/types/detail";

const SKILL_ROLES: Record<SkillGroupId, RoleId[]> = {
    languages: ["backend", "data"],
    backend: ["backend"],
    crm: ["crm"],
    data: ["data"],
    databases: ["backend", "data"],
    frontend: ["fullstack"],
    devops: ["devops"],
    cloud: ["devops", "backend"],
    security: ["devops", "backend"],
    networks: ["devops"],
    iot: ["fullstack", "backend"],
    ai: ["data"],
    testing: ["backend", "devops"],
    tools: [],
    foundations: [],
};

export const shortCompany = (company: string) => company.split(" – ")[0];

/**
 * Everything the assistant can search: jobs, projects, skills, certifications, programs, the about text, services,
 * recommendations, the case studies and, when their text is loaded, the job, program and organization pages. A fact
 * that has a page of its own links there instead of to a section of the profile.
 */
export const buildKnowledgeBase = (content: Content, cases?: Record<CaseStudyId, CaseStudyCopy>, details?: DetailPagesCopy): Fact[] => {
    const facts: Fact[] = [];
    const add = (id: string, section: SectionId, label: string, text: string, roles: RoleId[], extra = "", page?: FactPage) =>
        facts.push({
            id,
            section,
            label,
            text,
            roles,
            terms: terms(`${label} ${text} ${extra}`), ...(page ? {page} : {})
        });

    for (const job of experience) {
        const copy = content.experience.items[job.id];
        const label = shortCompany(job.company);
        const page: FactPage = {collection: "experience", slug: EXPERIENCE_SLUG[job.id]};
        add(`experience.${job.id}`, "experience", label, `${copy.title}. ${copy.summary.general}`, [...new Set(copy.bullets.flatMap((bullet) => bullet.roles))], job.tech.join(" "), page);
        for (const role of ROLE_IDS) add(`experience.${job.id}.summary.${role}`, "experience", label, copy.summary[role], [role], "", page);
        copy.bullets.forEach((bullet, index) => add(`experience.${job.id}.${index}`, "experience", label, bullet.text, bullet.roles, "", page));
        details?.experience[job.id].positions.forEach((position, index) =>
            add(`experience.${job.id}.position.${index}`, "experience", label, `${position.title}. ${position.text}`, [], "", page),
        );
    }

    for (const project of projects) {
        const copy = content.projects.items[project.id];
        const page: FactPage = {collection: "projects", slug: PROJECT_SLUG[project.id]};
        add(`projects.${project.id}`, "projects", copy.name, `${copy.context}. ${copy.summary}`, project.roles, project.tech.join(" "), page);
        copy.highlights.forEach((bullet, index) => add(`projects.${project.id}.${index}`, "projects", copy.name, bullet.text, bullet.roles, "", page));
    }

    for (const group of skillGroups) {
        add(`skills.${group.id}`, "skills", content.skills.groups[group.id], group.items.join(", "), SKILL_ROLES[group.id]);
    }

    for (const certification of certifications) {
        const text = `${certification.issuer} (${certification.date.slice(0, 4)})`;
        const copy = content.certifications.items[certification.id];
        const extra = `${copy.learned} ${copy.adds} ${certification.tech.join(" ")}`;
        const page: FactPage = {collection: "certifications", slug: CERTIFICATION_SLUG[certification.id]};
        add(`certifications.${certification.id}`, "certifications", certification.title, text, certification.roles, extra, page);
    }

    for (const school of education) {
        const copy = content.about.education[school.id];
        const page: FactPage = {collection: "education", slug: EDUCATION_SLUG[school.id]};
        const extra = [...copy.skills, ...(details?.education[school.id].courses ?? [])].join(" ");
        add(`education.${school.id}`, "about", copy.degree, `${school.school}${copy.note ? ` · ${copy.note}` : ""}`, [], extra, page);
        details?.education[school.id].areas.forEach((area, index) =>
            add(`education.${school.id}.area.${index}`, "about", copy.degree, `${area.title}: ${area.text}`, [], "", page),
        );
    }

    for (const organization of organizations) {
        const page: FactPage = {collection: "organizations", slug: ORGANIZATION_SLUG[organization.id]};
        const text = details ? `${details.organizations[organization.id].tagline}. ${details.organizations[organization.id].role}` : content.projects.organizations[organization.id];
        add(`organizations.${organization.id}`, "projects", organization.name, text, organization.roles, content.projects.organizations[organization.id], page);
    }

    [content.about.intro, ...content.about.story.general, content.about.versatility, ...content.about.ai, content.about.ambition, content.about.closing.general].forEach((paragraph, index) =>
        add(`about.${index}`, "about", content.ui.nav.about, paragraph, []),
    );
    for (const role of ROLE_IDS) {
        content.about.story[role].forEach((paragraph, index) => add(`about.${role}.${index}`, "about", content.ui.nav.about, paragraph, [role]));
    }

    for (const id of Object.keys(serviceRoles) as ServiceId[]) {
        const service = content.services.items[id];
        add(`services.${id}`, "services", service.title, `${service.points.join("; ")}.`, serviceRoles[id]);
    }

    for (const testimonial of testimonials) {
        const copy = content.testimonials.items[testimonial.id];
        add(
            `testimonials.${testimonial.id}`,
            "testimonials",
            testimonial.author,
            `${copy.role} · ${copy.highlight}. ${copy.context}`,
            testimonial.roles,
            copy.quote ?? testimonial.quote,
        );
    }

    for (const [id, copy] of Object.entries(cases ?? {}) as [CaseStudyId, CaseStudyCopy][]) {
        const page: FactPage = {collection: "projects", slug: PROJECT_SLUG[id]};
        const roles = caseStudyRoles[id];
        facts.push({
            id: `cases.${id}`,
            section: "projects",
            label: copy.name,
            text: copy.summary,
            roles,
            page,
            terms: terms(`${copy.name} ${copy.tagline} ${copy.summary}`)
        });
        copy.approach.forEach((text, index) =>
            facts.push({
                id: `cases.${id}.${index}`,
                section: "projects",
                label: copy.name,
                text,
                roles,
                page,
                terms: terms(`${copy.name} ${text}`)
            }),
        );
    }

    return facts;
};

import {SYNONYMS} from "@/lib/assistant/synonyms";

// Phrases become single tokens before splitting, so a question's intent survives the stopwords and the language.
const PHRASES: [RegExp, string][] = [
    [/\b(este|esta|this)\s+(asistente|assistant|chat|bot)\b/g, " assistantself "],
    [/\b(como\s+funcionas|quien\s+eres|que\s+eres|how\s+do\s+you\s+work|who\s+are\s+you|what\s+are\s+you)\b/g, " assistantself "],
    [/\b((este|el)\s+(sitio|portafolio)|esta\s+(pagina|web)|(this|the)\s+(site|website|portfolio)|this\s+page)\b/g, " thissite "],
    [/\b(quien\s+es|who\s+is)\b/g, " aboutperson "],
    [/\b(hablame|cuentame)\s+(de|sobre)\s+(el|sebastian|su\s+perfil)\b/g, " aboutperson "],
    [/\b(tell\s+me\s+about|introduce)\s+(him|sebastian|his\s+profile)\b/g, " aboutperson "],
    [/\bpor\s+que\b/g, " why "],
    [/\b((forma|manera)\s+de\s+trabajar|como\s+trabaja|how\s+(does\s+)?he\s+works?|work(ing)?\s+style)\b/g, " mindset "],
    [/\b(como|cuando)\s+(empezo|comenzo|inicio)\b/g, " trajectory "],
    [/\bhow\s+did\s+he\s+(start|begin|get\s+started)\b/g, " trajectory "],
    [/\b(inteligencia\s+artificial|artificial\s+intelligence)\b/g, " ai "],
    [/\b(hacking\s+etico|ethical\s+hacking)\b/g, " hacking "],
    [/\bmuv[\s-]?u\b/g, " muvu "],
    [/\bhigh\s+school\b/g, " highschool "],
    [/\blanding\s+pages?\b/g, " landing "],
    [/\bc#/g, " csharp "],
    [/\bc\+\+/g, " cpp "],
    [/\bci\s*\/\s*cd\b/g, " cicd "],
    [/\b(node|next|vue)\.?js\b/g, " $1js "],
    [/\bpower\s+bi\b/g, " powerbi "],
    [/\bspring\s+boot\b/g, " springboot "],
    [/\bgithub\s+actions\b/g, " githubactions "],
    [/\bopen\s+source\b/g, " opensource "],
    [/\bhojas?\s+de\s+vida\b/g, " cv "],
    [/\bbases?\s+de\s+datos\b/g, " database "],
    [/\b(full|back|front)[\s-]?end\b/g, " $1end "],
    [/\bfull[\s-]?stack\b/g, " fullstack "],
    [/\bdev\s?ops\b/g, " devops "],
    [/\bsmart\s?pot\b/g, " smartpot "],
    [/\bgo\s?poli\b/g, " gopoli "],
    [/\bpepper\s?crm\b/g, " peppercrm "],
    [/\bmachine\s+learning\b/g, " ml "],
    [/\bhow\s+much\b/g, " howmuch "],
    [/\bhow\s+many\b/g, " howmany "],
    [/\bcuant[oa]s?\b/g, " howmany "],
];

const STOPWORDS = new Set([
    "a", "an", "and", "are", "as", "at", "be", "by", "can", "could", "did", "do", "does", "for", "from", "had", "has", "have",
    "he", "her", "him", "his", "i", "in", "is", "it", "its", "me", "of", "on", "or", "she", "so", "that", "the", "their",
    "them", "there", "this", "to", "was", "what", "which", "who", "why", "will", "with", "would", "you", "your", "about", "any",
    "al", "algo", "algun", "alguna", "como", "con", "cual", "cuales", "de", "del", "el", "ella", "en", "es", "esta", "este",
    "ha", "hay", "la", "las", "le", "lo", "los", "me", "mi", "para", "por", "que", "quien", "se", "sobre", "su", "sus", "tiene",
    "tu", "un", "una", "uno", "y", "o", "ya", "sebastian", "lopez", "osorno", "hecho", "done", "know", "sabe",
]);

export const normalize = (text: string) => {
    let value = text.toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/\p{Diacritic}/gu, "");
    for (const [pattern, replacement] of PHRASES) value = value.replace(pattern, replacement);
    return value;
};

export const stem = (word: string) => {
    if (word.length <= 3 || word.endsWith("js")) return word;
    if (word.endsWith("ciones")) return word.slice(0, -2);
    if (word.endsWith("ies") && word.length > 4) return `${word.slice(0, -3)}y`;
    if (word.endsWith("s") && !word.endsWith("ss") && !word.endsWith("us")) return word.slice(0, -1);
    return word;
};

const canonical = (word: string) => SYNONYMS[word] ?? SYNONYMS[stem(word)] ?? stem(word);

const words = (text: string) => normalize(text).split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean);

export const tokenize = (text: string) => words(text).map(canonical);

export const terms = (text: string) =>
    words(text)
        .filter((word) => word.length > 1 && !STOPWORDS.has(word))
        .map(canonical);

FILE: src/lib/assistant/retrieval.ts

import type {RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import type {Fact} from "@/types/assistant";

const K1 = 1.2;
const B = 0.75;
const ROLE_BOOST = 1.25;

export interface SearchIndex {
    facts: Fact[];
    frequencies: Map<string, number>[];
    idf: Map<string, number>;
    averageLength: number;
}

export interface Hit {
    fact: Fact;
    score: number;
}

export const createIndex = (facts: Fact[]): SearchIndex => {
    const frequencies = facts.map((fact) => {
        const counts = new Map<string, number>();
        for (const term of fact.terms) counts.set(term, (counts.get(term) ?? 0) + 1);
        return counts;
    });
    const documents = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const counts of frequencies) for (const term of counts.keys()) documents.set(term, (documents.get(term) ?? 0) + 1);
    const idf = new Map(
        [...documents].map(([term, count]) => [term, Math.log(1 + (facts.length - count + 0.5) / (count + 0.5))]),
    );
    const averageLength = facts.reduce((sum, fact) => sum + fact.terms.length, 0) / Math.max(facts.length, 1);
    return {facts, frequencies, idf, averageLength};
};

export const search = (index: SearchIndex, query: string[], roles: (RoleId | null)[] = [], limit = 3): Hit[] => {
    const unique = [...new Set(query)].filter((term) => index.idf.has(term));
    if (unique.length === 0) return [];
    const boosted = roles.filter((role): role is RoleId => role !== null);

    const hits = index.facts.map((fact, position) => {
        const counts = index.frequencies[position];
        const length = fact.terms.length / index.averageLength;
        let score = 0;
        for (const term of unique) {
            const frequency = counts.get(term) ?? 0;
            if (frequency === 0) continue;
            score += (index.idf.get(term) ?? 0) * ((frequency * (K1 + 1)) / (frequency + K1 * (1 - B + B * length)));
        }
        if (score > 0 && boosted.some((role) => fact.roles.includes(role))) score *= ROLE_BOOST;
        return {fact, score};
    });

    const ranked = hits.filter((hit) => hit.score > 0).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    const best = ranked[0]?.score ?? 0;
    return ranked.filter((hit) => hit.score >= best * 0.5).slice(0, limit);
};

import {type Accessor, createContext, useContext} from "solid-js";
import {stripBase} from "@/lib/base";

export interface RouterLocation {
    pathname: string;
    search: string;
    hash: string;
}

export interface RouterValue {
    location: Accessor<RouterLocation>;
    navigate: (to: string, options?: { replace?: boolean }) => void;
    /** Whether links move inside the page (an in-memory router) instead of loading the next document. */
    soft: boolean;
}

export const RouterContext = createContext<RouterValue>();

export const parseUrl = (url: string): RouterLocation => {
    const parsed = new URL(url, "http://localhost");
    // The rest of the app routes on base-less paths, so the subpath comes off the browser's pathname here.
    return {pathname: stripBase(parsed.pathname), search: parsed.search, hash: parsed.hash};
};

const useRouter = () => {
    const value = useContext(RouterContext);
    if (!value) throw new Error("Router hooks must be used inside a router");
    return value;
};

/** The current location, as an accessor: reading it inside JSX or a computation tracks navigation. */
export const useLocation = () => useRouter().location;

export const useNavigate = () => useRouter().navigate;

FILE: src/routes/Router.tsx

import {createSignal, type JSX, type ParentProps, useContext} from "solid-js";
import {isServer} from "solid-js/web";
import {withBase} from "@/lib/base";
import {parseUrl, RouterContext} from "@/routes/router-context";

/**
 * The location of a generated page. Every page is its own document, so the location never changes while an island
 * lives: the prerender knows the path, and the browser adds the query and the hash, which an island reads only once
 * it is hydrated (hooks/useHydrated.ts). Moving to another page loads that page.
 */
export function PageRouter(props: ParentProps<{ path: string }>) {
    const location = () => (isServer ? parseUrl(props.path) : parseUrl(window.location.href));
    // The caller passes a base-less path; the browser needs it under the subpath the site is served from.
    const navigate = (to: string, {replace = false}: { replace?: boolean } = {}) => {
        if (replace) window.location.replace(withBase(to));
        else window.location.assign(withBase(to));
    };
    return <RouterContext.Provider value={{location, navigate, soft: false}}>{props.children}</RouterContext.Provider>;
}

export function MemoryRouter(props: ParentProps<{ initialUrl: string }>) {
    // The initial URL seeds the router once, like a browser's address bar on load.
    const [location, setLocation] = createSignal(parseUrl(props.initialUrl));
    const navigate = (to: string) => setLocation(parseUrl(to));
    return <RouterContext.Provider value={{location, navigate, soft: true}}>{props.children}</RouterContext.Provider>;
}

export function StaticRouter(props: ParentProps<{ url: string }>) {
    const location = () => parseUrl(props.url);
    return <RouterContext.Provider
        value={{location, navigate: () => undefined, soft: false}}>{props.children}</RouterContext.Provider>;
}

interface LinkProps {
    to: string;
    class?: string;
    onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
    tabindex?: number;
    translate?: "yes" | "no";
    "aria-current"?: JSX.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>["aria-current"];
    "aria-hidden"?: "true";
    "aria-labelledby"?: string;
    "aria-describedby"?: string;
    children?: JSX.Element;
}

/**
 * An internal link that moves without reloading. Its attributes are listed rather than spread, so each one compiles
 * to a direct update and the prerendered tag carries only the ones set.
 */
export function Link(props: LinkProps) {
    const router = useContext(RouterContext);

    const handleClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
        props.onClick?.(event);
        // Between generated pages the browser follows the link itself; only an in-memory router moves without it.
        if (!router?.soft || event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0) return;
        if (event.metaKey || event.altKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        router.navigate(props.to);
    };

    return (
        <a
            href={withBase(props.to)}
            onClick={handleClick}
            class={props.class}
            tabindex={props.tabindex}
            translate={props.translate}
            aria-current={props["aria-current"]}
            aria-hidden={props["aria-hidden"]}
            aria-labelledby={props["aria-labelledby"]}
            aria-describedby={props["aria-describedby"]}
        >
            {props.children}
        </a>
    );
}

    /*

    /*
     * The focus radar powers on when its tab opens: the rings grow from the center one after another, then every
     * technology flies out from the center to its place (--dx and --dy lead back to the center, --i is its order).
     */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
        .radar-ring {
            transform-box: fill-box;
            transform-origin: center;
            animation: radar-ring 640ms var(--ease-emphasized) both;
            animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 70ms);
        }

        .radar-blip {
            transform-box: fill-box;
            transform-origin: center;
            animation: radar-blip 560ms var(--ease-emphasized) both;
            animation-delay: calc(260ms + var(--i, 0) * 22ms);
        }
    }

    /*
     * What a control brings into the page (another tab, the phone menu) eases in instead of popping: its first style,
     * also the first after display: none, starts from the values in @starting-style at the end of this file.
     */
    .appear {
        transition: opacity var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-standard),
        translate var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-standard);
    }

    /*
     * The second layer of a part of the page (components/ui/More.tsx): a details element with no marker, whose summary
     * says what opening it does and whose chevron points where the rows go. Where the browser can ease to auto, it
     * opens to its height.
     */
    .more > summary {
        list-style: none;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .more > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
        display: none;
    }

    .more:not([open]) .more-open,
    .more[open] .more-closed {
        display: none;
    }

    .more-chevron {
        transition: rotate var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-emphasized);
    }

    .more[open] .more-chevron {
        rotate: 180deg;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
        .more::details-content {
            block-size: 0;
            overflow-y: clip;
            transition: block-size var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-emphasized), content-visibility var(--duration-slow);
            transition-behavior: allow-discrete;
        }

        .more[open]::details-content {
            block-size: auto;
        }
    }

    /* Small answers to a pointer that hovers: the arrow of a link leans the way it leads, the icon of a link that
       leaves the site lifts and a download drops. The icons are Lucide's (components/ui/icons.tsx), named by class. */
    @media (hover: hover) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
        :is(a, button) > :is(.lucide-arrow-right, .lucide-arrow-left, .lucide-external-link, .lucide-arrow-up-right, .lucide-download) {
            transition: translate var(--duration-base) var(--ease-standard);
        }

        /* A card marked hover-card answers as a whole: wherever the pointer rests on it, its way in leans forward. */
        :is(a, button):hover > .lucide-arrow-right,
        .hover-card:hover :is(a, button) > .lucide-arrow-right {
            translate: 0.1875rem 0;
        }

        :is(a, button):hover > .lucide-arrow-left {
            translate: -0.1875rem 0;
        }

        :is(a, button):hover > :is(.lucide-external-link, .lucide-arrow-up-right) {
            translate: 0.125rem -0.125rem;
        }

        :is(a, button):hover > .lucide-download {
            translate: 0 0.125rem;
        }
    }

    .journey-station {
        outline: none;
    }

/*
 * The design tokens. Every color is written once as light-dark(light, dark): the page follows the reader's system and
 * the theme button pins one (<html data-theme>, globals.css), so a component never names a theme. The interface is
 * monochrome, ink on paper or paper on ink; color lives in the layers (the tiles behind the illustrations, the
 * categories, the charts) and in one cobalt accent for small highlights. scripts/check-contrast.mjs reads both halves
 * of every pair below and holds text to WCAG AAA in each theme.
 */
@theme {
    --color-*: initial;

    /* Surfaces, from the page to the most raised layer, and their edges. */
    --color-bg: light-dark(oklch(0.99 0.002 250), oklch(0.16 0 0));
    --color-surface: light-dark(oklch(0.965 0.003 250), oklch(0.2 0 0));
    --color-surface-raised: light-dark(oklch(0.935 0.004 250), oklch(0.245 0 0));
    --color-border: light-dark(oklch(0.9 0.004 250), oklch(0.3 0 0));
    --color-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(0.6 0.008 250), oklch(0.56 0 0));

    /* Text, from headings to captions. */
    --color-fg: light-dark(oklch(0.2 0.006 260), oklch(0.97 0 0));
    --color-fg-muted: light-dark(oklch(0.37 0.008 260), oklch(0.84 0 0));
    --color-fg-subtle: light-dark(oklch(0.41 0.008 260), oklch(0.77 0 0));

    /* The action color is the ink itself: a primary button is an ink pill, a link darkens to ink. */
    --color-primary: light-dark(oklch(0.2 0.006 260), oklch(0.97 0 0));
    --color-primary-hover: light-dark(oklch(0.34 0.008 260), oklch(0.88 0 0));
    --color-on-primary: light-dark(oklch(0.99 0.002 250), oklch(0.16 0 0));
    /* One cobalt for what must stand out without shouting: the current item, a small mark, the focus ring. */
    --color-accent: light-dark(oklch(0.45 0.2 264), oklch(0.8 0.1 264));
    --color-ring: light-dark(oklch(0.55 0.2 264), oklch(0.72 0.14 264));
    --color-success: light-dark(oklch(0.42 0.1 152), oklch(0.8 0.15 155));
    --color-warning: light-dark(oklch(0.43 0.09 70), oklch(0.85 0.14 85));
    --color-danger: light-dark(oklch(0.45 0.16 27), oklch(0.77 0.15 25));

    /* Ink and paper that never swap: text on the fixed colors of the UN goal badges. */
    --color-ink: oklch(0.2 0.006 260);
    --color-paper: oklch(0.99 0.002 250);

    /* Categories in charts, such as the commit areas: cobalt first, then mint, amber, lilac and the neutrals. */
    --color-chart-1: light-dark(oklch(0.45 0.2 264), oklch(0.72 0.14 264));
    --color-chart-2: light-dark(oklch(0.58 0.11 170), oklch(0.78 0.12 170));

    --color-chart-4: light-dark(oklch(0.55 0.15 300), oklch(0.74 0.12 300));
    --color-chart-5: light-dark(oklch(0.62 0.01 250), oklch(0.7 0 0));
    --color-chart-6: light-dark(oklch(0.78 0.006 250), oklch(0.45 0 0));
    --color-whatsapp: #25d366;
    --color-on-whatsapp: oklch(0.16 0 0);

    /* Three voices from the original portfolio: DM Serif Text for headings, IBM Plex Sans for text, Source Code Pro for tools, dates and figures. */
    --font-sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Fallback", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
    --font-display: "DM Serif Text", "DM Serif Text Fallback", ui-serif, Georgia, serif;
    --font-mono: "Source Code Pro", "Source Code Pro Fallback", ui-monospace, monospace;

    --text-heading--line-height: 1.15;

    /* The smallest text that is read (dates, labels, chips) stays at 13px. */
    --text-xs: 0.8125rem;
    --text-xs--line-height: calc(1.125 / 0.8125);

    /* 72rem up to a 1440px viewport, then 80% of it, up to 96rem: wide screens get wider grids, not wider margins. */
    --container-page: clamp(72rem, 82vw, 96rem);

    --radius-sm: 0.5rem;

import type {ProfileKey, RoleId} from "@/content/roles";
import type {DetailCollection} from "@/content/shared/detail-links";
import type {ProjectSlug} from "@/content/shared/project-links";
import type {SectionId} from "@/types/content";

export type IntentId =
    | "greeting"
    | "about"
    | "salary"
    | "experienceYears"
    | "currentRole"
    | "company"
    | "roleFit"
    | "availability"
    | "location"
    | "education"
    | "program"
    | "plans"
    | "security"
    | "languages"
    | "projects"
    | "certifications"
    | "testimonials"
    | "resume"
    | "githubStats"
    | "organizations"
    | "coding"
    | "clients"
    | "industries"
    | "services"
    | "whyHire"
    | "workStyle"
    | "journey"
    | "leadership"
    | "ai"
    | "site"
    | "stack";

/** A page beyond the profile that a fact can link to: a project, or a job, program, certification or organization. */
export type FactPage = { collection: "projects"; slug: ProjectSlug } | { collection: DetailCollection; slug: string };

export interface Fact {
    id: string;
    section: SectionId;
    label: string;
    text: string;
    terms: string[];
    roles: RoleId[];
    /** Facts from a case study or a detail page link to that page instead of a section. */
    page?: FactPage;
}

export type AnswerLinkKind = "section" | "route" | "download" | "external";

export interface AnswerLink {
    kind: AnswerLinkKind;
    label: string;
    href: string;
}

export interface Answer {
    intents: (IntentId | "search" | "fallback")[];
    text: string;
    details: string[];
    links: AnswerLink[];
    /** Questions worth asking next, from the topic of this answer. */
    followUps: string[];
}

export interface CurrentJob {
    title: string;
    company: string;
}

export interface AnswerFacts {
    years: string;
    currentJobs: CurrentJob[];
    topStack: string[];
    certifications: number;
    issuers: number;
    testimonials: number;
    contributions: string;
    commits: string;
    repositories: number;
    organizations: number;
    streak: number;
    asOf: string;
    integrations: string;
    clients: string;
    landingPages: string;
    codingHours: string;
    topLanguages: string[];
    services: string[];
    pages: number;
}

export interface RoleFitFacts extends AnswerFacts {
    role: string;
    stack: string[];
    company: string;
    example: string;
}

export interface ProjectFacts extends AnswerFacts {
    name: string;
    summary: string;
}

export interface CompanyFacts extends AnswerFacts {
    company: string;
    title: string;
    period: string;
    summary: string;
}

export interface ProgramFacts extends AnswerFacts {
    degree: string;
    school: string;
    period: string;
    tagline: string;
}

export interface MatchFacts extends AnswerFacts {
    /** The certifications that match the question, by title. */
    titles: string[];
}

type AnswerCopy = (facts: AnswerFacts) => string;

/**
 * The intents with a plain answer: everything but the ones that need the matched role, project, job or program, and
 * the two told with the about text (how he works, and how he got here).
 */
export type PlainIntent = Exclude<IntentId, "roleFit" | "company" | "program" | "workStyle" | "journey">;

/** Where the follow-up questions come from: an intent, or the kind of thing the answer was about. */
export type FollowUpKey = IntentId | "project" | "search" | "fallback";

export interface AssistantCopy {
    title: string;
    subtitle: string;
    close: string;
    placeholder: string;
    send: string;
    inputLabel: string;
    you: string;
    assistant: string;
    welcome: string;
    suggestionsLabel: string;
    /** Quotes Sebastián's own first-person text inside an answer told in the third person. */
    inHisWords: (text: string) => string;
    /** The first questions offered, for each view. */
    suggestions: Record<ProfileKey, string[]>;
    /** The questions offered after an answer, by its topic. */
    followUps: Partial<Record<FollowUpKey, string[]>>;
    /** Every question the assistant knows how to answer, grouped by topic, behind a "more questions" toggle. */
    catalog: { open: string; close: string; groups: { title: string; questions: string[] }[] };
    links: Record<SectionId | "roleView" | "downloadCv" | "whatsapp" | "email", string>;
    /** Labels of the links to the indexes of the pages beyond the profile. */
    pages: Record<DetailCollection | "projects", string>;
    answers: Record<PlainIntent, AnswerCopy> & {
        roleFit: (facts: RoleFitFacts) => string;
        project: (facts: ProjectFacts) => string;
        company: (facts: CompanyFacts) => string;
        program: (facts: ProgramFacts) => string;
        certificationMatch: (facts: MatchFacts) => string;
        search: AnswerCopy;
        fallback: AnswerCopy;
    };
}

import type {YearMonth} from "@/types/content";

export type CaseStudyId = "integrationPlatform" | "smartpot" | "gopoli" | "martech" | "emailSignatures";

export interface CaseFigureFacts {
    id: string;
    value: number;
    /** Shown as "N+" because the real figure keeps growing past it. */
    atLeast?: boolean;
    unit?: "%";
}

export interface CaseImageFacts {
    id: string;
    /** Base path of the AVIF and WebP variants, without the width suffix. */
    base: string;
    widths: number[];
    width: number;
    height: number;
    /** Attribution the image needs, such as the map data under a screenshot. */
    credit?: { text: string; href: string };
    /** A screen of a private system redrawn with fictional data (assets-src/mockups), captioned as such. */
    recreation?: boolean;
}

export interface DiagramFacts {
