                                    <h2 class="mt-1 text-title text-fg">{benefit.title}</h2>
                                    <span class="mt-2 block max-w-[68ch] text-fg-muted">{benefit.description}</span>
                                    <span class="mt-4 block border-l-2 border-fg/20 pl-3 text-sm">
                                        <span class="block text-fg">“{benefit.evidence.excerpt}”</span>
                                        <span
                                            class="mt-1 block text-fg-subtle">{author.author} · {recommendations.items[author.id].role}</span>
                                    </span>
                                </span>
                            </Link>
                        </li>
                    );
                }}</For>
            </ol>
        </div>
    );
}

export function ReasonPage(props: { slug: string }) {
    // The route mounts a new page for every slug.
    // eslint-disable-next-line solid/reactivity
    const {slug} = props;
    const {content: {ui: siteUi}} = useLanguage();
    const {role, pathFor} = useRole();
    const {ui} = useDetailCopy();
    const copy = useSectionCopy("services");
    const recommendations = useSectionCopy("testimonials");
    const links = useLinks();
    const id = reasonBySlug(slug)!;
    const benefit = copy.benefits[id];
    const art = REASON_ART[id];
    const {facts, local, excerpt, quote, original} = useQuote(id);
    const work = benefitWork[id];
    const projectsHere = work.projects.map(projectById);
    const jobsHere = work.experience.map(experienceById);
    const programsHere = work.education.map(educationById);
    const services = servicesWithReason(id);
    const {previous, next} = neighbors(benefitOrder, benefitOrder.indexOf(id));
    const sections = [
        {id: "detail-quote", title: ui.sections.quote},
        {id: "detail-practice", title: ui.sections.practice},
        {id: "detail-projects", title: ui.sections.projects},
        ...(jobsHere.length > 0 ? [{id: "detail-jobs", title: ui.sections.jobs}] : []),
        ...(programsHere.length > 0 ? [{id: "detail-studies", title: ui.sections.studies}] : []),
        ...(services.length > 0 ? [{id: "detail-services", title: ui.sections.services}] : []),
    ];
    const reasonLink = (other: BenefitId) => ({
        to: links.detail("reasons", REASON_SLUG[other]),
        label: copy.benefits[other].title
    });

    return (
        <DetailArticle
            collection="reasons"
            title={benefit.title}
            subtitle={benefit.description}
            art={art}
            sections={sections}
            glance={
                <Glance items={[
                    {label: ui.facts.quotedBy, value: <span class="font-semibold">{facts.author}</span>},
                    {
                        label: ui.facts.relationship,
                        value: `${recommendations.relationships[facts.relationship]} · ${formatYearMonth(facts.date, siteUi.months)}`
                    },
                    ...(facts.experience
                        ? [{
                            label: ui.facts.company,
                            value: (
                                <Link to={links.detail("experience", EXPERIENCE_SLUG[facts.experience])}
                                      class="font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover">
                                    {experienceById(facts.experience).company.split(" – ")[0]}
                                </Link>
                            ),
                        }]
                        : []),
                ]}>
                    <p class="text-fg-muted">
                        {countOf(ui.counts.projects, projectsHere.length)} · {countOf(ui.counts.jobs, jobsHere.length)}
                        {programsHere.length > 0 && ` · ${countOf(ui.counts.programs, programsHere.length)}`}
                    </p>
                    <Link to={pathFor(role(), "contact")}
                          class="inline-flex min-h-11 w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 font-semibold text-on-primary transition-colors hover:bg-primary-hover">
                        {siteUi.actions.contact}
                        <ArrowRight class="size-4"/>
                    </Link>
                </Glance>
            }
            navigation={
                <NeighborNavigation
                    label={ui.all.reasons}
                    previous={reasonLink(previous)}
                    next={reasonLink(next)}
                    previousLabel={ui.actions.previous}
                    nextLabel={ui.actions.next}
                    all={{to: links.detail("reasons"), label: ui.all.reasons}}
                />
            }
        >
            <TextSection id="detail-quote" title={ui.sections.quote}>
                <figure class="max-w-[68ch]">
                    <blockquote class="text-xl leading-relaxed text-fg-muted" lang={original ? "es" : undefined}>
                        <p>“<Marked quote={quote} excerpt={excerpt} tile={art.tile}/>”</p>
                    </blockquote>
                    <figcaption class="mt-5 border-t border-border pt-4">
                        <p class="font-semibold text-fg">{facts.author}</p>
                        <p class="text-sm text-fg-muted">{local.role} · {local.context}</p>
                        <Show when={!original && recommendations.translatedNote}>
                            <p class="mt-1 text-xs text-fg-subtle">{recommendations.translatedNote}</p>
                        </Show>
                    </figcaption>
                </figure>
            </TextSection>
            <TextSection id="detail-practice" title={ui.sections.practice}>
                <p class="max-w-[68ch] text-lg text-fg">{benefit.practice}</p>
            </TextSection>
            <TextSection id="detail-projects" title={ui.sections.projects}>
                <ProjectTiles items={projectsHere}/>
            </TextSection>
            <Show when={jobsHere.length > 0}>
                <TextSection id="detail-jobs" title={ui.sections.jobs}>
                    <JobTiles items={jobsHere}/>
                </TextSection>
            </Show>
            <Show when={programsHere.length > 0}>
                <TextSection id="detail-studies" title={ui.sections.studies}>
                    <ProgramTiles items={programsHere}/>
                </TextSection>
            </Show>
            <Show when={services.length > 0}>
                <TextSection id="detail-services" title={ui.sections.services}>
                    <ArtRows items={services.map((service) => ({
                        key: service,
                        art: SERVICE_ART[service],
                        to: links.detail("services", SERVICE_SLUG[service]),
                        name: copy.items[service].title,
                        text: copy.items[service].tagline,
                    }))}/>
                </TextSection>
            </Show>
        </DetailArticle>
    );
}

/** Home, the projects index and, on a project, the project; the same trail the page's structured data declares. */
function ProjectCrumbs(props: { current?: string }) {
    const {lang, content} = useLanguage();
    const {role, locked, pathFor} = useRole();
    const {cases: {ui}} = useProjectsCopy();
    const items = () => {
        const home = {label: content.ui.home, to: pathFor(role(), "projects")};
        return props.current
            ? [home, {
                label: ui.indexTitle,
                to: buildProjectPath(lang, {locked: locked()})
            }, {label: props.current}]
            : [home, {label: ui.indexTitle}];
    };
    return <PageTrail label={ui.breadcrumb} items={items()}/>;
}

function ProjectLinks(props: { links: { demo?: string; code?: string }; privateLabel: string }) {
    const {cases: {ui}} = useProjectsCopy();
    return (
        <Show when={props.links.demo || props.links.code} fallback={
            <p class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-fg-subtle">
                <Lock class="size-4"/>
                {props.privateLabel}
            </p>
        }>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                <Show when={props.links.demo}>
                    <a
                        href={props.links.demo}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        class="inline-flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 font-semibold text-on-primary hover:bg-primary-hover"
                    >
                        <ExternalLink class="size-4"/>
                        {ui.liveDemo}
                    </a>
                </Show>
                <Show when={props.links.code}>
                    <a
                        href={props.links.code}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        class="inline-flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border-strong px-5 font-semibold text-fg hover:border-primary hover:text-primary"
                    >
                        <GithubIcon class="size-4"/>
                        {ui.viewCode}
                    </a>
                </Show>
            </div>
        </Show>
    );
}

/** The facts of a project as the header's table: role, place, period, team and status, then its links. */
function ProjectMeta(props: {
    facts: {
        start: CaseStudyFacts["start"];
        end?: CaseStudyFacts["end"];
        team?: number | null;
        links: { demo?: string; code?: string }
    };
    role: string;
    place: string;
    status: string;
}) {
    const {content} = useLanguage();
    const {cases: {ui}} = useProjectsCopy();
    const row = "grid grid-cols-[7.5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] gap-4 border-t border-border py-3 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0";
    return (
        <div class="grid content-start gap-6">
            <dl class="text-sm">
                <div class={row}>
                    <dt class="font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-fg-subtle">{ui.overview.role}</dt>
                    <dd class="text-fg">{props.role}</dd>
                </div>
                <div class={row}>
                    <dt class="font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-fg-subtle">{ui.overview.organization}</dt>
                    <dd class="text-fg">{props.place}</dd>
                </div>
                <div class={row}>
                    <dt class="font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-fg-subtle">{ui.overview.period}</dt>
                    <dd class="text-fg">{formatRange(props.facts.start, props.facts.end ?? null, content.ui.months, content.ui.present)}</dd>
                </div>
                <Show when={props.facts.team && props.facts.team > 1}>
                    <div class={row}>
                        <dt class="font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-fg-subtle">{ui.overview.team}</dt>
                        <dd class="text-fg">{props.facts.team} {ui.overview.people}</dd>
                    </div>
                </Show>
                <div class={row}>
                    <dt class="font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-fg-subtle">{ui.overview.status}</dt>
                    <dd class="text-fg">{props.status}</dd>
                </div>
            </dl>
            <ProjectLinks links={props.facts.links} privateLabel={ui.privateCode}/>
        </div>
    );
}

/**

/** A project title stays within two lines: phones get the heading size, and names past 48 characters keep it on wide
 * screens too, as the detail pages do with long certificate titles. */
const titleSize = (name: string) => (name.length > 48 ? "text-heading md:text-[3.5rem] md:leading-[1.02]" : "text-[2.75rem] leading-none tracking-[-0.045em] md:text-display");

/** The other projects of the same job or program, most relevant to the role view first. */
const siblingsOf = (facts: ProjectFacts) =>
    projects.filter((project) => project.id !== facts.id && (
        (facts.experience !== undefined && project.experience === facts.experience)
        || (facts.education !== undefined && project.education === facts.education)
    ));

const certificationsIn = (id: ProjectId) =>
    certifications.filter((item) => item.applied.some((ref) => ref.kind === "project" && ref.id === id));

const hasRelated = (id: ProjectId) => {
    const facts = projectById(id);
    return Boolean(facts.experience || facts.education || facts.organization) || certificationsIn(id).length > 0;
};

/** Where the project sits in the rest of the site: its job, program and organization pages, the certifications that
 * show in it and the other projects of the same job or program. */
function Related(props: { id: ProjectId; sectionId: string }) {
    const {lang, content} = useLanguage();
    const {locked} = useRole();
    const {pages} = useProjectsCopy();
    const cards = useSectionCopy("projects");
    const about = useSectionCopy("about");
    const ui = pages.ui.related;
    // The page mounts anew for every project, so the id is fixed for its life.
    // eslint-disable-next-line solid/reactivity
    const {id} = props;
    const facts = projectById(id);
    const detail = (collection: "experience" | "education" | "organizations" | "certifications", slug: string) =>
        buildDetailPath(lang, collection, {slug, locked: locked()});
    const job = experience.find((item) => item.id === facts.experience);
    const program = education.find((item) => item.id === facts.education);
    const organization = organizations.find((item) => item.id === facts.organization);
    const places = () => [
        ...(job ? [{
            key: job.id, to: detail("experience", EXPERIENCE_SLUG[job.id]), label: ui.experience, name: job.company,
            text: formatRange(job.start, job.end, content.ui.months, content.ui.present)
        }] : []),
        ...(program ? [{
            key: program.id, to: detail("education", EDUCATION_SLUG[program.id]), label: ui.program,
            name: about.education[program.id].degree, text: program.school
        }] : []),
        ...(organization ? [{
            key: organization.id, to: detail("organizations", ORGANIZATION_SLUG[organization.id]),
            label: ui.organization, name: organization.name
        }] : []),
    ];
    const certified = certificationsIn(id);
    const siblings = siblingsOf(facts);
    const place = job?.company ?? (program ? about.education[program.id].degree : "");

    return (
        <Show when={places().length > 0 || certified.length > 0}>
            <TextSection id={props.sectionId} title={ui.title}>
                <div class="space-y-10">
                    <Show when={places().length > 0}>
                        <div>
                            <h3 class="mb-4 font-semibold text-fg">{ui.places}</h3>
                            <LinkRows items={places()}/>
                        </div>
                    </Show>
                    <Show when={certified.length > 0}>
                        <div>
                            <h3 class="mb-4 font-semibold text-fg">{ui.certifications}</h3>
                            <LinkRows items={certified.map((item) => ({
                                key: item.id,
                                to: detail("certifications", CERTIFICATION_SLUG[item.id]),
                                label: `${formatYearMonth(item.date, content.ui.months)} · ${item.issuer}`,
                                name: item.title,
                            }))}/>
                        </div>
                    </Show>
                    <Show when={siblings.length > 0 && place}>
                        <div>
                            <h3 class="mb-4 font-semibold text-fg">{ui.siblings.replace("{place}", place)}</h3>
                            {/* Like the index: one card per view on phones, a grid from 48rem. */}
                            <Carousel
                                previousLabel={cards.slider.previous}
                                nextLabel={cards.slider.next}
                                slideClass="flex basis-[85%] sm:basis-[calc((100%-1.25rem)/2)] md:basis-auto"
                                trackClass="md:grid md:snap-none md:grid-cols-2 md:overflow-visible xl:grid-cols-3"
                                controlsClass="md:hidden"
                                items={siblings}
                            >
                                {(sibling) => (
                                    <ProjectTile
                                        id={sibling.id}
                                        name={cards.items[sibling.id].name}
                                        brief={cards.items[sibling.id].brief}
                                        href={buildProjectPath(lang, {
                                            slug: PROJECT_SLUG[sibling.id],
                                            locked: locked()
                                        })}
                                        headingLevel="h4"
                                    />
                                )}
                            </Carousel>
                        </div>
                    </Show>
                </div>
            </TextSection>
        </Show>
    );
}

/** The links under every project page: the projects before and after it in the list, and back to the index. */
function ProjectNavigation(props: { id: ProjectId }) {
    const {lang} = useLanguage();
    const {locked} = useRole();
    const {cases: {ui}, pages} = useProjectsCopy();
    const cards = useSectionCopy("projects");
    const index = () => projects.findIndex((project) => project.id === props.id);
    const previous = () => projects[(index() - 1 + projects.length) % projects.length];
    const next = () => projects[(index() + 1) % projects.length];
    const linkTo = (project: ProjectFacts) => ({
        to: buildProjectPath(lang, {slug: PROJECT_SLUG[project.id], locked: locked()}),
        label: cards.items[project.id].name,
    });

    return (
        <NeighborNavigation
            label={ui.allProjects}
            previous={linkTo(previous())}
            next={linkTo(next())}
            previousLabel={pages.ui.previous}
            nextLabel={pages.ui.next}
            all={{to: buildProjectPath(lang, {locked: locked()}), label: ui.allProjects}}
        />
    );
}

function RepositoryList(props: { entries: ArchiveEntry[]; note?: string }) {
    const {lang} = useLanguage();
    return (
        <>
            <Show when={props.note}>
                <p class="mb-6 text-fg-muted">{props.note}</p>
            </Show>
            <ul class="divide-y divide-border rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface">
                <For each={props.entries}>{(entry) => (
                    <li
                        class="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] gap-1 p-4 md:grid-cols-[4rem_minmax(0,1fr)_auto] md:items-baseline md:gap-4">
                        <span class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">{entry.year}</span>
                        <div>
                            {/* Name and organization wrap apart, so a long repository name never widens the page. */}
                            <p class="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2">
                                <a href={archiveUrl(entry)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" translate="no"
                                   class="font-semibold [overflow-wrap:anywhere] text-fg hover:text-primary">
                                    {entry.name}
                                </a>
                                <span translate="no" class="text-xs text-fg-subtle">{entry.org}</span>
                            </p>
                            <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-fg-muted">{entry.note[lang]}</p>
                        </div>
                        <span translate="no"
                              class="font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle md:text-right">{entry.stack}</span>
                    </li>
                )}</For>
            </ul>
        </>
    );
}

function CaseStudy(props: { slug: ProjectSlug }) {
    const {role} = useRole();
    const {content} = useLanguage();
    const {cases: {ui, items}, pages} = useProjectsCopy();
    // The route mounts a new page for every slug.
    // eslint-disable-next-line solid/reactivity
    const {slug} = props;
    const id = projectIdBySlug(slug) as CaseStudyFacts["id"];
    const facts = caseStudyById(id);
    const copy = items[id];
    const related = hasRelated(id);
    const sections = [
        {id: "case-problem", title: ui.sections.problem},
        {id: "case-constraints", title: ui.sections.constraints},
        {id: "case-approach", title: ui.sections.approach},
        {id: "case-architecture", title: ui.sections.architecture},
        {id: "case-decisions", title: ui.sections.decisions},
        {id: "case-results", title: ui.sections.results},
        ...(copy.next.length > 0 ? [{id: "case-next", title: ui.sections.next}] : []),
        {id: "case-stack", title: ui.sections.stack},
        ...(related ? [{id: "case-related", title: pages.ui.related.title}] : []),
    ];

    return (
        // A case study reads like an article: past 80rem the text and its side column keep their width instead of drifting apart.
        <article class="container-page py-12 md:py-16 xl:max-w-[80rem]">
            <ProjectCrumbs current={copy.name}/>
            <ProjectHeader id={id} eyebrow={ui.eyebrow} name={copy.name} tagline={copy.tagline} summary={copy.summary}
                           meta={<ProjectMeta facts={facts} role={copy.role} place={copy.organization}
                                              status={copy.status}/>}/>

            {/* On wide screens the figures and the page index sit beside the text instead of above it. */}
            <div class="mt-10 xl:grid xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem] xl:gap-x-16">
                <aside aria-label={ui.atAGlance} class="xl:col-start-2 xl:row-start-1">
                    <Show when={facts.figures.length > 0}>
                        <CaseFigures figures={facts.figures} labels={copy.figures} locale={content.locale} compact
                                     class="content-start sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-1"/>
                    </Show>
                    <PageIndex label={ui.onThisPage} sections={sections}/>
                </aside>

                <div class="xl:col-start-1 xl:row-start-1 xl:[&>:first-child]:mt-0">
                    <Show when={facts.images.length > 0}>
                        <section aria-label={ui.sections.screens} class="mt-12">
                            <CaseImages images={facts.images} phoneImages={facts.phoneImages} alts={copy.images}
                                        recreationLabel={ui.recreation}
                                        enlargeLabel={ui.enlarge}/>
                        </section>
                    </Show>

                    <div class="mt-12 max-w-4xl space-y-12">
                        <TextSection id="case-problem" title={ui.sections.problem}>
                            <div class="max-w-[68ch] space-y-4 text-lg text-fg-muted">
                                <For each={copy.problem}>{(paragraph) => <p>{paragraph}</p>}</For>
                            </div>
                        </TextSection>
                        <TextSection id="case-constraints" title={ui.sections.constraints}>
                            <Bullets items={copy.constraints}/>
                        </TextSection>
                        <TextSection id="case-approach" title={ui.sections.approach}>
                            <Bullets items={copy.approach}/>
                        </TextSection>
                    </div>

                    <section aria-labelledby="case-architecture" class="mt-12 border-t border-border pt-10">
                        <h2 id="case-architecture" class="text-heading text-fg">{ui.sections.architecture}</h2>
                        <div class="mt-6">
                            <LayeredDiagram diagram={facts.diagram} labels={copy.diagram.labels}
                                            title={copy.diagram.title} caption={copy.diagram.caption}/>
                        </div>
                    </section>

                    <div class="mt-12 max-w-4xl space-y-12">
                        <TextSection id="case-decisions" title={ui.sections.decisions}>
                            <Decisions items={copy.decisions} labels={ui.decisionLabels} tile={PROJECT_ART[id].tile}/>
                        </TextSection>
                        <TextSection id="case-results" title={ui.sections.results}>
                            <Bullets items={copy.results}/>
                        </TextSection>
                        <Show when={copy.next.length > 0}>
                            <TextSection id="case-next" title={ui.sections.next}>
                                <Bullets items={copy.next}/>
                            </TextSection>
                        </Show>
                        <TextSection id="case-stack" title={ui.sections.stack}>
                            <TechExplorer tech={facts.tech} role={role()} exclude={id}/>
                        </TextSection>
                        <Related id={id} sectionId="case-related"/>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <ProjectNavigation id={id}/>
        </article>
    );
}

const repositoriesOf = (facts: ProjectFacts) => {
    if (!facts.repositories) return [];
    const {org, only, except} = facts.repositories;
    return archiveOf(org).filter((entry) => (!only || only.includes(entry.name)) && !except?.includes(entry.name));
};

/** A project without a full case study: what it is, what it does, how it works, its decisions and its repositories. */
function ProjectPage(props: { slug: ProjectSlug }) {
    const {role} = useRole();
    const {content} = useLanguage();
    const {cases: {ui}, pages} = useProjectsCopy();
    const cards = useSectionCopy("projects");
    // The route mounts a new page for every slug.
    // eslint-disable-next-line solid/reactivity
    const {slug} = props;
    const id = projectIdBySlug(slug) as ProjectPageId;
    const facts = projectById(id);
    const card = cards.items[id];
    const page = pages.items[id];
    const repositories = repositoriesOf(facts);
    const related = hasRelated(id);
    const sections = [
        {id: "project-overview", title: pages.ui.overview},
        {id: "project-what", title: pages.ui.whatItDoes},
        ...(facts.diagram && page.diagram ? [{id: "project-architecture", title: pages.ui.howItWorks}] : []),
        ...(page.decisions.length > 0 ? [{id: "project-decisions", title: pages.ui.decisions}] : []),
        ...(repositories.length > 0 ? [{id: "project-repositories", title: pages.ui.repositories}] : []),
        {id: "project-stack", title: pages.ui.stack},
        ...(related ? [{id: "project-related", title: pages.ui.related.title}] : []),
    ];

    return (
        <article class="container-page py-12 md:py-16 xl:max-w-[80rem]">
            <ProjectCrumbs current={card.name}/>
            <ProjectHeader id={id} eyebrow={pages.ui.eyebrow[facts.category]} name={card.name} tagline={page.tagline}
                           summary={card.summary}
                           meta={<ProjectMeta facts={facts} role={page.role} place={card.context}
                                              status={page.status}/>}/>

            <div class="mt-10 xl:grid xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem] xl:gap-x-16">
                <aside aria-label={ui.atAGlance} class="xl:col-start-2 xl:row-start-1">
                    <Show when={facts.figures && facts.figures.length > 0 && facts.figures}>
                        {(figures) => (
                            <CaseFigures figures={figures()} labels={page.figures} locale={content.locale} compact
                                         class="content-start sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-1"/>
                        )}
                    </Show>
                    <PageIndex label={ui.onThisPage} sections={sections}/>
                </aside>

                <div class="xl:col-start-1 xl:row-start-1 xl:[&>:first-child]:mt-0">
                    <Show when={facts.images && facts.images.length > 0 && facts.images}>
                        {(images) => (
                            <section aria-label={pages.ui.screens} class="mt-12">
                                <CaseImages images={images()} alts={page.images} recreationLabel={ui.recreation}
                                            enlargeLabel={ui.enlarge}/>
                            </section>
                        )}
                    </Show>

                    <div class="mt-12 max-w-4xl space-y-12">
                        <TextSection id="project-overview" title={pages.ui.overview}>
                            <div class="max-w-[68ch] space-y-4 text-lg text-fg-muted">
                                <For each={page.overview}>{(paragraph) => <p>{paragraph}</p>}</For>
                            </div>
                        </TextSection>
                        <TextSection id="project-what" title={pages.ui.whatItDoes}>
                            <ul class="space-y-3 text-fg-muted">
                                <For each={card.highlights}>{(bullet) => {
                                    const match = () => {
                                        const current = role();
                                        return current !== null && bullet.roles.includes(current);
                                    };
                                    return (
                                        <li class={cn("flex gap-3", match() && "text-fg")}>
                                            <span aria-hidden="true"
                                                  class={cn("mt-2.5 size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full", role() && !match() ? "border border-fg-subtle" : "bg-fg")}/>
                                            {bullet.text}
                                        </li>
                                    );
                                }}</For>
                            </ul>
                        </TextSection>
                    </div>

                    <Show when={facts.diagram && page.diagram ? {facts: facts.diagram, copy: page.diagram} : undefined}>
                        {(diagram) => (
                            <section aria-labelledby="project-architecture" class="mt-12 border-t border-border pt-10">
                                <h2 id="project-architecture" class="text-heading text-fg">{pages.ui.howItWorks}</h2>
                                <div class="mt-6">
                                    <LayeredDiagram diagram={diagram().facts} labels={diagram().copy.labels}
                                                    title={diagram().copy.title} caption={diagram().copy.caption}/>
                                </div>
                            </section>
                        )}
                    </Show>

                    <div class="mt-12 max-w-4xl space-y-12">
                        <Show when={page.decisions.length > 0}>
                            <TextSection id="project-decisions" title={pages.ui.decisions}>
                                <Decisions items={page.decisions} labels={ui.decisionLabels}
                                           tile={PROJECT_ART[id].tile}/>
                            </TextSection>
                        </Show>
                        <Show when={repositories.length > 0 && facts.repositories}>
                            {(source) => (
                                <TextSection id="project-repositories" title={pages.ui.repositories}>
                                    <RepositoryList entries={repositories} note={pages.ui.repositoriesNote}/>
                                    <a
                                        href={archiveOrgUrl(source().org)}
                                        target="_blank"
                                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                        class="mt-4 inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary-hover"
                                    >
                                        <GithubIcon class="size-4"/>
                                        {pages.ui.organization}: {source().org}
                                    </a>
                                </TextSection>
                            )}
                        </Show>
                        <TextSection id="project-stack" title={pages.ui.stack}>
                            <TechExplorer tech={facts.tech} role={role()} exclude={id}/>
                        </TextSection>
                        <Related id={id} sectionId="project-related"/>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <ProjectNavigation id={id}/>
        </article>
    );
}

const newestFirst = [...archive].sort((a, b) => b.year - a.year);
const archiveOrgs = [...new Set(newestFirst.map((entry) => entry.org))];

/** Every archived repository, newest first, with a filter by the organization that holds it. */
function Archive() {
    const {cases: {ui}, pages} = useProjectsCopy();
    const interactive = useHydrated();
    const [org, setOrg] = createSignal<ArchiveOrg | null>(null);
    const shown = createMemo(() => {
        const current = org();
        return current ? newestFirst.filter((entry) => entry.org === current) : newestFirst;
    });

    return (
        <section aria-labelledby="archive" class="mt-16">
            <div class="flex items-baseline gap-3">
                <h2 id="archive" class="text-heading text-fg">{ui.archiveTitle}</h2>
                <span class="font-mono text-base text-fg-subtle">{archive.length}</span>
            </div>
            <p class="mt-2 text-fg-muted">{ui.archiveSubtitle}</p>
            <div role="group" aria-label={pages.ui.archiveFilter} data-interactive={interactive() || undefined}
                 class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <For each={[null, ...archiveOrgs]}>
                    {(value) => (
                        <ToggleButton pressed={org() === value} onClick={() => setOrg(value)}
                                      count={value ? archiveOf(value).length : archive.length}>
                            <span translate={value ? "no" : undefined}>{value ?? pages.ui.archiveAll}</span>
                        </ToggleButton>
                    )}
                </For>
            </div>
            <div class="mt-6">
                <RepositoryList entries={shown()}/>
            </div>
        </section>
    );
}

function ProjectsIndex() {
    const {lang} = useLanguage();
    const {locked} = useRole();
    const {cases: {ui}} = useProjectsCopy();
    const cards = useSectionCopy("projects");
    return (
        <div class="container-page py-12 md:py-16">
            <ProjectCrumbs/>
            <header class="mt-10 max-w-4xl md:mt-14">
                <h1 class="text-display text-fg">{ui.indexTitle}</h1>
                <p class="mt-6 text-lg text-fg-muted md:text-xl">{ui.indexSubtitle}</p>
            </header>

            <For each={PROJECT_CATEGORIES}>{(category, categoryIndex) => (
                <section aria-labelledby={`projects-${category}`} class="mt-20">
                    <div class="flex items-baseline gap-3">
                        <h2 id={`projects-${category}`}
                            class="text-heading text-fg">{cards.categories[category].label}</h2>
                        <span class="font-mono text-base text-fg-subtle">{projectsIn(category).length}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p class="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-fg-muted">{cards.categories[category].description}</p>
                    {/* Like the home page: two tiles a row on a phone, three on a desktop, four on a wide screen. */}
                    <ul class="enter-each mt-8 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3 lg:gap-5 2xl:grid-cols-4">
                        <For each={projectsIn(category)}>{(project, index) => (
                            <li>
                                <ProjectTile
                                    id={project.id}
                                    name={cards.items[project.id].name}
                                    brief={cards.items[project.id].brief}
                                    href={buildProjectPath(lang, {slug: PROJECT_SLUG[project.id], locked: locked()})}
                                    tag={projectYears(project.id)}
                                    headingLevel="h3"
                                    eager={categoryIndex() === 0 && index() < 4}
                                />
                            </li>
                        )}</For>
                    </ul>
                </section>
            )}</For>

            <Archive/>
        </div>
    );
}

// Keyed by slug: moving to the next project on the client starts its filters and picks fresh instead of keeping
// the ones of the page before, whose lists may have a different length.
export function ProjectBody(props: { slug: ProjectSlug | null }): JSX.Element {
    return (
        <Switch fallback={<ProjectsIndex/>}>
            <Match when={props.slug && isCaseStudy(projectIdBySlug(props.slug)) && props.slug} keyed>
                {(slug) => <CaseStudy slug={slug}/>}
            </Match>
            <Match when={props.slug} keyed>
                {(slug) => <ProjectPage slug={slug}/>}
            </Match>
        </Switch>
    );
}

import {createMemo, For, Show} from "solid-js";
import {ArrowRight, Check} from "@/components/ui/icons";

// The pages of the technical skills: every group of tools with an index and a page of its own, which says what I aim
// at with it, what it is, what it is good for, and where it shows in the projects, the jobs, the studies and the
// services.

/** How many tools the index names under each group; its page lists them all. */
const NAMED = 5;

/** The role views that list a group among their first four, the ones it matters most to. */
const rolesOf = (id: SkillGroupId) => ROLE_IDS.filter((role) => roleConfig(role).skillGroupOrder.indexOf(id) < 4);

/** A group's tools as chips; in a role view its own come first and stand out. */
function ToolChips(props: { items: readonly string[] }) {
    const {role} = useRole();
    return (
        <ul translate="no" class="enter-each flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            <For each={orderTech(props.items, role())}>{(item) => (
                <li class={cn(
                    "rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-mono text-sm",
                    !role() || isFocusTech(item, role()) ? "bg-surface-raised text-fg" : "text-fg-subtle ring-1 ring-border ring-inset",
                )}>
                    {item}
                </li>
            )}</For>
        </ul>
    );
}

/** Every group by its object, its name, its line and its first tools; each leads to its page. */
export function SkillsIndex() {
    const {role} = useRole();
    const {ui} = useDetailCopy();
    const skills = useSectionCopy("skills");
    const links = useLinks();
    const ordered = createMemo(() => orderSkillGroups(SKILL_IDS.map(skillGroupById), role()));

    return (
        <div class="container-page py-12 md:py-16">
            <IndexHeader collection="skills"/>
            <ul class="enter-each mt-14 grid gap-x-12 gap-y-12 md:grid-cols-2">
                <For each={ordered()}>{(group) => (
                    <li>
                        <Link to={links.detail("skills", SKILL_SLUG[group.id])}
                              class="service-entry group grid grid-cols-[6rem_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-5 sm:grid-cols-[8rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-7">
                            <span aria-hidden="true"
                                  class="service-icon grid aspect-square place-items-center rounded-3xl"
                                  style={{background: `var(--color-tile-${SKILL_ART[group.id].tile})`}}>
                                <img src={withBase(SKILL_ART[group.id].file)} alt="" width={128} height={128}
                                     loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="w-[78%]"/>
                            </span>
                            <span class="min-w-0">
                                <span class="block font-mono text-xs text-fg-subtle">
                                    {skills.count.replace("{count}", String(group.items.length))}
                                </span>
                                <h2 class="mt-2 text-title text-fg">{skills.groups[group.id]}</h2>
                                <span class="mt-1 block text-lg text-fg">{skills.taglines[group.id]}</span>
                                <span translate="no" class="mt-2 block font-mono text-sm text-fg-muted">
                                    {orderTech(group.items, role()).slice(0, NAMED).join(" · ")}
                                </span>
                                <span class="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-fg">
                                    {ui.actions.readPage}
                                    <ArrowRight class="service-arrow size-4"/>
                                </span>
                            </span>
                        </Link>
                    </li>
                )}</For>
            </ul>
        </div>
    );
}

export function SkillPage(props: { slug: string }) {
    // The route mounts a new page for every slug.
    // eslint-disable-next-line solid/reactivity
    const {slug} = props;
    const {content: {ui: siteUi}} = useLanguage();
    const {role, pathFor} = useRole();
    const {ui, skills: pages} = useDetailCopy();
    const skills = useSectionCopy("skills");
    const services = useSectionCopy("services");
    const jobs = useSectionCopy("experience");
    const links = useLinks();
    const id = skillBySlug(slug)!;
    const group = skillGroupById(id);
    const page = pages[id];
    const art = SKILL_ART[id];
    const work = skillWork[id];
    const projectsHere = work.projects.map(projectById);
    const jobsHere = work.experience.map(experienceById);
    const programsHere = work.education.map(educationById);
    const certificationsHere = work.certifications.map(certificationById);
    const roles = rolesOf(id);
    const {previous, next} = neighbors(SKILL_IDS, SKILL_IDS.indexOf(id));
    const studied = programsHere.length + certificationsHere.length > 0;
    const sections = [
        {id: "detail-focus", title: ui.sections.focus},
        {id: "detail-description", title: ui.sections.description},
        {id: "detail-uses", title: ui.sections.uses},
        {id: "detail-tools", title: ui.sections.tools},
        {id: "detail-projects", title: ui.sections.projects},
        ...(jobsHere.length > 0 ? [{id: "detail-jobs", title: ui.sections.jobs}] : []),
        ...(studied ? [{id: "detail-education", title: ui.sections.education}] : []),
        {id: "detail-services", title: ui.sections.services},
    ];
    const skillLink = (other: SkillGroupId) => ({
        to: links.detail("skills", SKILL_SLUG[other]),
        label: skills.groups[other]
    });

    return (
        <DetailArticle
            collection="skills"
            title={skills.groups[id]}
            subtitle={skills.taglines[id]}
            art={art}
            sections={sections}
            glance={
                <Glance items={[
                    {label: ui.facts.tools, value: skills.count.replace("{count}", String(group.items.length))},
                    ...(roles.length > 0
                        ? [{label: ui.facts.roles, value: roles.map((item) => siteUi.roleNames[item]).join(" · ")}]
                        : []),
                ]}>
                    <p class="text-fg-muted">
                        {countOf(ui.counts.projects, projectsHere.length)}
                        {jobsHere.length > 0 && ` · ${countOf(ui.counts.jobs, jobsHere.length)}`}
                        {programsHere.length > 0 && ` · ${countOf(ui.counts.programs, programsHere.length)}`}
                    </p>
                    <Link to={pathFor(role(), "contact")}
                          class="inline-flex min-h-11 w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 font-semibold text-on-primary transition-colors hover:bg-primary-hover">
                        {ui.actions.talkSkill}
                        <ArrowRight class="size-4"/>
                    </Link>
                </Glance>
            }
            navigation={
                <NeighborNavigation
                    label={ui.all.skills}
                    previous={skillLink(previous)}
                    next={skillLink(next)}
                    previousLabel={ui.actions.previous}
                    nextLabel={ui.actions.next}
                    all={{to: links.detail("skills"), label: ui.all.skills}}
                />
            }
        >
            <TextSection id="detail-focus" title={ui.sections.focus}>
                <p class="max-w-[68ch] border-l-2 pl-5 text-xl leading-relaxed text-fg"
                   style={{"border-color": `var(--color-tile-${art.tile})`}}>
                    {page.focus}
                </p>
            </TextSection>
            <TextSection id="detail-description" title={ui.sections.description}>
                <div class="max-w-[68ch] space-y-4 text-lg text-fg-muted">
                    <For each={page.description}>{(paragraph) => <p>{paragraph}</p>}</For>
                </div>
            </TextSection>
            <TextSection id="detail-uses" title={ui.sections.uses}>
                <ul class="enter-each grid gap-x-8 gap-y-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <For each={page.uses}>{(use) => (
                        <li class="flex gap-3 text-fg">
                            <span aria-hidden="true"
                                  class="mt-0.5 grid size-6 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full"
                                  style={{background: `var(--color-tile-${art.tile})`}}>
                                <Check class="size-3.5"/>
                            </span>
                            {use}
                        </li>
                    )}</For>
                </ul>
            </TextSection>
            <TextSection id="detail-tools" title={ui.sections.tools}>
                <ToolChips items={group.items}/>
            </TextSection>
            <TextSection id="detail-projects" title={ui.sections.projects}>
                <ProjectTiles items={projectsHere}/>
            </TextSection>
            <Show when={jobsHere.length > 0}>
                <TextSection id="detail-jobs" title={ui.sections.jobs}>
                    {/* Each job names the tools of this group it used, or its title when the group is a practice. */}
                    <TileGrid>
                        <For each={jobsHere}>{(job) => {
                            const used = toolsOfGroupIn(id, job.tech);
                            return (
                                <li>
                                    <ArtTile art={EXPERIENCE_ART[job.id]} name={job.company.split(" – ")[0]}
                                             brief={used.length > 0 ? used.slice(0, 4).join(" · ") : jobs.items[job.id].title.split(" · ")[0]}
                                             href={links.detail("experience", EXPERIENCE_SLUG[job.id])}/>
                                </li>
                            );
                        }}</For>
                    </TileGrid>
                </TextSection>
            </Show>
            <Show when={studied}>
                <TextSection id="detail-education" title={ui.sections.education}>
                    <Show when={programsHere.length > 0}>
                        <ProgramTiles items={programsHere}/>
                    </Show>
                    <Show when={certificationsHere.length > 0}>
                        <div class={programsHere.length > 0 ? "mt-6" : undefined}>
                            <LinkRows
                                items={certificationsHere.map((certification) => ({
                                    key: certification.id,
                                    to: links.detail("certifications", CERTIFICATION_SLUG[certification.id]),
                                    label: `${formatYearMonth(certification.date, siteUi.months)} · ${certification.issuer}`,
                                    name: certification.title,
                                }))}
                            />
                        </div>
                    </Show>
                </TextSection>
            </Show>
            <TextSection id="detail-services" title={ui.sections.services}>
                <ArtRows items={work.services.map((service) => ({
                    key: service,
                    art: SERVICE_ART[service],
                    to: links.detail("services", SERVICE_SLUG[service]),
                    name: services.items[service].title,
                    text: services.items[service].tagline,
                }))}/>
            </TextSection>
        </DetailArticle>
    );
}

---
name: modern-web-guidance
description: |
  Search tool for modern web development best practices. MANDATORY: Execute FIRST for all HTML/CSS and clientside JS tasks. Do NOT skip — web APIs evolve rapidly and training weights contain obsolete patterns.
  Trigger immediately for: modals/dialogs/popovers, tables, dark mode, anchor positioning, container queries, view transitions, scroll-driven animations, parallax/reveals, forms, validation, autofill, accessibility, custom selects, scrollbars, CWV (LCP, INP, CLS), content-visibility, fetch priority, image optimization, security, passkeys, HTML sanitization, web components, dates/timezones, built-in AI, WebAssembly, standard HTML/CSS/DOM in frameworks, etc.
  DO NOT trigger for: backend (SQL, ORMs, API routes), infra/scripts (CI/CD, Docker, Actions, Python/Go, Git), or tooling/trivial (Vite, tsconfig, ESLint, tests, copy/renames, 3P docs), etc.
---

# Modern Web Guidance

Search and retrieve standardized modern web best practices at the **start** of implementing or updating any web UI, CSS
layout/animation, or client-side JS logic (dates/timezones, sanitization, performance, accessibility, UX fixes) before
writing ad-hoc solutions or adding dependencies.

## Primary Workflow

### Step 1. Search Use Cases

Run `modern-web-guidance` directly with `npx` using a **2–5 word action-oriented English query** for a **single web
platform capability or UI pattern**:

- **Keep queries focused and generic**: Describe the user-visible capability (`<verb> + <UI/platform object>`,
  optionally paired with the target HTML/CSS/JS feature name if known). Omit framework/library names (`React`, `Vue`,
  `Tailwind`, etc.) and app/domain nouns (product, route, or component/file names). Split multi-feature tasks into
  separate `search` calls.
- **Name implied UI primitives**: When the user's prompt expresses intent without naming the UI primitive (e.g. "confirm
  first", "delete with confirmation", "pick a date"), translate the domain intent into the implied UI component or
  platform mechanism (e.g. search `"confirmation modal dialog"` or `"confirm dialog"` rather than
  `"confirm destructive action"`, or `"date picker input"` rather than `"pick a date"`).
- **Example**: Search `"light dismiss dialog"` or `"responsive data table"`, **not** `"dialog"` (too terse),
  `"responsive table dark mode"` (compound — split into two searches), or
  `"close React settings modal on outside click"` (framework/app noise).

```sh
npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "<query>" --skill-version 2026_11_10-47b4c80e
```

> **Note**: Returns `[{ "id", "description" }, ...]`. Judge results by their `description` fields:
> - **Match found**: Call `retrieve` directly—do not also run `list`.
> - **Weak or empty results**: If `search` returns `[]` or unrelated descriptions, **rephrase `search` once** using the
    concrete HTML/CSS/UI component noun or synonym (e.g., `dialog`, `modal`, `popover`, `table`, `form`) before falling
    back to `list` (or use `list` once for broad UI audits).
> - **Topic not covered**: If no `description` matches after rephrasing, proceed without retrieving unrelated guides.

### Step 2. Retrieve Best Practices

Once you have relevant `id`(s) from the search results, call `retrieve` to get the full guide(s)—including both specific
use-case guides that match your task and any broader discipline guide (e.g., `html`, `css`, `forms`, `accessibility`,
`color`, `performance`, `security`) that applies. You can pass multiple IDs separated by commas.

```sh
npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve "<id>"
```

If `retrieve` saves large output (> 9.5 KB) to a temporary file to prevent truncation, read that file path in full using
your file-reading tool (reading remaining line ranges if needed)—do not use `cat` or `head`.

### Step 3. Verify Guidance Compliance

When generating or modifying code, cross-check the implementation against the retrieved guide before concluding:

- **Applicable Guidance & Fallbacks**: Ensure the relevant modern patterns and necessary fallback strategies from the
  guide are correctly applied, without forcing unrequested features.
- **Task Fulfillment**: Confirm that the implementation fully satisfies the user's request.
- Do not run `legacy-scan`; it's for detecting legacy patterns to modernize, not this.

### Step 4. Disclose Skill Usage

When you consult `modern-web-guidance` for a task, end the response where you deliver those changes with a
`### Modern Web Guidance` section:

- **When retrieved guides shaped your code**: Write **one** bullet (1–2 sentences, ≤75 words) per newly applied `<id>`
  in first-person voice explaining the non-obvious implementation choices, CSS/API overrides, or fallbacks `<id>`
  required and the pitfall it prevented, anchored by a short verbatim quote of that specific rule or gotcha (never the
  guide's intro overview):
  `- **\`<id>\`**: <Non-obvious APIs, overrides, or fallbacks applied and the pitfall
  prevented> ("<short verbatim quote of the specific rule or gotcha>").`
    - **Never** guess `<id>`s or quotes from memory after context compaction (re-run `search`/`retrieve` if needed), and
      credit **only** guide-backed changes from the current turn.
- **When searched/listed in this turn but zero guides applied**: Write one first-person sentence naming which topics or
  guides you checked in `modern-web-guidance` and why none applied (omit if any guide applied).

## Alternative flow: Modernize an existing codebase

**Only** when asked for a broad, open-ended codebase modernization or legacy-pattern scan where no specific target
feature or component is named (do **not** run `legacy-scan` when asked to add, update, fix, or audit a specific feature
or component), run the 4-step modernization flow:

> **Note**: `legacy-scan` scans for a curated subset (~20% of the guidance corpus).

```sh
npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan <path> --json
```

1. Scan: Run `legacy-scan <path> --json` to detect legacy web platform patterns across the project or directory.
2. Verify: Check each finding against its `keepWhen` / `dropWhen` rubric; drop false positives (fallbacks, cross-file
   helpers, vendor code, lookalikes).
3. Report: Summarize verified findings (and the modernization plan, if editing) for the user, noting that `legacy-scan`
   only checks the subset of guides (~20% of the catalog) that have deterministic legacy rules.
4. Modernize (when the user asked to modernize rather than only audit/report): Retrieve each finding's guide (
   `retrieve "<guide-id>"` via Step 2), apply the replacement (keeping existing libraries as fallbacks where the guide
   requires one), and re-run `legacy-scan <path>` on the modified files to confirm resolution.
    - Dropped findings and kept fallbacks still match static scans; do not edit safe code or inspect `legacy-scan.mjs`
      to force 0 findings.

## Using npx / pnpx

- **Runner & Permissions**: Prefer `pnpx` over `npx` if `pnpm` is available (`pnpx` does not use `-y`); on Windows, use
  `npx.cmd`. When requesting tool permissions, allowlist `npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest *` (or
  `pnpx modern-web-guidance@latest *`) specifically, never bare `npx *` or `pnpx *`.
- **Sandboxes & Network**: Fetching `modern-web-guidance` requires outbound network access. In sandboxed or
  approval-gated environments (e.g., Codex, Claude Code), **proactively request approval/allowlisting with network
  access BEFORE the first execution** to avoid timeouts, and set `NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/npm-cache` if `~/.npm` is
  read-only.
- **Offline**: If the command hangs due to being offline, retry with `npx --offline …`.

## Guidelines

- Always search **first** to find the most relevant guides. Do not hallucinate guides or ignore them; they represent the
  preferred local standard for the user's project.
- These guides use vanilla HTML/CSS/JS; adapt them to your framework without dropping the modern feature:
    - **Types**: Spread/cast newly shipped HTML attributes (
      `{...({ popover: 'hint', interestfor: id, commandfor: id, switch: '' } as any)}`, `[attr.*]`) rather than removing
      them or merging `@types/react`.
    - **SSR & Bundlers**: Guard `window`/`HTMLElement` in SSR and load polyfills via bare `import('<pkg>')` in client
      effects (or set Vite `build.target: 'esnext'` for top-level `await`)—never copy files from `node_modules`.
    - **DOM, IDs & CSS**: Call `showModal()`/`moveBefore()` via refs on non-VDOM-managed nodes, generate per-instance
      IDs/`anchor-name`s (`useId()`), and keep `:root` and `@starting-style` top-level/unscoped.

## Interpreting Browser Support & Fallbacks

* **Default Behavior**: All guides assume **Baseline Widely available** features are safe to use without fallbacks. For
  features that are not Baseline widely available, you **MUST** follow the fallback recommendations in the guide, unless
  the user has specified a custom browser support policy.
* **Custom Policies**: If the user defines explicit browser support requirements, use the guide's compatibility data to
  determine if a fallback can be ignored (for `Baseline YYYY` targets, a feature satisfies the target if its "Baseline
  since" date is `<= YYYY`). Examples: _"Do not implement feature fallbacks"_, _"Safari 17.4+"_, _"Never implement
  polyfills; use a lightweight custom fallback or redesign"_, or _"Allow Newly Available features if feature-detected
  with graceful degradation"_.
* **Reactive Policy Discovery**: Suggest documenting a policy in `AGENTS.md` or `CLAUDE.md` (e.g.,
  `**Browser Support:** Allow Newly Available features, but only adopt custom fallback code that adds <= 20 lines and no external dependencies`)
  if the developer targets a restricted runtime (Electron/Tauri), excludes specific browsers, hesitates over polyfill
  size/complexity, or asks if a feature is safe without fallbacks.

# Accessibility Coding Guidelines

This guide provides actionable DOs and DON'Ts for AI coding agents to ensure web applications are accessible to all
users, including those using assistive technologies.

Keep these principles in mind throughout:

- **Accessibility is the minimum, not the ceiling.** Conformance to standards is the floor; aim for genuine usability.
- **Patterns are use-case specific.** No checklist replaces real testing — including testing with disabled users — to
  confirm a given implementation is actually accessible in context.
